example: My little cousin was a bundle of nerves on his first school morning, clutching his new lunchbox like a life raft.

term: burn a hole in your pocket
hindi: जेब में पैसा न टिकना — मिलते ही उड़ा देना
definition: money that tempts quick spending, spent freely and lavishly soon after payday arrives
example: The birthday cash burned a hole in his pocket, and by evening he owned a secondhand guitar.

hindi: टायर घिसते हुए भागना — तेज़ी से निकल पड़ना
definition: drive away with screeching speed, tyres spinning hard against the road; also leaving anywhere hurriedly
example: The moment her shift ended, Priya burned rubber out of the car park to catch the start of her daughter's recital.

term: burn the candle at both ends
hindi: नींद और आराम छोड़कर ख़ुद को थका डालना
definition: becoming exhausted through late nights and early rising, draining energy and eventually health
example: Burning the candle at both ends through exam season, he fell asleep during his own party.

hindi: रात का तेल जलाना — देर रात तक जागकर काम करना
definition: working late into the night hours, giving exhausting effort while everyone else sleeps
example: The kitchen light stayed on till three; Ammu was burning the midnight oil over her thesis chapter.

hindi: वापसी के रास्ते जला देना — लौटने की गुंजाइश खत्म करना
definition: destroy every possible retreat deliberately, committing beyond return with nothing behind worth keeping
example: He resigned politely instead of burning his bridges, because that little town had only three good employers.

hindi: हाथ जलाना — जल्दबाज़ी के सौदे में नुकसान उठाना
definition: suffer painful financial loss through reckless venture, learning caution only after gamble collapses
example: Having burnt his fingers once on a friend's scheme, Anil now reads every page twice before signing anything.

hindi: सपना तोड़ देना — ख़ुशफ़हमी दूर करना
definition: shatter someone's happy illusion or hopes, bringing them sharply back to disappointing reality
example: I hated to burst her bubble about snow on Christmas, so we built a paper snowman on the balcony instead.

hindi: ठसाठस भरा — जगह कम पड़ना
definition: overcrowded beyond comfortable capacity, holding many more people than intended space allows
example: The little tuition room was bursting at the seams, with three boys sharing every bench and one perched happily outside.

hindi: सुलह कर लेना — पुरानी अदावत भुलाकर मेल कर लेना
definition: settle an ancient quarrel, restoring peaceful relations between former enemies who stopped speaking
example: The brothers buried the hatchet over a shared plate of jalebis, forty years after the shop was divided.

term: bury your head in the sand
hindi: आँख मूँदकर बैठना — सच्चाई से मुँह मोड़ लेना
definition: deliberately ignoring unpleasant reality, avoiding practical trouble instead of solving anything
example: They buried their heads in the sand about the cracked wall until monsoon water reached the almirah.

hindi: कानोंकान ख़बर — मुँहज़बानी फैलती बात
definition: rumour and gossip spreading informally, Australian and British, news travelling faster than official channels
example: By the bush telegraph, the whole valley knew about the new baby before the proud father reached the pub.

hindi: एड़ी-चोटी का ज़ोर लगाना — बेहद मेहनत करना
definition: strain extremely hard, pushing your energy well past comfort to finish something
example: The volunteers busted a gut repainting the community hall so it would be ready for the wedding on Saturday.

hindi: चला हुआ कारतूस — अब किसी काम का नहीं
definition: in British usage, someone or something once promising that proved ultimately worthless and powerless
example: Pundits called the veteran striker a busted flush, then he scored twice in the cup final.

hindi: मधुमक्खी जैसा व्यस्त — छोटे-छोटे कामों में लगातार जुटा
definition: constantly occupied with small useful tasks, labouring cheerfully through crowded hours
example: Grandmother stayed busy as a bee before Diwali, sorting wicks and jars, refusing every offer of help except tea.

hindi: मस्का लगाना — चापलूसी
definition: used for shameless flattery offered to please someone, usually hoping for favours in return, as said in Indian English
example: The children's butter polish began at breakfast, and by lunch Papa had somehow agreed to buy them a puppy.

hindi: मक्खन लगाना — तारीफ़ करके काम निकालना
definition: praise somebody excessively hoping flattery will persuade them into granting something later
example: He buttered his grandmother up with three compliments about her cooking before mentioning the money he needed.

hindi: पेट में तितलियाँ उड़ना — घबराहट और उत्साह का मिला-जुला डर
definition: nervous fluttering felt before something important, mixing anxious dread with restless anticipation
example: She had butterflies in her stomach before the recital, and her teacher told her every good singer feels exactly that.

hindi: बस चुप करो — अब और मत बोलो
definition: blunt command telling someone to stop talking immediately, informal British speech
example: Button it, you two, said Dad from the front seat, and the squabbling in the back dissolved into giggles.

hindi: मुँह बंद रखना — चुप हो जाना
definition: stopping talk instantly, keeping the secret safe by telling nobody standing nearby
example: Dad buttoned his lip the second my sister walked in carrying the birthday cake we had hidden.

term: buy a pig in a poke
hindi: बिना देखे सौदा करना — अनजाने में ठगा जाना
definition: purchase or accept something without inspecting it first, ignorant of its true condition or value
example: They bought the caravan unseen, a pig in a poke if ever there was one, yet it turned out perfect and hosted three family summers.

hindi: उधार पर लेना — खाते में लिखवाना
definition: British for purchasing goods on credit, taking them home now and paying the shopkeeper later
example: In the lean weeks Nan bought on tick from Mr Patel, who always rounded the total down and slipped in a sweet for the children.

hindi: ख़रीदकर पछताना — सौदे के बाद की कसक
definition: anxious regret after buying something, suddenly doubting whether the purchase was wise
example: Buyer's remorse hit the moment the giant sofa arrived, until the whole family piled onto it for movie night.

hindi: कोसों आगे — भारी अंतर से
definition: winning or leading by an enormous margin, leaving every competitor hopelessly behind; British
example: Her hand-drawn birthday card was the best in the class by a country mile, and the teacher pinned it above the blackboard.

hindi: ज़रा-से अंतर से — मामूली बढ़त के साथ
definition: narrowly, edging fractionally in front of a rival by the smallest possible distance; British racing
example: The two grandmothers' marmalades were judged so close that Edith's took first prize by a short head, and she shared the jar anyway.

hindi: साम-दाम-दंड-भेद से — किसी भी तरह
definition: through any possible means, determined to succeed regardless of difficulties or methods required
example: By hook or by crook, the students were going to get their teacher to the reunion, even if it meant borrowing a minibus.

hindi: छलांगें लगाते हुए — बहुत तेज़ी से
definition: improving remarkably quickly, making rapid progress through large impressive stages
example: Her English came on by leaps and bounds once she started chatting with the neighbours over the fence.

term: by the seat of your pants
hindi: जैसे-तैसे निभा लेना — बिना योजना अंदाज़ से
definition: managing something risky without preparation, improvising continuously through instinct rather than planning
example: They ran the whole school play by the seat of their pants, and the audience never guessed the curtain jammed twice.

term: by the skin of your teeth
hindi: मुश्किल से जान बचाकर — बहुत मामूली अंतर से बच निकलना
definition: escape failure narrowly, clearing serious danger with margin almost impossibly slender
example: He reached the platform by the skin of his teeth, one shoe untied, the guard's whistle already in the air.

term: by the sweat of your brow
hindi: पसीने की कमाई से — अपनी मेहनत के बल पर
definition: through your own honest physical labour, earning everything without help or shortcuts
example: Her grandfather built that house by the sweat of his brow, laying every brick himself over three long summers.

hindi: अपने बलबूते — बिना सहारे आगे बढ़ना
definition: rising from poverty toward success through personal effort alone, without help from wealthy connections, from 'pull yourself up by your bootstraps'
example: She rose by her own bootstraps, studying under a streetlamp, and now funds a scholarship for girls from her village.

hindi: लड़कपन का प्यार — बचपन की दीवानगी
definition: innocent romantic infatuation between young people, tender, intense and soon passing, in British usage
example: Her father remembered his own calf love for the baker's daughter and let her mope for a week.

hindi: खरी-खरी कहना — बात घुमाए बिना सच बोलना
definition: describe unpleasant truth plainly, naming obvious problems without softening careful language
example: Their father called a spade a spade about the leaking roof, and the landlord arrived within hours carrying actual tools.

hindi: बस अब इतना ही — काम रोककर छुट्टी कर देना
definition: to stop working and finish an activity, deciding that further effort brings nothing worthwhile
example: After the fourth burnt pancake my father called it a day, and we walked to the bakery in our pyjamas.

term: call it as you see it
hindi: जैसा देखा वैसा कहना — खरी राय देना
definition: give your honest opinion openly, judging situations fairly without favouring anybody's feelings
example: The village cricket umpire called it as he saw it, even when it meant giving his own grandson out.

hindi: हिसाब बराबर — अब कोई बकाया नहीं
definition: declare past grievances settled, neither person owing the other anything further after quarrelling
example: You broke my mug, I lost your umbrella, so let's call it even and go get coffee.

hindi: किनारा कर लेना — आपसी सहमति से सिलसिला यहीं ख़त्म करना
definition: to abandon an effort or relationship by mutual agreement, accepting defeat without further struggle
example: They called it quits on the band after the third drummer left, and stayed friends anyway.

hindi: हुक्म चलाना — सारे फ़ैसले अपने हाथ में रखना
definition: control every important decision that other people must finally follow
example: Nani sat quietly through the whole wedding meeting, but everyone knew she would call the shots about the menu.

hindi: जिसकी लाठी उसकी भैंस — पैसा देनेवाला ही हुक्म चलाता है
definition: control every decision because you supply the money, leaving others following your instructions quietly
example: The eldest cousin paid for the wedding tent, so nobody was surprised that he called the tune about seating.

hindi: पोल खोलना — दावे को चुनौती देना
definition: challenging somebody's pretence directly, forcing hidden reality forward when their confident claims collapse
example: Mother called his bluff about cooking dinner, sat down, and waited cheerfully while the kitchen filled with smoke.

hindi: विराम लगा देना — किसी चीज़ को समाप्त घोषित करना
definition: deciding that something must finish now, announcing its ending as landlords announce closing, chiefly British
example: After thirty summers, the family finally called time on their caravan holidays and booked a cottage instead.

hindi: शांत तालाब जैसा — बिल्कुल स्थिर
definition: utterly untroubled and calm, water or temper showing barely noticeable disturbance
example: After the storm the lake lay calm as a millpond, and the fishermen went out laughing about the previous night.

hindi: तूफ़ान से पहले की शांति — बड़ी मुसीबत से पहले का सन्नाटा
definition: quiet peaceful period arriving just before serious trouble finally breaks over everyone
example: The kitchen was silent at four o'clock, the calm before the storm of forty wedding guests arriving hungry.

hindi: उसकी हर बात सही — अंधा भरोसा
definition: enjoying such complete approval that people forgive or praise whatever you choose to do
example: In his grandmother's eyes the youngest grandson can do no wrong, even with muddy boots on her rug.

term: can take it or leave it
hindi: न ठंडा न गरम — कोई ख़ास लगाव नहीं
definition: mildly indifferent about something, neither disliking strongly enough refusing nor really enjoying
example: He can take or leave chocolate cake, which is lucky, because his sister finishes both slices anyway.

hindi: क़िस्मत साथ न देना — लगातार बदनसीबी
definition: suffering repeated misfortune where every attempt seems doomed by luck, an American phrase
example: He can't catch a break this month, lost wallet, flat tyre, burst pipe, so we're bringing him dinner tonight.

hindi: सिर-पैर समझ न आना — कुछ पल्ले न पड़ना
definition: understand nothing whatever despite effort, finding explanation completely confusing throughout
example: She could not make head nor tail of the assembly diagram, so her brother turned the paper around.

term: can't make head or tail of
hindi: सिर-पैर समझ न आना — बिल्कुल पल्ले न पड़ना
definition: completely unable to understand something, finding neither beginning nor ending that makes sense
example: Grandpa turned the flat-pack instructions upside down twice and admitted he couldn't make head or tail of them, so the grandchildren took over.

hindi: ज़िंदगी का तय पड़ाव — यह दुख होना ही था
definition: unavoidable painful episode treated afterwards as necessary chapter shaping somebody's eventual character
example: Losing that first terrible job became a canon event nobody in the family could tell without laughing.

hindi: हाथ फैलाना — विनम्र होकर मदद माँगना
definition: humbly asking others for money or help, forced into begging through need or hardship
example: The village school went cap in hand to the council, and came back with funding plus a councillor volunteering to coach football.

hindi: इनाम और सज़ा दोनों — लालच और डर
definition: controlling behaviour through promised rewards alongside threatened punishment, pushing people whichever direction works
example: Mum's carrot and stick for exam season was simple: a cinema trip for good marks, no phone for bad ones.

hindi: दिल में मशाल जलाए रखना — एकतरफ़ा प्यार निभाना
definition: keep longing quietly for somebody whose affection remains unreturned, sometimes continuing years afterwards
example: Uncle still carries a torch for a classmate from Nainital, which explains why he hums that particular song while gardening.

hindi: हर मोर्चे पर जीतना — सबको पीछे छोड़ते जाना
definition: succeeding everywhere, defeating every rival and obstacle without meeting serious resistance; British
example: In her first season the young swimmer carried all before her, collecting medals at every gala in the county.

hindi: उल्टे बाँस बरेली को — जहाँ चीज़ पहले से भरी हो वहीं पहुँचाना
definition: wasting effort supplying something already abundant, where nothing useful comes from giving more
example: Taking mangoes to her uncle's orchard was carrying coals to Newcastle, though he hugged her anyway.

term: carry on like a pork chop
hindi: बात का बतंगड़ बनाना — नाटक करके शोर मचाना
definition: lose temper theatrically, complaining childishly about thoroughly minor trouble, said across Australia
example: She carried on like a pork chop about the missing charger, which turned out under the cushion she sat upon.

hindi: ठीकरा सिर पर लेना — दूसरों की गलती की सज़ा भुगतना
definition: accept blame alone, punished publicly for failings other people actually caused, British phrasing
example: Somebody had forgotten the wedding tents, and poor Chotu carried the can while three uncles quietly rewrote their version.

hindi: बाज़ी मार ले जाना — मुक़ाबले में जीत हासिल करना
definition: finish a contest as clear winner after hard struggle against strong rivals
example: Three speakers argued well, but the quiet girl with the hand-drawn charts carried the day.

hindi: कोरा कागज़ थमाना — जो चाहो करने का पूरा अधिकार
definition: complete freedom and authority to proceed however you choose, without restriction
example: They handed the cook carte blanche for the wedding menu, and she quietly replaced every fashionable dish with her grandmother's recipes.

hindi: दुधारू गाय — लगातार कमाई का ज़रिया
definition: product, business or asset reliably producing steady profits, funding everything else without much attention
example: The humble notebook range became the printing shop's cash cow, paying for every experimental poster.

hindi: चल बसना — जीवन का खेल समेट लेना
definition: to leave living behind and pass away, gambling slang treating death as a person collecting final winnings
example: Grandpa joked for years that he would cash in his chips only after seeing the new bridge finished, and somehow he did.

hindi: मझधार में छोड़ देना — बिना सहारे अकेला छोड़ना
definition: abandoned without guidance, support, direction after those responsible quietly stopped helping
example: When the senior teacher retired mid-term, the new arrivals felt cast adrift until the librarian began sitting with them at lunch.

hindi: लांछन लगाना — चरित्र पर उँगली उठाना
definition: suggesting damaging things about someone's character, attacking their reputation with unfair hints rather than proof
example: I would never cast aspersions on your baking, but this cake could anchor a ship.

hindi: भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना — नासमझों पर हुनर बरबाद
definition: offering valuable things toward people completely unable to appreciate their worth
example: Playing his grandfather's rare recordings during the noisy party felt like casting pearls before swine, so he saved them.

hindi: हवाई क़िले बनाना — असंभव योजनाएँ गढ़ना
definition: unrealistic hopeful plans imagined without money, permission, or practical foundation
example: They built castles in the air on the terrace every summer night, naming rooms in a house nobody could afford.

hindi: मुँह में दही जमना — अचानक बोल न पाना
definition: suddenly unable to speak, standing silent when words were clearly expected
example: Her aunt teased her at the doorway, asking whether the cat had got her tongue again.

term: cat on a hot tin roof
hindi: गरम तवे पर बिल्ली — घबराहट में एक जगह टिक न पाना
definition: extremely nervous, fidgeting restlessly because anxious waiting makes sitting still impossible
example: Waiting outside the interview hall he was a cat on a hot tin roof, until another candidate offered him half a biscuit.

hindi: मलाई खाई बिल्ली — अपनी कामयाबी पर इतराना
definition: someone looking smugly delighted with themselves, triumphant over a private success; usually 'look like the cat that got the cream'
example: Having beaten his grandson at chess for the first time, Dadaji sat back looking like the cat that got the cream.

hindi: मोहरा — दूसरे के हाथ की कठपुतली
definition: person tricked into doing someone else's dishonest work, unknowingly taking every risk themselves
example: The younger boy realised too late he had been the cat's paw, sent to fetch the biscuits while the others stayed clean.

hindi: मज़बूत कुर्सी — हर हाल में फ़ायदे की स्थिति
definition: commanding enviable position where circumstances favour whatever decision somebody chooses, advantage assured
example: With both landlords bidding for the shop, the tailor sat comfortably in the catbird seat, stitching quietly through their offers.

hindi: दिल लग जाना — बेइरादा प्यार हो जाना
definition: developing unexpected romantic attachment toward somebody despite intending everything remain casual
example: They promised nothing serious, then she caught feelings somewhere between the borrowed umbrella and the second breakfast.

hindi: झपकी मार लेना — थोड़ी नींद पूरी करना
definition: snatch brief sleep whenever possible, tired person resting between duties rather than proper bedtime
example: She caught some shut-eye on the train bench, waking exactly when the tea seller called down the platform.

hindi: नज़र मिल जाना — पहली झलक में ध्यान खींचना
definition: attract somebody's romantic attention briefly through glances exchanged across crowded rooms
example: She caught his eye between courses, both looked away immediately, and his brother pretended nothing whatsoever had happened.

hindi: ठंड लगाकर बीमार पड़ना — लापरवाही से रोग बुला लेना
definition: become dangerously unwell through careless exposure, usually cold weather warnings from worried elders
example: Standing on the wet balcony without slippers, he heard his aunt promise he would catch his death before dinner.

hindi: होश में आ — बहकी बात छोड़ने की नसीहत
definition: telling somebody deluded to stop believing obvious nonsense, Northern Irish corrective phrase
example: Catch yourself on, his sister said gently, when he announced that quitting college would obviously make him wealthy within months.

hindi: गोल चक्कर वाली मजबूरी — हर रास्ता वापस वहीं
definition: trapped situation where the only escape depends on conditions that the situation itself prevents, from Joseph Heller's novel
example: It was a catch-22: no job without experience, no experience without a job, until the bakery owner let him start on Saturdays.

hindi: बेख़बर पकड़ा जाना — तैयारी न होना
definition: surprised while completely unprepared, unable to react quickly when trouble suddenly arrives
example: The guests arrived an hour early and caught us flat-footed, still in pyjamas with the onions half chopped.

hindi: रंगे हाथों पकड़ा गया — सबूत सहित
definition: exposed with undeniable recorded evidence, screenshots preserving exactly what somebody kept denying
example: He swore he never watched the finale, then somebody posted the photograph: caught in 4K, popcorn included.

hindi: दो पाटों के बीच पिसना — दूसरों की लड़ाई में नुकसान
definition: harmed by a quarrel between other people although you never took either side
example: The youngest brother always got caught in the crossfire of the twins' arguments, so he learned to make excellent peace-offering pancakes.

hindi: रंगे हाथों पकड़ा जाना — चोरी करते हुए धरा जाना
definition: discovered during wrongdoing itself, leaving somebody unable to deny dishonest behaviour convincingly
example: The puppy was caught red-handed beside the emptied plate, tail wagging through the entire interrogation.

hindi: बेखबरी में पकड़े जाना — बिना तैयारी शर्मिंदा होना
definition: caught unprepared during something embarrassing, discovered before excuses could cover obvious wrongdoing
example: The inspection arrived early and caught the whole kitchen with its pants down, three burners cold and nobody wearing gloves.

hindi: हलचल मचा देना — चर्चा छिड़ जाना
definition: provoke excited argument among watching audience, becoming topic everybody discusses immediately
example: Her arrival with the ex-boyfriend caused such a stir that nobody noticed the speeches beginning.

hindi: चाय-पानी — छोटी-मोटी रिश्वत
definition: euphemism for a small bribe expected by petty officials before paperwork moves forward, as said in Indian English
example: The clerk hinted at chai-pani, but the old teacher just smiled, offered him actual tea from her flask, and waited.

hindi: सबक़ मानकर आगे बढ़ना — ग़लती से सीखना
definition: accept a failure calmly, treating the disappointment as a useful lesson learned, American English
example: He chalked the missed train up to experience and now leaves home twenty minutes early.

hindi: चलता है — लापरवाही वाला रवैया
definition: phrase describing careless acceptance of shoddy work, shrugging that anything passable will somehow manage, as said in Indian English
example: Her new principal had no patience for the old chalta hai attitude, and within a month even the school clocks told the right time.

hindi: शाही ठाठ-बाट
definition: extravagant manner of living full of expensive pleasures, often more than someone's income supports
example: He kept up a champagne lifestyle on a clerk's salary until his mother gently intervened.

hindi: अमीरी के शौक़, ग़रीबी की जेब — हैसियत से बड़े सपने
definition: wanting expensive luxuries while having only modest money, spending desires exceeding what income allows, often extended as champagne taste on a beer budget
example: With champagne taste on a beer budget, Ana hunted charity shops until she found a velvet coat that looked straight off a runway.

hindi: उतावला होना — शुरू करने को बेताब
definition: restlessly eager, bursting with excitement while waiting impatiently for permission to start; also chomping at the bit
example: The twins were champing at the bit by the pool gate, towels on shoulders, waiting for the lifeguard's whistle.

hindi: हाथ आज़माना — नुकसान की परवाह किए बिना हिम्मत करके कोशिश करना
definition: attempt something boldly risky despite likely failure, keeping nothing back should embarrassment follow
example: Nobody expected the trainee to answer, but she chanced her arm and the visiting professor stopped mid-sentence to listen.

hindi: मन बदल जाना — राय या इरादा पलटना
definition: complete reversal of your opinion, feeling or decision, usually becoming kinder or more willing
example: Dad swore he would never own a cat, then had a change of heart when the soaked kitten followed him home.

hindi: पैंतरा बदलना — तरीका बदल देना
definition: abandon your present approach, trying completely different method after earlier attempts failed
example: After arguing for an hour he changed tack, brought out old photographs instead, and his brother finally started talking.

hindi: फ़ितरत बदलना — स्वभाव बदल लेना
definition: altering your basic character or habits, usually doubted because people seldom transform their nature
example: Everyone said the old rogue would never change his spots, yet he now runs the church tombola.

hindi: सुर बदल लेना — पहले जैसी बात नहीं
definition: abruptly reverse your stated opinion, singing completely different notes once circumstances turn against
example: He changed his tune about noisy neighbours the week his daughter brought home a drum kit.

hindi: पूरा हिसाब — हर बात सबूत सहित
definition: exact detailed evidence recited from memory, proving somebody's earlier promises beyond argument
example: Ask about the borrowed scooter and she gives chapter and verse, dates and messages, without pausing.

hindi: किस्मत का धनी होना — हर मुसीबत से बेदाग़ निकल आना
definition: existence blessed with constant fortune, where luck deflects trouble that ruins ordinary people
example: Three crashes, one flood, and not a scratch on him — the village decided the man led a charmed life.

hindi: शोहरत के पीछे भागना — लाइक बटोरने की होड़
definition: pursue online popularity shamelessly, courting attention from strangers instead of building genuine friendship
example: He stopped chasing clout after his cousin pointed out that nobody in their family watched those videos anyway.

hindi: हार की भरपाई के लिए और दाँव लगाना
definition: keep gambling or spending money hoping to recover earlier losses, usually losing even more
example: He had learnt not to chase his losses, so after two lost raffles he pocketed his coins and enjoyed the fair.

hindi: अपनी ही पूँछ के पीछे भागना — भागदौड़ बहुत, नतीजा शून्य
definition: working frantically without progress, repeating effort that never finishes anything useful
example: She spent the whole morning chasing her tail between courier calls, and finally sat down with cold tea to make one proper list.

hindi: सस्ता और बढ़िया — कम दाम में अच्छी चीज़
definition: praise for something inexpensive yet excellent, offering great value for the money spent, as said in Indian English
example: The little dhaba near the highway became their family favourite, cheap and best, with rotis that kept arriving hot.

hindi: सस्ता और बढ़िया — कम दाम, पूरा मज़ा
definition: British for inexpensive yet pleasant, spending little money while still offering simple honest enjoyment
example: The seaside caravan was cheap and cheerful, and the kids declared it better than any hotel because the rain drummed on the roof.

hindi: पानी के भाव — बेहद सस्ता
definition: priced cheaply, costing hardly anything and worth considerably more than the modest price paid
example: The bookshop near the station sells old paperbacks cheap as chips, three for the price of tea.

hindi: आज नहीं कल — भुगतान का झूठा वादा
definition: reassuring excuse promising overdue payment arrives soon, often delaying without real intention, American
example: Her little brother swore the check was in the mail for the pizza he owed, then turned up with a homemade lasagne instead.

hindi: क्या बात है — बिलकुल लाजवाब, कोई कमी नहीं
definition: flawless, deeply satisfying quality deserving loud praise, nothing anybody could sensibly improve further
example: He tasted the rasam, closed both eyes, kissed his fingertips and pronounced it chef's kiss before serving everyone.

hindi: ऊपर से बोनस — बढ़िया चीज़ पर आख़िरी सजावट
definition: delightful small addition crowning something already excellent, pleasing beyond reasonable expectation
example: The train arrived early, and finding window seats together was the cherry on top of an already gentle journey.

hindi: गप्पें मारना — बेफ़िक्र लंबी बातचीत
definition: enjoy long relaxed conversation about unimportant subjects, chatting comfortably without hurrying anywhere
example: The two uncles chewed the fat outside the barber shop for an hour, neither of them remembering why they had come.

hindi: मंच चबा जाना — हद से ज़्यादा नाटकीय होना
definition: acting theatrically overblown throughout performance, exaggerating every emotion beyond believable measure
example: The villain chewed the scenery so thoroughly that children began cheering for him instead.

hindi: जैसा बोओगे वैसा काटोगे — पुराने कर्म लौट आना
definition: earlier wrongdoing returns eventually, bringing unpleasant consequences onto someone believing themselves safely forgotten
example: The shortcuts taken during construction stayed hidden until monsoon, when every chicken came home to roost across the ceiling.

hindi: सब कुछ करने वाला — अकेला हर काम सँभालने वाला
definition: person personally handling every task, busy doing everything from important decisions down to menial chores
example: At the village fête she was chief cook and bottle washer, selling raffle tickets one minute and unblocking the sink the next.

hindi: बच्चों का खेल — बेहद सरल काम
definition: task simple enough that anyone finishes easily, without effort, training, trouble, special skill
example: After a winter of rebuilding tractor engines, fixing the kitchen tap was child's play for grandfather.

hindi: बकबक — खोखली बातें जो कुछ तय नहीं करतीं
definition: an American term for empty aimless chatter filling time, pleasant talking that settles absolutely nothing
example: The barbershop offered plenty of chin music alongside every haircut, and half the customers came mostly for that.

hindi: बाप पर पूत — पिता जैसा ही स्वभाव और आदतें
definition: child whose habits and manner closely resemble a parent, sharing personality and talents
example: He hummed while he worked, exactly the way his mother did over the same kitchen sink, and his aunt laughed that he was a chip off the old block.

hindi: मन में गाँठ — पुरानी नाइंसाफ़ी का बोझ
definition: lasting resentment about earlier unfairness, carried through years, quarrelsome with everybody
example: He arrived with a chip on his shoulder about being the scholarship boy, and lost it slowly over four good friendships.

hindi: उतावला होना — शुरू करने को बेचैन
definition: restless and impatient while waiting, eager to start immediately but held back by delays
example: The children were chomping at the bit all morning, noses pressed to the window, waiting for the first snowflakes.

hindi: घड़ी में तोला घड़ी में माशा — बार-बार राय बदलना
definition: repeatedly changing your plans or mind, switching decisions constantly without settling anywhere, chiefly British
example: The bride kept chopping and changing the seating plan until her grandmother simply sat wherever she liked.

hindi: इंटरनेट का कीड़ा — असली दुनिया से कटा हुआ
definition: describing somebody whose opinions come entirely from screens, having forgotten ordinary offline reality
example: Her nephew arrived chronically online, explaining internet feuds nobody recognised, until three days of cousins cured him.

hindi: आग-बबूला होना — छोटी बात पर तमाशा
definition: lose temper suddenly, shouting childishly about minor disappointment, said across Australia
example: He chucked a wobbly when the printer jammed before the wedding cards, so his sister quietly refilled the paper tray.

hindi: फूला नहीं समाना — भीतर तक ख़ुश
definition: thoroughly delighted in British usage, quietly pleased and glowing with proud happiness
example: Nan was chuffed to bits with her marrow rosette and propped it against the kettle for visitors.

hindi: मोर्चा बाँधना — मिलकर बचाव करना
definition: close together defensively, protecting your group loyally against outside criticism, chiefly American usage
example: The moment a neighbour criticised their youngest, the whole family circled the wagons and invited her round for dinner to talk it out.

hindi: ढलान पर होना — धीरे-धीरे अंत की ओर बढ़ना
definition: declining steadily close toward death, barely responding while illness worsens beyond likely recovery
example: The old mare had been circling the drain all autumn, so the family took turns sleeping in the barn beside her.

hindi: सब ठीक होने की मुहर — कोई खराबी नहीं मिली
definition: official confirmation that nothing dangerous remains, allowing normal activity without further worry
example: The engineer gave the old building a clean bill of health, and the residents celebrated by repainting the stairwell themselves.

hindi: क्लीन बोल्ड — पूरी तरह चित या फ़िदा
definition: cricket idiom meaning completely defeated or unprepared, often used for being totally smitten, as said in Indian English
example: One smile from the girl at the bookshop and Vikram was clean bowled, buying three poetry books he would never read.

hindi: पूरी तरह नाता तोड़ना — बिना खिंचाव के अलग होना
definition: complete separation from a person, place or habit, leaving without lingering connections afterwards
example: Moving to the coast gave her a clean break from the city, and she learned every neighbour's name within a month.

hindi: नई शुरुआत — पुराना हिसाब भुलाकर
definition: fresh starting point where past mistakes are forgotten, letting everyone begin again with nothing held against them, chiefly British
example: After the summer holidays the teacher gave the whole class a clean sheet, and even the troublemakers sat up straighter.

hindi: पूरी सफ़ाई — हर मुक़ाबला जीतना
definition: winning every single prize, match or position available, leaving rivals with nothing at all
example: The gardening club made a clean sweep at the flower show, carrying home rosettes for roses, dahlias and sweet peas.

hindi: घंटी जैसी साफ़ आवाज़ — एकदम स्पष्ट
definition: perfectly obvious and easily noticeable, every sound reaching listeners without confusion
example: The line crackled all evening, then suddenly his mother's voice came through clear as a bell asking whether he had eaten.

hindi: दिन के उजाले जैसा साफ़ — समझने में ज़रा भी उलझन नहीं
definition: immediately obvious and easily understood, needing nothing further explained afterwards
example: Once she drew the family tree on newspaper, the whole tangle of cousins became clear as day to everybody watching.

hindi: उल्टा उलझा देना — समझाने पर और गड़बड़ हो जाना
definition: supposedly helpful explanation that remains thoroughly incomprehensible, leaving the listener understanding rather less than before
example: The instructions for assembling the cupboard were clear as mud, so they worked from the picture instead and finished by midnight.

hindi: गिले-शिकवे दूर करना — खुलकर बात करके तनाव मिटाना
definition: settle simmering tension through honest conversation, removing quarrel and restoring peaceful understanding
example: One long walk around the lake cleared the air between the flatmates better than three weeks of silence.

hindi: मैदान साफ़ करना — काम शुरू करने से पहले सब हटा देना
definition: remove every distraction beforehand, leaving nothing except important work needing full attention
example: She cleared the decks the evening before results came out, cancelling visitors and leaving nothing on the table except tea.

hindi: सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ना — पद में ऊपर उठना
definition: steadily rising toward higher positions, gaining status and seniority through effort over years
example: He climbed the ladder from paperboy to editor, yet still wrote the crossword clues himself every Sunday.

hindi: चिपक कर रह जाना — किसी हाल में न छूटना
definition: holding tightly and stubbornly to something, resisting every attempt at removal or dislodging
example: The new puppy clung like a limpet to my brother's ankle all evening, determined to follow him everywhere.

hindi: पर कतरना — आज़ादी और ताक़त छीन लेना
definition: restrict someone's freedom or power, preventing them from doing whatever they previously pleased
example: Dad clipped Rohan's wings after the midnight scooter ride, and the keys vanished into a drawer for a month.

hindi: जासूसी का खेल — रहस्य और षड्यंत्र से भरा
definition: involving dramatic secrecy and intrigue, like spies plotting mysterious schemes
example: The cloak and dagger planning for Mum's retirement party involved code names and a group chat called Knitting Club.

hindi: मुँह पर ताला — अपनी निजी बातें किसी को न बताने वाला
definition: extremely secretive and silent, revealing nothing whatever about private matters however people press
example: Ask Auntie Meena about her famous chutney recipe and she turns close as an oyster, only smiling and pouring more tea.

hindi: क़रीब, पर चूक गए — बस थोड़ी-सी कसर
definition: nearly correct or successful, but still falling short and missing the reward, mostly heard in American English
example: Close but no cigar, laughed Grandpa as my dart landed a whisker outside the bullseye, then handed me three more.

hindi: कंधे से कंधा मिलाना — बाहरी हमले पर अंदरूनी झगड़ा भुलाना
definition: unite tightly to defend your group against outside criticism, hiding internal disagreement completely from strangers
example: The moment the inspector questioned their teacher, the noisiest class in the school closed ranks and answered nothing.

hindi: बाल-बाल बचना — ज़रा सी दूरी से खतरा टल जाना
definition: narrow escape where serious danger passed within barest margin, leaving everyone badly shaken
example: The scooter wobbled past the truck with inches to spare; Ravi parked, sat down on the kerb, and admitted it was a close shave.

hindi: पन्ना पलट देना — उस अध्याय को हमेशा के लिए पीछे छोड़ देना
definition: to permanently stop revisiting a finished activity, treating the matter closed against further involvement
example: He closed the book on his racing years the morning he sold the helmet to a delighted teenager down the street.

hindi: दरवाज़ा हमेशा के लिए बंद करना — सारा नाता तोड़ देना
definition: ending access permanently, refusing further contact, conversation, closeness with somebody difficult
example: She closed the door on the friend who borrowed money twice, gently, without speeches, simply never opening that conversation again.

hindi: चिड़िया चुग गई खेत — नुक़सान हो जाने के बाद सावधानी बरतना
definition: taking careful precautions only after harm already happened, once the chance which actually mattered passed unused
example: They bought three smoke alarms the week after the kitchen fire, closing the stable door with great enthusiasm.

hindi: बंद किताब — जो कुछ समझ में न आए
definition: subject remaining completely mysterious, understanding nothing about somebody despite considerable reading
example: Astronomy stayed a closed book until his neighbour dragged the telescope onto the terrace one winter night.

hindi: मन पर छाया बोझ — लगातार बनी रहने वाली उदासी या चिंता
definition: lingering sadness or worry that shadows every moment, refusing to lift for long
example: The unanswered letter from her brother was a cloud hanging over her, until she picked up the phone and simply called him.

hindi: आसमान पर बादल मंडराना — आने वाली मुसीबत के संकेत
definition: early warning signals suggesting approaching trouble before matters actually worsen
example: The shop was busy, but Amma counted the unpaid ledgers and saw clouds on the horizon.

hindi: डूबते को तिनके का सहारा — निराशा में बेकार उपायों से चिपकना
definition: grasping desperately at hopeless remedies once every reasonable chance of success vanished
example: They were clutching at straws by then, phoning distant cousins who had never repaired anything electrical.

hindi: मनगढ़ंत कहानी — बेसिर-पैर की बात
definition: ridiculous invented story offered as excuse or explanation, which nobody sensible believes
example: He came up with a cock and bull story about a goat eating his homework, and the teacher laughed too hard to scold him.

hindi: अपनी गली का शेर — सबसे रौबदार
definition: person holding the leading, dominant position within a group, often behaving rather proudly about it; British
example: Ever since he won the conker championship, little Tom has strutted round the playground like the cock of the walk.

hindi: फूले न समाना — ख़ुशी से झूम उठना
definition: extremely delighted and triumphant, especially after winning something or receiving wonderful news; British
example: The whole family was cock-a-hoop when Grandpa's giant marrow finally took first prize after twenty years of trying.

hindi: मशीन का पुरज़ा — बड़े तंत्र में मामूली इंसान
definition: insignificant person inside large organisation, replaceable worker whose absence changes almost nothing
example: He called himself only a cog in the machine, though half the neighbourhood asked him about their pension papers.

hindi: पैसा कूटना — खूब कमाई
definition: in British usage, earning plenty of money quickly and easily, profits flowing without much effort
example: The seaside café coins it in every August, then the owners close shop and travel all winter.

hindi: बर्फ़ जैसा ठंडा — व्यवहार में बिलकुल अपनापन नहीं
definition: showing chilling absence of warmth toward others, refusing friendly feeling during ordinary conversation
example: She stayed cold as ice through the whole dinner, and only softened when someone praised her mother's cooking.

hindi: झूठी तसल्ली — नाम भर की सांत्वना
definition: consolation offering very little real relief or warmth when you are disappointed, grieving or hurting
example: Knowing the trophy was lost by one point was cold comfort, but the team's pizza party afterwards helped more.

hindi: हिम्मत छूट जाना — ऐन मौके पर घबरा जाना
definition: sudden nervousness arriving before commitment, losing courage exactly when the decision becomes real
example: He got cold feet outside the interview hall, so his sister walked him twice around the block and pushed him gently inside.

hindi: ठंडा आदमी — जिसमें भावनाओं की गर्माहट नहीं
definition: person showing little warmth toward anybody, seeming distant during even affectionate family occasions
example: Everyone called the uncle a cold fish until they found the drawer where he kept every childhood drawing.

hindi: मुँह फेर लेना — जान-बूझकर उपेक्षा करना
definition: deliberate coldness toward your partner, withdrawing warmth until the romantic relationship feels distant
example: After the forgotten anniversary he received the cold shoulder through breakfast, lunch and dinner.

hindi: मुँह की खाना — बुरी तरह असफल होना
definition: failing badly and suddenly, tumbling from confidence into a ruined position after an obvious mistake
example: He boasted about cycling the hill without stopping and came a cropper halfway, wheeling the bicycle home while his cousins laughed.

hindi: मुँह के बल गिरना — ज़ोरदार पटखनी खाना
definition: in British and Australian usage, suffer a heavy fall or spectacular failure, crashing down hard
example: Tom came a purler on the ice rink, then got up grinning and asked the instructor for another lesson.

hindi: चूलें हिल जाना — ढाँचा भीतर से दरकना
definition: something once solid collapses steadily, as a plan or household loses every remaining support
example: By the third night without sleep the whole tour was coming apart at the seams, and the drummer just sat down on the stage.

hindi: सच उगल देना — छिपाया हुआ सच मान लेना
definition: confess the whole truth about hidden wrongdoing, admitting what deception concealed until conscience forced honesty
example: He came clean about the dented bumper over breakfast, and his mother laughed harder than she scolded.

term: come down like a ton of bricks
hindi: टूट पड़ना — बहुत सख़्ती से पेश आना
definition: reacting with sudden, furious criticism and punishment, attacking any mistake with overwhelming severity
example: The headmaster came down like a ton of bricks on anyone caught teasing the new boy.

term: come down to earth with a bump
hindi: आसमान से ज़मीन पर गिरना — अचानक हक़ीक़त से सामना
definition: return suddenly from happiness or excitement to a disappointing, ordinary reality, mostly heard in British English
example: After the honeymoon they came down to earth with a bump, sorting laundry and laughing at the mountain of it.

hindi: पिछड़कर जीतना — हारी बाज़ी पलटना
definition: finally triumph after trailing rivals throughout most of the contest, overtaking them during the closing stages
example: The school relay team came from behind on the final leg, and the whole crowd of parents leapt to their feet.

hindi: घूम-फिरकर वहीं — जहाँ से शुरू किया वहीं लौट आना
definition: returning finally to the original position or situation after passing through many changes
example: Things came full circle when the girl who once borrowed books there became the village librarian.

hindi: आख़िरकार रंग लाना — देर से ही सही, सफल होना
definition: finally flourish after disappointing beginnings, proving patient supporters right all along; mainly British
example: Everyone had given up on the scruffy young striker, but he came good in his third season and the whole town sang his name.

hindi: चाहे कुछ भी हो जाए — हर हाल में
definition: whatever difficulties arise, determined to continue regardless of trouble, danger or disaster
example: Come hell or high water, Nani made the four-hour trip every Diwali to light lamps at her sister's house.

hindi: अपने पैरों पर खिलना — असली रंग और आत्मविश्वास सामने आना
definition: finally reaching confident maturity where talent, appearance, judgement stop hiding behind earlier nervousness
example: Around thirty she came into her own, painting boldly, arguing calmly, dressing exactly however pleased herself.

hindi: छोड़ो भी — ऐसी बात मत करो
definition: reply, chiefly British, dismissing an exaggerated claim as nonsense and urging the speaker to stop pretending
example: 'I was nearly picked for the national team,' said Tom, and his best friend grinned, 'Oh, come off it, you trip over the kerb.'

hindi: खोल से बाहर आना — शर्म छोड़कर खुलकर मिलना
definition: gradually shedding painful shyness, becoming talkative, confident, willing among unfamiliar people
example: After joining the drama club Ishaan came out of his shell, arguing about costumes with people twice his height.

hindi: आख़िर में बाज़ी जीतना — विजयी होकर निकलना
definition: finally emerge victorious after a difficult struggle, finishing ahead once everything is settled
example: After three rounds of arguing over the board game rules, Grandma came out on top and demanded a rematch anyway.

hindi: पूरे दम से भिड़ना — शुरू से ही हमला
definition: begin a quarrel or contest aggressively, attacking hard from the very first moment
example: Accused of cheating at cards, Grandma came out swinging and demanded a full recount of every hand.

hindi: धूप हो या बारिश — हर हाल में
definition: continuing faithfully regardless whether conditions turn pleasant, never offering excuses
example: Come rain or shine, the old postman walked the lane, whistling under a black umbrella held against monsoon wind.

hindi: हाथापाई पर उतरना — मारपीट तक पहुँचना
definition: quarrel until physical fighting finally breaks out, arguments turning into actual punches
example: The two fishermen nearly came to blows over the biggest catch, until they realised it was the same fish.

hindi: मुँह की खाना — बुरी तरह नाकाम होना
definition: meet with disaster or serious accident, a venture or person ending badly damaged
example: Grandpa's homemade kite came to grief in the neighbour's apple tree, and he climbed up after it anyway.

hindi: भेद खुलना — छिपी हुई बात सामने आ जाना
definition: previously hidden secret facts become publicly known, exposing truth that careful concealment kept buried many years
example: The letters came to light when the old desk was moved, and the whole village learned who had paid for the school.

hindi: धरा का धरा रह जाना — सारी कोशिश बेकार जाना
definition: fail completely, so that plans, hopes or effort produce no result whatsoever in the end
example: Months of letters to the council came to nothing, so the neighbours fixed the swing themselves.

hindi: गाड़ी पटरी से उतरना — बीच रास्ते योजना बिगड़ना
definition: fail badly midway, British usage, plans collapsing publicly through unnoticed mistakes
example: Their clever shortcut came unstuck near the river, where the bridge had been closed since April.

hindi: सब कुछ अच्छा निकलना — चिंता के बाद सफलता
definition: turn out wonderfully despite earlier worry, every difficulty flowering into unexpected success
example: The wedding lunch began with burnt rice and a power cut, yet somehow everything came up roses by evening.

hindi: ठोकरें खाकर आगे बढ़ना — संघर्ष से मुक़ाम पाना
definition: reach success after struggling through poverty and hardship, earning everything without privilege or shortcuts
example: The chef came up the hard way, washing dishes for years, and now she makes every new dishwasher a birthday cake.

hindi: कसौटी पर खरा उतरना — अपेक्षित स्तर तक पहुँचना
definition: reach the required standard, meeting expectations satisfactorily after previous doubts about quality
example: His early paintings never came up to scratch in his own eyes, but his granddaughter framed every one of them anyway.

hindi: तुरुप का पत्ता निकलना — ऐन मौके पर कामयाब होना
definition: succeed unexpectedly well, delivering exactly what everyone needed when hopes were fading; British, also 'turn up trumps'
example: Nobody expected much from Grandad's old camping stove, but it came up trumps when the power failed and he made tea for the whole street.

hindi: गिरकर उठने वाला — बार-बार वापसी करने वाला
definition: person who repeatedly recovers after defeat or failure, returning stronger when everyone expected them finished
example: After two failed restaurants and a third that thrived, the town started calling him the comeback kid.

hindi: अपनी सुविधा का दायरा — जाना-पहचाना घेरा
definition: familiar comfortable surroundings where nothing frightens, cosy limits nobody stretches without deliberate effort
example: Singing publicly sat far outside her comfort zone, so her sister simply booked the slot and told her afterwards.

hindi: खुद से चैन होना — जैसा हूँ वैसा ही ठीक लगना
definition: accepting yourself calmly without wanting approval from strangers, confidence quietly settled inside
example: She arrived without makeup, hair pinned anyhow, entirely comfortable in her own skin among people photographing everything.

hindi: साझा ज़मीन — दोनों की सहमति का बिंदु
definition: the shared beliefs where opposing sides already agree, giving a compromise somewhere solid to begin
example: Over three hours and much chai, the two committees found common ground on the festival dates.

hindi: चोरी और सीनाज़ोरी — गलती पर गलती
definition: worsen an existing offence through second blunder, multiplying blame instead of apologising
example: Having forgotten the anniversary, he compounded the felony by booking the restaurant she disliked most.

hindi: तिलमिलाहट का दौरा — बेकाबू झल्लाहट
definition: sudden hysterical tantrum of temper, flailing agitated anger over something that went wrong, American
example: Grandpa nearly had a conniption fit when the cricket feed froze in the final over, until the neighbours shouted the score.

hindi: ग़ैरहाज़िरी से ही नज़र आना
definition: noticeably absent from somewhere you were expected, your missing presence drawing attention from everybody
example: The best man was conspicuous by his absence at the rehearsal, turning up late with a surprise cake for the couple.

hindi: चुप्पी की साज़िश — सबका जानबूझकर किसी बात पर मौन रहना
definition: collective agreement, often unspoken, among people staying silent about something everyone knows
example: There was a loving conspiracy of silence about Uncle Mohan's singing, and at every wedding he sang anyway.

hindi: हिसाब में हेराफेरी — खाते झूठे बनाना
definition: falsify financial accounts secretly, changing figures so records hide stolen money
example: The auditor noticed the tiny bakery's accounts balanced far too neatly, and gently asked who had been cooking the books.

hindi: अपनी लुटिया डुबोना — बचे हुए मौक़े भी ख़त्म कर लेना
definition: someone ruins their remaining chances through actions that harm themselves permanently
example: Telling the examiner she had never opened the textbook cooked her goose before the second question.

hindi: बर्फ़ जैसा शांत — घबराहट में भी बिल्कुल स्थिर
definition: remaining calmly composed during frightening pressure, showing absolutely nothing troubling outside
example: While everybody shouted about the flooded kitchen, Nani stayed cool as a cucumber and started lifting the steel plates.

hindi: ठंडे दिमाग़ से डटे रहना — संकट में भी शांत
definition: staying calm and thinking clearly under pressure, criticism or danger that would rattle others
example: Even when the wedding caterer vanished an hour before dinner, Aunt Rekha stayed cool under fire and phoned three dhabas at once.

hindi: इंतज़ार में एड़ियाँ रगड़ना — बेबस होकर प्रतीक्षा करना
definition: waiting around impatiently while others delay, kept standing still instead of rushing
example: We cooled our heels outside the clinic for an hour, counting sparrows on the wire above the gate.

hindi: ठंड रखो — गुस्सा शांत करो
definition: calm down and stop getting agitated or angry, slowing your heated reaction before acting, American
example: Cool your jets, the pizza will arrive, Dad told the hungry teenagers pacing by the front window.

hindi: सत्ता के गलियारे
definition: places where influential people make important decisions, especially within government, away from public view
example: Her grandfather spent forty years in the corridors of power, yet still insisted on queuing for his own vegetables.

term: cost an arm and a leg
hindi: कमर तोड़ देना — इतना महँगा कि जेब खाली हो जाए
definition: extremely expensive, costing enough that paying leaves ordinary household finances visibly damaged
example: The plumber fixed it in an hour and it still cost an arm and a leg.

hindi: दाम आसमान छूना — बेहद महँगा पड़ना
definition: requires an enormously large amount of money, proving much more expensive than anyone expected
example: The little balcony flat looked perfect until the agent named the rent, which would cost the earth.

hindi: सोफ़े का आलू — टीवी के आगे पड़ा रहने वाला
definition: lazy person spending long hours slumped watching screens, avoiding exercise and any effort whatsoever
example: The former couch potato surprised everyone by finishing the village fun run, waving his medal at the whole street.

hindi: कर सकते थे, करना चाहिए था — बीती बातों का पछतावा
definition: dismissive summary of useless regret about things you might have done differently
example: Coulda woulda shoulda, said Aunt Rosa as I moaned about the lost flat, now help me find you a better one.

hindi: अंडे फूटने से पहले चूज़े गिनना — पहले से जश्न मनाना
definition: assume success before it happens, planning around rewards that may never actually arrive
example: "Don't count your chickens," Nani warned, as he spent his imaginary quiz prize on paper before the first question was even asked.

hindi: अपने विश्वास पर अडिग रहना — मान्यता के लिए डट जाना
definition: bravery needed to act firmly on your beliefs, even when powerful people oppose them publicly
example: She had the courage of her convictions and served only vegetarian food at the wedding, despite three uncles' loud protests.

hindi: हर पहलू सँभाल लेना — किसी भी स्थिति के लिए तैयार रहना
definition: prepare against every likely outcome, protecting your position whichever choice finally proves correct
example: For the wedding lunch they covered all the bases, ordering extra rice, spare chairs and an emergency umbrella.

hindi: निशान मिटाना — अपने किए के सबूत छिपाना
definition: conceal evidence carefully, hiding every trace of your secret actions from anybody searching
example: He covered his tracks well, but the flour on his nose gave away who had been baking Mum's birthday cake.

hindi: यश कमाना — शान बढ़ाना
definition: performing impressively and earning admiration, often used ironically when someone performs embarrassingly
example: Dad hardly covered himself in glory at the parents' race, but he finished laughing.

hindi: मुँह अँधेरे — सूरज निकलने से पहले
definition: earliest morning hours, rising before sunrise while everybody else remains sleeping
example: Grandfather walked to the river at the crack of dawn, returning with wet feet before anyone else found their slippers.

hindi: गुत्थी सुलझाना — राज़ समझ लेना
definition: finally work out the hidden secret or method behind something puzzling that baffled everyone
example: After years of flat loaves, Nani finally cracked the code: the dough needed a warm cupboard, not the windowsill.

hindi: चाबुक चलाना — सख़्ती से काम कराना
definition: an American phrase meaning supervising sternly, pushing people harder through strict impatient watching authority
example: Aunt cracked the whip through the kitchen until every dish arrived, then poured herself the largest lemonade.

hindi: कम उम्र से रिश्ता जोड़ने वाला — उम्र का बड़ा फ़ासला
definition: someone dating a partner much younger than themselves, a teasing British phrase; the American version is cradle robber
example: When Nani married a man eight years younger, her friends called her a cradle snatcher at every kitty party.

hindi: महफ़िल जम गई — ज़बरदस्त रंगीन शाम
definition: wonderfully lively enjoyment in Irish usage, hours vanishing amid music, jokes, dancing
example: The craic was ninety in that little kitchen until somebody noticed the milkman outside and everybody realised morning had arrived.

hindi: औंधे मुँह गिरना — शानदार शुरुआत के बाद बुरी तरह असफल होना
definition: fail suddenly and completely after confident beginning, leaving plans wrecked beyond repair
example: His audition crashed and burned halfway through the second song, and the judges still clapped because he bowed anyway.

hindi: नवरत्न — सबसे चुनिंदा और बेहतरीन लोग
definition: the finest people chosen from a larger group, better than everyone else considered
example: Forty players trialled in the heat; these eleven were the cream of the crop.

hindi: हिसाब की कलाकारी — चालाकी भरा लेखा
definition: dishonest manipulation of financial accounts, disguising real figures through clever misleading records
example: Dad's creative accounting of the holiday budget somehow listed three ice creams as essential travel expenses.

hindi: आराम की छोटी-छोटी चीज़ें — रोज़ का सुख
definition: small physical comforts making daily living cosy, familiar soothing things nobody willingly surrenders
example: He packed light for the trek but smuggled his creature comforts along: proper tea, thick socks, one absurd pillow.

hindi: जिसका हक़ उसकी तारीफ़ — न्यायपूर्ण सराहना
definition: fair acknowledgement given honestly, praising someone deserving even when you usually criticise them
example: Credit where it's due, my brother cooked a proper Sunday lunch without setting off a single alarm.

hindi: घड़ियाली आँसू — दिखावटी दुख
definition: insincere show of sadness, fooling nobody watching closely because the grief seems obviously pretended
example: The toddler shed crocodile tears over bedtime, peeking between his fingers to check whether anybody was falling for it.

term: crooked as a dog's hind leg
hindi: टेढ़ा आदमी — पूरा बेईमान
definition: thoroughly dishonest, crooked, cheating anybody whenever there's profit available, American usage
example: The old horse trader was crooked as a dog's hind leg, yet somehow everyone in town still bought from him.

hindi: क़सम से — सच्ची क़सम
definition: solemnly promising, often childishly, that every word spoken is truthful and sincere without trickery or pretence
example: 'Cross my heart, I fed the goldfish,' said Kabir, and the goldfish, looking plump and pleased, seemed to agree.

hindi: भिड़ जाना — किसी से खुलकर बहस में उतरना
definition: enter bitter dispute with opposing person, arguing fiercely over sharply conflicting positions
example: Grandmother crossed swords with the doctor about salt, and neither side surrendered before dessert.

hindi: समय आने पर देखेंगे — फैसला बाद के लिए टालना
definition: postpone difficult decisions deliberately until circumstances actually require choosing something
example: Asked about hostel fees three years ahead, his father laughed and said they would cross that bridge together.

hindi: निर्णायक कदम उठाना — जहाँ से वापसी नहीं
definition: commit irreversibly beyond retreat, taking decisive action which cannot afterwards be undone
example: Signing the shop lease felt like crossing the Rubicon, and that evening they celebrated with jalebi from the corner stall.

hindi: अपना बोझ अपने कंधों पर — जीवन भर सहने वाला दुख
definition: prolonged private suffering carried patiently, burden nobody else fully understands
example: His father's failing memory became his own cross to bear, and he learned every story twice over gladly.

hindi: सिरमौर — सबसे बड़ी उपलब्धि
definition: greatest achievement completing someone's efforts, the finest accomplishment everything else leads toward
example: The rose garden was the crowning glory of his retirement, and strangers leaned over the wall to admire it.

hindi: आँसुओं की नदियाँ बहाना — बहुत ज़्यादा रोना
definition: shed enormous quantities of tears, usually over something sorrowful or deeply moving
example: We cried buckets at the end of the dog film, then went straight home and hugged our own snoring mutt.

hindi: ग़म में पीते हुए रोना — शराब के साथ अपने दुखड़े सुनाना
definition: wallow in self-pity over your misfortunes, usually while drinking and complaining to anybody listening
example: Instead of crying into his beer about the lost match, Joe bought a round and asked the winners for tips.

hindi: अब पछताए क्या होत — बीती बात पर रोना बेकार
definition: wasting sorrow over past mistakes nobody could reverse, since regret cannot change finished damage
example: Grandmother refused to cry over spilt milk about the broken dish and simply moved the flowers into the surviving brass bowl.

hindi: हार मान लेना — बस करो, मैं हारा
definition: surrender and admit defeat, begging opponents to stop the pressure, chiefly American English
example: The little brothers tickled their sister until she cried uncle, laughing, and handed back the remote.

hindi: झूठी दुहाई देना — बार-बार झूठा शोर, फिर कोई नहीं सुनता
definition: raising false alarms repeatedly until genuine truthful warning story stops being believed
example: She reported burglars every second night, so when smoke actually filled her kitchen the neighbours assumed she was crying wolf again.

hindi: रो-रोकर आँखें सुजा लेना — फूट-फूटकर रोना
definition: weeping with long, heavy tears until you feel completely drained and exhausted
example: She cried her eyes out at the station, then laughed when her little brother handed her his only, very crumpled tissue.

hindi: बड़े अफ़सोस की बात — सचमुच दुखद
definition: something truly regrettable and unfortunate, deserving open sorrow because it could have gone better
example: It's a crying shame the old bakery is closing, so the whole street queued on its last morning to buy one final loaf.

hindi: पराया जाया — घर में पला बेगाना
definition: unwelcome outsider living inside a family, quietly resented by the other relatives
example: For years the stepson felt like a cuckoo in the nest, until his stepfather taught him to sharpen chisels on winter evenings.

hindi: झींगुरों की आवाज़ — किसी ने कुछ जवाब नहीं दिया
definition: joking remark noting awkward silence after something falls flat and nobody responds
example: Dad asked who wanted to help clean the garage, and, cue the crickets, the whole family suddenly found their phones.

hindi: सर्दियों का साथ — ठंड में जोड़ी ढूँढना
definition: colder months when single people eagerly seek partners, craving company through long winter evenings
example: By November her group chat was full of friends suddenly coupled up, and she laughed that cuffing season had arrived.

hindi: मतलब का प्यार — स्वार्थी लाड़
definition: affection shown only when wanting something, especially food or favours, in British usage
example: The cat purred against her ankles every evening at six, pure cupboard love until the bowl was filled.

hindi: आधा अच्छा आधा ख़राब — तारीफ़ मजबूरी में
definition: a British term for something partly decent, praised politely although mostly disappointing throughout
example: The school play was a curate's egg, wonderful scenery around actors who forgot every single line.

hindi: परदा गिरने पर सलामी — तालियों के बीच आख़िरी हाज़िरी
definition: final appearance accepting audience applause after performance finishes, bowing before house lights return
example: During the curtain call she pulled the nervous prompter forward, insisting the audience clap for him too.

hindi: पर्दे के पीछे से ताक-झाँक करने वाला पड़ोसी
definition: nosy neighbour secretly prying into street comings and goings, collecting gossip, British usage
example: Every curtain twitcher in the close watched the removal van arrive, then brought biscuits round by teatime.

hindi: खेल ख़त्म — अंत आ गया
definition: final defeat or finish, the moment where someone's chances, career or hopes are completely over; usually 'it's curtains for'
example: When the goalkeeper slipped, it looked like curtains for our team, but little Arjun cleared the ball off the line.

hindi: मौज की नौकरी — आराम का काम
definition: comfortable, pleasant work bringing good reward for little effort, said in British usage
example: Minding the lighthouse gift shop through the quiet winter months turned out to be a cushy number.

hindi: औरों से बेहतर — एक दर्जा ऊपर
definition: noticeably better or superior compared with others of the same kind; usually 'a cut above the rest'
example: The little bakery on the corner is a cut above the rest, and its cinnamon buns sell out before eight each morning.

hindi: दुम दबाकर भागना — मुसीबत देखकर साथ छोड़ देना
definition: abandon a commitment suddenly and leave others behind rather than facing approaching trouble
example: The other two partners cut and run when the roof caved in, leaving Marta alone with the builders and the bills.

hindi: काम में कोताही करना — जल्दबाज़ी में ज़रूरी क़दम छोड़ देना
definition: skip necessary steps carelessly, saving effort while producing shoddier result than promised
example: The contractor cut corners on the terrace waterproofing, and the first proper monsoon quietly announced his shortcut across the ceiling.

hindi: एक ही थैली के चट्टे-बट्टे — स्वभाव में एक जैसे
definition: people who closely resemble each other in character, values, habits, and manner
example: Both brothers gave away their umbrellas in the rain and walked home soaked, cut from the same cloth as their stubbornly generous father.

hindi: ऐन वक़्त पर — बहुत कम समय छोड़ना
definition: leaving barely enough time, delaying until almost missing the deadline completely, British
example: They cut it fine at the station, sprinting down the platform as the guard held the door for Granny's suitcase.

hindi: किसी का घमंड तोड़ना
definition: reduce someone's arrogant self-importance, showing them they hold less power than they assumed
example: Grandma cut the chess champion down to size in eleven moves, then offered him a biscuit.

hindi: आँचल छोड़ना — माता-पिता का सहारा छोड़कर अलग होना
definition: stop depending upon parents and begin living independently, without their constant help
example: He cut the apron strings the summer he moved two cities away, though he still called every Sunday to ask how to cook rice.

hindi: पैरों तले ज़मीन खींच लेना — किसी का आधार छीन लेना
definition: undermine someone's argument or position suddenly, removing the support they were standing upon; fully 'cut the ground from under someone's feet'
example: She cut the ground from under her brother by producing the photo of him eating the last samosa.

hindi: खरा उतरना — काम के लायक साबित होना
definition: prove good enough, meeting the required standard when real demands arrive
example: The old tractor still cuts the mustard, grumbling through every harvest while the shiny new one sits broken.

hindi: नाता तोड़ना — संबंध खत्म कर देना
definition: ending connection with somebody permanently, refusing further involvement or shared responsibility
example: She cut ties with the business partner politely, returned his ledgers, and slept properly for the first time in months.

hindi: सीधे मुद्दे पर आना — भूमिका छोड़कर असली बात
definition: abandon lengthy preamble immediately, reaching important matters without wasting further words
example: After twenty minutes about the weather, Auntie cut to the chase and asked whether anyone liked the boy's photograph.

hindi: दिल को गहरी चोट पहुँचाना — मर्म पर वार
definition: wound someone's feelings deeply, hurting the most tender and personal part of them
example: Her friend's offhand joke about her cooking cut her to the quick, though she only admitted it weeks later over dinner.

term: cut your coat to your cloth
hindi: जितनी चादर हो उतने पैर फैलाना — हैसियत के हिसाब से ख़र्च
definition: match spending carefully to available money, planning ambitions within what your resources actually allow, also 'according to your cloth'
example: Cutting their coat to their cloth, the newlyweds skipped the big hall and threw a garden wedding that everyone still calls the best party ever.

hindi: जितना डूबा सो डूबा — और नुक़सान से पहले पीछे हट जाना
definition: to abandon a failing venture early, accepting a small defeat instead of a larger ruin
example: She cut her losses on the leaking scooter and took the bus home smiling.

hindi: शुरुआती अनुभव पाना — पहली सीख लेना
definition: gain your first practical experience of a craft or career, usually early, before becoming truly skilled
example: The famous chef cut her teeth frying pakoras at her aunt's roadside stall, burning her fingers every single evening.

hindi: सबसे आगे — नवीनतम और उन्नत
definition: newest, most advanced stage of pioneering ideas, where development happens first
example: The retired engineer still reads every journal, determined to stay at the cutting edge of bridge design.

hindi: पापा की परी — पिता की लाडली
definition: daughter especially attached to her father, often adored and spoiled by him since childhood
example: She was a daddy's girl through and through, and at her graduation he cried harder than she did.

hindi: तारीफ़ में छिपा ताना — हल्की प्रशंसा से निंदा
definition: criticise somebody indirectly, offering praise mild enough that listeners understand insult intended
example: The review damned the little restaurant with faint praise, calling the bread reliable and stopping there.

hindi: इधर कुआँ उधर खाई — हर हाल में दोष
definition: trapped between two unpleasant choices, certain to receive blame whichever decision you make; fully 'damned if you do, damned if you don't'
example: Seating the two grandmothers together or apart, the bride knew she was damned if you do, damned if you don't, so she sat herself between them.

hindi: फुस्स पटाखा — बड़े वादे के बाद बेअसर नतीजा
definition: disappointing event promising enormous excitement, ending flatly without anything memorable happening (British)
example: The grand light show turned out a damp squib, though the children enjoyed the generator failing more than the lights.

hindi: बात घुमाना — असली मुद्दे से बचना
definition: avoiding the real topic deliberately, talking evasively around something uncomfortable without addressing it directly
example: He danced around the subject all dinner before finally admitting he had dented the car reversing into a hedge.

hindi: किसी की धुन पर नाचना — मर्ज़ी के मुताबिक चलना
definition: following another person's wishes obediently, moving exactly where their chosen tune directs
example: She refused to dance to her landlord's tune, and repainted the shutters the colour she wanted.

hindi: गाजर दिखाकर दौड़ाना — लालच देकर लटकाना
definition: manipulating hope deliberately, offering tempting promises repeatedly while keeping somebody chasing what never arrives
example: He dangled the carrot of moving cities together whenever she mentioned leaving, then changed the subject again.

hindi: छिपा रुस्तम — जिससे किसी को उम्मीद न थी
definition: an overlooked competitor succeeding unexpectedly, when almost nobody expected such narrow victory
example: The dark horse of the quiz turned out to be the librarian's quiet nephew.

hindi: गहरी निराशा और आत्मिक खालीपन का लंबा दौर
definition: long period of profound despair and spiritual emptiness, when hope and meaning seem lost
example: He called that year his dark night of the soul, and says the letters from his aunt were what carried him through.

hindi: दहलीज़ पर पैर रखना — अनचाहे घर आना
definition: visit an unwelcome household, arriving where nobody wants your presence again
example: After the quarrel over the boundary wall he never darkened their door again, though both families still exchanged sweets silently.

hindi: उम्मीदों पर पानी फेरना — आशा तोड़ देना
definition: destroy someone's hopes completely, leaving them deeply disappointed about something they wanted
example: The rain dashed our hopes of a picnic, so the kids spread the blanket across the living-room floor.

hindi: नए युग का सवेरा — एक नए दौर की शुरुआत
definition: beginning of an important historical period, marking a profound change from everything before
example: When the village finally got a bus service, the old men at the tea stall called it the dawn of a new era.

hindi: रोज़-रोज़ — बिना नागा
definition: daily without break or variation, repeating the same tiring routine endlessly and faithfully
example: Day in, day out, the postman climbed our hill on his bicycle, and on his last day the whole street met him with cake.

hindi: बासी कढ़ी में उबाल — देर से और अधूरी मदद
definition: arriving with help or effort after the chance already passed, offering rather less than the moment needed
example: His apology arrived day late and dollar short, taped to a wilting bunch of flowers outside her door.

hindi: हिसाब का दिन — किए कर्मों का फल भुगतने की घड़ी
definition: future moment when consequences arrive, forcing final accounting regarding earlier behaviour
example: The day of reckoning came with the examination results, and his mother simply made poha and sat beside him.

hindi: दिनदहाड़े लूट — मनमाने दाम वसूलना
definition: an outrageously expensive price that takes much more money than goods honestly deserve
example: Four hundred rupees for two cold samosas at the airport gate felt like daylight robbery.

hindi: बेजान ख़ामोशी — बातचीत में अटपटा सन्नाटा
definition: awkward silence during conversation where nobody speaks, borrowed from radio broadcasting gaps
example: The first date had some dead air over the starters, but by dessert they were laughing about their terrible school uniforms.

hindi: मरा-खपा — पूरी तरह ख़त्म
definition: completely finished and beyond revival, an idea or dispute long abandoned forever
example: We thought the family feud was dead and buried, and it was, once Aunt Meena brought her famous samosas.

hindi: ठंडा पड़ जाना — बिलकुल बेजान हो जाना
definition: completely lifeless and beyond reviving, never useful again and never worth keeping
example: The torch was dead as a doornail halfway through the cave, so we finished the walk by the light of a phone.

hindi: बुझते दीये की भभक — गिरावट से पहले की झूठी बढ़त
definition: brief, misleading recovery after steep collapse, before prices or fortunes keep falling
example: The shop's busy Saturday was only a dead cat bounce, but it gave the owner time to plan a proper farewell sale.

hindi: पक्का दाँव — जीत पहले से तय मानी जाती है
definition: in British betting talk, an outcome treated as absolutely certain, especially horse expected finishing first
example: The taxi driver called the grey mare a dead cert, then spent the journey home explaining exactly what went wrong.

hindi: डूबी नैया — जिसका बचना नामुमकिन
definition: hopelessly doomed person or plan, defenceless against failure nobody believes still avoidable
example: Once the rains failed twice, the rooftop garden scheme became a dead duck, though nobody had courage telling Father directly.

hindi: बराबरी का मुक़ाबला — बराबर पर छूटा
definition: contest finishing exactly level, so competitors cannot be separated and nobody clearly prevails
example: The chilli-eating contest between father and son ended in a dead heat, both of them weeping into the same glass of lassi.

hindi: ठप पड़ जाना — आगे बढ़ने की गुंजाइश न बचना
definition: something stalled completely, with hopeless prospects of moving toward success again
example: Without the second signature the adoption paperwork sat dead in the water, and they waited another winter.

hindi: आते ही दम तोड़ना — शुरू से ही नाकाम
definition: in American usage, of plans or proposals, doomed from their first appearance, producing no results whatsoever
example: Dad's proposal of a camping trip without phones was dead on arrival, though the kids secretly loved the one they eventually took.

hindi: खड़े-खड़े नींद आना — थकान से चूर होना
definition: utterly exhausted and barely able to stand, energy completely drained after prolonged effort
example: Dead on her feet after the night shift, she still stopped to water the tulsi.

hindi: सबूत के साथ धरा जाना — बचने का कोई रास्ता नहीं
definition: trapped completely by evidence proving guilty wrongdoing, leaving denial pointless before investigators
example: Security footage had the delivery driver dead to rights, so he apologised, refunded the missing parcels, and asked for another chance.

hindi: सूखी लकड़ी — बेकार पड़ा बोझ
definition: useless portion kept without purpose, weighing everything down until finally cleared away
example: Clearing the dead wood from the storeroom took a whole Sunday, and revealed a cricket bat nobody remembered.

hindi: कान फाड़ देने वाली चुप्पी — ख़ामोशी जो सब कुछ कह दे
definition: silence so complete and meaningful it feels louder than speech, revealing disapproval
example: His joke at the dinner table was met with deafening silence, until his grandmother finally snorted into her soup.

hindi: किस्मत का खराब पत्ता — हालात शुरू से उलटे
definition: given unfair disadvantage from circumstances nobody chose, starting considerably behind everybody else
example: Dealt a bad hand after the floods, they rebuilt the workshop anyway, and half the lane arrived carrying borrowed tools.

hindi: रिश्ता तोड़ने की चिट्ठी — जुदाई का पैगाम
definition: written message ending a relationship, originally one mailed to soldiers serving overseas, dumping a partner from afar, in American usage
example: The dear John letter reached him at the camp, and his bunkmates shared their chocolate with him all week.

hindi: अंत की आहट — विनाश निकट होने का संकेत
definition: a signal announcing certain ending, warning that final collapse arrives very soon
example: The new highway rang the death knell for the roadside diner, whose cook now feeds truckers two towns away.

hindi: मायूसी फैलाने वाला — हर ख़ुशी में कमी निकालने वाला
definition: gloomy person who always spoils cheerful moods by dwelling on something negative, mostly heard in American English
