example: I don't want to be a Debbie Downer, she said, then admitted the picnic spot flooded every spring, and we moved uphill.

hindi: घाटे में डूबा — खर्च आमदनी से ज़्यादा
definition: owing more money than earned, with accounts showing steady debt month after month
example: The bakery ran deep in the red all winter, then broke even the week the tourists returned.

hindi: मोटी आसामी — खर्चने की भारी ताकत
definition: plentiful wealth available for spending, especially a backer whose money seems almost bottomless
example: The little theatre survived only because a retired judge with deep pockets quietly covered every season's losses.

hindi: सकते में आ जाना — घबराहट से जड़ हो जाना
definition: frozen with panic, staring blankly, unable to move or respond; British speakers often prefer rabbit in the headlights
example: When the teacher called his name he looked like a deer in the headlights, until his best friend mouthed the answer.

hindi: वादा निभाना — जो कहा वो कर दिखाना
definition: succeed completely, delivering exactly what everyone expected and promised, proving doubters wrong
example: She promised her nervous choir they would be ready by spring, and on the night they delivered the goods without a single wobble.

term: devil and the deep blue sea
hindi: आगे कुआँ पीछे खाई — दोनों रास्ते खतरनाक
definition: forced to choose between dangers equally frightening, with nowhere safer remaining between them
example: Between the devil and the deep blue sea, the captain picked the storm over the reef and reached harbour by dawn.

hindi: मौत से खेलना — जानलेवा जोखिम उठाना
definition: take reckless chances that place your life in serious danger, chiefly British
example: Surfing that reef at low tide is dicing with death, the lifeguard told the tourists, before offering them a lesson instead.

hindi: पूरा ज़ोर लगाना — भीतर की छिपी ताक़त खोजना
definition: summon hidden reserves of courage, strength or determination when exhausted and tempted to quit
example: Halfway up the last hill, her legs burning, the charity walker dug deep and waved at the cheering children lining the lane.

hindi: गड्ढा और गहरा करना — बहानों से हालत बदतर
definition: worsen your trouble through clumsy excuses, deepening damage every further attempt
example: Each explanation dug the hole deeper until his sister mercifully changed the subject to cricket.

hindi: एड़ी जमा लेना — जिद पर अड़ जाना
definition: refuse stubbornly to change your position, resisting every pressure toward some compromise
example: Grandfather dug his heels in about the walnut tree, and the extension was redrawn around it, branch by branch.

hindi: अपनी क़ब्र ख़ुद खोदना — अपने विनाश का इंतज़ाम स्वयं करना
definition: someone steadily prepares their downfall through actions that harm themselves beyond repair
example: Every unopened letter from the landlord was another spadeful; she knew she was digging her own grave.

hindi: स्क्रीन से छुट्टी — कुछ दिन बिना फोन
definition: deliberate period without phones, screens, accounts, recovering attention, patience and proper sleep
example: Their weekend digital detox lasted until somebody needed directions, though everybody slept beautifully both nights anyway.

hindi: कौड़ियों के मोल — हर जगह मिलने वाला
definition: extremely common, available everywhere cheaply, therefore hardly valued despite constant abundance
example: Plastic combs were a dime a dozen in that market, yet she still hunted for the wooden ones.

term: dip a toe in the water
hindi: पैर की उँगली डुबोना — छोटे पैमाने पर आज़माकर देखना
definition: attempt something cautiously on a small scale before committing yourself completely
example: She dipped a toe in the water with a weekend stall before renting the little bakery on Church Street.

hindi: बुरे हाल — पैसे और सहारे बिना गंभीर संकट
definition: trapped inside serious trouble, lacking money and support, facing harsh consequences without visible remedy
example: The bakery was in dire straits after the flood until regulars started paying months ahead for their morning bread.

hindi: मिट्टी के मोल — बहुत सस्ता
definition: costing very little money, priced well below what the thing is really worth
example: Mangoes are dirt cheap in June, so the whole street smells sweet by afternoon.

hindi: छिपी कमज़ोरी — शर्म की बात जो कोई मानता नहीं
definition: shameful secret hidden quietly behind a respectable surface, something people privately know but never mention
example: My dirty little secret, I confessed to the book club, is that I always read the last chapter first.

hindi: चुगली करना — किसी की बदनामी वाली बातें फैलाना
definition: spread damaging private gossip about acquaintances, enjoying every unflattering detail thoroughly
example: Two neighbours dished the dirt over the shared wall until the milkman arrived and the conversation turned innocent.

hindi: फूट डालो और राज करो
definition: keeping control over people by setting them against each other, preventing united resistance (also 'divide and conquer')
example: The twins finally saw through their older brother's divide and rule, and teamed up to reclaim the remote.

hindi: रफ़ूचक्कर हो जाना — चुपके से भागना
definition: running away secretly, disappearing suddenly to avoid obligations or trouble; British slang
example: The puppy did a bunk through the garden gate and turned up an hour later at the bakery, covered in flour.

hindi: हवा हो जाना — अचानक नदारद हो जाना
definition: vanish suddenly from somebody's life, avoiding contact rather than explaining departure honestly
example: He did a disappearing act before Diwali, and her mother kept setting an extra plate for two whole evenings.

hindi: चंपत हो जाना — बिना चुकाए भाग निकलना
definition: escape suddenly before payment, punishment, questioning, abandoning obligations behind, British phrasing
example: Their tenant did a runner overnight, leaving three months' rent, half a suitcase, and a kettle still faintly warm.

hindi: पलटी मारना — फ़ैसले से पूरी तरह मुकर जाना
definition: making a complete reversal of an announced decision or policy, abandoning your earlier position entirely
example: The school did a U-turn on banning conkers after the pupils presented a very serious petition.

hindi: आँख बंद करके करना — पूरी महारत से
definition: perform a familiar task with total ease, needing neither attention nor careful thought
example: After thirty years driving the village route, the bus driver could do it blindfolded, though thankfully he never tried.

hindi: रहने दो — मुझे बेवक़ूफ़ मत समझो
definition: reply in British English dismissing a claim as nonsense, suggesting the speaker must think you remarkably gullible
example: 'I'm going to bed early tonight,' said the teenager, and his mother laughed, 'Oh, do me a favour,' eyeing the new game on the shelf.

hindi: एक काम करो — सुझाव से पहले का तकिया कलाम
definition: conversational opener introducing a practical suggestion, meaning simply here is what you should attempt, as said in Indian English
example: Do one thing, beta, said the shopkeeper warmly, take both sizes home and bring back whichever doesn't fit.

hindi: जेल की सज़ा काटना — कैद में वक़्त गुज़ारना
definition: serve prison punishment across months, living confined until sentenced period finishes completely
example: He never hid having done time; instead he taught carpentry behind the school, patient with every clumsy beginner.

hindi: दिमाग़ ख़राब कर देना — उलझाकर परेशान करना
definition: confusing or frustrating you so thoroughly that thinking becomes difficult and tiring in British English
example: Trying to follow the plot of that time-travel film did his head in, but his daughter explained it all during the car ride home.

hindi: सिर पर खून सवार होना — गुस्से में होश खोना
definition: lose your temper completely, becoming furious and ranting loudly about something, British
example: Uncle Pete did his nut when the parking warden ticketed his van, then ended up sharing a flask of tea with her.

hindi: बला टलना — बड़ी मुसीबत ऐन वक़्त पर सिर से टल जाना
definition: escape serious danger narrowly through timing rather than planning, leaving harm barely avoided
example: Their flight was cancelled an hour before the storm shut the airport, and Meera realised they had dodged a bullet.

hindi: दिमाग़ में नहीं बैठता — समझ से परे
definition: joking declaration that some idea makes absolutely no sense, echoing a confused robot
example: My teenage son voluntarily tidied his room? Does not compute, I told my wife, checking whether he had a fever.

hindi: सिर झुकाना — सम्मान में झुकना
definition: showing admiring respect in British usage, acknowledging someone's superior skill with gracious humility
example: Even the rival coach doffed his cap to the schoolgirls who had outplayed his seasoned squad.

hindi: बेतुका बहाना — काम से बचने की झूठी कहानी
definition: feeble, unconvincing excuse offered for avoiding responsibility or failing to finish something expected
example: His excuse sounded like the dog ate my homework, until the dog trotted in carrying half his essay.

hindi: भद्दी हालत — ऊपर से भड़कीला, अंदर बेतरतीब
definition: a British term for something botched, either messy shambles or gaudily overdressed appearance
example: The banner spelled the town wrong, so the mayor called the whole parade a proper dog's dinner.

hindi: कहानी बनाने के लिए करना — मज़े से ज़्यादा किस्सा ज़रूरी
definition: choosing chaotic decisions because they improve your life story rather than your comfort
example: He booked the overnight bus doing it for the plot, and told that miserable journey happily for years.

hindi: उम्मीद मत रखो — जल्दी होने वाला नहीं
definition: warning that something expected will take forever, possibly never happening, so stop hoping
example: "Will the bus come?" "Don't hold your breath," laughed the farmer, and offered the hikers a lift on his tractor.

hindi: काम तमाम — पूरी तरह निपट गया
definition: finished completely and successfully, victory secured, nothing remaining that could possibly change the result; British
example: The wedding cake was iced, boxed and delivered by noon — done and dusted, so the baker finally sat down with a cup of tea.

hindi: बेगार — उबाऊ, भारी और बेनाम काम
definition: British: tedious, unglamorous labour requiring effort rather than skill or thought
example: Grandpa let the grandchildren choose the seeds while he quietly did the donkey work of turning the soil.

hindi: अरसा हो गया — बहुत लंबा समय
definition: extremely long period, British phrase covering many years without contact
example: They had not shared a meal in donkey's years, yet within minutes both were arguing about their grandmother's recipe again.

hindi: मायूसी और निराशा — हर तरफ़ अँधेरा दिखना
definition: gloomy mood of pessimism and despair, where people expect only grim outcomes ahead
example: Despite all the doom and gloom about the harvest, the village still held its festival and danced until midnight.

hindi: बुरी ख़बरों का चक्रव्यूह — जितना पढ़ो उतना डर
definition: endless scrolling through frightening online news, feeling worse after every miserable refresh
example: He climbed out of the doom loop at midnight, put the phone in another room, and slept better than he had all week.

hindi: जैसा किया वैसा भुगता — अपनी ही दवा का स्वाद
definition: unpleasant treatment returned upon somebody exactly as they inflicted earlier, teaching painful lesson
example: Her brother teased everyone about singing until cousins handed him a dose of his own medicine with a microphone.

hindi: समझ से परे बोली — गिटपिट
definition: speech or writing that sounds like complete nonsense because you cannot understand it in British English
example: The mechanic's explanation was double Dutch to her, so he drew the engine on a napkin and pointed at the broken part.

hindi: दुगना या कुछ नहीं — आख़िरी दाँव
definition: final gamble that either doubles whatever debt you already carry or cancels everything; British, American 'double or nothing'
example: Losing the chess game, Sam offered double or quits on the washing up, and lost again to his grinning younger sister.

hindi: दग़ा देना — साथी को धोखा देना
definition: betray someone deceitfully after promising cooperation, secretly working against their interests
example: The kids agreed to split the treasure, but the youngest double-crossed everyone and hid the coins in her sock.

hindi: दोगलापन — दोनों तरफ़ से खेलना
definition: deceitful behaviour pretending loyalty toward one side while secretly working against them
example: After years of his double dealing, both brothers finally compared notes and discovered he had promised each the same field.

hindi: शक्की आदमी — बिना सबूत न मानने वाला
definition: person who refuses belief without personal proof, doubting claims others accept readily enough
example: My father was the family's doubting Thomas and would not trust the new microwave until he had tested it with a cup of tea.

hindi: सड़क पर आ जाना — सब कुछ गँवा बैठना
definition: left without money, work or shelter, unable to afford basic living expenses
example: The tailor was down and out for a season, until an old customer lent him a sewing machine.

hindi: फटेहाल — घिसी एड़ियों वाली तंगहाली
definition: shabby through poverty, wearing worn clothing that quietly reveals shrinking money
example: The bookshop looked rather down at heel, yet the owner still wrapped every purchase in brown paper and string.

hindi: हारा नहीं, थका है — गिरकर भी लड़ने लायक बचा होना
definition: beaten badly though still able to endure painful defeat and recover without surrendering
example: The little theatre lost its grant and half its actors, but the posters still went up: down but not out.

hindi: पूरी तरह चित — उठने लायक़ न रहना
definition: completely beaten and unable to continue, crushing defeat leaving you flattened, from boxing
example: The flu had her down for the count all week, so her flatmates took turns bringing soup.

hindi: मन उतर जाना — दिल बुझा-बुझा रहना
definition: sunk into gloomy unhappy mood that lingers quietly, with spirits flat and nothing cheerful reaching through
example: She had been down in the dumps since the move, so her neighbour arrived with soup and stayed until the kitchen felt loud again.

hindi: मुँह लटकाए — उदास और मायूस
definition: looking visibly gloomy and dejected, spirits sunk so deep your whole face droops
example: Ravi came home down in the mouth after the audition, so his sister made chai and let him talk until the kettle went cold.

hindi: क़िस्मत रूठी होना — बदहाली के दिन
definition: suffering hardship and poverty through persistent misfortune, struggling while chances keep failing
example: Down on his luck, the busker found a note in his case one evening: 'Your song got me through my exam. Coffee's on me.'

hindi: नाली में बहा देना — पैसा और मेहनत बर्बाद
definition: effort and money wasted entirely, usually 'going down the drain', producing nothing except regret
example: Every rupee of the deposit went down the drain when the builder disappeared, and his father still keeps the receipt inside a plastic folder.

hindi: नाली में बह जाना — बेकार चला जाना
definition: in Australian usage, wasted or lost completely, like water swirling away through a plughole
example: All our savings for the caravan went down the gurgler, but Mum laughed and said at least we still had the tent.

hindi: एक कड़ी से दूसरी कड़ी में खो जाना — घंटे कहाँ गए पता नहीं
definition: following link after link online until several hours vanish inside some obscure subject
example: She went down the rabbit hole looking for a recipe and surfaced knowing everything about nineteenth-century canal boats.

hindi: पानी में गया — बर्बाद हो गया
definition: in British usage, completely ruined or wasted, effort and money lost beyond recovery
example: With rain arriving at noon, our picnic plans went down the Swanee, so we ate sandwiches in the car and sang.

hindi: आगे चलकर — भविष्य में किसी समय
definition: later on, sometime in the future, postponed until circumstances finally make things possible, Australian and British English
example: A bigger kitchen might come down the track, Nan said, but for now the whole family squeezed happily round the little table.

hindi: मिट्टी में मिलना — बर्बाद होना
definition: in American usage, heading swiftly towards ruin, with money, chances or quality steadily lost
example: Just when the diner seemed headed down the tubes, the regulars started bringing friends every Friday night.

hindi: ज़मीन से जुड़ा — सादा और व्यवहारिक स्वभाव
definition: practical, modest, sensible about ordinary matters, never pretending greater importance than deserved
example: For somebody with three factories he stayed remarkably down to earth, queuing with everyone else at the vegetable stall.

hindi: आख़िरी दम तक — अंतिम क्षण तक अनिश्चित रहना
definition: continuing until the final moments before a deadline, undecided until time nearly expires
example: The village chess final went down to the wire, with both players hunched over the board past midnight.

hindi: कीचड़ में घसीटना — इज़्ज़त उतार देना
definition: damage somebody's reputation publicly, repeating accusations until respect disappears among listeners
example: The campaign dragged his family through the mud, and his mother stopped answering the telephone.

hindi: टालमटोल करना — जान-बूझकर धीमे चलकर काम लटकाना
definition: deliberately delaying, working slowly because someone dislikes what they must finish
example: Ravi dragged his feet over packing the flat, folding each shirt twice, because folding meant leaving and leaving meant goodbye.

hindi: दिमाग़ सुन्न हो जाना — कुछ याद न आना
definition: remember nothing whatever when questioned, memory emptying completely during important examinations
example: Standing before the history paper, Ravi drew a blank until the invigilator quietly offered him water.

term: draw a line in the sand
hindi: हद तय करना — इसके आगे नहीं
definition: declare a firm limit during confrontation, warning opponents that crossing means serious consequences
example: When her roommate borrowed her toothbrush, Priya finally drew a line in the sand.

hindi: बात यहीं ख़त्म — किसी प्रकरण पर पूर्ण विराम लगाना
definition: to deliberately stop an unpleasant activity, ending further involvement and treating the matter closed
example: She drew a line under the whole quarrel by inviting both brothers to lunch and refusing to mention the land.

hindi: लंबी हाँकना — बात बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना
definition: exaggerating wildly, stretching facts into claims nobody quite believes, Australian and British usage
example: Saying the backyard cricket match drew a crowd of hundreds was drawing a long bow, since it was mostly cousins.

hindi: पर्दा डालना — अप्रिय बात को ढक देना
definition: deliberately avoid discussing something embarrassing, keeping unpleasant details politely hidden
example: We shall draw a veil over Uncle's attempt at karaoke and remember instead his beautiful toast.

hindi: गोलियाँ अपने ऊपर लेना — दूसरे को बचाने के लिए निशाना बनना
definition: attract concentrated criticism onto yourself, pulling hostile attention away from somebody weaker beside you
example: She drew fire deliberately at the meeting, asking the rudest question herself so the junior architect could breathe.

hindi: हद तय कर देना — यहाँ से आगे नहीं
definition: refuse firmly beyond certain point, setting limits which others must respect afterwards
example: She helped with the accounts happily, though she drew the line at answering the phone during dinner.

hindi: बुरा हिस्सा हाथ आना
definition: become the unlucky person chosen for an unpleasant task nobody else wanted
example: Ben drew the short straw and had to tell Grandma the cake had fallen, but she just laughed and fetched spoons.

hindi: सपना सच होना — मनोकामना पूरी होना
definition: something wonderful you longed for finally happening, bringing delighted fulfilment of long-held hopes
example: For a boy from a village without a pitch, walking out at the stadium was a dream come true.

hindi: क़यामत ढाने वाला बनाव — कपड़ों से क़हर बरपाना
definition: wearing deliberately spectacular clothing, appearance calculated until strangers stare admiringly while passing
example: They arrived dressed to kill for a birthday that turned out involving cricket, mud, and paper plates.

hindi: सोलह सिंगार करके तैयार — पूरी सज-धज में
definition: wearing your finest clothes elaborately, groomed carefully for some important social occasion
example: Grandmother came downstairs dressed to the nines for a lunch that turned out to be four cousins and a plate of pakoras.

hindi: नाक में दम करना — परेशान करके खिझाना
definition: annoy someone relentlessly through repeated irritating behaviour until their patience wears completely thin
example: The twins' endless knock-knock jokes drove their mother up the wall, yet she laughed at the hundredth one anyway.

hindi: बात दिल में उतारना — ज़ोर देकर समझाना
definition: make listeners fully understand an argument by stressing it forcefully and repeatedly
example: The coach drove his point home by replaying the missed tackle three times while the whole team watched in silence.

hindi: धमाका करना — अचानक चौंकाने वाली ख़बर देना
definition: reveal shocking news suddenly, announcing something unexpected that stuns everyone listening
example: Over Sunday lunch Nani dropped a bombshell: at eighty-one, she had signed up for salsa lessons.

hindi: गच्चा खा जाना — भारी भूल भरी बात
definition: commit an embarrassing verbal blunder, British usage, saying something tactless everybody notices instantly
example: He dropped a clanger by congratulating them on retirement, then spent the evening apologising over the biscuits.

hindi: ऊँट के मुँह में जीरा — बड़ी ज़रूरत के आगे मामूली मदद
definition: tiny insufficient amount compared against enormous surrounding need, chiefly British, achieving little visible improvement
example: Their collection felt like a drop in the ocean until fourteen neighbours added theirs, which repaired the whole school roof.

hindi: गायब हो जाना — बिना बताए संपर्क तोड़ देना
definition: vanishing from somebody's attention completely, withdrawing every message without offering explanation
example: She dropped off the radar after their third date, resurfacing eight months later asking about his sister's wedding.

hindi: चूक जाना — जिम्मेदारी संभाल नहीं पाना
definition: fail through careless mistake, mishandling responsibility everybody trusted you would manage
example: He dropped the ball on the tickets, and the whole family watched the concert from a pavement screen.

hindi: रस्सी छोड़ देना — खींचातानी में हिस्सा न लेना
definition: stopping engagement completely in a pointless argument, refusing further pulling against somebody
example: Halfway through the same old argument about the thermostat she dropped the rope, made cocoa, and the evening recovered.

hindi: ग़म ग़लत करना — दुख भुलाने के लिए पीना
definition: drinking heavily to forget sorrows, disappointments or heartbreak, hoping the pain fades
example: After the breakup his friends offered to help him drown his sorrows, but he chose a long karaoke night instead.

hindi: पीकर लुढ़क जाना — पूरी तरह नशे में धुत
definition: thoroughly intoxicated after heavy drinking, unsteady and cheerfully incapable of sense
example: The groom's friend arrived drunk as a skunk, sang three film songs badly, and slept peacefully through the ceremony.

hindi: बीच मंच पर शब्द भूल जाना — ज़बान चुप हो जाना
definition: forgetting your words completely during performance, standing silent while waiting audience watches
example: He dried up on stage during the second verse, and the whole choir carried him gently through.

hindi: इधर-उधर बचते फिरना — चालाकी से निकल जाना
definition: dodging obligations and difficulties cleverly, surviving by evasion and quick improvising; British slang
example: He ducked and dived through his twenties, then settled down running the friendliest corner shop in town.

hindi: चुटकियों का काम — बिना मेहनत का काम
definition: ridiculously simple task needing almost zero effort or skill, said in American usage
example: After years of fixing tractors, changing the lawnmower blade was duck soup for her.

hindi: सवाल टाल जाना — जवाब से बचना
definition: avoiding answering something awkward, evading directly with a clever change of subject
example: When asked who ate the last samosa, Grandpa ducked the question by suddenly admiring the weather.

hindi: कूड़े में लगी आग — बेकाबू अव्यवस्था
definition: in American usage, chaotic disaster spreading beyond control, a situation spectacularly ruined and still burning
example: The group project had become a dumpster fire, so we ordered pizza and rebuilt the slides together at midnight.

hindi: सबके सामने खिल्ली उड़ाना — तालियों के लिए बेइज़्ज़ती
definition: publicly humiliate somebody online with mocking replies, harvesting applause from watching strangers
example: Rather than dunking on the beginner, he answered the question properly, and half the thread quietly calmed down.

hindi: मिलकर डटने का जज़्बा — संकट में हार न मानना
definition: stubborn British refusal to surrender during crisis, everyone pulling together cheerfully when things look hopeless
example: When the power failed during the village fête, the Dunkirk spirit kicked in and someone started a candlelit sing-along.

hindi: झाड़-पोंछ कर उठना — नाकामी के बाद फिर सँभलना
definition: recovering composure after failure or embarrassment, standing again and continuing without dwelling on it
example: He forgot his lines in the school play, dusted himself off, and asked the drama teacher for a bigger part next year.

hindi: दोनों तरफ़ दाँव — सुरक्षित चाल
definition: cautious choice hedging between possibilities so something is gained whichever outcome arrives; British and Australian, borrowed from horse-racing wagers
example: Applying to both the art school and the engineering course was her each-way bet, and she happily got into both.

hindi: बाज़ जैसी नज़र — बारीक़ बात पकड़ लेना
definition: noticing every small detail while watching closely, missing almost nothing
example: Under the tailor's eagle eye, nobody dared claim the two sleeves were exactly equal.

hindi: अपनी रोटी हलाल करना — अपनी उपयोगिता साबित करना
definition: contribute enough useful work to justify being paid, housed, or kept around
example: The farm dog earned his keep rounding up the geese every evening, then flopped by the stove like a king.

hindi: तजुर्बे से पहचान कमाना — मेहनत से क़ाबिलियत साबित करना
definition: prove your ability through hard experience, gaining respect others grant only gradually
example: He earned his stripes washing dishes for years before the head cook let him season the sauce.

term: easy as falling off a log
hindi: बाएँ हाथ का खेल — बहुत ही आसान
definition: ridiculously simple, needing almost zero effort, skill or careful thought from anybody
example: Once she showed him the trick, folding the fitted sheet was easy as falling off a log.

hindi: पानी पीने जितना आसान — बिलकुल सरल
definition: something achieved easily, without effort, trouble, struggle, because nothing about task feels difficult
example: Grandmother folded the paper twice, snipped once, and the paper lantern appeared, easy as pie.

hindi: पलक झपकते — बिल्कुल आसानी से
definition: finished within moments, every step quick, painless and simple as blinking an eyelid, said in British usage
example: Her grandson set up the video call easy as winking, then showed her how to do it herself.

hindi: जैसे आया वैसे गया — आसानी से मिला, आसानी से गया
definition: cheerful shrug about losing something gained easily, accepting its departure without regret
example: He lost the raffle winnings on a broken kite that same afternoon, laughed, and said easy come, easy go.

hindi: आसान निशाना — भोला-भाला आदमी
definition: trusting person readily cheated or swindled by tricksters and con artists, said in American usage
example: Street sellers spotted Dad as an easy mark and he came home with three umbrellas and no rain.

hindi: आसान शिकार — जिसे आसानी से हराया या ठगा जाए
definition: opponent or target easily beaten, fooled or exploited, posing hardly any threat, said in British usage
example: The chess club veterans thought the new girl was easy meat until she won six games straight.

hindi: आँखों को भाने वाला — देखने में सुकून देने वाली सूरत
definition: pleasantly attractive, appearance restful rather than dazzling, comfortable admiring somebody quietly
example: Their neighbour was easy on the eyes, though Amma insisted his kindness toward stray puppies mattered considerably more.

hindi: चुटकी बजाते — बहुत आसान
definition: playful rhyming cheer announcing that something turned out wonderfully simple and effortless
example: Her daughter tied her own shoelaces for the first time, then announced, easy peasy lemon squeezy.

hindi: मुँह की खाना — अपनी बात वापस लेकर शर्मिंदा होना
definition: humbly admit being wrong, swallowing embarrassment after confident claims proved mistaken, chiefly American English
example: Uncle Ravi ate crow at dinner, admitting the vegetarian biryani was better than his mutton one.

hindi: आपके इशारों पर चलना — पूरी तरह मोहित
definition: be completely charmed and willing, obeying whatever someone suggests because you adore or trust them entirely
example: Ten minutes into her story about the elephant, the new teacher had the whole class eating out of her hand.

hindi: दिमाग़ खाना — बक-बक करके परेशान करना
definition: used for pestering someone endlessly with nagging chatter or questions, also said as 'eat your head', as said in Indian English
example: Stop eating my brain about the wedding menu, Amma, I promise the caterer already knows you want extra jalebis.

hindi: मूँछ मुँड़वा देना — पक्का दावा कि ऐसा कभी नहीं होगा
definition: promise something ridiculous because you feel certain a doubted event will never happen; said as I'll eat my hat
example: Dad said he would eat his hat if the village team won the cup, and when they did the whole pub brought him a cake shaped like one.

hindi: अपनी कही बात निगलना — भविष्यवाणी गलत निकलने पर पलटना
definition: retract confident statements publicly, admitting your earlier boastful prediction proved completely wrong
example: She had to eat her words when the little shop she called doomed opened a second branch across the road.

hindi: उँगलियों पर नाचना — पूरी तरह वश में होना
definition: completely charmed and persuaded, willingly doing whatever you suggest after your flattery worked
example: One magic trick at the party and the new stepdad had all four children eating out of his hand.

hindi: आधा सच बोलना — सच का ज़रूरी हिस्सा छिपा जाना
definition: telling technically accurate story while deliberately hiding important truthful details from listeners
example: He mentioned passing the driving test but stayed economical with the truth about the three earlier attempts.

hindi: मुँह पर कालिख — सबके सामने बेइज़्ज़ती
definition: obvious public embarrassment following confident claims that collapsed humiliatingly before witnesses
example: He had egg on his face after promising rain would hold off, standing there completely soaked.

hindi: हाथ-पैर की मेहनत — रगड़-रगड़ कर किया गया श्रम
definition: vigorous physical labour applied through tiring hours, scrubbing harder rather than buying gadgets
example: Papa insisted the brass lamps needed only tamarind paste and honest elbow grease, and by evening they threw light everywhere.

hindi: सामने का सच जिसे कोई नहीं छेड़ता — सबको पता, कोई नहीं बोलता
definition: obvious troubling problem everybody notices although nobody willingly mentions aloud
example: The empty chair beside the sweets was the elephant in the room, so relatives talked cheerfully about traffic instead.

hindi: ग्यारहवीं घड़ी — समय-सीमा से ठीक पहले का क्षण
definition: the final moments before a deadline, when remaining time nearly expires entirely
example: At the eleventh hour his brother arrived with the missing photographs, and the album was finished before the guests woke.

hindi: राजा नंगा है — सब जानते हैं, कोई कहता नहीं
definition: collective pretence about something worthless that nobody admits seeing through, until reality gets spoken aloud
example: The whole committee praised the sculpture until a child asked what part was supposed to be the horse.

hindi: सूना घोंसला — बच्चों के जाने के बाद खाली घर
definition: quiet parental household remaining after grown children leave permanently for independent living
example: They filled the empty nest with a badminton net and two rescued kittens, and pretended the noise was entirely accidental.

hindi: आँसुओं पर ख़त्म होना — अंत में दुख ही हाथ आना
definition: finish in unhappiness, disappointment or trouble, often after a situation started with excitement and laughter
example: Mum warned the pillow fight would end in tears, and sure enough she was soon icing a small, giggling bruised nose.

hindi: एक युग का अंत — लंबे दौर का ख़त्म होना
definition: closing of a long familiar period, when something people depended upon finishes forever
example: When the corner sweet shop closed after sixty years, the whole street agreed it was the end of an era.

hindi: आख़िरी पड़ाव — आगे कोई राह नहीं
definition: point where something finishes for good, with no further progress, recovery or options possible
example: The mechanic gently said it was the end of the road for our old van, so we drove it to the beach one last time.

hindi: प्रतिक्रिया की खेती — बस टिप्पणियाँ बटोरने के लिए तमाशा
definition: posting provocative material purely to harvest replies, attention and larger audience numbers
example: Once she spotted the engagement farming behind those daily arguments, the whole account stopped being interesting.

hindi: दिमाग़ की बत्ती जलना — अचानक हल सूझ जाना
definition: sudden triumphant realisation when the answer to a long puzzling problem finally becomes clear
example: Her eureka moment came in the bath: the leaking tap was dripping because the washer had been fitted upside down.

hindi: बराबरी करना — बदला लेकर हिसाब बराबर
definition: retaliate against someone until the injuries between you feel balanced, restoring fairness
example: After losing the snowball fight, the younger cousins waited behind the shed to even the score.

hindi: सुलह का हाथ बढ़ाना — पहल करके शांति का प्रस्ताव देना
definition: offer a peaceful gesture toward former enemies, inviting them to settle their lingering quarrel
example: He extended an olive branch by saving the corner seat, the one they had argued about every winter.

hindi: आँखों की ठंडक — सिर्फ़ देखने लायक़ सुंदरता
definition: someone attractive enough simply pleasing viewers, admired purely for looks rather than substance
example: The film's plot was thin, but the costumes and the leading man gave audiences plenty of eye candy.

hindi: आँख के बदले आँख — बराबर का बदला
definition: retaliation exactly matching the original injury, punishment repaid in equal measure, nothing more
example: Grandpa never believed in an eye for an eye; when the boys broke his window, he asked them to help him fix it.

hindi: आंखों की भूख — पेट से ज़्यादा थाली भर लेना
definition: wanting considerably more helping than appetite manages, taking beyond reasonable comfortable capacity
example: His eyes were bigger than his stomach at the buffet, and half the sweets travelled home wrapped in a napkin.

hindi: अपनी कॉपी देखो — दूसरों की रफ़्तार से मतलब नहीं
definition: chiefly American; giving attention only to personal business, progress, choices, ignoring other people
example: Every friend's wedding announcement rattled him until his sister said, kindly, eyes on your own paper.

hindi: बुझा-बुझा चेहरा — निराशा टपकती सूरत
definition: looking gloomily miserable in Irish and British usage, spoiling everybody's cheerfulness
example: Our driver had a face like a wet weekend until the road opened onto the coast, and even he admitted it looked lovely.

hindi: चेहरा तमतमाना — गुस्से से भरा चेहरा
definition: dark scowling expression showing grumpy anger that everyone reads before anything is said, chiefly British
example: Ravi walked in with a face like thunder after the bus broke down, so his sister quietly handed him a cold mango lassi.

hindi: अंजाम भुगतना — किए का सामना करना
definition: accept unpleasant consequences openly, standing before deserved criticism about your careless earlier actions
example: He finally switched off his phone, walked into the staff room and faced the music while his cousin waited outside with the scooter.

hindi: अपने डर से आँख मिलाना — भीतर के भय का सामना करना
definition: confront your deepest fears, painful memories or personal weaknesses bravely instead of avoiding them
example: Returning to the lake where he had nearly drowned, Dev faced his demons and swam slowly across while his daughter cheered.

hindi: ईमानदारी से — नियम के मुताबिक़
definition: honestly and fairly, winning without cheating, trickery, favouritism or bending any agreed rules
example: Little Zoya beat her uncle at carrom fair and square, and he proudly told the whole family at dinner.

hindi: सच्चा — असली, खरा
definition: in Australian usage, genuinely honest and authentic, real without trickery; also asks whether something is truly so
example: He's a fair dinkum bloke who fixed our fence for nothing because he saw the kids' puppy kept escaping.

hindi: बराबरी का मौक़ा दो — इंसाफ़ करो
definition: appeal demanding reasonable equal treatment, honest chance without hidden advantage, distinctly Australian, stretched into fair crack of the whip
example: The youngest bowler asked politely for a fair go, and the captain handed over the ball without further argument.

hindi: बराबर का मौक़ा — इंसाफ़ भरा बर्ताव
definition: in American English: fair and honest treatment, receiving equal chances like everyone else involved
example: The coach made sure even the smallest girl got a fair shake at batting, so she practised every evening in the yard.

hindi: सुख का साथी — मुसीबत में साथ छोड़ने वाला दोस्त
definition: companion enjoying pleasant times, disappearing quietly once genuine trouble finally arrives
example: The fair-weather friends stopped visiting after the business closed, while the quiet neighbour brought vegetables every Thursday.

hindi: पहले ही क़दम पर लड़खड़ाना — शुरुआत में ही हार
definition: fail right at the earliest stage, defeated by the very first difficulty encountered
example: My attempt at sourdough fell at the first hurdle when the starter went mouldy, so my neighbour gave me some of hers.

hindi: धोबी का कुत्ता, न घर का न घाट का — दो रास्तों के बीच नाकाम
definition: in British usage, fail by trying to satisfy competing aims at once, succeeding at neither
example: The film fell between two stools, too scary for children and too silly for adults, yet our family still quotes it.

hindi: बीच राह छूट जाना — अधूरा रह जाना
definition: withdraw or become abandoned partway, failing to continue while others keep going
example: Most of our new-year resolutions fell by the wayside, except Dad's promise to cook every Sunday.

hindi: फुस्स हो जाना — कोई असर छोड़े बिना बेकार जाना
definition: failing badly before an audience, when a rehearsed attempt collapses into a ruined, awkward mistake
example: His carefully rehearsed toast fell flat, though his aunt kindly clapped anyway and refilled everybody's glasses to cover the silence.

hindi: नज़रों से गिरना — इज़्ज़त और रुतबा दोनों गँवा देना
definition: losing power and high standing after once being widely trusted
example: The champion's fall from grace took one careless season, and the trophy shelf gathered dust after that.

hindi: बलि का बकरा — दूसरों के गुनाह का इल्ज़ाम ढोने वाला
definition: person chosen deliberately, accepting blame plus punishment while genuine wrongdoers stay comfortably hidden
example: They needed a fall guy before the audit landed, and the newest clerk simply happened to sign that register last.

hindi: सिर के बल गिरना — किसी पर पूरी तरह मोहित हो जाना
definition: become suddenly and completely enamoured with someone, losing every ordinary defence against romantic feeling
example: He swore he would stay single until spring, then fell head over heels beside the bookshop counter.

hindi: नज़रों से गिरना — सम्मान खो देना
definition: used for losing someone's respect after disappointing them, dropping in their estimation and honour, as said in Indian English
example: He confessed breaking the window before anyone asked, knowing lying would make him fall in his father's eyes.

hindi: क़तार में आ जाना — बात मान लेना
definition: begin obeying authority and conforming after earlier resistance, following what others expect
example: The cousins grumbled about the early start, then fell into line once breakfast smells drifted upstairs.

hindi: सब सुलझ जाना — टुकड़े जुड़ जाना
definition: scattered confusing pieces of information suddenly connect, making the whole puzzle finally make sense
example: Once the detective learned the twins had swapped coats, every strange clue fell into place at once.

hindi: बैठे बिठाए मिल जाना — बिना मेहनत सौभाग्य आना
definition: fortunate opportunity arriving effortlessly without planning, requiring almost nothing from yourself
example: The corner shop fell into her lap when the owner retired and remembered her kindness during monsoon.

hindi: एकदम लुढ़कना — अचानक धड़ाम से गिरना
definition: undergo sudden, steep decline, figures or sales collapsing dramatically almost overnight
example: Ice cream sales fell off a cliff when the storm rolled in, so the van man handed out free cones to the lifeguards.

hindi: बुरे दिन आना — अचानक ग़रीबी में घिरना
definition: suddenly slide into poverty and hardship after losing money, work, health or fortune
example: When the old tailor fell on hard times, the whole lane quietly ordered new shirts they didn't really need.

hindi: मुँह के बल गिरना — भरोसे के साथ जाकर पिटना
definition: attempt something confidently, fail publicly, suffering embarrassing collapse before people watching closely
example: She fell flat on her face during the debate, then won the next round because everybody remembered how gracefully she recovered.

hindi: अपनी गर्दन खुद पेश करना — इस्तीफ़ा देकर दोष लेना
definition: resign honourably, accepting blame publicly so colleagues escape further punishment
example: The old editor fell on his sword after the misprint, insisting the young reporters keep their positions.

hindi: झूठा झंडा — दोष दूसरे पर डालने की चाल
definition: deceitful operation disguised so blame falls deliberately upon someone else entirely innocent
example: The prank letter was a false flag, signed with the twins' names by the cousin who actually wrote it.

hindi: आग भड़काना — पहले से जल रहे झगड़े को और हवा देना
definition: deliberately worsen existing quarrel with provoking words that inflame conflict already burning fiercely
example: The neighbours were arguing about parking, and the chai stall regulars fanned the flames with cheerful commentary.

hindi: ताबड़तोड़ — धुआँधार
definition: wildly energetic and rapid, full of hectic action happening at breathless pace
example: The pillow fight was fast and furious until someone knocked over Grandma's favourite lamp.

hindi: पक्की दोस्ती — गहरे और टिकाऊ मित्र
definition: friends bound firmly and loyally together, where fast means fixed rather than quick, lasting through years
example: They met arguing over the last seat on the school bus and were fast friends by the end of the week.

hindi: धन्ना सेठ — मोटा पैसे वाला
definition: wealthy, privileged person, especially someone earning excessive money while others struggle, used disapprovingly
example: The fat cats upstairs got bonuses, grumbled the cleaners, until the boss handed them one too.

hindi: हरगिज़ नहीं — ऐसा होने से रहा
definition: scornful remark insisting something is practically impossible and will certainly never happen
example: "You think he'll tidy his room before the guests arrive? Fat chance," laughed Mum, handing her son a laundry basket anyway.

hindi: पाँचों उँगलियाँ घी में
definition: the finest and richest things available, usually in live off the fat of the land, enjoyed comfortably without much effort
example: Retired to the hills, the couple lived off the fat of the land, trading jam for honey with neighbours.

hindi: गौरव की बात — गर्व करने लायक उपलब्धि
definition: achievement bringing honour and pride, adding something admirable to your record
example: Winning the county baking prize was a feather in her cap, and the rosette hung in the kitchen for years.

hindi: अपने घर जैसा लगना — पूरी तरह सहज महसूस करना
definition: completely relaxed, comfortable, unhurried within surroundings, treating unfamiliar place like personal space
example: Within an hour of arriving she was feeding their cat and making tea, feeling at home already.

hindi: लाखों का महसूस करना — बेहद अच्छा और आत्मविश्वासी महसूस करना
definition: feel wonderfully healthy, attractive and confident; contented, satisfied and glowing with personal wellbeing
example: Freshly shaved and wearing the suit his daughter picked, Papa said he felt like a million dollars walking into the reunion.

hindi: तंगी महसूस होना — पैसों की कमी चुभना
definition: begin suffering money shortage as household budgets are squeezed tight by rising costs or smaller earnings, also 'feel the squeeze'
example: When the factory cut overtime, the Mehtas started to feel the pinch and swapped Sunday dinners out for long picnics in the park.

hindi: टटोल कर आगे बढ़ना — हर कदम जाँच कर चलना
definition: advance slowly and cautiously, checking each step before committing yourself further
example: New to the language and the city, he felt his way through the first month one polite sentence at a time.

hindi: मन उदास होना — बिना कारण मन भारी लगना
definition: quietly sinking into mild sadness without obvious reason, feeling gloomy rather than seriously unwell
example: She was feeling blue all Sunday, so her brother put on the old film songs and made a pot of chai.

hindi: मिट्टी के पैर — पूजनीय व्यक्ति की छिपी कमज़ोरी
definition: hidden weakness spoiling someone widely admired, revealing disappointing character beneath reputation
example: Her favourite poet turned out to have feet of clay, and she loved the poems slightly more carefully afterwards.

hindi: पैर ज़मीन पर रखना — कामयाबी में भी व्यवहारिक रहना
definition: staying practical amid excitement, judging ordinary matters sensibly instead of drifting into pleasant fantasy
example: Her first film succeeded enormously, yet she kept both feet on the ground and finished her college examinations.

hindi: गिनती के, कहीं-कहीं — बहुत कम और छितरे हुए
definition: occurring rarely and scattered widely apart, leaving long empty stretches between appearances
example: Buses along that hill road are few and far between, so the shopkeeper keeps a bench outside for whoever ends up waiting.

term: few bricks shy of a load
hindi: दिमाग़ में कुछ ईंटें कम — नासमझ सा इंसान
definition: foolish person lacking sensible intelligence, thinking that seems incomplete beside ordinary judgement
example: Anyone painting a roof during monsoon seemed a few bricks shy of a load, though his terrace never leaked again.

hindi: आग लगी हो और बाँसुरी बजाना — संकट में बेपरवाही
definition: busying yourself with trivial pleasures while neglecting a serious crisis that urgently demands your attention
example: While the kitchen flooded, my brother kept tuning his guitar, fiddling while Rome burned until Mum handed him a mop.

hindi: हारी हुई लड़ाई लड़ना — बेकार की जद्दोजहद
definition: keep struggling against something hopeless where eventual defeat seems certain whatever effort continues
example: Keeping the white sofa clean with three puppies in the house was a losing battle she happily fought.

hindi: हटते-हटते लड़ना — हार को टालने की देर तक कोशिश
definition: resist stubbornly while steadily retreating, delaying inevitable defeat rather than stopping opponents altogether
example: The old cinema fought a rearguard action for three years, selling cheaper tickets each season until the shutters stayed down.

hindi: लोहे को लोहा काटता है — उसी तरीके से जवाब
definition: answer an opponent's aggressive tactics using those same tactics, matching force with force
example: When the rival stall started shouting prices, the old flower seller fought fire with fire and sang hers instead.

hindi: कुत्ते-बिल्ली की तरह लड़ना — हर बात पर झगड़ा
definition: quarrel constantly and noisily, bickering fiercely yet somehow remaining close through everything
example: The twins fight like cat and dog all week, then insist on sharing the same bunk every weekend.

hindi: जी-जान से लड़ना — पूरी ताक़त से डटे रहना
definition: struggling fiercely with every possible effort, determined never to surrender, yield or give ground
example: The neighbours fought tooth and nail to save the old banyan tree, and it still shades the bus stop today.

hindi: अपने पक्ष की लड़ाई लड़ना — अपनी बात पर डटे रहना
definition: defend, in British usage, your interests or opinion determinedly, especially against stronger opposition
example: As the youngest of five, Leela learned early to fight her corner at the dinner table.

hindi: जीतने का मौक़ा — कोशिश से संभव
definition: reasonable chance of success, possible only through determined effort against real difficulty
example: The extra tutoring gave Arjun a fighting chance in the exam, and he spent every evening at the kitchen table working.

hindi: किसी की जगह संभालना — उतनी ही ज़िम्मेदारी निभाना
definition: take over another person's position successfully, carrying responsibilities they handled before leaving
example: When the old headmaster retired, nobody quite believed the quiet science teacher could fill his shoes so calmly.

hindi: फ़िल्मी ड्रामा — बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर नाटक
definition: used for exaggerated melodramatic behaviour, like overwrought family scenes straight from cinema, as said in Indian English
example: Her brother's filmy drama at the airport, kneeling with roses, made the whole departure lounge clap for their reunion.

hindi: मालामाल — बेतहाशा दौलत वाला
definition: possessing enormous wealth, rich enough that money stops being something worth counting
example: The quiet uncle who repaired radios turned out to be filthy rich, with land across three districts.

hindi: खेल ख़त्म होना — अंतिम पल जब सब कुछ समाप्त हो जाता है
definition: the concluding moment marking a final ending, after which something stops continuing altogether
example: The theatre's final curtain came on a rainy Tuesday, and the ushers kept their torches as souvenirs.

hindi: आख़िरी चरण — अंतिम कुछ क़दम
definition: closing final stage where remaining strength decides outcome, British racing phrasing
example: Their fundraising reached the final furlong with barely enough donations, until the neighbourhood bakery quietly covered the shortfall.

hindi: पैर जमाना — नई जगह में सहज होना
definition: gradually gain confidence and skill after arriving somewhere unfamiliar or starting something different
example: Ravi was painfully shy his first term at college, but by spring he had found his feet and joined three clubs.

hindi: हर काम में टाँग अड़ाना — हर जगह दख़ल
definition: influence or involvement in many different affairs, meddling everywhere around your community
example: Pinky Aunty has a finger in every pie, from the temple committee to the cricket club's tea menu.

hindi: अंदर की आग — कुछ कर दिखाने का जुनून
definition: strong inner passion and determination driving someone to keep striving towards their goals
example: At seventy, he still had fire in his belly and opened a small bookshop in the village square.

hindi: जोश में — उत्साह से लबालब
definition: passionately eager, charged with excitement and enthusiasm, ready to start tackling something immediately, spirits burning bright
example: Coming home from the climate march, Zoya was so fired up she started a recycling scheme for the whole building.

hindi: पूरे दम से चलना — पूरी ताक़त पर प्रदर्शन
definition: performing energetically at full capacity, every part working smoothly toward strong results
example: After lunch the debate team was firing on all cylinders, and their teacher stopped taking notes just watching.

hindi: सबसे पहले मैदान में — शुरुआत में ही आगे
definition: gaining an early advantage by starting before rivals, like horses leaving the starting gate
example: Her little cafe was first out of the gate with pumpkin soup this autumn, and the queue curled down the lane.

hindi: सबसे पहले मंज़िल पर — बाज़ी जीतने वाला
definition: being the earliest to finish or succeed, beating every competitor to the winning line; also British term for plurality voting
example: Whoever is first past the post with the washing-up chooses the film, Dad announced, and three children sprinted for the sink.

hindi: पानी से बाहर मछली — बेगानी जगह में असहज
definition: uncomfortable awkward person among unfamiliar surroundings, clearly belonging somewhere completely different
example: At the formal dinner he looked a fish out of water until another guest quietly asked him about pigeons.

hindi: लंबी-चौड़ी गप — बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहा गया किस्सा
definition: wildly exaggerated story, especially boasting about something that escaped, invented or embellished, American usage
example: Uncle Ray's fish story about the pike that dragged his boat got another foot longer every Thanksgiving.

hindi: तारीफ़ की भीख माँगना — बहाने से वाहवाही बटोरना
definition: inviting admiration indirectly, mentioning modest worries hoping listeners supply flattering reassurance
example: Grumbling about his cooking while everyone reached for seconds was plainly fishing for compliments, and nobody minded giving them.

hindi: चंगा-भला होना — पूरी तरह स्वस्थ
definition: enjoying excellent health, strong and energetic with nothing physically wrong anywhere
example: Fit as a fiddle at seventy, she walks the whole lake before the shops open.

hindi: हाथ-पैर जवाब दे गए — किसी काम लायक नहीं बचना
definition: weakened completely in Irish and Scottish usage, unable to manage the simplest household chores
example: The heat left him fit for nothing, so he lay under the mango tree while his daughters finished the sweeping.

hindi: आपे से बाहर — गुस्से में बेकाबू
definition: extremely furious and agitated, so angry someone might need restraining from lashing out, American
example: The coach was fit to be tied after the missed penalty, then hugged the striker the moment the whistle blew.

hindi: थककर चूर — खड़े रहना भी मुश्किल
definition: British: so completely exhausted and tired after long exertion that collapsing feels imminent
example: They had walked the whole coastal path and were fit to drop when the farmer's wife waved them in for tea.

hindi: प्यार की आग बुझ जाना — जोश ठंडा पड़ जाना
definition: romantic passion dying completely, leaving affection cold where excitement once burned brightly
example: Their letters thinned through autumn, and by spring the flame had gone out without either of them announcing it.

hindi: जबान चलाना — बोलते जाना, करना कुछ नहीं
definition: an American phrase meaning talking endlessly, aimless chatter accomplishing nothing anybody actually needed
example: Uncle flapped his gums about the fence repair every Sunday, while Aunt quietly bought nails and finished it herself.

hindi: चार दिन की चाँदनी — क्षणिक सफलता
definition: sudden, brief success that quickly fizzles, never repeated or followed by anything lasting
example: Critics called the young singer a flash in the pan, but twenty years later she still fills the town hall.

hindi: पैसे की नुमाइश — दौलत का दिखावा
definition: showing money openly, spending loudly so everyone notices exactly your newfound wealth
example: He flashed the cash at the reunion, but his old classmates only wanted to hear about his daughter's cricket team.

hindi: जेब खाली होना — एक पैसा भी पास न होना
definition: completely without money, unable to afford even ordinary everyday expenses
example: Flat broke and cheerful, she walked eleven kilometres home and called it excellent exercise.

hindi: जुटे रहना बिना दम लिए — बेतहाशा व्यस्त
definition: working nonstop with frantic hurry, pausing never through relentless busy speed, Australian simile
example: The chai stall owner worked flat out like a lizard until the cricket crowd thinned and someone finally brought him food.

hindi: कुछ दिनों का चहेता — अस्थायी लोकप्रियता
definition: someone enjoying popularity and favour in British usage, though that affection seems likely to fade quickly
example: Last spring the ukulele was flavour of the month in our house, and now it guards the wardrobe.

hindi: कान खींचना — तीखी झिड़की
definition: sharp scolding in British usage, a severe, brief rebuke that sends someone away embarrassed
example: The farmer sent the trespassing teenagers off with a flea in their ear and a basket of windfall apples.

hindi: अपना ख़ून — सगे संबंधी
definition: your own close relatives, family bound to you by birth whatever quarrels come between you
example: They had not spoken in years, but when his brother was in hospital he drove all night, because flesh and blood is flesh and blood.

hindi: पासा पलटना — बाज़ी उलट देना
definition: reversing expected roles or circumstances completely, turning a familiar situation around in surprising fashion
example: The kids flipped the script on Mother's Day and made their parents stay in bed while they cooked.

hindi: पारा चढ़ना — अचानक बेकाबू गुस्सा
definition: suddenly explode into furious temper, losing control completely and behaving wildly angry
example: Mum flipped her lid when she found the puppy asleep on the wedding sari, then took forty photos of it.

hindi: मरे घोड़े को कोड़े मारना — खत्म हो चुकी बात पर ज़ोर लगाना
definition: wasting effort upon something already finished, where continued persuasion produces nothing whatever
example: Arguing about last year's holiday photographs was flogging a dead horse, so they made tea instead.

hindi: जेब गरम होना — हाथ में भरपूर नकदी
definition: suddenly wealthy, holding plenty of ready money after a payday, windfall or bonus arrives
example: Flush with cash after his first proper salary, Arjun took both grandmothers out for the fanciest thali in town.

hindi: दूध में मक्खी — छोटी खराबी जो सब बिगाड़ दे
definition: minor irritating flaw spoiling arrangement that otherwise seemed thoroughly pleasant
example: The wedding hall was perfect except for one fly in the ointment, a leaking cooler beside the sweets table.

hindi: आपे से बाहर होना — गुस्से में अचानक बिफर पड़ना
definition: suddenly lose your temper, shouting fierce anger before calmer thinking arrives
example: Dad flew off the handle when he saw the dented car, then apologised over dinner and asked how my day had gone.

hindi: दुकान से गायब — बिक्री बहुत तेज़
definition: an American phrase meaning merchandise selling remarkably quickly, shoppers emptying stock within surprisingly short hours
example: The umbrellas flew off the shelves during that grey week, and everybody suddenly remembered where the corner shop stood.

hindi: अनदेखा गवाह — चुपचाप सब देखने वाला
definition: unseen observer secretly watching private events, noticing everything without being noticed
example: I would love to be a fly on the wall when Grandma meets the new vicar she has heard so much about.

hindi: नौ दो ग्यारह होना — पिंजरा छोड़कर चुपचाप भाग निकलना
definition: sudden escape from confinement, leaving quietly without telling anyone where
example: The hostel warden checked the beds at midnight and found that three boys had flown the coop, leaving their pillows stuffed under the blankets.

hindi: घोंसला छोड़ना — बच्चों का घर छोड़कर अलग बसना
definition: leave the parental household permanently, beginning independent adult living somewhere else
example: The younger sister flew the nest in August, and her mother still cooked enough rice for four people until December.

hindi: रातोंरात भागने वाला — अविश्वसनीय धंधा
definition: dishonest and unreliable business, likely vanishing suddenly with customers' money before delivering
example: We almost booked a fly-by-night travel agency until Aunty Meena noticed its office was a phone box.

hindi: अंधेरे में तीर चलाना — बिना जानकारी आगे बढ़ना
definition: proceeding without information, guidance or understanding, relying purely on instinct and hope
example: Cooking her mother's famous curry without the recipe, she was flying blind, but the smell alone brought the whole family into the kitchen.

hindi: बुलंदियों पर — कामयाबी के शिखर पर
definition: enjoying great success and happiness, riding confidently while everything goes wonderfully well
example: The little bookshop is flying high since the author event, with the owner humming behind the till all week.

hindi: मुँह से झाग निकलना — गुस्से में बेकाबू होना
definition: wildly furious in appearance, ranting with visible anger that alarms bystanders
example: The commentator was practically foaming at the mouth about the referee, while his co-host calmly poured himself water.

hindi: ताश के पत्तों की तरह ढह जाना — दबाव में तुरंत हार मान लेना
definition: surrender immediately under pressure, abandoning your stated position without offering serious resistance
example: The captain promised to argue about the fielding order, then folded like a cheap suit when his mother mentioned dinner.

hindi: डेरा समेट लेना — चुपचाप मैदान छोड़ना
definition: quietly abandon a hopeless effort and withdraw, giving up without fuss or announcement, chiefly American English
example: When nobody came to the book club for a month, Mrs Kapoor folded her tent and started a garden club instead.

hindi: देखा-देखी करना — दूसरे की राह पर चलना
definition: copy what someone else has just done, behaving similarly after watching their example
example: When the eldest cousin jumped into the cold river first, the rest followed suit, shrieking all the way down.

hindi: भेड़चाल में चलना — बिना सोचे भीड़ के पीछे
definition: copy popular opinion without thinking, joining crowds merely because everybody else already went
example: Instead of following the herd towards the famous stall, they tried the quiet corner shop and ate wonderfully.

hindi: बेकार का काम — जिसमें कुछ हासिल नहीं होता
definition: pointless effort pursuing something impossible to finish, wasting time from beginning
example: Sending a child to borrow left-handed scissors from the neighbours was, everyone knew, a gentle fool's errand.

hindi: पीतल को सोना समझना — जो क़ीमती लगे पर निकले बेकार
definition: something looking impressive valuable that actually proves worthless hollow disappointment afterwards
example: He hunted rare coins all winter, and the jeweller gently explained that his prize find was fool's gold.

hindi: पैर जमाने की जगह — शुरुआती छोटा मौका
definition: small initial opening into an opportunity, allowing gradual deeper entry afterwards
example: Teaching two neighbourhood children gave her a foot in the door, and three years later the whole lane sent theirs.

hindi: पहला मौक़ा — आगे बढ़ने की शुरुआती सीढ़ी
definition: first modest opportunity giving early advantage, starting position from which progress becomes possible
example: The weekend job at the garage gave him a foot on the ladder, and he now runs the place.

hindi: बेफ़िक्र और आज़ाद — किसी बंधन या ज़िम्मेदारी से मुक्त
definition: free from commitments and responsibilities, able to wander and choose without restriction
example: At twenty he was footloose and fancy free, sleeping on trains and deciding each destination by whichever platform announcement sounded prettiest.

hindi: कौड़ियों के मोल — बेहद सस्ते में मिलना
definition: sold at a surprisingly cheap price, costing much less money than the thing is worth
example: She bought the rosewood desk for a song at a closing-down sale and polished it every Sunday.

hindi: बस तस्वीर के लिए — स्वाद बाद में, फोटो पहले
definition: arranged purely to photograph beautifully online rather than genuinely enjoyed while happening
example: They stacked the pancakes for the gram, photographed them twice, then ate everything cold and perfectly happy.

hindi: सिर्फ़ तुम्हारे लिए — किसी और को न दिखाना
definition: intended secretly for a single reader, private information nobody else should ever read
example: She slipped him a folded note marked for your eyes only; inside was the address of the puppy they were adopting.

hindi: वर्जित फल — मना किया गया, इसलिए और लुभावना
definition: tempting pleasure that becomes desirable precisely because rules forbid enjoying anything
example: Late night television became forbidden fruit after the rule arrived, and the volume knob learned marvellous subtlety.

hindi: युगों-युगों तक — बहुत लंबे समय तक
definition: extremely long time, seemingly endless, lasting much longer than anybody could reasonably expect
example: The queue for the new roller coaster took forever and a day, but the grin on Maya's face afterwards made it worth it.

hindi: माफ़ करके भूल जाना — मन में मैल न रखना
definition: pardon a past wrong until the grievance fades, keeping resentment and blame from lingering afterwards
example: Her grandmother could forgive and forget faster than anyone, which is why the house stayed full of visitors.

hindi: राह का दोराहा — चुनाव का मोड़
definition: moment demanding choice between separate directions, each leading somewhere entirely different
example: The scholarship letter arrived like a fork in the road, and the family discussed it over dinner until midnight.

hindi: चार सौ बीस — धोखेबाज़, ठग
definition: used for a cheat or swindler, taken from the penal code section dealing with fraud, as said in Indian English
example: The children decided the neighbourhood cat was a proper four-twenty after it charmed three different houses into feeding it dinner.

hindi: खुली बहस — तू-तू मैं-मैं
definition: in British usage, a euphemism for heated argument where both sides spoke bluntly, described politely afterwards
example: The two grandmothers had a frank exchange of views about the recipe, then shared the kitchen happily all Diwali.

hindi: किनारों से उधड़ना — धीरे-धीरे बिखरने लगना
definition: begin showing signs of strain and wear, slowly coming apart after holding together
example: By the fourth day of the road trip, everyone's patience had started to fray at the edges, so we stopped for ice cream.

hindi: खुली छूट — मनमानी करने की पूरी आज़ादी
definition: complete freedom to decide and choose without restriction, supervision, or interference
example: The old painter gave his student free rein with the back wall, and by evening it had turned into a garden of impossible birds.

hindi: मुफ़्त की सवारी — बिना मेहनत का लाभ
definition: benefit enjoyed without contributing effort or payment, while others carry the work and costs
example: Grandpa said the lodger was not getting a free ride, so the student cheerfully took over the vegetable patch.

hindi: मुँह फेर लेना — बिना कहे दूरी बना लेना
definition: deliberately withdraw warmth entirely, ignoring someone until they understand rejection
example: After the argument beside the tea stall she froze him out completely, greeting everyone else and looking straight through him.

hindi: अपनों की मार — मदद करनेवालों से पहुँचा नुक़सान
definition: damage inflicted accidentally by your own allies, criticism arriving from people supposedly supporting you
example: His cousin's proud speech about the failed bakery attempt was pure friendly fire, and the whole table winced together.

hindi: ऊपर तक पहुँच — रसूख़दार जान-पहचान
definition: influential connections among powerful people who can grant favours or smooth difficulties for you
example: Getting that last-minute table made everyone wonder if Grandma had friends in high places; she had simply taught the chef in Year Two.

hindi: जान सूख जाना — बहुत ज़्यादा डरना
definition: terrified beyond measure, frozen with dread, unable to move or face what awaits you
example: My aunt is frightened to death of flying, yet she held my hand the whole way to Delhi so I would not be nervous.

hindi: अर्श से फ़र्श — इज़्ज़त से ज़िल्लत तक
definition: falling suddenly from admiration into disgrace, losing your reputation after one conspicuous failure
example: The goalkeeper went from hero to zero in a minute, then saved the final penalty to win it back.

hindi: बिना सबूत न मानने वाला — दिखाओ तो मानें
definition: describing, in American usage, someone sceptical who demands proof before believing any claim, the Show-Me State
example: 'Sure, you painted the whole fence,' said Mum. 'I'm from Missouri, sweetheart, so show me.'

hindi: शून्य से शुरुआत — बिल्कुल शुरू से बनाना
definition: starting completely fresh with nothing prepared, building every single piece yourself from the beginning
example: The old recipe book was lost in the move, so Nani rebuilt her whole pickle collection from scratch, tasting each jar until it felt right.

term: from the bottom of your heart
hindi: दिल की गहराई से — पूरी सच्चाई के साथ
definition: speaking with completely genuine private feeling, thanking someone sincerely without polite exaggeration
example: She thanked the neighbours from the bottom of her heart, remembering every night they had watched the children.

hindi: पहले दिन से — शुरुआत से ही
definition: right from the very first moment, present since things began and never absent afterwards, chiefly American
example: The twins were inseparable from the get-go, holding hands in their cots before either could even crawl.

hindi: नींव से — जड़ से पूरा खड़ा करना
definition: building something entirely yourself, beginning with the foundations and adding every later layer personally
example: She built the bakery from the ground up, starting with one oven in her garage and a hand-painted sign.

hindi: सीधे स्रोत से — ख़ुद उसी के मुँह से
definition: information heard directly from the original source, the person most likely knowing firsthand
example: We didn't believe the bakery was closing until we heard it from the horse's mouth, as Mr Das handed out free buns.

hindi: सबसे आगे चलने वाला — जीत का प्रबल दावेदार
definition: leading contender expected to succeed in a race, election or competition, currently ahead of rivals
example: Aunty Sunita's mango chutney was the clear front runner at the fair until someone brought a lime pickle.

hindi: पूरा और आख़िरी — अंतिम फ़ैसला
definition: meaning complete and finally settled, leaving nothing further open for later argument, as said in Indian English
example: That is my full and final price, said the vegetable seller, then slipped an extra bunch of coriander into the bag anyway.

hindi: पूरा टून — बहुत ज़्यादा पिया हुआ
definition: extremely drunk in Irish usage, staggering happily homeward after hours spent drinking
example: He arrived at the door full as a bingo bus, singing softly, and his mother handed him bread and left the lecture until morning.

hindi: पूरे जोश से — पूरे उत्साह के साथ
definition: meaning with complete energy and enthusiasm, throwing yourself wholeheartedly into something, as said in Indian English
example: The whole street danced with full josh at the Ganpati procession, even the grumpy retired colonel from the third floor.

hindi: जोश से भरा — चंचल और चुस्त
definition: bursting with cheerful restless energy, chattering happily without settling quietly anywhere
example: The children came back from the mango orchard full of beans, and nobody slept until well past midnight.

hindi: गप्पी — खोखली डींगें हाँकने वाला
definition: loudly boastful, producing empty talk that carries almost nothing of real substance
example: The new landlord was full of hot air about repairs, but the tap kept dripping all winter.

term: full of the joys of spring
hindi: बसंत सी ताज़गी — ख़ुशमिज़ाज और ऊर्जावान
definition: a British phrase for being cheerful and lively, brimming with sunny morning energy and optimism
example: Mr Khanna came down the stairs full of the joys of spring, whistling and offering to make pancakes for the whole house.

hindi: पूरी ताक़त से — बिना हिचक
definition: total commitment to something daring, risking everything without hesitation or holding anything back; modern slang
example: The toddler went full send down the snowy hill on a tea tray, shrieking with delight all the way.

hindi: पूरी रफ़्तार से आगे — बिना रुके बढ़ना
definition: declaring forward movement with maximum speed and energy, nothing slowing progress anymore
example: Once the council approved the playground, the parents shouted full steam ahead and started digging that same weekend.

hindi: हाथ आया मौका गँवा देना — लापरवाही से नुकसान
definition: waste a golden opportunity through careless mistake, losing rewards already within reach
example: She had the scholarship almost signed and fumbled the bag by missing the final interview email.

hindi: गड़बड़झाला — संदिग्ध हरकत
definition: suspicious or dishonest activity happening secretly, prompting others to watch closely and doubt
example: 'No funny business at the card table,' warned Nani, and the grandchildren giggled, hiding the extra aces under their cushions.

hindi: बढ़त बनाना — फ़ासला घटाना
definition: advance steadily, closing the distance between yourself and whoever leads ahead
example: The younger runner gained ground on every bend, and the crowd along the canal started shouting her name.

hindi: कानोंकान बिगड़ती बात
definition: message passed along through many people, becoming increasingly distorted until nobody recognises the original, American usage
example: After a game of telephone through the family group chat, Grandpa's sore knee had become a hospital stay.

hindi: खेल ख़त्म — अब कुछ नहीं हो सकता
definition: declaring that everything is finished, defeat certain and further chances completely gone
example: When the babysitter found the hidden biscuits, the twins looked at each other and whispered game over.

hindi: निर्णायक जीत — बाज़ी पूरी तरह ख़त्म
definition: declaring complete, decisive victory where the opponent's defeat is final, from tennis
example: She produced the receipt showing the date, and it was game, set and match to Mum.

hindi: हौसला बढ़ाना — बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर तारीफ़ करना
definition: praising someone with enthusiastic admiration in American slang, hyping their confidence higher before something important
example: Her friends gassed her up in the parking lot until she walked into the audition grinning.

hindi: धूल खाना — पड़े-पड़े बेकार होते रहना
definition: postponed and neglected, sitting untouched while everyone keeps promising attention later
example: His father's harmonium gathered dust behind the almirah until a neighbour's daughter asked, shyly, whether anyone still played it.

hindi: अंदाज़ा होना — किसी चीज़ की समझ बनना
definition: slowly develop an instinctive sense of something by spending time around it and trying it repeatedly
example: She walked the market streets every morning until she got a feel for which stalls sold the freshest mangoes.

hindi: मज़ा आना — किसी बात से आनंद लेना
definition: find particular pleasure and amusement in some activity, enjoying it thoroughly and much more than anyone expected
example: Dad gets a real kick out of teaching the neighbourhood kids to fly kites on the terrace.

hindi: जल्दी करो — हाथ-पैर चलाओ
definition: hurry along immediately, stopping dawdling and moving faster because time presses
example: Get a move on, the fireworks start at eight and we still need to find a spot on the hill.

hindi: बीच में बोलने का मौक़ा पाना
definition: managing to speak briefly while someone else dominates the conversation, usually said negatively, British form; American speakers say edgewise
example: At Diwali the aunties were so busy catching up that the children could not get a word in edgeways.

hindi: बच निकलना — बड़ी गलती पर भी सज़ा न मिलना
definition: escape punishment entirely despite serious wrongdoing, because nobody bothers holding wrongdoers accountable
example: The youngest grandchild gets away with murder because Nani laughs before she remembers she meant to scold him.

hindi: फिर से कमर कसना — गिरकर दोबारा शुरू करना
definition: returning to an activity straight after failure or injury, refusing to allow fear to settle permanently
example: After the car accident Dad was shaky behind the wheel, but he got back on the horse and drove us to the beach himself.

hindi: बात पर तुनक जाना — छोटी बात पर नाराज़
definition: become upset and angry over something minor, taking offence beyond what is necessary, American
example: Don't get bent out of shape about the burnt toast, Grandpa said, scraping it cheerfully into the bin.

hindi: घुटने पर बैठकर पूछना — शादी का प्रस्ताव
definition: propose marriage formally, kneeling before your beloved while offering them a ring
example: He got down on one knee on the beach at sunset, and a passing jogger started the applause.

hindi: असली बात पर आना — काम की ठोस बातें करना
definition: abandon vague pleasantries, discussing practical essential details before deciding anything further
example: Once the samosas were finished they finally got down to brass tacks about repairing the leaking terrace.

hindi: गाँठ बँधना — बिना तामझाम शादी कर लेना
definition: marry your partner casually, accepting lifelong commitment without elaborate expensive ceremony
example: They got hitched at the registry office on a Tuesday and celebrated with dosas afterwards.

term: get in on the ground floor
hindi: शुरू से साझेदार — बिल्कुल आरंभ में जुड़ जाना
definition: becoming involved from the very beginning of something promising, joining before others notice its value
example: Her cousin got in on the ground floor of the neighbourhood choir, and now she chooses every carol.

hindi: मन की भड़ास निकालना — दबी बात कहकर हल्का हो जाना
definition: confess troubling secrets aloud, releasing feelings that long silence pressed steadily harder upon a tired conscience
example: She had rehearsed the apology on the whole bus ride, and getting it off her chest took only nine seconds.

hindi: बाल भी बाँका न होना — बिना किसी सज़ा छूट जाना
definition: escape punishment completely after wrongdoing, walking away without penalty, payment, blemish, blame
example: Both drivers argued for twenty minutes, then the tempo owner got off scot-free because nobody could find the broken mirror.

hindi: परवान चढ़ना — ठीक से शुरू हो पाना
definition: of plans or projects, start properly and begin making progress; mostly heard negatively, as 'never get off the ground'
example: The street-party idea never got off the ground, so the neighbours settled for tea on Mrs Patel's lawn instead.

term: get off to a flying start
hindi: शानदार शुरुआत करना — पहले ही कदम पर आगे निकल जाना
definition: begin brilliantly quickly, gaining early momentum that leaves rivals trailing behind
example: Their little bakery got off to a flying start, because three neighbours smelled the cardamom buns and told everybody else.

term: get on like a house on fire
hindi: खूब पटरी बैठना — तुरंत गहरी दोस्ती
definition: become extremely friendly with somebody quickly, British usage, sharing constant warm agreement and endless conversation
example: The grandmothers got on like a house on fire, and their grandchildren waited an hour beside the parked cars.

hindi: हाथ से निकल जाना — काबू से बाहर होना
definition: situation escalating beyond anyone's control, spreading trouble faster than sensible people manage handling
example: The cricket match between cousins got out of hand around the third broken window, so lunch was declared immediately.

term: get out of jail free card
hindi: बचाव का रास्ता — सज़ा से छूटने का ज़रिया
definition: something allowing escape from consequences or responsibility, excusing you from trouble you would otherwise face
example: Her birthday was her get out of jail free card; nobody minded that she skipped the washing up.

hindi: किसी को चिढ़ाना — नाराज़ कर देना
definition: annoy someone so they become defensive and hostile, ready to quarrel back
example: His habit of correcting everyone's grammar got my aunt's back up before the soup was even served.

hindi: काम में भिड़ जाना — जोश से जुटना
definition: British and Australian: start working properly and enthusiastically, throwing yourself fully into things
