example: Nobody waited for instructions at the beach clean-up; the kids grabbed bags and got stuck in straight away.

hindi: गाड़ी चला देना — काम की शुरुआत कर देना
definition: begin proceedings promptly, creating momentum others follow once initial hesitation disappears
example: Somebody had to get the ball rolling, so Chinni stood first and sang badly, after which everyone happily volunteered.

hindi: हूटिंग झेलना — दर्शकों की फटकार
definition: receive loud audience jeering during performance, British theatre slang describing hostile reception
example: The magician got the bird when the rabbit strolled out early, then won everybody back completely.

hindi: मतलब भाँप लेना — बात का सार पकड़ना
definition: follow roughly what somebody is hinting, although their actual words remain vague and indirect
example: Grandpa never said he wanted company on Sunday, but after his third hint about the lonely roast chicken we got the drift.

hindi: हाथ बैठ जाना — किसी काम की आदत पड़ जाना
definition: gradually learn a skill through practice until doing it feels natural and confident
example: After a week of wobbling round the park, Meera finally got the hang of the bicycle and rode off laughing.

hindi: अचानक अरुचि होना — पसंद का घिन में बदल जाना
definition: suddenly feel physical revulsion toward someone previously attractive, losing romantic desire completely
example: She got the ick watching him argue with the auto driver over five rupees, and somehow the evening never recovered.

hindi: पहल कर लेना — दूसरों से पहले शुरुआत
definition: gain an early advantage over rivals by starting sooner or moving faster than them; mainly American
example: He got the jump on the other volunteers by booking the church hall months early, so the jumble sale finally had space.

hindi: इशारा समझ जाना — आशय पकड़ लेना
definition: understand the unspoken meaning somebody intends, usually a hint about their wishes or feelings
example: When she started stacking chairs and switching off lamps, the last lingering guests finally got the message and fetched their coats.

hindi: बात समझ आना — पूरी स्थिति पकड़ लेना
definition: finally grasp the whole situation from scattered clues without needing every detail spelled out
example: She glanced at the empty biscuit tin, the guilty dog and the crumbs on the sofa, and got the picture straight away.

term: get the wrong end of the stick
hindi: उल्टा समझना — बात का ठीक विपरीत अर्थ निकालना
definition: understanding a situation completely backwards, holding a mistaken version of what somebody actually meant
example: He heard "we should talk" and packed his desk; his manager had the wrong end of the stick pointed out to her only later, over apologies.

hindi: पकड़ में आना — मुश्किल काम समझने लगना
definition: begin understanding difficult material properly, chiefly British, handling complicated demands after confused early attempts
example: By March he had got to grips with the new syllabus, and his mother stopped hiding the report cards.

hindi: तह तक जाना — असली वजह ढूँढना
definition: discover the real hidden cause behind a mystery by investigating carefully and thoroughly
example: Grandma vowed to get to the bottom of the vanishing jam, and she found crumbs leading straight to the twins' room.

hindi: खटकना — भीतर तक चुभना
definition: bother someone persistently, a remark or habit lingering inside and quietly building irritation
example: His cousin's teasing about the burnt rotis got under his skin, so the next Sunday he cooked perfect ones for everyone.

hindi: किसी की चालाकी भाँप लेना — सतर्क हो जाना
definition: finally understand a person's tricks or deception after being fooled for some time, said in American English
example: The pigeons stole our sandwiches for weeks until we got wise to them and started eating indoors.

hindi: अपनी हालत सुधारना — बिखरा काम व्यवस्थित करना
definition: become organised competent again, ending careless muddle before serious trouble arrives
example: After losing two library books he finally got his act together, buying a proper shelf and labelling everything hopefully.

hindi: बुरी तरह पिटना — करारी हार खाना
definition: suffer a thorough, crushing defeat that leaves you completely beaten, American informal
example: I challenged my nephew to a video game and got my clock cleaned in under three minutes.

hindi: किए की सज़ा मिलना — हिसाब आख़िर बराबर होता है
definition: finally suffer deserved punishment, consequences arriving after long unpunished misbehaviour
example: The neighbour who parked across everybody's gate finally got his comeuppance when the council arrived with a clipboard.

hindi: हाथ जमाना — धीरे-धीरे काम में रम जाना
definition: in British English, from cricket: gradually become accustomed to a task until your judgement grows sharp and reliable
example: The first few jars of pickle were lopsided, but once Nani got her eye in, every label went on straight.

hindi: पहला क़दम रखना — किसी काम का पहला अनुभव
definition: gaining your first small experience of an unfamiliar activity, trying gently before committing fully as a beginner
example: She got her feet wet volunteering at the Saturday market before opening a stall of her own.

hindi: जी जलाना — बार-बार चिढ़ाकर गुस्सा दिलाना
definition: annoy someone deeply through persistent irritating behaviour until their patience finally snaps
example: The neighbour's leaf blower at seven every Sunday morning really got Grandpa's goat, though he still waved over the fence.

term: get your knickers in a twist
hindi: छोटी बात पर बौखलाना — बेवजह परेशान होना
definition: become flustered and irritated over something trivial, fussing angrily without real cause, British
example: Don't get your knickers in a twist about the seating plan, Auntie laughed, everyone will swap chairs anyway.

hindi: फुर्ती दिखाओ — जल्दी करो
definition: hurry along immediately, moving faster because otherwise you'll arrive late; British informal
example: Get your skates on, love, Granny's train pulls in at ten and she hates waiting on the platform.

hindi: बात का उल्टा मतलब निकलना — ग़लतफ़हमी हो जाना
definition: small misunderstanding between people who each expected something different from arrangement
example: Both brothers waited an hour, one outside the station, one inside; they had got their wires crossed again.

hindi: बिना बताए गायब हो जाना — संपर्क अचानक तोड़ देना
definition: vanish from someone's messages permanently, ending romantic contact without explanation
example: He ghosted her after four lovely weeks, and her sister quietly deleted the restaurant booking without mentioning it again.

hindi: वाक्पटुता — बोलने की सहज कला
definition: natural talent for endless charming talk that holds every listener with easy words
example: Grandpa had the gift of the gab; strangers at the bus stand would miss two buses listening to him.

hindi: कमर कस लेना — मुश्किल का सामना करने को तैयार होना
definition: prepare yourself for approaching trouble, gathering courage before difficulty arrives
example: She girded her loins outside the ward, took one long breath, and pushed the door open smiling.

hindi: पूरी जान लगा देना — कुछ बाक़ी न रखना
definition: commit complete effort without holding anything back, working with total dedication
example: He gave a hundred percent during the school relay and collapsed grinning onto the grass while his mother clapped.

hindi: दूर से सलाम — झगड़ालू व्यक्ति से दूरी बनाए रखना
definition: keep deliberate distance from someone troublesome, avoiding every chance of angry confrontation
example: Vendors gave the parking inspector a wide berth, suddenly very busy whenever his scooter turned the corner.

hindi: लेन-देन का रिश्ता — आपसी समझौते से निभाना
definition: the mutual concessions that allow both sides to reach a workable compromise instead of demanding everything
example: Thirty years of marriage taught them that give and take beats winning any single argument.

term: give as good as you get
hindi: ईंट का जवाब पत्थर से — बराबरी से जवाब देना
definition: answer attacks or insults with equal force, never letting yourself be bullied quietly
example: She was the smallest in the family, but at the dinner table she gave as good as she got.

hindi: पीछे हटना — ज़मीन छोड़ना
definition: retreat gradually, yielding position or conceding arguments under pressure from opponents
example: Neither sister would give ground over the window seat, so their mother gave it to the cat.

hindi: ज्ञान देना — बिन माँगी सलाह बाँटना
definition: used for delivering unasked lofty advice or lectures, sermonising grandly about matters nobody raised, as said in Indian English
example: Her uncle started giving gyan on the stock market at dinner, until the cousins gently changed the subject to cricket.

hindi: एक हाथ आज़मा लो — कोशिश करके देखो
definition: attempt something cheerfully, trying willingly without expecting brilliant immediate success, distinctly Australian phrasing
example: She had never thrown a boomerang, but gave it a burl anyway while the children shouted advice from behind.

hindi: छोड़ देना — इस बार न जाना
definition: deciding not to attend or take part, skipping something you would rather avoid; British
example: We gave the fireworks a miss this year and watched the whole display from the hill with a flask of cocoa.

hindi: ज़रा ज़ोर लगाओ — और ताक़त झोंको
definition: British: apply much more force and effort, working properly harder straight away
example: The lawnmower coughed and died until Gran leaned over and told him to give the cord some welly.

hindi: सीधी बात कहना — बिना घुमाए सच बताना
definition: tell someone difficult news bluntly and plainly, without softening, padding or hopeful evasions
example: The vet knelt beside the boy, gave it to him straight about the old dog's hip, and then let him choose the new blanket.

term: give it up as a bad job
hindi: बेकार समझकर छोड़ देना — हार मानकर हाथ खींचना
definition: abandon a hopeless effort, accepting further trying would prove pointless, British English
example: After an hour hunting the lost earring, they gave it up as a bad job and ordered pizza.

hindi: पूरा ज़ोर लगाना — कोई कसर न छोड़ना
definition: pour every ounce of strength and effort into something, holding nothing back whatsoever for later
example: He was nervous about the audition, but his grandmother squeezed his hand and told him to give it his all and let the rest follow.

hindi: बस करो — ऐसी बात कौन मानेगा
definition: exasperated reply dismissing something as ridiculous, joking or unbelievable, asking the speaker to stop
example: When her brother claimed he had cooked the lasagne himself, the takeaway box still in the bin, she said, 'Oh, give me a break.'

hindi: मेरा सिर मत खा — लगातार परेशान करने पर झुंझलाना
definition: begging somebody pestering constantly to stop, Northern Irish plea against relentless complaining
example: Give my head peace, said their father from behind the newspaper, though he was already reaching for the car keys.

hindi: कन्नी काटना — किसी से बचकर निकलना
definition: deliberately avoiding someone or something, steering neatly around them; Scottish and British slang
example: I gave the karaoke night a body swerve, but my friends recorded every song and played them at my birthday.

hindi: झाड़ पिलाना — तीखी डाँट
definition: scolding someone severely and suddenly in British usage, delivering angry criticism about their careless behaviour
example: Mum gave us a rocket for tracking mud through the hall, then handed us towels and cocoa.

hindi: खूब सुनाना — जमकर डाँटना
definition: scold someone angrily at length, pouring every complaint into their listening ears
example: When I finally rang home after a week of silence, Mum gave me an earful before asking whether I had eaten.

hindi: खिंचाई करना — ताने मारना
definition: criticising or teasing someone persistently in British usage, mocking them about something they did
example: His mates gave him stick all season about the penalty he skied over the crossbar.

hindi: किसी से अजीब सी दहशत होना — बेचैनी महसूस कराना
definition: making someone feel uneasy, a creeping dread they cannot quite explain or shake off
example: That old doll in the guest room gives my sister the creeps, so Nani quietly turns it to face the wall whenever she visits.

hindi: किसी को चलता करना — रिश्ता ख़त्म करना
definition: ending relationship abruptly, dumping partner without much ceremony or regret, in British usage
example: She gave him the elbow after he forgot her birthday for the third year running.

hindi: आँखें लड़ाना — नज़रों से इशारा करना
definition: flirting silently, looking meaningfully across distance and signalling romantic interest without speaking
example: At the wedding a cousin kept giving him the eye across the dance floor until he finally asked her to dance.

hindi: चकमा देकर निकल जाना — पीछा करने वाले को गच्चा देना
definition: sudden quiet escape from somebody following you, leaving them behind without warning
example: She gave the photographers the slip by walking calmly through the hotel kitchen and out into a lane that smelled of frying onions.

hindi: जीते जी सम्मान देना — समय रहते सराहना
definition: praising someone warmly and publicly while they are living, offering admiration they deserve before it arrives too late
example: At the retirement lunch the whole staff gave the cook her flowers, reading out thirty years of thank-you notes.

hindi: पोल खुल जाना — मुँह से भेद निकल जाना
definition: reveal a secret plan carelessly, letting hidden intentions escape before the chosen moment arrives
example: Dad had guarded the puppy secret for a week, then asked at dinner whether anyone had bought a leash yet, and gave the game away.

hindi: अंदर की बात बताना — असली किस्सा खोलकर सुनाना
definition: share confidential background details about someone, telling gossip that explains their hidden situation
example: Over samosas, the office peon gave her the lowdown on why the transfer list kept changing, and suddenly the rumours made sense.

term: give the shirt off your back
hindi: अपना सब कुछ दे देना — बेहद उदार होना
definition: be generous and loyal enough to give away whatever you own to support someone needing help
example: Uncle Ravi would give the shirt off his back to anyone in trouble, which is why his spare room was never empty.

hindi: बात करना बंद कर देना — नाराज़गी में चुप्पी साधना
definition: punish someone through deliberate silence, refusing conversation instead of explaining your actual grievance
example: Grandmother gave her son the silent treatment across four whole meals, passing him rotis without once meeting his eyes.

hindi: दम तोड़ देना — शरीर छोड़कर चल बसना
definition: to release a final breath and pass away, when the slow dying of a person quietly finishes
example: He gave up the ghost on a Sunday morning, an hour after the family had finished singing the hymn he asked for.

hindi: रेंगती हुई रफ़्तार — इतनी धीमी प्रगति कि दिखाई ही न दे
definition: progress unfolding painfully slowly, with barely visible movement across long stretches
example: The garden wall rose at a glacial pace, one row of bricks each Sunday, and somehow that made him love it more.

hindi: जश्न वाले कपड़े — खास मौके की पोशाक
definition: finest festive clothes saved carefully, worn only while celebrating some special evening
example: Father dug his glad rags out of the trunk, smelling faintly of naphthalene, and declared himself ready for the wedding.

hindi: अदृश्य रुकावट — तरक्की रोकने वाली अनकही बाधा
definition: invisible barrier keeping women or minorities from reaching senior positions; people speak of breaking or shattering it
example: His mother broke through the glass ceiling at the railway, becoming its first woman station master in 1987.

hindi: कमज़ोर नस — ज़रा-सी चोट में ढह जाना
definition: surprising fragility behind a tough exterior, collapsing quickly under criticism or pressure, like a boxer easily floored
example: For all his loud opinions at dinner, Karan had a glass jaw, and one gentle joke about his cooking sent him sulking to the balcony.

hindi: निखर जाना — रूप और आत्मविश्वास दोनों बदल जाना
definition: striking transformation improving appearance and confidence, dressing better after quietly rebuilding yourself
example: Nobody recognised him at the reunion, and he enjoyed explaining that the glow up cost mostly sleep and swimming.

hindi: स्क्रीन से चिपका हुआ — नज़र हटती ही नहीं
definition: unable to look away from a glowing screen, ignoring everybody sitting nearby for hours
example: The whole family stayed glued to the screen until Grandmother carried the tea tray in and drew the curtains open.

hindi: मुसीबत मोल लेने वाला — मुश्किल काम ख़ुद चुनने वाला
definition: person who keeps choosing tiring, difficult or unpleasant tasks, seemingly enjoying the hardship
example: Having just finished one marathon, Priya signed up for another the same afternoon, a true glutton for punishment.

hindi: सारा दाँव लगा देना — कुछ भी बचाकर नहीं रखना
definition: commit every resource toward single risky attempt, keeping nothing whatever back afterwards
example: She went all in on the little bakery, selling even her scooter, and the first week's queue reached the tailor's shop.

hindi: पूरी ताक़त झोंक देना — कुछ बचाकर नहीं रखना
definition: commit maximum effort beyond ordinary limits, holding nothing back while attempting something difficult
example: They went all out for the school function, painting backdrops until midnight while somebody's father kept supplying lemon tea.

hindi: ग़ायब हो जाना — बिना बताए नदारद
definition: disappearing without permission or explanation, absent exactly when people expect you; from military slang
example: The remote control went AWOL for a week before turning up inside the biscuit tin.

hindi: भड़क जाना — गुस्से में फट पड़ना
definition: lose your temper suddenly, shouting violent anger that frightens everyone standing nearby
example: Uncle went ballistic during the cricket match, waving both arms at the television while the dog watched him with mild concern.

hindi: पीठ पीछे करना — चोरी-छिपे काम करना
definition: secretly betray someone's trust and loyalty, acting without their knowledge in ways they would oppose
example: She felt awful after going behind her sister's back to plan the party, until she saw her face light up at the door.

hindi: दिवाला निकलना — कारोबार पूरी तरह ठप हो जाना
definition: a business collapses completely, unable to repay money owed, leaving nobody with anything
example: The corner bakery went belly up in January, and the neighbours still glance at the papered windows every morning.

hindi: दिवाला पिटना — पैसे ख़त्म होकर धंधा बंद होना
definition: of a business, collapse into bankruptcy and close down after running completely short of money
example: When the travel firm went bust mid-holiday, the hotel owner fed the stranded family free of charge until their flight home.

hindi: दिल ठंडा पड़ जाना — पहले जैसी गर्मजोशी न रहना
definition: lose romantic warmth toward someone gradually, becoming distant instead of affectionate
example: He had gone cold on her without announcing it, and his cousin noticed the empty chair beside him at every wedding function.

hindi: गायब हो जाना — संपर्क बंद कर देना
definition: vanish from messages and screens deliberately, staying offline while nobody reaches you
example: Ritu went dark for a fortnight before the exams, leaving only her mother with the hostel landline number.

hindi: बंद गली में जाना — बेकार रास्ता पकड़ना
definition: follow a course of thinking or action that leads nowhere and yields nothing useful
example: Searching for the family's lost photographs, they went down a blind alley at the old house before an aunt remembered the attic.

hindi: लड़ते-लड़ते हारना — आख़िरी दम तक जूझना
definition: keep struggling bravely until final defeat, refusing surrender although losing seems certain
example: The little school team went down fighting, and the whole town clapped them off the pitch.

hindi: धूम‑धड़ाके से मुँह की खाना — सबके सामने बुरी तरह नाकाम
definition: collapse spectacularly before witnesses, suffering public failure instead of failing quietly behind closed doors
example: His confident magic act went down in flames when the pigeon refused to leave the hat, though the children clapped anyway.

term: go down like a lead balloon
hindi: बात बिल्कुल नहीं चली — ढेला पानी में
definition: fail embarrassingly before an audience, British usage, greeted with silence rather than approving laughter
example: His opening joke went down like a lead balloon, so he abandoned the speech and simply thanked everybody.

hindi: लड़ते-लड़ते हारना — बिना हथियार डाले हार
definition: losing only after struggling fiercely until the finish, never surrendering quietly or meekly
example: The underdog quiz team knew they were beaten, but they went down swinging and won the final round anyway.

hindi: डूबते जहाज़ के साथ डूबना — अंत तक साथ निभाना
definition: stay loyal to a failing cause until its collapse, sharing the ruin rather than escaping
example: The café owner could have sold up, but she went down with the ship, serving soup until the final morning.

hindi: सब कुछ दांव पर लगा देना — बचाव के लिए कुछ भी न बचाना
definition: commit every remaining resource toward single risky attempt, keeping nothing safe should everything collapse
example: With four minutes left and nothing to defend, the coach pulled his keeper forward and told the bench they were going for broke.

hindi: दिन दूनी रात चौगुनी तरक्की — लगातार बढ़ते जाना
definition: keep flourishing steadily, each triumph building upon the previous one while momentum grows
example: Since the move to the bigger hall, the community choir has gone from strength to strength.

hindi: ज़ोरों पर चलना — तेज़ी से आगे बढ़ना
definition: British: progress with impressive speed and energy, working vigorously and succeeding
example: The knitting circle has been going great guns since spring and has already sent forty blankets to the shelter.

hindi: या तो पूरा ज़ोर, या कुछ नहीं
definition: insisting upon total effort, since half-hearted attempts simply aren't worth anybody's bother
example: Before the tug-of-war the captain yelled go hard or go home, and the whole team dug their heels into the grass.

hindi: चक्कर खाकर गिरना — बेकाबू गिरावट
definition: enter sudden, steep decline spiralling beyond control, often with panic or confusion
example: When the flight was cancelled, Mum went into a tailspin until Dad produced a map and suggested a road trip.

hindi: पूरे ज़ोर में आ जाना — जोश चरम पर
definition: suddenly working with greatly increased speed and energy, intensity rising well beyond normal
example: The week before Diwali, my mother's kitchen goes into overdrive, sweets cooling on every surface.

hindi: अकेले दम पर चलना — बिना साथी के काम संभालना
definition: attempt something independently, without partners, help, or support from other people
example: Everyone advised her to find a partner for the bakery, but she decided to go it alone and opened at five every morning.

hindi: बिना अड़चन के चलना — सब कुछ ठीक-ठाक होना
definition: running perfectly smoothly, every part working without trouble, said in British usage
example: After weeks of worry, the wedding went like a dream, right down to the sunshine.

hindi: धुआँधार चलना — ज़ोरदार कामयाबी
definition: an American phrase meaning business booming rapidly, sudden success arriving beyond every careful expectation
example: Their little taco window went like gangbusters once the delivery drivers started recommending it to each other.

hindi: हवा हो जाना — बहुत तेज़ दौड़ना
definition: travel with wonderful speed, moving smoothly and swiftly over ground without apparent effort
example: Once Dad took the stabilisers off, little Meera went like the wind along the promenade, laughing the whole way.

hindi: पूरा कहर बरपाना — गुस्से में सबसे बड़ा वार
definition: respond with maximum furious force, unleashing the most extreme angry reaction available
example: The group chat went nuclear over who ate the leftover biryani, until Amma admitted she had frozen it for Sunday.

hindi: अधकचरी तैयारी से कूद पड़ना — बिना सोचे शुरू कर देना
definition: acting hastily before preparations finish, starting without thinking the whole plan through
example: They went off half-cocked with the picnic, arriving at the lake with blankets, guitars, and absolutely nothing edible.

term: go off like a frog in a sock
hindi: बौखला जाना — बेतहाशा भड़कना
definition: erupt into wild frantic anger or excitement, thrashing about noisily and uncontrollably, Australian
example: Dad went off like a frog in a sock when the umpire gave his son out, then shook the umpire's hand after the match.

hindi: जोश ठंडा पड़ना — रफ़्तार खो देना
definition: in British usage, lose momentum and enthusiasm, progress or performance cooling after strong beginnings
example: The band went off the boil after the drummer moved away, until his nephew turned up with a borrowed kit.

hindi: होश खो बैठना — गुस्से में बेकाबू
definition: react with sudden uncontrolled anger or hysteria, overreacting wildly beyond what the situation deserves
example: She went off the deep end about the scratched table, then admitted she had scratched it herself years ago.

hindi: पटरी से उतरना — योजना बेकाबू होकर बिगड़ना
definition: plans losing control completely, spreading trouble everywhere while heading toward obvious approaching disaster
example: The wedding schedule went off the rails before breakfast, and somehow everybody remembers that morning most fondly.

hindi: धूमधाम से विदा — शानदार अंत करना
definition: finishing something spectacularly, making your final moment memorable and exciting rather than quiet
example: The retiring headmaster went out with a bang, leading the whole school in a conga around the playground.

hindi: गुड़ गोबर हो जाना — बनी बनाई बात बिगड़ जाना
definition: turning badly wrong partway through, when careful arrangements collapse into a ruined, confusing mistake
example: The picnic went pear-shaped around noon: rain, a punctured tyre, and a cake nobody had remembered to bring.

hindi: ठप हो जाना — अचानक बिगड़ कर बंद होना
definition: in British usage, of machines or plans, suddenly break down and stop working, leaving hopes ruined
example: The old radio went phut halfway through the cricket, so Nana narrated the final overs from memory.

hindi: बहुत आगे जाना — तरक्की करना
definition: show promise of becoming very successful, heading toward famous achievement later
example: Her teacher always said the quiet girl who fixed everyone's bicycles would go places, and now she designs aircraft.

hindi: एक ही जगह चक्कर काटना — कोई नतीजा न निकलना
definition: keep thinking or arguing about something without making progress or reaching any clear answer
example: The cousins went round in circles choosing a restaurant until Gran stood up and announced they were all coming to hers.

hindi: घुमा-फिराकर बात करना — सीधे मुद्दे पर न आना
definition: talking evasively and lengthily without reaching the point, avoiding saying something directly; British
example: She went round the houses for ten minutes before asking whether we could look after her parrot for a month.

hindi: बिगड़ जाना — हालात ख़राब होना
definition: in American usage, take a turn for the worse, plans or values sliding downward into trouble
example: The barbecue went south when the rain came, so everyone crammed into the garage and kept grilling.

hindi: भन्ना जाना — बुरी तरह नाराज़ होना
definition: lose your temper completely, becoming furious and shouting wildly about something that went wrong, British
example: Mum will go spare if we're late for the train again, Jamie warned, sprinting with both suitcases.

hindi: पक्का रिश्ता बनाना — एक ही से जुड़ना
definition: dating one person exclusively as a committed couple, old-fashioned American phrase for official courtship
example: In 1958 going steady meant he gave her his class ring, which she wore on a chain.

hindi: अंत तक डटे रहना — आख़िरी पड़ाव तक पहुँचना
definition: persevering through hardship until the finish, continuing despite exhaustion and repeated painful setbacks
example: He had trained for eleven months, and at the thirty-eighth kilometre he decided he would go the distance, walking if needed.

hindi: एक कदम और बढ़कर करना — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा मेहनत
definition: make additional effort beyond whatever duty requires, helping further than anyone expected
example: The rickshaw driver went the extra mile and carried her suitcase upstairs, then waved away the extra twenty rupees.

term: go the way of the dodo
hindi: इतिहास बन जाना — चलन से पूरी तरह लुप्त हो जाना
definition: to vanish into extinction, becoming completely outdated until nothing remains useful worth keeping
example: Handwritten telegrams went the way of the dodo, though my uncle keeps one framed above his desk.

hindi: पूरा ही कर डालना — आधा-अधूरा नहीं, सब कुछ
definition: commit completely rather than partially, accepting entire expense instead of cautious halfway measure
example: They meant to repaint only the hallway, then went the whole hog and gave every room a different quiet colour.

hindi: रस्म निभाना — दिल लगाए बिना ऊपरी तौर पर करना
definition: perform required actions listlessly without genuine involvement, skipping proper commitment entirely
example: He went through the motions at morning yoga, stretching whenever the instructor looked, dreaming steadily about breakfast parathas.

hindi: चक्की में पिसना — कठिन दौर से गुज़रना
definition: enduring an exhausting, painful ordeal that leaves someone drained, battered and weary
example: She went through the wringer with the house move, but the first cup of tea on the new porch made it worthwhile.

hindi: किसी की ढाल बनना — खुलकर पक्ष लेना
definition: support someone loyally, defending them openly whatever others think of them, chiefly American usage
example: When the neighbours complained about the boy's drumming, old Mrs Kaur went to bat for him and found him a garage to practise in.

hindi: ज़मीन में समा जाना — नज़रों से बिलकुल गायब हो जाना
definition: disappear completely into hiding, avoiding attention until searching people finally lose interest in finding you
example: After borrowing the scooter without asking, our cousin went to ground at his friend's farm for a whole fortnight.

term: go to hell in a handbasket
hindi: रसातल को जाना — तेज़ी से बिगड़ना
definition: in American usage, deteriorate rapidly and heedlessly towards disaster, usually said of society generally
example: Every generation insists the world is going to hell in a handbasket, Grandma said, handing me another biscuit.

hindi: टूट जाना — भीतर से बिखरकर सँभल न पाना
definition: someone collapses emotionally, unable to cope, sinking toward the lowest reaches of despair
example: She went to pieces during the speech, and her brother finished reading the letter aloud for her.

hindi: बर्बादी की राह पर — हालत बिगड़ते जाना
definition: decline badly through neglect, a place or person deteriorating steadily into ruin
example: Locals said the old pier had gone to the dogs, until volunteers spent a summer painting every railing sky blue.

hindi: ढल जाना — स्तर गिर जाना
definition: in Australian usage, deteriorate noticeably, losing standards, condition or quality over time
example: The footy club had gone to the pack, but the new coach brought oranges at half time and the spirit came back.

hindi: दिवाला निकल जाना — कारोबार का पूरी तरह डूब जाना
definition: of a business, collapse into bankruptcy and close, ruined after struggling financially for months
example: The corner bookshop went to the wall after forty years, and on its final day the whole street came to buy one last paperback.

hindi: जी भरकर करना — कोई कसर न छोड़ना
definition: doing something lavishly and enthusiastically, spending freely and holding nothing back for a special occasion
example: The neighbours really went to town on the wedding, stringing marigolds from every balcony down the whole lane.

hindi: हिम्मत टूट जाना — दबाव में बिखर जाना
definition: courage failing under pressure, backing away or collapsing when things turn tough, in Australian English
example: The young goalkeeper never went to water, even when the whole crowd was chanting his name to rattle him.

hindi: आमने-सामने भिड़ना — बराबरी से मुक़ाबला करना
definition: confront a stronger opponent boldly and directly, fighting fiercely as an equal without backing down
example: The tiny village team went toe to toe with the city champions and walked off smiling, mud on every knee.

hindi: धुएँ में उड़ जाना — मेहनत बेकार हो जाना
definition: collapse completely after careful effort, leaving plans destroyed with nothing useful remaining anywhere
example: Two years of savings for the wedding hall went up in smoke when the builder vanished, so the family married under a borrowed tent instead.

hindi: आग की तरह फैल जाना — रातोंरात हर जगह पहुँच जाना
definition: spread suddenly across countless screens, gathering enormous attention within remarkably brief hours
example: The clip of her grandfather dancing went viral overnight, and he began receiving telephone calls from forgotten schoolfriends.

hindi: पुरानी जान-पहचान — बरसों का साथ
definition: have known each other since long ago, sharing a friendship that stretches across many years
example: The two grandmothers go way back, to a school where they shared one slate and a great many secrets.

hindi: घुटने काँप जाना — किसी के आकर्षण से सुध-बुध खोना
definition: become suddenly overwhelmed by romantic feeling for someone, losing ordinary composure completely
example: He had rehearsed a calm hello, but went weak at the knees the moment she waved.

hindi: बहाव के साथ बहना — जैसा चले वैसा मान लेना
definition: accept whatever popular crowd decides calmly, joining arrangements rather than arguing about plans
example: The itinerary collapsed by noon, so they went with the flow and spent the afternoon feeding temple monkeys.

hindi: भगवान क़सम सच — सोलह आने सच
definition: absolute truth sworn completely, nothing added or hidden, beyond questioning or doubt
example: It's the God's honest truth, Mum, the cake was already half gone when I opened the tin.

hindi: सरपट भागना — बेकाबू रफ़्तार से दौड़ना
definition: racing along wildly with frantic reckless speed, hurrying nonstop without caution, Australian simile
example: The puppy went like a cut snake around the yard until it collapsed against the water bowl, thoroughly satisfied.

hindi: कोल्हू का बैल — मेहनत बहुत, तरक़्क़ी नहीं
definition: making no progress whatsoever despite effort, busy movement producing absolutely nothing forward
example: The jigsaw was going nowhere fast until Grandma turned the box over and found the picture on the back.

hindi: शाबाशी का सितारा — अच्छे काम की मान्यता
definition: playful mark of approval, praise given because somebody behaved exactly as others hoped
example: Grandpa took his medicine without grumbling, and his granddaughter solemnly awarded him a gold star.

hindi: सुनहरा दौर — बीता हुआ खुशहाल ज़माना
definition: earlier period remembered as unusually prosperous flourishing happy, seemingly better than everything since
example: They call those radio evenings the golden age, mostly because everyone gathered around the same small table.

hindi: सबका चहेता — होनहार नौजवान
definition: young man enjoying popular approval and admiration, widely expected to achieve great success
example: The town's golden boy came home from university and still helped his father at the market stall.

hindi: सोने का अंडा देने वाली मुर्गी
definition: valuable source of continuing wealth or profit, foolish to destroy through greed or impatience
example: The festival was the town's golden goose, so nobody dared raise stall rents again.

hindi: गया काम से — जिसका कुछ नहीं हो सकता
definition: used for a hopeless person beyond saving, usually said fondly about someone hopelessly lovestruck or foolish, as said in Indian English
example: Ever since he met the new neighbour, Arjun hums love songs while brushing his teeth, and his friends have declared him a gone case.

hindi: ख़त्म हो गया — नष्ट, या दुनिया से गया
definition: destroyed beyond repair in British wartime slang, sometimes describing somebody's death
example: The kettle finally went for a burton, and the whole office observed a respectful minute beside the sink.

hindi: सब चौपट — योजना पूरी तरह गड़बड़
definition: describing plans thoroughly wrong in Cockney rhyming slang, ruining whatever everybody arranged
example: Halfway through the bake the oven quit, and Mum announced cheerfully that pudding had gone Pete Tong.

hindi: बर्बाद हो गया — अच्छी चीज़ धीरे-धीरे चौपट
definition: once decent, slowly deteriorated through neglect until British speakers consider something hopeless
example: The tennis club had gone to pot, though nobody minded because the kettle still worked beautifully.

hindi: बरबाद हो जाना — देखभाल बिना बिगड़ जाना
definition: declined slowly through neglect, losing earlier good condition after years without proper care
example: The rest house had gone to seed, though the caretaker still swept the veranda every single morning.

hindi: ज़ुबान का पक्का — कहा हुआ हमेशा निभाने वाला
definition: completely reliable, honest, always keeping promises exactly, without excuses, delays, reminders
example: He said the bicycle would be repaired before Sunday, and was good as his word, chain oiled and bell polished.

hindi: भला आदमी — नेक और भरोसेमंद
definition: chiefly British: thoroughly decent dependable person, kindly reliable company whom everybody trusts instinctively
example: The landlord turned out a good egg, fixing the boiler himself and leaving marmalade beside the note.

hindi: नेकदिल अजनबी — बिना स्वार्थ मदद करने वाला
definition: generous stranger helping injured people without expecting reward, thanks, later recognition
example: Some good Samaritan pushed their stalled scooter half a kilometre uphill and waved away every offer of money.

hindi: गुंडा राज — गुंडों की हुकूमत
definition: used for lawlessness where thugs rule openly, frightening ordinary citizens while authorities look away, as said in Indian English
example: The residents ended the goonda raj in their lane by simply walking together to the police station every single evening.

hindi: ब्रह्म वाक्य — पत्थर की लकीर
definition: absolute truth, trusted completely as though written scripture, beyond questioning or doubt
example: Whatever Mrs Kapoor said about gardening was gospel truth on our street, and every balcony bloomed because of it.

hindi: एक बार में सही — तुरंत समझ गए
definition: praise for somebody who guessed or understood something correctly at the very first attempt, said in British English
example: Guess who baked this cake? Your grandmother? Got it in one — nobody else puts that much cardamom in.

hindi: तमाशा देखने बैठ जाना — मज़ा लेना
definition: settle happily watching somebody else's argument unfold, treating drama purely entertainment
example: When the two committees started emailing each other, everybody else grabbed the popcorn and stopped replying.

hindi: सच्चाई का अंश — थोड़ा-सा सच
definition: small genuine part hidden inside an exaggerated claim, making the story partly believable
example: There was a grain of truth in Grandpa's war stories, though the tank he captured single-handed was probably a bicycle.

hindi: काँटे को मुट्ठी में लेना — अप्रिय काम का सीधा सामना करना
definition: tackle an unpleasant, painful problem boldly and directly instead of putting it off, chiefly British
example: After weeks of polite hints, Meera grasped the nettle and sat her brother down to talk about their father's care.

hindi: ज़मीनी स्तर — आम लोगों का आधार
definition: ordinary people forming firmly rooted base of movement, deciding matters locally rather than centrally
example: The library reopened because grass roots neighbours collected signatures outside the temple every Sunday morning for months.

hindi: रात की पाली — आधी रात से सुबह तक का काम
definition: working hours stretching through the lonely middle of the night until early morning
example: He took the graveyard shift at the bakery so he could walk his daughter to school every morning.

hindi: मुफ़्त की मलाई — बिना मेहनत लगातार कमाई
definition: comfortable arrangement producing generous money effortlessly, continuing longer than anybody honestly deserves
example: The rental sheds beside the highway were a gravy train until the bypass opened and the lorries stopped coming.

hindi: हाथ गरम करना — घूस देकर काम निकलवाना
definition: offer secret payment persuading somebody official toward ignoring rules, granting improper favours
example: Uncle insisted greasing that peon's palm would speed matters, though Amma got the certificate anyway simply arriving early.

hindi: पहिये में तेल देना — काम पहले से आसान बनाना
definition: smooth difficult arrangements beforehand, quietly making later cooperation easier through helpful preparation
example: A tray of samosas greased the wheels considerably, and the committee approved their courtyard repairs before evening.

hindi: चेहरा पीला पड़ जाना — मिचली से बदहाल दिखना
definition: visibly unwell and queasy, pale with nausea and passing sickness before actual vomiting
example: Ten minutes into the ferry ride my brother went green around the gills and hugged the railing.

hindi: हरी झंडी — भरोसे लायक होने का लक्षण
definition: reassuring behaviour revealing somebody trustworthy, signalling healthy promise inside future relationship
example: He remembered her mother's medicine timings without being asked, which her sister declared an enormous green flag.

hindi: हरी कोंपलें — सुधार के शुरुआती संकेत
definition: early visible signs showing recovery beginning, growth returning quietly after difficult decline
example: Two customers on Tuesday, four on Wednesday, and the shopkeeper allowed himself to call them green shoots.

hindi: जलन से जलना — दूसरे की तरक्की चुभना
definition: openly resentful about another person's fortune, wanting their advantages painfully instead of celebrating
example: The whole colony went green with envy over their new balcony garden, then asked politely for cuttings.

hindi: ईर्ष्या का कीड़ा — मन कुतरती जलन
definition: jealousy imagined as creature devouring somebody quietly, breeding resentment about another person's happiness
example: The green-eyed monster stirred when his friend's promotion arrived, though he clapped loudest at the celebration.

hindi: धुँधला मामला — जहाँ नियम साफ़ नहीं
definition: uncertain territory where rules remain unclear, making decisions difficult because guidance never settles matters, spelled gray area American
example: Whether cricket counted as homework became a grey area, negotiated nightly between father, mother and bowler.

hindi: हँसकर सह लेना — जो टल नहीं सकता उसे बिना शिकायत झेलना
definition: endure unpleasant difficulty without complaint, continuing calmly while the pressure remains
example: Our seats were right beside the engine, so we grinned and bore it for nine hours and slept in Kanpur.

hindi: मुँह फाड़कर मुस्कुराना — रहस्यमय चौड़ी हँसी
definition: smiling broadly, delighted about something private, showing happiness that slightly unsettles watching people
example: She grinned like a Cheshire cat throughout dinner, and only while serving kheer admitted she had bought the scooter.

hindi: घिस-घिस कर पूरा करना — ज़िद और मेहनत से काम निकालना
definition: continuing through long, difficult work by sheer stubborn effort, progress coming slowly rather than brilliantly
example: The team had no stars that season, so they ground it out match after match, winning on scrappy goals and muddy knees.

hindi: ठप पड़ जाना — धीरे-धीरे रुक जाना
definition: slowly lose momentum until progress stops completely, like machinery seizing
example: Traffic through town ground to a halt behind the parade, and strangers began sharing snacks through car windows.

hindi: कान तक मुस्कान — चेहरा खिल उठना
definition: beaming with delighted happiness, cheerful expression spreading across your whole face without any restraint
example: He came off the stage grinning from ear to ear, still clutching the borrowed guitar like something rescued.

hindi: कान तक मुस्कान — चौड़ी संतुष्ट हँसी
definition: smiling broadly with obvious satisfaction, delighted and cheerful because something secretly pleases you
example: She came back from the interview grinning like a Cheshire cat and refused to explain anything until everyone had eaten.

hindi: दाँत भींचकर सहना — तकलीफ चुपचाप झेल लेना
definition: endure something painful with silent determination rather than showing distress to everyone watching
example: The physiotherapist bent his knee another degree and Rafiq gritted his teeth, counting the ceiling tiles until it passed.

hindi: अंधेरे में टटोलना — बिना समझ के कोशिश करना
definition: search clumsily for answers or understanding without having knowledge, clues or guidance
example: The new parents were groping in the dark for weeks until a kind neighbour showed them how to settle the baby.

hindi: रीढ़ सीधी करना — दब्बूपन छोड़ कर अड़ना
definition: find courage to stand firm and speak up instead of meekly giving way, modern conversational
example: Her best friend told her gently to grow a spine, so she finally told the flatmate to wash his own dishes.

hindi: मामूली मेहनत वाला काम — जिसे कोई सराहता नहीं
definition: American: tedious, unglamorous labour nobody praises, usually handed down to beginners
example: She spent her first summer at the animal shelter doing the grunt work, and she loved every muddy minute of it.

hindi: गाड़ी अटका देना — चलती व्यवस्था जाम कर देना
definition: obstruct smoothly running arrangements, clogging steady progress until nothing continues properly
example: One missing signature gummed up the works for weeks, though the clerk kept offering tea and honest sympathy.

hindi: मन की आवाज़ — भीतर से उठा अनकहा फ़ैसला
definition: senses hidden truth through instinct alone, trusting judgement that careful reasoning cannot explain
example: Every paper checked out, yet a gut feeling kept him from signing that afternoon.

hindi: जी कड़ा करके झेलना — दर्द में भी हार न मानना
definition: enduring pain or hardship through sheer determination, refusing to quit before finishing, American usage
example: Her ankle throbbed from mile twenty, but she gutted it out and hugged her father at the finish line.

hindi: आख़िरी दाँव — हताशा में फेंका गया तीर
definition: desperate final attempt with very little chance, thrown hopefully when every sensible option has failed; American, borrowed from football's long last-second pass
example: With two minutes before the shop closed, his Hail Mary pass was a handwritten card promising to cook her dinner for a month.

hindi: हल्की चढ़ी हुई — थोड़ा नशे में
definition: mildly drunk in Irish and British usage, cheerful and unsteady without collapsing completely
example: Half cut and delighted with himself, uncle insisted on carrying the cake, so somebody quietly walked beside him the whole way.

hindi: अधूरी बात — असली पूरा सच छिपा हुआ
definition: incomplete partial account hiding important details listeners genuinely deserve knowing
example: The broken window was half the story, and the cricket bat behind the sofa quietly supplied the remainder.

hindi: ओवर एक्टिंग करना — जान-बूझकर बढ़ाकर निभाना
definition: acting with deliberately exaggerated gestures, overplaying performance until audience notices somebody pretending
example: Grandfather hammed it up during the storytelling, clutching his chest until every child shrieked happily.

hindi: पूरे ज़ोर-शोर से — जमकर लड़ना-झगड़ना
definition: arguing fiercely and noisily, both opponents putting enormous energy into every bitter exchange
example: The two old friends went at it hammer and tongs over cricket, then shared a taxi home laughing.

hindi: मिले हुए होना — गहरी साँठगाँठ
definition: working together closely, cooperating almost secretly toward shared purposes others cannot separate
example: The baker and the milkman worked hand in glove, so nobody in the lane ever ran short before breakfast.

hindi: चोरी करते हुए ऐन मौके पर पकड़ा जाना
definition: situation where somebody stealing quietly gets discovered mid-theft, evidence gripped between guilty fingers
example: The treasurer was found with his hand in the cookie jar during the temple audit, and nobody spoke through the entire evening.

hindi: हाथ तंग होना — पैसों की तंगी
definition: Indian English for being short of money this month, household budget stretched until the next salary arrives
example: "Hand is a bit tight till the fifteenth," Papa said, smiling, and promised the new cricket bat would come with his next salary.

hindi: दिल पर हाथ रखकर — पूरी ईमानदारी से
definition: speaking with complete sincerity, solemnly promising that every word spoken is truthful
example: Hand on heart, she told her sister, that red dress looks far better than the grey one.

hindi: रोज़ कमाना रोज़ खाना — बचत के बिना गुज़ारा
definition: spending whatever money arrives immediately, keeping nothing saved against later shortage
example: He grew up hand to mouth, which is why he still tucks half of every paycheck away.

hindi: उतरन — बड़े भाई-बहन के पुराने कपड़े
definition: worn secondhand clothing inherited from older siblings, passed downward through family instead of buying
example: Her winter coat was a hand-me-down from three cousins, and each of them had sewn a different button on.

hindi: छोटी-मोटी तकरार — दिखावटी भिड़ंत
definition: trivial quarrel or scuffle, making much noise but causing little actual harm, humorous British usage
example: The row between the two footballers was just handbags at dawn, and they were laughing together by half-time.

hindi: थाली में परोसा हुआ — बिना मेहनत के मिला
definition: given something valuable without needing effort, struggle or earning, said in British usage
example: The rival team missed three penalties, so the trophy was practically handed on a plate to the girls.

hindi: फूँक-फूँक कर पेश आना — बहुत नरमी से संभालना
definition: treat someone gently, keeping them sheltered from hardship, difficulty, and blunt truth
example: After the funeral everyone decided to handle their youngest sister with kid gloves, hiding the unpaid bills until spring.

hindi: हाथ बँधे होना — मजबूरी में कुछ न कर पाना
definition: lacking authority completely, unable to control matters although willing, prevented by rules
example: The clerk's hands were tied by paperwork, though he quietly explained which office might listen sooner.

hindi: खेल-खेल में — बिना ज़ोर लगाए जीत जाना
definition: winning easily without effort or struggle, because nobody else came anywhere close
example: Her mother's mango pickle won the neighbourhood tasting hands down, again.

hindi: रुके रहना — फ़ैसले को थोड़ा टालना
definition: waiting briefly before acting, holding back decisions or plans until more information arrives, mainly British English
example: Hang fire on booking the cottage, love; your sister thinks she can bring the baby after all.

hindi: हिम्मत बाँधे रखना — मुश्किल में डटे रहना
definition: continuing bravely through hardship, persevering with effort despite discouraging setbacks and lengthening delay
example: His sister taped a note to the mirror before the results week, just two words telling him to hang in there.

hindi: जान लगाकर पकड़े रहना — किसी हाल में न छोड़ना
definition: holding tightly with desperate determination, refusing absolutely to release your grip, British usage
example: The toddler hung on like grim death to the carousel pony and refused to get off until the third ride.

hindi: किसी की हर बात ध्यान से सुनना
definition: listening intently, completely captivated by everything someone says, eager never to miss anything
example: The children hung on the storyteller's every word, nobody even reaching for the sweets.

hindi: बीच मझधार छोड़ देना — अकेला फँसा देना
definition: abandon somebody publicly, letting shame reach them while withholding defence, support or explanation
example: His co-host went quiet during the interview, hanging him out to dry while the questions kept coming.

hindi: अड़े रहना — दबाव में भी न झुकना
definition: staying firm and determined under pressure, refusing to yield or quit, American usage
example: The coach told his nervous players to hang tough for one more quarter, and they held the lead to the buzzer.

hindi: जूते टाँग देना — लंबे करियर से हमेशा के लिए विदा लेना
definition: abandon a long career permanently, leaving that familiar work behind after many years
example: After thirty seasons of coaching muddy under-elevens, Uncle Sanjay hung up his boots and took the whistle home as a keepsake.

hindi: सिर झुकाना — शर्म से नज़रें नीची करना
definition: show shame and embarrassment after defeat or failure, looking downward with humbled posture
example: The striker hung his head after the missed penalty until his teammates lifted him up.

hindi: जान पर बनी होना — बाल बराबर आसरे पर टिका होना
definition: surviving precariously close to death, where slight worsening would finish a barely holding life
example: For two nights his recovery was hanging by a thread, and the whole ward learned to read the nurse's face.

hindi: हाल बेहाल — थका और उतरा हुआ दिखना
definition: looking wretchedly exhausted in Irish usage, hungover after night without sleep
example: The lads arrived hanging out of themselves after the overnight bus, and their host wisely offered breakfast before conversation.

hindi: मस्त और बेफ़िक्र — अपनी दुनिया में पूरी तरह खुश
definition: quietly delighted with comfortable surroundings, showing contented happiness without wanting anything further, chiefly American
example: Give him a shaded verandah chair and yesterday's newspaper and he stays happy as a clam until somebody mentions lunch.

hindi: चिड़िया सा चहकना — बेहद प्रसन्न
definition: cheerful and carefree, singing with lively energy like a bird greeting morning sunshine
example: Having finally handed in her thesis, Priya cycled to the market happy as a lark, humming the whole way.

hindi: मस्त-मौला — अपनी धुन में ख़ुश
definition: a British simile for being contentedly delighted, absorbed in simple pleasures and wanting nothing more
example: Give Arjun a pile of cardboard boxes and some tape and he is happy as a sandboy until dinner.

hindi: मस्त-मौला — बेफ़िक्र और पूरी तरह ख़ुश
definition: a British simile describing somebody delighted, thoroughly pleased with modest surroundings
example: Give Grandad a deckchair, thermos and crossword and he sits there happy as Larry until sunset.

hindi: संतुष्ट इंसान — मन से ख़ुश
definition: an American-born phrase for a contented, satisfied person pleased with life's current arrangements; often 'not a happy camper' when things sour
example: With a window seat, a fresh samosa and a train running on time, Uncle Rajiv was a very happy camper.

hindi: वाह, मज़ा आ गया — बढ़िया!
definition: a British exclamation of cheerful satisfaction when things turn out nicely; everything sorted, pleasant times ahead
example: The rain stopped just as they unpacked the picnic. 'Happy days,' said Uncle Tom, handing round the sandwiches.

hindi: पत्थर दिल — सख़्त और बेरहम
definition: physically tough and emotionally unsentimental, showing little visible sympathy toward weakness
example: The coach was hard as nails during practice, then bought everybody sugarcane juice and pretended it never happened.

hindi: क़िस्मत ख़राब — अफ़सोस, कुछ नहीं हो सकता
definition: British expression for tough luck, sometimes sympathetic, often mock-sympathetic about someone's misfortune
example: "Hard cheese, old chap," said Granddad when I lost at conkers, then showed me how to pick a winning chestnut for next time.

hindi: कड़ी मशक़्क़त — लगातार मेहनत
definition: long, tiring physical or mental labour requiring steady effort over time, British usage
example: The allotment looked effortless in July, but it was built on months of hard graft through a wet spring.

hindi: रिश्ते का खुला ऐलान — तस्वीर डालकर सबको बता देना
definition: announcing your relationship publicly with unmistakable photographs, revealing your partner without earlier hints
example: Her hard launch arrived without warning on Diwali morning, and forty relatives commented before she had finished breakfast.

hindi: ज़ोर-ज़बरदस्ती से मनवाना — दबाव डालकर बेचने या राज़ी करने का तरीक़ा
definition: aggressive, insistent pressure pushing someone toward agreeing or buying, leaving little breathing room
example: The timeshare salesman gave them the hard sell for two hours, and they escaped only by pretending the babysitter had phoned.

hindi: गले न उतरना — मानना कठिन
definition: difficult to believe or accept, because the claim seems unlikely or the truth painful
example: The news that their favourite café was closing was hard to swallow, so the regulars held one last long breakfast.

hindi: तंगहाल होना — पैसों की किल्लत
definition: short of money and enduring hardship, struggling with poverty that makes ordinary purchases difficult
example: Hard up that winter, Jamie knitted everyone's presents, and his lumpy scarves became the family's favourite heirlooms.

hindi: कड़ी मेहनत — पसीना बहाने वाला काम
definition: heavy exhausting physical labour, tiring effort demanding genuine sweat daily, distinctly Australian phrasing
example: Digging the bore was hard yakka, so the family fed everyone rotis and jaggery until the last shovel stopped.

hindi: मेहनत की घिसाई — लगातार कठिन परिश्रम
definition: unglamorous sustained effort (Australian) earning slow progress through genuinely difficult work
example: Nobody photographed the hard yards behind that garden, only the roses, though her hands remembered every monsoon.

hindi: दुखड़ा रोना — हमदर्दी पाने की कहानी
definition: tale describing personal misfortune and hardship, told seeking sympathy, money or special treatment
example: The stray cat's hard-luck story, told entirely through meowing at the back door, won over the whole household within a day.

hindi: लगातार तीन कामयाबियाँ
definition: three successes achieved consecutively, originally three wickets taken with three straight deliveries in cricket
example: When Dad's third pancake landed perfectly after two flawless flips, the kids cheered his breakfast hat trick.

hindi: बदनाम करने वाली समीक्षा — जानबूझकर की गई बुराई
definition: deliberately harsh, unfair criticism written or spoken to destroy someone's reputation completely
example: The magazine's hatchet job on the old actor was so cruel that readers wrote in to defend him.

hindi: सलाम है — दिल से सम्मान
definition: exclamation expressing admiring respect, praising someone whose effort deserves honour from everybody watching
example: Hats off to the volunteers who kept the soup kitchen running straight through the blizzard.

hindi: ख़ूब मज़े करना — शानदार समय बिताना
definition: enjoy yourself enormously, usually celebrating or partying with friends, laughing through the night
example: The grandparents had a ball at the wedding sangeet, out-dancing every cousin under forty.

hindi: अचानक सूझ आना — बढ़िया तरकीब सूझना
definition: suddenly think of a clever idea or solution, often when things look hopeless, said in British English
example: Stuck with a flat tyre and no jack, Priya had a brainwave and borrowed the hotel's luggage trolley to lift the car.

hindi: गपशप करना — मज़े से बतियाना
definition: chatting informally and happily at length, catching up with friends over gossip, British usage
example: The two grandmothers had a chinwag over the garden fence every morning, rain or shine.

hindi: आसमान सिर पर उठाना — बात का बतंगड़ बनाकर भड़कना
definition: become excessively upset and angry, making a dramatic temper tantrum over something trivial, American
example: Mum would have a cow if she saw the flour on the ceiling, so the kids scrubbed it before she got home.

hindi: दिल आ जाना — किसी पर चुपके से फ़िदा होना
definition: feel secret romantic infatuation toward someone, often while young, shy and never openly confessing it
example: She had a crush on the boy from the library, so she borrowed books she never meant to read.

hindi: छोटा सा दाँव — मज़े के लिए जुआ
definition: place a small wager for amusement, gambling modestly without serious money involved; British
example: Every Grand National, Nana would have a flutter on whichever horse had the prettiest name.

hindi: किसी पर बरस पड़ना — ताना देना
definition: criticise or scold someone angrily, attacking them verbally without much warning, British usage
example: Dad had a go at the neighbour about the hedge, then felt so guilty he trimmed it for him on Sunday.

hindi: भरपूर ज़िंदगी जीना — लंबी और अच्छी पारी खेलना
definition: in British English, from cricket: enjoy a long, full life or career, said kindly after someone's death or retirement
example: At the farewell tea, the old postman's daughter smiled and said he'd had a good innings, forty years of knowing every dog on the route.

hindi: बिखर जाना — गुस्से और तनाव में टूट पड़ना
definition: lose emotional control completely, collapsing into angry tears or shouting under mounting pressure
example: Riya had a meltdown when her laptop crashed before the deadline, and her roommate stayed up helping her retype everything.

hindi: क्या हिमाक़त है — बड़ी ढिठाई करना
definition: behave with shameless cheek or audacity, doing something others find rude or presumptuous
example: You have a nerve, laughed Grandma, when her grandson asked to borrow the car he had dented only last week.

hindi: अकेले में समझाना — चुपचाप दो बात कर लेना
definition: speaking privately and tactfully with someone about a delicate problem, British phrase
example: Rather than scold him at the party, his father had a quiet word by the car, and the apology followed within minutes.

hindi: दिमाग़ का पेच ढीला — कुछ सनकी बरताव
definition: behave in slightly unhinged fashion, showing eccentric thinking without sensible ordinary judgement
example: Neighbours said the beekeeper had a screw loose, then queued politely whenever his honey appeared at the gate.

hindi: सेटिंग होना — जुगाड़ या चुपचाप रिश्ता
definition: used for having a quiet arrangement with someone, whether useful connection or secret romance, as said in Indian English
example: Everyone suspected Priya had a setting with the canteen boy, because her chai always arrived first and extra sweet.

hindi: अपने दिन देख चुका — ज़माना लद गया
definition: passed beyond its period of usefulness or popularity, now considered outdated after earlier success
example: The old cassette player had had its day, but Grandpa still kept it on the shelf beside his records.

hindi: बुरी तरह आशिक़ होना — नींद तक उड़ जाना
definition: suffer helpless romantic longing, thinking constantly about somebody whose affection stays uncertain
example: He had it bad for her from the first monsoon week, agreeing to badminton every evening despite hating badminton.

term: have it made in the shade
hindi: पौ बारह होना — ज़िंदगी सेट होना
definition: enjoying assured success and comfort, every hardship seemingly finished, said in American usage
example: With a pension, a garden and grandchildren next door, Grandpa said he had it made in the shade.

hindi: दो-टूक बात कर लेना — आमने-सामने खुलकर निपटना
definition: settle a grievance through frank confrontation, finally discussing openly what has festered between you
example: After weeks of cold silence, the flatmates had it out over the dishes and ended up ordering pizza together.

hindi: हाथ-पाँव फूल जाना — घबराहट में बेहाल होना
definition: becoming wildly nervous, flustered and agitated, fretting loudly about something that might happen, in British English
example: Mum had kittens when the school trip coach ran an hour late, ringing every parent on the list until it finally pulled into the car park.

hindi: भेजे में भूसा भरा होना — दिमाग़ में अक्ल न होना
definition: behave like a foolish person lacking intelligence and ordinary common judgement
example: Selling a working scooter to buy a broken motorcycle, Ravi's mother said, means having rocks in your head.

hindi: अच्छे दिन देख चुका — अब ख़स्ता हाल
definition: looking worn, shabby or damaged, clearly past its best condition after long years of heavy usage
example: The armchair had seen better days, but nobody dared replace the spot where Grandad read his paper.

hindi: किसी की गर्दन अपने हाथ में होना — मजबूर कर देना
definition: hold someone helpless, forcing them to accept your terms because they have no other choice
example: The only plumber open on Christmas Eve had them over a barrel, and they paid his price with dripping ceilings and grateful hearts.

hindi: साथ खड़े रहना — मुश्किल में किसी का पूरा साथ देना
definition: loyally supporting someone through trouble, ready defending them whenever serious difficulty arrives
example: When the landlord shouted about the broken window, Meera stepped forward and said quietly that she had her brother's back.

hindi: किसी तक सीधी पहुँच होना — बात सुनी जाना
definition: enjoy direct influence with someone powerful, able to share opinions they will listen to
example: Everyone knew the gardener had the principal's ear, so the students quietly asked him about more mango trees.

hindi: किसी की रग-रग पहचानना — असलियत जानना
definition: understand a person's real character and motives, so their tricks no longer fool you
example: He tried charming the landlady into waiving the rent, but she had his number from their very first meeting.

hindi: पेट में मरोड़ — घबराहट से पेट गड़बड़ाना
definition: queasy anxiety churning your stomach, your body jittery before some daunting event, in British English
example: The groom had the collywobbles before his speech, so his best man slipped him a peppermint and a wink.

hindi: पलड़ा भारी होना — थोड़ी बढ़त होना
definition: possess a slight advantage over rivals, making victory somewhat more likely when abilities seem closely matched
example: Both bakers were brilliant, but her years of making bread for a big family gave her the edge in the final round.

hindi: मन में अजीब सी घबराहट — बिना वजह का डर
definition: feeling creeping dread and nervous unease, usually about something spooky or unexplained
example: Walking past the dark churchyard, we had the heebie-jeebies, so we held hands and hummed all the way home.

hindi: किसी पर लट्टू होना — ज़ोरदार आकर्षण
definition: feel strong physical romantic attraction toward someone, fancying them openly and eagerly
example: Everyone in the office knew Priya had the hots for the new florist downstairs, given how many bouquets she suddenly needed.

hindi: जी घबराना — बेचैनी से हाथ-पाँव काँपना
definition: restless and nervous, fidgeting and trembling slightly before something important begins
example: The bride had the jitters in the car, so her father told silly jokes until she was laughing too hard to shake.

hindi: आख़िरी हँसी अपनी — अंत में जीतकर दिखाना
definition: finally emerge victorious after others mocked or doubted you, proving them wrong eventually
example: They teased him for planting tomatoes in old boots, but he had the last laugh when his crop was the biggest on the allotment.

hindi: आख़िरी बात अपनी रखना — बहस में अंतिम वार करना
definition: make the final remark in an argument, refusing to allow anyone else a response afterwards
example: Even at ninety, Great-aunt Rosa always had the last word, usually from the doorway as she left.

hindi: पलड़ा भारी होना — मुक़ाबले में बढ़त होना
definition: hold the stronger position in a contest or argument, with more control and advantage than rivals
example: After winning the first two sets, she had the upper hand and began to play with real freedom.

hindi: लगाम हाथ में होना — हुक्म चलाने की स्थिति
definition: hold commanding control over others, able to dictate terms because they depend completely on you
example: With the only key to the storeroom, the caretaker had the whip hand, and every teacher learned to greet him warmly.

term: have your cake and eat it
hindi: दोनों हाथों में लड्डू — दोनों फ़ायदे साथ चाहना
definition: wanting both incompatible advantages together, refusing whichever sacrifice sensible choice clearly demands
example: He wanted the hostel freedom and his mother's cooking, which is having your cake and eating it, as his father gently noted.

hindi: मज़ाक उड़ाना — मसखरी में कही बात, गंभीर नहीं
definition: joking around, teasing somebody playfully in British usage rather than speaking seriously
example: When Grandad announced he was learning skateboarding we assumed he was having a laugh, until the helmet arrived.

hindi: आगे आकर मोर्चा लेना — आलोचना झेलने के लिए सामने आना
definition: exposed position taken when you speak publicly and risk criticism or attack from others, usually 'put your head above the parapet', chiefly British
example: She knew putting her head above the parapet at the village meeting would cost her friends, but the old well needed saving.

hindi: इक्कीस पड़ना — बाक़ी सबसे साफ़ तौर पर बेहतर
definition: clearly better than everyone else in the group, standing above them in quality
example: Her essay was head and shoulders above the rest, and the examiner said so aloud.

hindi: जान बचाकर भागना — सिर पर पैर रखकर भागना
definition: escape hurriedly, leaving approaching trouble behind rather than remaining somewhere dangerous
example: The moment their landlord appeared with a clipboard, the whole cricket team headed for the hills, leaving one bat behind.

hindi: मुखिया — सबसे बड़ा अधिकारी
definition: person holding chief authority and making final decisions within some group, said informally
example: The head honcho of the wedding catering was a tiny grandmother with a clipboard and a voice like thunder.

hindi: ख़्यालों में खोया रहना — हवाई किले बनाना
definition: daydreaming unrealistically, ignoring practical details while imagining impossible pleasant futures
example: Her brother had his head in the clouds again, planning a mountain cafe while ignoring the leaking tap.

hindi: दिमाग ठिकाने पर — समझदार और व्यावहारिक
definition: thinking sensibly about practical trouble, judging situations calmly without foolish excitement (British)
example: Everyone trusted the youngest sister with the shop money because she clearly had her head screwed on.

hindi: पहले से बढ़त — शुरुआती फ़ायदा
definition: early advantage gained before others begin, giving opportunity to reach success sooner
example: Reading with her father every night gave her a head start when school finally began.

hindi: सुई गिरने की आवाज़ सुनाई देना — एकदम सन्नाटा होना
definition: noticing complete silence throughout a room, everyone holding still while waiting breathlessly
example: When the little girl stepped up to sing, the hall went so quiet you could hear a pin drop.

hindi: कानोंकान खबर मिलना — अफ़वाह के ज़रिए पता चलना
definition: learn private news through informal gossip, before anybody official announces anything
example: We heard it on the grapevine that the school was closing early, so the whole lane planned an afternoon picnic.

hindi: उड़ती-उड़ती खबर सुनना — अफ़वाह से पता चलना
definition: learn news through informal gossip chains, also heard "on the grapevine", rather than official announcement
example: She heard on the grapevine about the transfer, and had already congratulated him before the letter came.

hindi: दिल बैठ जाना — हिम्मत टूट जाना
definition: spirits sunk into gloomy dread, unhappy expectation weighing every thought before anything actually happens
example: She walked into the results hall with her heart in her boots, and walked out grinning at a number she had not dared hope for.

hindi: कलेजा मुँह को आना — डर से दिल धड़कना
definition: sudden fright or alarm, your heart pounding hard as danger looms startlingly close
example: My heart was in my mouth as my daughter wobbled on her bike, but she found her balance and pedalled off grinning.

hindi: दिल बल्लियों उछलना — अचानक ख़ुशी
definition: sudden rush of thrilled excitement or delight, feeling your pulse quicken at welcome news
example: Her heart leapt when she spotted her son's face among the crowd at the arrivals gate.

hindi: मन न लगना — बेमन से करना
definition: lacking spirit and enthusiasm, continuing something while your courage and hope have quietly drained
example: He kept turning up to piano lessons, but his heart was not in it since his teacher moved away.

hindi: दिल का सोना — ऊपर से रूखा, अंदर से नरम
definition: genuinely kind generous nature hidden beneath gruff manner, helping others quietly without expecting reward
example: The watchman scolds every child about the gate, then keeps bandages ready, having a heart of gold underneath.

hindi: पत्थर दिल — दूसरों के दुख से अनछुआ
definition: completely unmoved before other people's suffering, refusing sympathy however sadly somebody pleads
example: The landlord had a heart of stone about the rent until his own daughter mentioned the leaking ceiling.

hindi: दिल बैठ जाना — हिम्मत टूट जाना
definition: feeling sudden discouragement, losing courage completely when disappointing news finally arrives
example: His heart sank when the results page loaded, though his sister insisted the second attempt would feel easier.

hindi: दिल धड़क उठना — अचानक बेचैन कर देने वाली ख़ुशी
definition: feeling sudden breathless excitement when somebody attractive appears unexpectedly nearby
example: Her heart skipped a beat when the lift doors opened and he stood there holding the same novel.

hindi: दिल की बात — खुलकर आपसी बातचीत
definition: honest private conversation about difficult feelings, sharing worries frankly without pretending
example: After the shouting stopped, father and daughter finally had a heart to heart beside the parked scooter.

hindi: राम जाने — ऊपर वाला ही जाने
definition: declaring that nobody on earth could possibly answer, the matter being known only above
example: Heaven only knows how Nana fits forty relatives into that tiny flat every Diwali, yet somehow there is always room for one more.

hindi: बड़ा खिलाड़ी — असरदार और रसूख़दार शख़्स
definition: powerful, influential person whose involvement carries serious weight and reliably produces results
example: The school fete was struggling until the retired headmaster, a real heavy hitter in town, started ringing round for raffle prizes.

hindi: दोनों तरफ दाँव लगाना — जोखिम बाँट लेना
definition: spread your risk across several possible outcomes, protecting yourself whichever result arrives
example: She hedged her bets by applying locally as well, and later thanked herself when the distant college delayed everything.

hindi: हर वक़्त सिर पर मँडराना — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा निगरानी
definition: parent hovering constantly over their child, controlling every decision and protecting them from any difficulty
example: He tried not to be a helicopter parent, but he still drove past the playground twice on her first solo walk.

hindi: आँधी की तरह — बेतहाशा और लापरवाह रफ़्तार से भागना
definition: moving extremely quickly and recklessly, riding onward with furious careless speed
example: The postman came hell for leather down the lane because the storm was already darkening the far hills.

hindi: कयामत आ जाएगी — भारी नतीजे भुगतने पड़ेंगे
definition: severe consequences waiting ahead, furious punishment certain once somebody discovers everything
example: There would be hell to pay when their mother noticed the cake, so both children ate the evidence.

hindi: भगीरथ प्रयास — असंभव-सा बड़ा काम
definition: enormously difficult undertaking demanding almost superhuman strength and effort
example: Clearing out Grandma's attic after forty years was a Herculean task, and every box held a story worth hearing.

hindi: बिल्लियों को हाँकना — बेकाबू भीड़ को संभालने की नाकाम कोशिश
definition: trying hopelessly to organise people scattering everywhere, wasting effort without visible progress
example: Getting eleven cousins into one wedding photograph was like herding cats until Grandmother simply held up the sweet box.

hindi: फिर वही रामकहानी — लो, दोबारा शुरू
definition: exclamation greeting tiresome familiar trouble repeating again, weary recognition rather than genuine surprise
example: When the lights flickered twice, Papa said here we go again and reached calmly for the candles.

hindi: छू मंतर — पलक झपकते ही हो गया
definition: exclamation marking something achieved suddenly, simply and almost magically, British magician's phrase
example: She jiggled the plug twice and, hey presto, the old radio crackled back into song.

hindi: मन में कुछ, ज़ुबान पर कुछ — छिपा हुआ मक़सद
definition: secret motive concealed behind friendly behaviour, private purpose someone deliberately keeps disguised
example: The twins' sudden offer to wash the car had a hidden agenda: they wanted to borrow it on Saturday.

hindi: किसी के आँचल में छिपना — दूसरों की आड़ लेना
definition: avoiding responsibility by relying on another person's protection instead of facing consequences yourself
example: The boy stopped hiding behind his sister's skirts and walked over to apologise to the neighbour himself.

hindi: आँखों के सामने छिपना — खुले में रहकर भी नज़र न आना
definition: remain concealed openly, escaping notice precisely because something sits where everyone looks
example: The spare key hid in plain sight under the smiling garden gnome for twenty years.

hindi: बीच रास्ते छूट जाना — बिना मदद अकेला
definition: stranded without support, abandoned suddenly while everyone else escapes trouble safely
example: His partners withdrew the week before the exhibition and left him high and dry, holding forty unframed paintings and a signed lease.

hindi: ज़िंदगी के नशे में — बिना वजह ख़ुश
definition: naturally elated and energised, thrilled with life itself, needing no special reason or substance
example: After the sunrise hike, Neha came back high on life, talking nonstop about the colours over the valley.

hindi: बड़ा दाँव लगाने वाला
definition: someone spending or gambling enormous sums freely, especially wealthy casino guests betting lavishly
example: The quiet man in the corner turned out to be a high roller who tipped every waiter generously.

hindi: तलवार की धार पर चलना
definition: delicate, risky undertaking requiring constant balance, where one mistake could cause complete failure
example: Hosting both grandmothers at Christmas was a high-wire act, but a shared love of card games saved the day.

hindi: बस अच्छे पल दिखाना — बाक़ी सब परदे के पीछे
definition: polished selection of best moments shown publicly, hiding ordinary struggle standing behind them
example: Comparing your ordinary Tuesday against somebody's highlight reel spoils an evening faster than burnt rice.

hindi: मर-मिटने वाली बात — जिस बात पर अड़े रहना हो
definition: principle or position worth defending stubbornly whatever the cost, often questioned when the issue seems trivial
example: Folding the towels in thirds was, for my mother, a hill to die on, and nobody ever folded them otherwise.

hindi: नखरे भरा गुस्सा — छोटी बात पर तमाशा
definition: childish angry tantrum, dramatic temper shown over something small and quite unimportant
example: My nephew threw a hissy fit over the blue cup, then drank happily from the green one five minutes later.

hindi: बंद गली में पहुँचना — रास्ता बंद मिलना
definition: reach a point where further progress becomes impossible, every route blocked
example: Their search for the old records hit a dead end at the flooded archive, so they started asking neighbours instead.

hindi: अड़चन आना — काम में रुकावट
definition: meet an unexpected obstacle that stalls progress, usually small though frustrating
example: The treehouse plans hit a snag when Dad realised the chosen branch belonged to the neighbour's tree.

hindi: अचानक दम टूट जाना — आगे एक क़दम नहीं
definition: suddenly exhausted beyond continuing, concentration collapsing although plenty of work remains unfinished
example: She hit a wall halfway through the second chapter, closed everything, and walked to the park instead.

hindi: धज्जियाँ उड़ा देना — पूरी तरह पछाड़ देना
definition: in British and Indian English, from cricket: thoroughly demolish someone's argument, plans or confidence with a single forceful stroke
