example: Grandma's quiet question about who had actually washed the dishes hit Rohan's whole speech for six, and the table dissolved into laughter.

hindi: दिल तक उतरना — बात का पूरा असर समझ आ जाना
definition: suddenly understands full meaning emotionally, realizing truth that earlier explanation never quite reached
example: His mother's quiet thank-you hit home harder than the whole hour of arguing had.

hindi: जमना — पहली मुलाक़ात में दोस्ती हो जाना
definition: become friendly with somebody immediately, enjoying easy agreement from your very first conversation
example: They hit it off beside the sweets counter and were exchanging recipes before their families finished shopping.

term: hit it out of the park
hindi: छक्का मार देना — उम्मीद से कहीं बढ़कर कामयाबी
definition: achieve spectacular success beyond every expectation, delivering performance nobody could fault
example: She practised her recital piece nightly and hit it out of the park, leaving even the tabla teacher clapping above his head.

hindi: कभी हाँ कभी ना — कभी सही कभी ग़लत, भरोसे लायक़ नहीं
definition: working unpredictably, with results left to random chance rather than reliable skill or steady control
example: The old oven was hit or miss, so every birthday cake carried a small element of family suspense.

hindi: सोने की खान मिल जाना — फ़ायदे का ठिकाना मिलना
definition: an American mining phrase meaning sudden profitable success arriving after considerable patient searching
example: After forty rejections the illustrator hit pay dirt with a children's book about anxious dinosaurs.

hindi: रसातल में जाना — बिलकुल तल तक पहुँच जाना
definition: someone reaches the lowest possible point, where despair leaves nothing further remaining
example: He hit rock bottom that February, and the neighbour started leaving soup outside the door without knocking.

hindi: बुलंदी छूना — शोहरत की दुनिया में पहुँचना
definition: reach wealthy, famous success after struggling, finally arriving among celebrated names
example: The band hit the big time but still played a free gig every Christmas at the school where they met.

hindi: किताबों में सिर खपाना — जमकर पढ़ाई करना
definition: study textbooks intensively, reading lessons repeatedly while preparing anxiously before important examinations
example: Meera hit the books every evening after the shop closed, and her mother kept refilling the lamp without being asked.

hindi: रुकावट से टकराना — अचानक थम जाना
definition: in British usage, of plans or progress, stop abruptly after losing momentum, like trains reaching the track's final barrier
example: Our plan to renovate the attic hit the buffers when we found a family of bats living there, so we built them a box.

hindi: धराशायी होना — मुँह के बल गिरना
definition: suffer a heavy, humbling setback that knocks you flat, like a boxer floored mid-fight
example: When the bakery failed its first inspection, Salma hit the canvas for a week, then came back with a spotless kitchen and new recipes.

hindi: आग बबूला होना — एकदम भड़क जाना
definition: suddenly explode into furious temper, reacting with shouting anger to shocking news
example: Dad hit the ceiling when he saw the phone bill, then laughed when he found out Grandma had been calling Canada.

hindi: चादर तान के सोना — नींद के हवाले होना
definition: head towards bedtime sleep, admitting tiredness rather than watching another late programme
example: Grandfather hit the hay before the second innings ended, trusting somebody would report the score at breakfast.

hindi: लॉटरी लग जाना — अचानक बड़ी क़िस्मत या मोटा धन हाथ लगना
definition: sudden unexpected fortune, usually money, arriving through luck rather than labour
example: She bought the crumbling corner shop for almost nothing, and when the metro line was announced she realised she had hit the jackpot.

term: hit the nail on the head
hindi: सटीक बात कहना — ठीक वही मर्म पकड़ लेना
definition: state precisely the correct point, naming exactly what everybody else struggled describing
example: Grandmother listened through the whole argument, then hit the nail on the head with one sentence about school fees, and nobody disagreed.

hindi: हड़बड़ी मचाना — घबराकर जल्दबाज़ी करना
definition: reacting with sudden alarm, rushing into drastic measures before thinking anything through calmly
example: When the cake sank in the middle we nearly hit the panic button, then filled the hollow with strawberries instead.

hindi: सफ़र पर निकल पड़ना — यात्रा शुरू कर देना
definition: begin a journey, departing promptly instead of lingering over long unfinished goodbyes
example: They hit the road before sunrise, thermos wedged between the seats, hoping to reach Nainital before the afternoon buses filled every road.

hindi: आग-बबूला होना — सुनते ही भड़क उठना
definition: react with sudden temper, shouting furious anger when unwelcome news finally arrives
example: Grandma hit the roof about the broken window, though she was mostly frightened that someone might have been hurt by the glass.

hindi: बिस्तर पकड़ना — सोने चल देना
definition: settle into bedtime sleep, finally tired enough that abandoning evening feels sensible
example: After the long drive everyone hit the sack early, leaving the unpacked bags standing beside the door.

hindi: ढलान पर आना — लगातार गिरावट में चले जाना
definition: a business slides steadily downward, losing money and standing until collapse seems certain
example: The little press hit the skids after the second printer broke, though the editor kept mailing pamphlets anyway.

hindi: रौ में आ जाना — लय पकड़ लेना
definition: settle into a confident rhythm, moving smoothly after difficult early stumbling
example: Around the second week of rehearsals the dancers hit their stride, and afternoons stopped feeling like punishment.

hindi: कुछ और असर करना — साधारण से कहीं गहरा लगना
definition: affects somebody unusually powerfully, feeling richer, stranger, memorable beyond ordinary comparable experiences
example: That same monsoon song hits different once you have actually waited beside a station platform alone, soaking.

hindi: नाम का विकल्प — लेना है तो यही लेना है
definition: apparent choice offering only single option, accepting whatever arrives rather than refusing, chiefly British
example: The last bus offered Hobson's choice, so they squeezed aboard beside crates of guavas and sang most of the journey.

hindi: सारी रौशनी खुद ले लेना — दूसरों को छाया में रखना
definition: grab constant audience attention during performance, refusing other performers their fair share
example: He hogged the limelight through every rehearsal until the director quietly moved his chair behind the chorus.

hindi: अपने ही जाल में फँसना — अपनी चाल से अपना नुकसान
definition: harmed badly through your scheming, suffering precisely what your trick intended against others
example: He locked the gate early to teach his cousin punctuality and stood outside in the drizzle, hoist by his own petard.

term: hold a gun to someone's head
hindi: सिर पर बंदूक रखना — ज़बरदस्ती मजबूर करना
definition: force someone into a decision through threatening pressure, leaving them no genuine freedom to refuse
example: Nobody held a gun to your head, Arjun, his sister laughed, reminding him he had volunteered to cook for twenty.

hindi: सारे पत्ते हाथ में होना — पूरी ताक़त अपने पास
definition: possess every important advantage over rivals, controlling what happens next completely
example: With the only car in the family and a full tank of petrol, Dad held all the cards over where the picnic would be.

hindi: दरबार लगाना — घिरे रहकर बातों से सबको बांधे रखना
definition: dominate surrounding conversation happily while admirers gather, everybody listening rather than talking themselves
example: Grandfather held court beside the heater until midnight, retelling the flood story while nobody dared interrupt properly.

hindi: ज़रा देखो मैं क्या करता हूँ — शेख़ी भरी बेतुकी चुनौती
definition: jokey announcement that you are about to attempt something even more reckless or daring, internet-era
example: When his sister landed a cartwheel, Grandpa said "hold my beer", managed half of one, and laughed on the lawn.

hindi: किसी को बंधक बनाकर शर्तें मनवाना
definition: pressure people by threatening to withhold something they badly need until they accept your demands
example: The toddler held the whole family to ransom, refusing to put on her shoes until someone promised ice cream.

hindi: यह बात याद रखना — अभी रुको, बाद में कहना
definition: request that someone pause their idea briefly, promising the conversation returns after interruption
example: Hold that thought — the kettle's boiling, and I want to hear the whole story about your first day.

hindi: मोर्चा संभालना — पीछे रहकर काम चलाते रहना
definition: keeping ordinary work running alone while other people stay away, managing responsibility temporarily
example: Uncle held the fort at the shop through the wedding week, dozing between customers by afternoon.

hindi: मोर्चा थामे रखना — दबाव में भी स्तर गिरने न देना
definition: refuse to allow standards to slip, resisting steady pressure from every direction
example: Cheaper cheese would have doubled their margin, but the two brothers held the line, and regulars tasted the difference.

hindi: तिजोरी की चाबी हाथ में होना — पैसों पर नियंत्रण
definition: control spending within a family or group, deciding exactly where the money goes
example: Nani still holds the purse strings, and every grandchild's birthday gift passes through her careful approval.

hindi: लगाम थामे रखना — संस्था की कमान संभालना
definition: control an organisation, guiding every important decision that others must follow
example: Grandfather still held the reins of the tea estate, though he signed papers from a wicker chair now.

hindi: बात में दम न होना — दलील का टिक न पाना
definition: stand firm under scrutiny, the argument or excuse proving sound; usually said negatively about flawed claims
example: His excuse did not hold water, since he claimed to be at the library on a day it was closed for painting.

hindi: ज़रा रुको, गोली मत चलाओ — जवाब देने से पहले ठहरना
definition: stop attacking briefly, waiting quietly before continuing a quarrel until better information finally arrives
example: Hold your fire until the doctor phones back, his father said, folding the alarming letter into his shirt pocket.

hindi: ग़लती क़बूल करना — दोष अपने सिर लेना
definition: in British usage, admit your mistake honestly, accepting blame openly instead of inventing excuses
example: Dad held his hands up about the burnt lasagne and ordered everyone's favourite curry to make amends.

hindi: सिर ऊँचा रखना — गरिमा से डटे रहना
definition: keep your dignity and pride in difficult times, showing courage rather than shame or defeat
example: The team lost the final by a single point, but the coach told them to hold their heads high all the way home.

hindi: ज़रा ठहरो — जल्दबाज़ी छोड़कर धीरज रखना
definition: waiting patiently, slowing down instead of rushing ahead before everything becomes ready
example: Hold your horses, said the cook, waving a spoon; the rice needs another minute under the lid.

hindi: हिम्मत बनाए रखना — दबाव में न घबराना
definition: staying calm and determined under pressure, refusing panic when things become frightening
example: On the final penalty she held her nerve, looked the goalkeeper in the eye, and sent it into the corner.

hindi: शोर बंद करो — चुप हो जाओ
definition: telling someone to stop talking, complaining or making fuss, said in Scottish and Irish English
example: Hold your noise, laughed Granda, lifting the wailing baby onto his knee and pulling a funny face.

hindi: ख़ामोश रहना — मन की बात मन में रखना
definition: remain silent, keeping objections unspoken, deliberately refusing to reveal what you think
example: When the vicar paused for objections, even the bride's grumpy uncle held his peace and smiled.

hindi: ज़ुबान रोकना — चुप रह जाना
definition: staying quiet deliberately, holding back words that would worsen this fragile moment
example: Grandmother held her tongue through the entire argument, then quietly served everyone dessert.

hindi: चुप हो जा — ज़रा शांत रहो
definition: telling someone to stay silent, stop chattering and listen quietly, said in Irish English
example: Hold your whisht now, said Nana gently, and the children fell silent as the kettle finally began to sing.

hindi: खोखली जीत — जीत जिसमें कोई ख़ुशी नहीं
definition: victory that brings no genuine satisfaction, because winning demanded enormous sacrifice or meant little
example: Beating his little brother at tennis felt like a hollow victory once he saw the boy's wobbling lip.

hindi: बेड़ा पार — अब कोई ख़तरा नहीं
definition: safely successful, victory certain and secured, with every remaining danger behind you; British
example: Once the last exam paper was handed in, she felt home and dry and ran straight to the beach with her friends.

hindi: जीत पक्की — मंज़िल पर सुरक्षित पहुँचे
definition: finished and victorious, the result beyond doubt with nothing left to worry about; Australian and New Zealand
example: With the last hay bale in the shed before the rain, the farmer grinned and declared the family home and hosed.

hindi: दूसरा घर — जहाँ अपने घर जैसा सुख मिले
definition: place where visitors feel comfortably settled, almost belonging like their actual household
example: Her grandmother's kitchen became a home away from home during exams, complete with a spare quilt and endless roasted peanuts.

hindi: एक ही झटके में बाज़ी — पूरी कामयाबी
definition: single spectacular success settling everything decisively through well-judged confident effort
example: His first attempt at his grandmother's biryani turned into a home run, and cousins queued twice with empty plates.

hindi: आख़िरी दौर — मंज़िल बिलकुल सामने
definition: final demanding stage before completion, when exhausted effort nearly reaches finish
example: They painted the last window frame during the home stretch, then collapsed onto the veranda steps with cold lemonade.

hindi: अपना घर सबसे प्यारा — लौटने का सुख
definition: relieved delight upon returning inside your comfortable household after tiring travel
example: He dropped both suitcases in the corridor, sighed home sweet home, and went straight for the kettle without removing his shoes.

hindi: खरी-खोटी — चुभने वाली सच्चाइयाँ
definition: in British usage, plain, unwelcome truths about your character, spoken bluntly by someone close
example: After a few home truths from his sister, he rang their father and apologised for missing every birthday.

term: honest as the day is long
hindi: खरा सोना — पूरी तरह ईमानदार
definition: thoroughly honest through and through, someone trusted completely, never cheating anybody
example: The corner shopkeeper is honest as the day is long and always tells children when their sweets money is short.

hindi: निष्पक्ष बिचौलिया — ईमानदार मध्यस्थ
definition: impartial mediator trusted honestly by both quarrelling sides, dealing fairly without hidden motives
example: Their eldest cousin acted as honest broker between the two brothers until they finally shared a meal again.

hindi: हुस्न का जाल — प्रेम के बहाने फँसाना
definition: deceitful scheme using false romance or seduction, luring someone into revealing secrets
example: The spy novel on Grandpa's shelf turned on a honey trap, and he read the final chapter aloud with great relish.

hindi: शुरुआती मिठास — नए रिश्ते का सुनहरा दौर
definition: early blissful stretch when everything feels perfect, before ordinary problems start appearing
example: The honeymoon period ended the first time they tried assembling a wardrobe together.

hindi: पूरी तरह — बिना शक के
definition: completely and without doubt, describing someone believing a trick or invented story entirely
example: Dad fell for the April Fool's joke hook, line and sinker and was already dialling the zoo about the escaped penguin.

hindi: लग जाओ काम पर — फ़ौरन
definition: hurry along immediately, starting some task quickly and energetically without further delay
example: The guests arrive in an hour, so hop to it and get those fairy lights strung up.

hindi: गुस्से से लाल-पीला — बेहद नाराज़
definition: extremely furious, so angry you could practically bounce with barely contained temper
example: Grandma was hopping mad when the goat ate her marigolds, but by evening she was feeding it biscuits.

hindi: ख़रीद-फ़रोख़्त — विधायकों का सौदा
definition: common in Indian English politics for buying legislators' loyalty with favours, especially while forming shaky governments
example: The school council election turned into horse trading, with votes openly exchanged for cafeteria samosas and borrowed notebooks.

hindi: परेशान और बेचैन — घबराहट में लाल-पीला
definition: flustered and agitated, flushed with nervous irritation when things become stressful
example: He got hot and bothered trying to assemble the cot, until his wife read the instructions aloud and they finished together.

hindi: किस्मत चमकी हुई — हर दाँव सही बैठ रहा
definition: temporary spell during which everything attempted succeeds, fortune running unusually strong meanwhile
example: Grandmother had a hot hand at rummy that evening, and nobody dared mention how often she reshuffled the pack.

hindi: बिखरा हाल — अस्त-व्यस्त पर प्यारा
definition: chaotic, disorganised person or situation, spectacularly disastrous though often oddly endearing
example: I arrived at my sister's wedding a hot mess, one shoe missing, and she hugged me before anyone else.

hindi: ठीक पीछे-पीछे — एड़ी से एड़ी मिलाकर
definition: following very closely behind, arriving quickly after something else just happened
example: Hot on the heels of the first snowfall came the whole neighbourhood, sledges and all.

hindi: जलता अंगारा — जिसे कोई हाथ न लगाए
definition: troublesome issue so controversial that everyone quickly passes it along rather than handling it
example: Who would host Christmas became the family's hot potato, until the youngest cousin cheerfully volunteered her tiny flat.

hindi: तीखी राय — ध्यान खींचने के लिए झटपट दी गई राय
definition: deliberately provocative opinion shared quickly, often online, designed more for attention than careful reasoning
example: Her hot take that biryani tastes better cold started a family group chat that ran until midnight.

hindi: तमतमाया हुआ — गुस्से से लाल-पीला
definition: visibly furious and flustered, showing rising anger through reddened, sweating face
example: The umpire grew hot under the collar as both captains argued, until rain sent everyone laughing into the pavilion.

hindi: सिर पर पैर रखकर भागना — जल्दी से पहुँचना
definition: hurry somewhere urgently on foot, leaving quickly without wasting a single moment
example: When the bakery texted that the last cinnamon rolls were coming out, my sister hotfooted it down the hill in her slippers.

hindi: नाज़ों का पला — कठिनाई सहने का अभ्यास नहीं
definition: person raised sheltered from hardship, delicate and unprepared for difficulty outside family protection
example: Her first winter in the hostel, with cold water and shared kitchens, taught the hothouse flower more than four years of tutoring had.

hindi: फूट पड़ा घर — भीतरी झगड़े से कमज़ोर संगठन
definition: family or group weakened badly through internal quarrelling, heading toward likely collapse
example: Two brothers running one sweet shop with separate cash boxes made a house divided, and the customers chose sides too.

hindi: ताश का महल — देखने में खड़ा, छूते ही ढेर
definition: impressive looking arrangement that actually stands hollow, collapsing instantly once anyone questions it
example: One honest question from the auditor, and the family business turned out to be a house of cards.

hindi: घर बड़ा, जेब ख़ाली — मकान के कर्ज़ में दबे रहना
definition: American for owning a costly home while having little money left, mortgage spending draining everything else
example: House poor that first year, they furnished the living room with cushions and fairy lights and hosted the cosiest parties in town.

hindi: घर-घर में नाम — हर किसी की ज़ुबान पर
definition: someone whose fame reached everywhere until almost everyone instantly recognises the name
example: Twenty years of radio mornings turned the weather announcer into a household name.

hindi: गड़बड़ हो गई — मुसीबत की घोषणा
definition: humorous announcement that something serious has gone wrong, borrowed from Apollo spaceflight history
example: Opening the oven to find a blackened turkey, Mum called out, “Houston, we have a problem,” and ordered pizza for twelve.

hindi: गले मिलकर सुलह — गिले-शिकवे भुलाना
definition: settle a quarrel through warm embrace, restoring friendship without lengthy discussion, informal American usage
example: After a week of sulking about the borrowed jacket, the roommates finally hugged it out in the hallway.

hindi: आगा-पीछा करना — टालमटोल में समय गँवाना
definition: hesitating endlessly, postponing decisions while muttering doubts and avoiding commitment, mainly British; Americans usually prefer 'hem and haw'
example: Dad hummed and hawed over the puppies for an hour, until the smallest one fell asleep on his shoe and settled it.

hindi: शिकायत की चादर में तारीफ़ — अपनी बड़ाई घुमाकर
definition: boasting disguised inside pretend complaint, displaying achievement while performing modest embarrassment
example: His humble brag about exhausting travel fooled nobody, least of all the sister counting every foreign stamp.

hindi: घुटने टेकना — अपनी गलती मानकर सबके सामने माफ़ी मांगना
definition: humiliating public admission that you were completely wrong, elsewhere phrased as eating crow
example: After insisting the shortcut existed, Ramesh had a plateful of humble pie before the whole family and asked his cousin to lead the way.

hindi: किसी पर अटका रहना — भुला नहीं पाना
definition: remaining stubbornly attached to somebody romantically, thinking about them constantly despite long separation
example: Three years later he stayed hung up on her, keeping the postcard inside his passport wallet.

hindi: भागो और फिर इंतज़ार करो — बेमतलब की जल्दबाज़ी
definition: frantic rushing followed by long pointless waiting, urgency wasted because nothing actually moves; American
example: The airport was pure hurry up and wait: we sprinted to the gate, then sat for two hours eating crisps.

hindi: मुँह बंद करने की रक़म — चुप रहने के बदले पैसा
definition: payment given secretly to purchase silence, stopping someone from revealing damaging information
example: My little brother demanded hush money of two chocolate bars before promising not to mention the broken vase.

hindi: मज़ाक नहीं कर रहा — सच बता रहा हूँ
definition: insisting something surprising really happened, honestly, though listeners might suspect joking or exaggeration
example: I kid you not, the baby's first word was 'biscuit', and she has been negotiating for them ever since.

hindi: मैं तटस्थ हूँ — किसी का पक्ष नहीं लूँगा
definition: declaring yourself neutral, refusing to take sides between friends quarrelling around you
example: When his cousins started arguing about the wedding caterer, Aman raised both palms and said he was Switzerland until dessert arrived.

hindi: रगों में बर्फ़ — दबाव में भी ठंडा दिमाग़
definition: cold, unshakeable calm under intense pressure, especially when everything depends on your next move
example: With the scores level and the crowd roaring, the eleven-year-old stepped up with ice in her veins and sank the final penalty.

hindi: ठंडा बर्ताव कर दूर करना — धीरे-धीरे किनारा कर लेना
definition: gradually freezing somebody from your attention, withdrawing warmth until they understand they seem unwanted
example: The group iced him out slowly, replies arriving later each week until the invitations simply stopped.

hindi: सोने पे सुहागा — अच्छी बात पर और अच्छा जुड़ना
definition: pleasant final addition improving something already thoroughly satisfying without being necessary
example: Passing the exam delighted her, and the scholarship letter arriving that same week was simply icing on the cake.

hindi: औकात से बड़े सपने — हैसियत से ऊँची चाहत
definition: ambitions and manners pretending higher social rank than your actual background honestly supports
example: His grandmother said ideas above your station never hurt anybody, then packed him off to the city with two shirts.

hindi: मूड ख़राब — चिड़चिड़े मिजाज़ में
definition: badly tempered in Irish usage, snapping resentfully at anybody speaking nearby
example: Grandad was in a bad skin about the flooded shed, so everybody discussed cricket instead until the mood shifted.

hindi: मजबूरी में फँसना — हाथ में कोई विकल्प न होना
definition: constrained by awkward circumstances that leave very few workable options open for escaping trouble
example: The florist was in a bind when the lilies never arrived, so the neighbours stripped their gardens of roses for the wedding.

hindi: साँप-छछूंदर की गति — न निगलते बने न उगलते
definition: trapped between two unpleasant choices, unable to move forward or backward, a British phrase
example: Asked to choose which best friend would be bridesmaid, Anya was in a cleft stick and finally asked them both.

hindi: उलझन में पड़ना — क्या करें समझ न आना
definition: caught inside an awkward predicament, puzzled about which remedy could possibly work
example: Grandpa was in a fix when the cake collapsed an hour before the party, until my sister suggested turning it into a trifle.

hindi: हड़बड़ी में होना — घबराकर बौखलाना
definition: flustered and agitated, rushing about nervously when something unexpected goes wrong, in British English
example: Auntie was in a flap when twelve extra guests arrived, but the whole street chipped in with pots of curry.

hindi: पल भर में — बिजली की तरह
definition: happening suddenly and instantly, quick like lightning, arriving with almost no warning beforehand
example: The rain stopped in a flash, and the whole street stepped out to admire the rainbow.

hindi: धुंधलाया दिमाग़ — उलझन में होना, कुछ साफ़ समझ न आना
definition: confused and unable to think clearly, understand the situation, or notice ordinary surroundings
example: After three nights awake with the baby, Daniel wandered through the office in a fog, greeting the printer politely.

hindi: मूड उखड़ा हुआ — बेवजह उदासी में
definition: sunk in gloomy, sluggish spirits that linger for days without any clear reason, mostly heard in American English
example: Maya had been in a funk since the holidays ended, so her roommate dragged her out for pancakes and a walk by the river.

hindi: टूटकर बिखर जाना — थकान और चिंता से चूर
definition: utterly exhausted in Irish usage, emotionally collapsed after relentless worry
example: After three nights beside the hospital bed she was in a heap, and her aunt simply took the children home without asking.

hindi: बिना सोचे-समझे — तुरंत
definition: instantly and without hesitation, agreeing eagerly before stopping even briefly to think
example: If you ever need someone to drive you to the hospital at midnight, I'll come in a heartbeat.

hindi: इंतज़ार की घड़ी में — आगे बढ़ने की अनुमति का इंतज़ार
definition: circling uncertainly while waiting, unable to move forward until permission or news arrives
example: The slow house sale left the whole family in a holding pattern, so they spent the summer camping happily in the garden.

hindi: गड्ढे में गिरना — कर्ज़ या मुसीबत में
definition: sunk into difficulty, especially money trouble or debt, that feels hard climbing back from
example: After the harvest failed, the family was deeply in a hole, yet the village pooled seed until the next season came good.

hindi: फँस जाना — अटकी हुई हालत
definition: stuck inside sudden trouble, usually needing someone quick to come rescue you
example: Whenever any cousin was in a jam, they rang Auntie Rose first, because she always turned up with a flask and a plan.

hindi: अभी आया — एक पल में
definition: within a very short moment, promised almost immediately, usually said cheerfully to someone waiting
example: Sit down and warm your hands, the soup will be ready in a jiffy.

hindi: फ़ौरन — बिना एक पल सोचे
definition: instantly and without hesitation, faster than anyone could reasonably expect; American informal
example: If my old band asked me to play one more reunion show, I would say yes in a New York minute.

hindi: संक्षेप में — थोड़े शब्दों में
definition: explained simply and briefly, reducing something complicated to its essential clear points
example: In a nutshell, Grandma's secret to a long marriage was separate blankets and a shared love of crossword puzzles.

hindi: मुसीबत में फँसना — कोई आसान रास्ता नहीं
definition: trapped inside awkward difficult situation where every available escape looks equally troublesome
example: With guests arriving early and the cylinder empty, Amma stood in a pickle until the neighbour offered her stove.

hindi: हरगिज़ नहीं — बिल्कुल झूठ
definition: scornful reply, American in usage, dismissing a claim as nonsense and showing flat disbelief
example: When the neighbour claimed his tomatoes beat hers fairly at the fair, Grandma muttered, 'In a pig's eye,' and went back to her garden.

hindi: पचड़े में पड़ना — शरारत से मुसीबत
definition: caught in trouble caused by mischief or recklessness, especially youthful adventures that went wrong
example: Every summer the twins landed in a scrape of some kind, and every summer their grandmother quietly paid for the broken greenhouse glass.

hindi: चकराया हुआ — घबराहट और उलझन में
definition: flustered and confused, thoughts whirling so fast that clear thinking becomes impossible
example: The wedding caterer cancelled the night before, sending the whole family into a spin until the neighbours offered their kitchens.

hindi: छोटी-मोटी परेशानी — हल्की दिक़्क़त
definition: understated British phrase for being in minor trouble, often considerably worse than the modest wording admits
example: The captain radioed that they were in a spot of bother, which turned out to mean one engine had quietly stopped.

hindi: मुँह फुलाकर बैठना — रूठकर चिढ़ा रहना
definition: sulking in grumpy irritated silence, stomping about after feeling unfairly treated, British
example: Priya spent the afternoon in a strop over the cancelled picnic, until her father set up a blanket in the living room.

hindi: मुश्किल में फँसना — तंग हालत
definition: stuck inside an awkward predicament with little room to escape without outside help; also 'in a tight corner'
example: When the car died on the hill road at dusk, we were in a tight spot until a farmer arrived with his tractor and a length of rope.

hindi: पलक झपकते ही — क्षण भर में
definition: happening almost instantly, gone or changed without any noticeable delay; rather literary
example: The street magician made the coin vanish in a trice, and the children gasped in delight.

hindi: बदहवास हालत — घबराहट में सब गड़बड़
definition: flustered, in Cockney rhyming slang, describing somebody panicking amid messy confusion
example: Mum arrived in a right two and eight, having posted the tickets instead of the birthday card.

term: in a world of your own
hindi: अपनी ही दुनिया में मगन — आसपास से बेख़बर
definition: completely absorbed in private thoughts, unaware of people and things happening around you
example: The little boy was in a world of his own, building a castle of cushions while the grown-ups talked.

hindi: हर मौसम में — सर्दी-गर्मी की परवाह किए बिना
definition: steady faithful presence maintained regardless of miserable conditions, British phrasing
example: She cycled to the library in all weathers, arriving with damp shoulders and dry books wrapped carefully inside plastic.

hindi: मौज में होना — सुख-समृद्धि में जीना
definition: living comfortably, luxuriously, without money worry, surrounded plenty, enjoying prosperity gained recently
example: After the little cafe caught on with tourists, Anil and his sister were in clover.

hindi: दाखिल दफ़्तर करना — फ़ाइल बंद करके भुला देना
definition: postponed indefinitely and forgotten, waiting quietly for attention arriving much later
example: His grandmother's letters stayed in cold storage inside a biscuit tin, and reading them at forty felt like meeting a stranger who loved him.

hindi: गहरे पानी में — गंभीर मुसीबत में फँसा हुआ
definition: struggling inside serious trouble beyond your ability, needing rescue from somebody more capable
example: By the third month of the loan he was in deep water, and his brother-in-law arrived with a calculator and no lecture.

term: in for a penny, in for a pound
hindi: ओखली में सिर दिया तो मूसलों से क्या डरना — शुरू किया है तो पूरा करो
definition: once already committed, carry through completely rather than stopping halfway; British
example: We'd already painted one wall yellow, so in for a penny, in for a pound, we painted the ceiling too.

hindi: पूरे निखार पर — सबसे सुंदर अवस्था में
definition: flourishing completely, showing healthy beauty exactly when growth reaches finest possible moment
example: At sixty-two, with grandchildren shouting in the courtyard, our neighbour insisted her happiness was only now in full bloom.

hindi: नेक नीयत से — सच्चे मन से
definition: acting honestly with sincere intentions, dealing fairly without deception or hidden motives
example: The neighbours agreed in good faith to share the garden, and twenty years later they still split every mango.

hindi: तुनककर — अपमान महसूस कर नाराज़गी से
definition: indignantly offended and grumpy, leaving or complaining with a great show of wounded pride
example: The old tailor left the wedding in high dudgeon when the groom's cousin criticised his stitching.

hindi: मन प्रसन्न होना — तबीयत चहकती हुई
definition: cheerful, delighted mood carrying lively happiness through everything happening around you that afternoon
example: The whole carriage travelled in high spirits, passing sweets along the aisle to strangers who became temporary cousins.

hindi: गिरवी रखकर चलना — कर्ज़ में
definition: owing money against pawned belongings, unable to reclaim them until that debt clears
example: His trumpet sat in hock behind the counter, and the pawnbroker promised nobody else would touch it.

hindi: मौज ही मौज — मन की मुराद पूरी
definition: an American phrase for being blissfully delighted, surrounded by plenty of the simple pleasures you love most
example: With a hammock, a paperback and a bowl of cold cherries, Dad was in hog heaven all afternoon.

hindi: मुसीबत मोल लेना — नाराज़गी के चलते संकट में फँसना
definition: facing serious trouble after angering people, with punishment or unpleasant consequences approaching rather quickly
example: Ravi landed in hot water with his mother after borrowing the scooter without asking and returning it scratched.

hindi: चुटकी में — झटपट
definition: done remarkably quickly and briskly, whole task completed without fuss; Irish English
example: Mam had the whole kitchen scrubbed in jig time before the visitors pulled into the drive.

hindi: अधर में लटका — न इधर न उधर
definition: stuck waiting in uncertainty, unable to move forward until somebody else finally decides
example: With the visa still in limbo, she kept a suitcase half-packed by the door and learned every bus route just in case.

hindi: बात की बात में — बहुत जल्दी
definition: finished remarkably quickly, completing some task faster than everybody watching expected; American informal
example: She had the flat-pack wardrobe assembled in no time flat while her brother was still reading the instructions.

term: in one ear and out the other
hindi: एक कान से सुना दूसरे से निकाला — कुछ याद न रखना
definition: forget instruction immediately after hearing, remembering nothing despite patient repeated explanation
example: Grandmother's cooking advice went in one ear and out the other, which the burnt rice announced clearly.

hindi: बस के बाहर होना — संभाल न पाना
definition: involved in something beyond your ability, struggling badly without enough knowledge or strength
example: Volunteering to cater fifty guests, he was soon in over his head, until the neighbours arrived carrying pots.

hindi: हालत पतली होना — अमीरी से तंगी में आना
definition: British euphemism for living in poverty after former comfort, hardship politely described by the genteel
example: Living in reduced circumstances, the retired actress still poured tea from her silver pot and told the grandest stories on the street.

hindi: सातवें आसमान पर होना — परम आनंद में डूब जाना
definition: extremely happy inside perfect contentment, delighted enough that ordinary worries briefly disappear
example: Give him a plate of hot jalebis and a cricket match, and my brother is in seventh heaven until sundown.

hindi: जल्द ही — बिना देर किए
definition: promptly and efficiently, dealt with quickly without needless delay or fuss afterwards
example: The neighbours rallied round and had the fallen fence rebuilt in short order.

hindi: किसी की नज़र से गिरा हुआ — नाराज़गी झेलना
definition: suffering disapproval after annoying somebody, currently out of favour until you earn forgiveness
example: He stayed in his wife's bad books for days after forgetting their anniversary dinner.

hindi: किसी का पक्ष लेना — मुश्किल में हौसला और समर्थन देना
definition: actively supporting someone, staying loyally encouraging through difficulty until trouble finally passes
example: Before the audition she looked out and found her old teacher clapping already, and knew somebody was still in her corner.

hindi: किसी की नज़र में अच्छा — कृपापात्र होना
definition: enjoying someone's approval and favour, liked because your recent behaviour pleased them
example: Washing Dad's car every Saturday kept Priya firmly in his good books.

hindi: किसी की जगह खुद को रखकर — उसकी स्थिति महसूस करना
definition: imagining another person's difficult position sympathetically, feeling what facing their circumstances means
example: Standing there in his brother's shoes for a moment, he stopped composing the lecture he had planned.

hindi: भरपूर मात्रा में — ज़रूरत से कहीं ज़्यादा
definition: in huge abundance, possessed to an extreme degree, far more plentiful than anyone needed or expected
example: The new puppy had charm in spades, and within a week even the grumpy landlord was bringing it biscuits.

hindi: मुट्ठी में — जीत पक्की
definition: victory or success already certain, secured completely before the formal finish arrives
example: With three questions left and a twenty-point lead, the grandparents knew the quiz was in the bag and ordered celebratory scones.

term: in the blink of an eye
hindi: पलक झपकते ही — क्षण भर में हो जाना
definition: happening instantly, finished within moments, before anyone notices anything changed
example: In the blink of an eye the wedding lawn emptied, and only the string lights kept swaying above the empty chairs.

hindi: बेदाग़ निकलना — शक और इल्ज़ाम से पूरी तरह मुक्त
definition: released from blame, suspicion, and danger after a worrying period finally ends
example: The auditors closed their files, told the old shopkeeper he was in the clear, and he sat down heavily on his stool and laughed.

hindi: निशाने पर — सबकी आलोचना का केंद्र
definition: singled out as the chosen target, everybody's criticism and blame pointing steadily toward you alone
example: Once the accounts went missing, the treasurer found himself in the crosshairs of aunties who had never counted anything.

hindi: अँधेरे में रखा जाना — जानकारी से वंचित रहना
definition: confused and understanding nothing about a situation because others deliberately withheld important information
example: The whole street knew about the wedding; only the groom's uncle stayed in the dark.

hindi: नाराज़गी झेलना — अपनों की खफ़गी में रहना
definition: stuck facing displeasure from someone close, remaining quietly troubled until forgiveness finally arrives
example: Having forgotten their anniversary entirely, he spent Sunday in the doghouse, washing vegetables without being asked once.

hindi: सुस्ती में डूबा — मन उदास, कुछ करने का जी नहीं
definition: stuck in gloomy, listless spirits where nothing moves forward and every task feels flat
example: Grandpa was in the doldrums all winter, until the first seedlings pushed through his window box and he started humming again.

hindi: पतवार अपने हाथ में होना — दिशा तय करने की ताक़त होना
definition: control the direction of a group, making every important decision that others follow
example: After her father retired, Meera found herself in the driver's seat of the little press on Lane Four.

hindi: उम्मीद से होना — गर्भवती होना
definition: old-fashioned phrase meaning pregnant, expecting a baby that will soon join the family
example: Grandad still says a woman is in the family way, which makes my cousin laugh every time he says it about her.

hindi: बस दोस्त बनकर रह जाना — इश्क़ में दोस्ती का ठप्पा
definition: stuck being treated purely as companion when you secretly hoped for romance instead
example: He spent four years in the friend zone before she asked him to her cousin's wedding as her date.

hindi: समय आने पर — जब वक़्त पक जाएगा
definition: eventually, after considerable delay, whenever circumstances finally allow something happening naturally
example: In the fullness of time the youngest inherited the workshop, though nobody discussed inheritance while their father still whistled there.

hindi: कठघरे में खड़ा होना — जवाबदेही का दबाव
definition: holding responsibility under intense scrutiny, facing tough questions others are watching closely
example: At the parents' evening the new headteacher was in the hot seat, answering every worried question with patience and biscuits.

hindi: भीतर की ख़बर रखने वाला — जानकार
definition: having secret insider information about private matters that others remain unaware about
example: Only those in the know went to the bakery at seven, when the cinnamon buns were still warm.

term: in the lap of the gods
hindi: ऊपर वाले के हाथ में — नतीजा अब किसी के बस में नहीं
definition: situation whose outcome nobody controls, uncertain result depending entirely upon chance beyond human effort
example: The seeds were sown, the canal was dry, and the whole season now lay in the lap of the gods.

hindi: चाँदी ही चाँदी — पैसे की बहार
definition: enjoying plenty of money at last, often after winning a prize, race or lucky investment
example: Once the orchard's mango harvest sold abroad, the whole village felt in the money and repainted the temple gates.

hindi: ऐन मौके पर — बिलकुल आख़िरी क्षण में
definition: arriving at the final possible moment, just before a deadline expires completely
example: She reached the platform in the nick of time, hair everywhere, waving her ticket like a small flag.

hindi: आसार दिखना — निकट भविष्य में होने के संकेत
definition: visibly approaching soon, expected shortly although nothing formal announced anywhere
example: There was a transfer in the offing, so Father started sorting the bookshelves months before anybody mentioned packing.

term: in the palm of your hand
hindi: मुट्ठी में — पूरी तरह क़ाबू में
definition: under your complete control or charm, willing to follow wherever you lead them
example: The storyteller held the village square in the palm of his hand until the final line made everyone gasp.

hindi: लाल-भबूका होना — खिली हुई सेहत
definition: glowing with excellent health, rested and cheerful, showing colour that signals real wellbeing
example: Two weeks in the hills and the children came home in the pink, sunburnt and starving.

hindi: एक ही नाव में सवार — सबकी हालत एक जैसी
definition: sharing identical difficult circumstances alongside others, facing similar unpleasant trouble without special advantage
example: Every family on the lane lost power that week, and being in the same boat turned the terrace into one long dinner.

hindi: धीमी रफ़्तार में — सुकून भरी ज़िंदगी
definition: living or moving deliberately slowly, choosing gentle pace while others rush ahead
example: After retiring they happily moved into the slow lane, spending mornings feeding ducks and afternoons reading on the porch.

hindi: आफ़त में पड़ना — बुरी तरह फँसना
definition: informal, slightly old-fashioned phrase meaning deep in serious trouble, usually through careless mistakes
example: Having forgotten both anniversary and dinner reservation, Tom knew he was properly in the soup and went straight to the flower stall.

hindi: सुर्ख़ियों में — हर हरकत पर निगाहें
definition: receiving intense public audience attention, where every action stays closely watched during performance
example: Suddenly in the spotlight after one viral clip, the shy tailor started answering his phone in a whisper.

term: in the twinkling of an eye
hindi: पलक झपकते — आँख मूँदते-खोलते
definition: within a single moment so brief it passes between blinks, happening almost instantly
example: In the twinkling of an eye the summer was over, and the children were packing their school bags again.

hindi: पर्दे के पीछे तैयार — मौके के इंतज़ार में
definition: waiting quietly offstage, ready to enter performance whenever somebody ahead falters or leaves
example: A younger cousin sat in the wings with the account books, patient, certain his turn would arrive.

hindi: दुविधा में पड़ना — मन का बँट जाना
definition: unable to decide between competing choices, hesitating while weighing both options endlessly
example: She was in two minds about the transfer letter, and her mother simply asked which city let her sleep better.

hindi: पलक झपकते — बस ज़रा सी देर में
definition: within a very short moment, done almost before anyone notices waiting; also 'in two shakes of a lamb's tail'
example: Grandpa promised the kettle would boil in two shakes, and sure enough the whistle went before we had found the biscuit tin.

hindi: दो पल में — ज़रा रुको
definition: within a couple of seconds, a cheerful promise to someone waiting that you will be very quick; British informal
example: Hang on, I'll find the torch in two ticks and then we can go and look for the kitten.

hindi: अपने रंग में होना — अपनी सबसे मज़बूत कला में डूबा हुआ
definition: performing confidently inside your strongest talent, everything landing easily without visible strain
example: Three songs into the set the drummer was completely in his bag, grinning at nobody, hearing only the room.

hindi: ख़ून में होना — जन्मजात गुण
definition: talent or instinct inherited deeply, passed down through generations so naturally it feels part of you
example: Three generations of his family had fished that river, so when the boy cast his first line it looked like it was in his blood.

hindi: सपने में — ऐसा कभी नहीं होगा
definition: teasing reply suggesting someone's hope or claim will never happen outside their imagination
example: 'I'll beat you at chess tonight,' said the nine-year-old, and her grandmother smiled, 'In your dreams, darling,' setting up the board.

hindi: अपने रंग में होना — अपनी ही दुनिया में सहज
definition: relaxed, comfortable, confident doing something familiar, perfectly suited toward natural talent, surroundings
example: Give him a garden, a spade, and a whole Sunday, and my father is entirely in his element.

hindi: जज़्बात में बहे — भावुक और उदास
definition: modern slang for feeling unusually emotional, tender or wistful, usually after a song or memory
example: One old voice note from his grandmother had him in his feels for the whole bus ride home.

hindi: जेब में होना — किसी के पूरे काबू में होना
definition: kept under another person's secret control while publicly appearing completely independent
example: The referee insisted he was neutral, but half the town believed he was in the club president's pocket.

hindi: नींद में भी कर लेना — इतना अभ्यास होना
definition: performing something easily, automatically, without thinking, effort, concentration, after endless repeated practice
example: Forty years behind the counter, and she could weigh, wrap, and total an order in her sleep.

hindi: भारतीय लचीला समय — तय वक़्त से हमेशा देर
definition: joking Indian English phrase describing habitual lateness, where announced starting times stretch hours beyond schedule
example: The wedding card said seven, but everyone knew about Indian Stretchable Time, so the band only tuned up at nine.

hindi: अंदर की ख़बर — गुप्त जानकारी
definition: secret insider information, private details learned before others hear, often shared eagerly
example: My cousin works at the zoo, so we got the inside scoop on when the baby otters would first swim.

hindi: अंदर की जानकारी — मुक़ाबले में ख़ास बढ़त
definition: privileged knowledge granting quiet advantage, favoured position among other people competing
example: Having grown beside the orchard gave her the inside track about which mangoes ripened first, so neighbours followed her basket.

hindi: सोशल मीडिया पर रिश्ता पक्का — तस्वीर डालकर मुहर लगाना
definition: declaring your relationship publicly through shared photographs, letting followers confirm your chosen partner
example: They became Instagram official beside the Marine Drive railing, and his mother learned about it from a neighbour's daughter.

hindi: शेर के मुँह में — विरोधियों के ठीक बीच
definition: entering a place full of powerful, hostile people who might attack you, requiring courage
example: Wearing his team's scarf, Arjun walked into the lion's den of the rival supporters' stand and was greeted with good-natured jeers.

term: iron fist in a velvet glove
hindi: मख़मली दस्ताने में फ़ौलादी मुट्ठी — नरम अंदाज़ में सख़्त इरादा
definition: firm determination hidden behind gentle, courteous manners, getting your way through apparent softness
example: The school's gentle librarian ruled with an iron fist in a velvet glove, and not one overdue book ever escaped her.

hindi: सुस्त घड़ी — आराम से चलने वाला समय
definition: relaxed, unhurried pace where schedules stretch and nobody minds delays, associated with tropical islands
example: Nobody rushed breakfast on island time, and by the third morning even Dad had stopped checking his watch.

hindi: पोल खुल गई — खेल ख़त्म
definition: scheme or deception exposed and finished, nothing further possible to hide; usually 'the jig is up'
example: When the kitchen smelled of chocolate cake, the jig was up and the children confessed to planning Mum's surprise.

hindi: हेराफेरी — छोटी-मोटी चालबाज़ी
definition: sneaky dishonest trickery, underhand manipulation behind people's backs, often mildly comic, British usage
example: There was some jiggery-pokery with the raffle tickets, because Uncle Tony won the hamper for the third year running.

hindi: आगे निकलने की होड़ — जगह के लिए धक्का-मुक्की
definition: manoeuvre competitively for advantage, pushing and scheming quietly against rivals seeking identical rewards
example: At the wedding photo, the cousins jockeyed for position beside the bride, each insisting their good side was the left.

hindi: याद दिलाना — भूली बात कुरेदकर उभारना
definition: help somebody recall forgotten details, mentioning something familiar until their memory returns properly
example: She jogged his memory with the old photograph, and suddenly he remembered every name around that table.

hindi: नया-नया आया — देर से जुड़ा हुआ
definition: newcomer arriving belatedly, joining something established long after others built it
example: The old gardeners teased him as a Johnny-come-lately, then gave him the best allotment when his tomatoes won first prize.

hindi: तार जोड़ना — बिखरी बातों से तस्वीर बनाना
definition: connect separate pieces of information, understanding pattern nobody explained clearly beforehand
example: She joined the dots between the missing sugar and her nephew's sudden generosity with morning tea for everyone.

hindi: साये की तरह साथ — हर वक़्त साथ रहने वाले
definition: inseparable close friends, constantly together, rarely seen apart from each other anywhere
example: Since the first day of hostel they have been joined at the hip, sharing notes, noodles and every complaint about the mess food.

hindi: अनजाना मोहरा — जिसका असर कोई न भाँप सके
definition: in British English: unpredictable person or element whose influence could upset expected outcomes surprisingly
example: The new transfer student was the joker in the pack at sports day, winning the sack race in borrowed wellies.

hindi: मीठी छुरी — अपनापन दिखाकर किया गया विश्वासघात
definition: betrayal hidden beneath warm affection, greeting a trusted friend kindly while quietly planning treacherous harm
example: He hugged his cousin warmly on the courthouse steps, and only later did that Judas kiss make sense.

term: judge a book by its cover
hindi: सूरत देखकर सीरत आँकना — ऊपरी रूप से राय बनाना
definition: assess somebody entirely from outward appearance, misjudging character before learning anything genuine
example: They judged the visitor by his cover until he sat down and repaired the harmonium in twenty minutes.

hindi: परछाईं से चौंकना — बेवजह डरना
definition: timid and easily frightened, seeing danger in harmless things that pose no real threat
example: After moving to the city she jumped at shadows for weeks, until the neighbours started dropping by with tea.

hindi: मौका लपक लेना — बिना सोचे अवसर तुरंत स्वीकार कर लेना
definition: accept a rare opportunity eagerly and instantly, taking action before that favourable moment slips quietly away
example: When the bakery offered her the early shift, Rukhsana jumped at the chance, because mornings smelled better than anything else in that town.

hindi: बरस पड़ना — अचानक तीखी डाँट
definition: snap angrily at someone suddenly, answering harshly before they have even finished speaking
example: He jumped down his daughter's throat about the dented car, then learned a delivery truck had done it.

hindi: ख़ुशी से उछल पड़ना — बेहद प्रसन्न होना
definition: leap about openly delighted, overflowing with happiness after wonderful news arrives unexpectedly
example: When the letter from the university came, Nani read it twice, then grabbed Meera's hands and the two of them jumped for joy in the kitchen.

hindi: बहती गंगा में हाथ धोना — चलन देखकर शामिल होना
definition: join sudden popular trend rather late, supporting something only after crowds began cheering
example: Once the local team started winning, every shop jumped on the bandwagon and hung flags above the shutters.

hindi: चौंक पड़ना — अचानक डर से उछल जाना
definition: startled violently by something sudden, your whole body jolting with instant fright
example: Grandpa's cuckoo clock struck midnight just as I crept past, and I nearly jumped out of my skin in the dark hallway.

hindi: डूबती नाव छोड़ना — संकट से पहले साथ छोड़ देना
definition: abandon a group or commitment early, leaving companions behind before trouble arrives
example: Half the choir jumped ship the week before the concert, so the remaining seven sang louder and nobody noticed.

hindi: जल्दबाज़ी करना — समय से पहले शुरू कर देना
definition: starting something before the proper moment, acting hastily before preparations finish
example: He jumped the gun and announced the baby's name, though his sister had not chosen between the final three.

hindi: बेढंगा पैंतरा — जहाँ से गिरावट शुरू हो जाती है
definition: an American phrase describing series, career, project attempting desperate gimmick where quality declines permanently afterwards
example: Fans agreed the show jumped the shark when the detective adopted a talking parrot, though everybody kept watching anyway.

hindi: पापड़ बेलना — हर शर्त पूरी करना
definition: obey demanding, often pointless requirements set by someone with authority, before getting what you want
example: Mira jumped through hoops for the visa, then cried happily at the airport when her sister finally walked through.

hindi: जंगल राज — अराजकता
definition: used for complete lawlessness where brute strength rules, order collapsing and authorities absent, as said in Indian English
example: With the teacher out of the room, the classroom descended into jungle raj until the monitor restored order with a biscuit bribe.

hindi: फ़ैसला बाक़ी — अभी तय नहीं
definition: people remain undecided whether something is true or good, still weighing evidence and doubts
example: The jury is still out on Dad's new beard, although the baby definitely seems to enjoy pulling it.

hindi: मेरी क़िस्मत ही ऐसी है
definition: rueful complaint that misfortune has struck you again, typically when things could easily have turned differently
example: "Just my luck," sighed Tom as the last slice of cake went to his sister, who promptly shared it with him.

hindi: ज़बान में मिठास रखना — गुस्से में भी शालीनता से बोलना
definition: speaking politely despite anger, avoiding rude words even when provoked by someone
example: Even when the landlord blamed her for the leaking roof, Farah kept a civil tongue and quietly showed him the photographs.

hindi: बात दबा कर रखना — राज़ छिपाना
definition: prevent secret spreading further, holding private information away from curious listeners
example: Keep a lid on it until Friday, she pleaded, knowing her cousin could never manage silence.

hindi: हँसी दबाए रखना — चेहरे पर कोई भाव न आने देना
definition: hiding amusement behind serious expressions, holding back laughter when something funny happens
example: The priest somehow kept a straight face when the groom's phone rang with a cartoon theme during the vows.

term: keep a tight rein on someone
hindi: लगाम कसकर रखना — कड़ा नियंत्रण
definition: maintain strict, careful control over someone's behaviour or spending, allowing very little freedom
example: Priya kept a tight rein on the holiday budget, counting every rickshaw fare while her friends teased her lovingly.

hindi: नज़र रखना — ध्यान से देखते रहना
definition: watching carefully over time, checking regularly whether trouble might begin
example: Grandmother kept an eye on the boiling milk while pretending to read yesterday's newspaper.

hindi: हाथ भर की दूरी रखना — नज़दीकी से बचना
definition: maintain deliberate emotional distance, refusing closeness while remaining superficially friendly
example: She kept him at arm's length all winter, warm in conversation yet careful never to answer anything personal.

hindi: जैसे-तैसे गुज़ारा करना — दो जून की रोटी जुटाना
definition: earn barely enough food and shelter to survive, managing somehow with very little money
example: In her first year in the city she kept body and soul together with night shifts, borrowed books, and her landlady's leftover soup.

hindi: घर की बात घर में रखना — बाहर किसी को न बताना
definition: keeping private matters secret among relatives, refusing to share them with outsiders
example: Whatever happened at Diwali stays between us, said Uncle Ravi, winking; we keep it in the family.

hindi: सौ टका सच बोलना — पूरी तरह खरा रहना
definition: stay completely honest and authentic, speaking openly even when pretending would feel easier
example: 'Keep it one hundred with me,' her best friend said, 'do you actually like the haircut?' and they both burst out laughing.

hindi: असली बने रहना — दिखावा न करना
definition: stay authentic and honest, speaking openly without pretending or performing for approval
example: Even after the band got famous, they kept it real by playing the same village fair every summer.

hindi: बात पेट में रखना — भेद किसी को न बताना
definition: keeping news completely secret, telling nobody until permission finally arrives
example: She told me about the engagement and made me keep it under my hat for three long weeks.

hindi: मुँह पर ताला लगाना — बात छिपाकर चुप रहना
definition: staying deliberately silent about a secret, refusing to reveal anything whatever questions arrive
example: Grandma kept mum about the surprise party all week, even when Priya fished for clues over breakfast every single morning.

hindi: पट्टे में बाँधे रखना — किसी को खुली छूट न देना
definition: closely watched and forced to obey another person, given little freedom
example: The new intern was kept on a short leash for a month, then handed the keys to the darkroom.

hindi: चलते रहना — धीरज से अपना रास्ता जारी रखना
definition: quietly continuing forward through ordinary troubles, persisting patiently without dramatic effort or complaint
example: Asked how she had managed forty years of running the corner shop, Mrs Kapoor just shrugged and said you keep on keeping on.

hindi: चलते रहो — हिम्मत न हारना
definition: cheerfully continuing forward through life's troubles, refusing discouragement, American slang from the seventies
example: Grandpa waved from the hospital bed, grinned at the nurses, and told us he planned to keep on trucking for another decade.

hindi: लगे रहना — धीरे-धीरे मेहनत करते रहना
definition: continuing steadily working at something difficult, patiently making slow progress despite little encouragement
example: Nobody bought her pottery for the first two summers, but she kept plugging away at the market stall until the regulars started saving her a corner.

hindi: सबूत सहेज कर रखना — कागज़ात संभालना
definition: preserve screenshots, messages and evidence proving what somebody actually promised earlier
example: She kept receipts through every excuse, and produced them calmly when the landlord denied everything.

hindi: चुप्पी साध लेना — जानते हुए भी कुछ न बताना
definition: stay completely silent, British slang from Yiddish, refusing to reveal anything you know about a secret
example: Asked who had eaten the last mince pie, Grandpa kept schtum and quietly brushed crumbs off his jumper.

hindi: दूर रखना — पास आने से रोकना
definition: holding trouble or people away steadily, preventing anybody unwanted from coming closer
example: Two friendly street dogs kept the pamphlet-distributors at bay, and the family enjoyed a quiet Sunday afternoon.

hindi: काँटे पर टाँगे रखना — उम्मीद देकर आज़ाद भी न करना
definition: retain someone's romantic hope without commitment, refusing either closeness or honest release
example: She kept him on the hook through two summers, until his transfer letter arrived and decided the matter kindly for everyone.

hindi: नींद उड़ा देना — लगातार चिंता कराना
definition: worrying someone constantly, a nagging anxious concern stealing their sleep night after night
example: What keeps my father up at night is whether his old tailoring shop will survive, not whether he will retire.

hindi: हिसाब रखना — नज़र बनाए रखना
definition: an American phrase meaning supervising somebody quietly, watching activity closely through steady patient tracking
example: She kept tabs on her brother's studying through cheerful phone calls disguised as questions about football.

hindi: भरोसा बनाए रखना — उम्मीद न छोड़ना
definition: continuing to believe and hope, staying loyal to your cause despite discouragement
example: The club hadn't won in eleven seasons, but the old supporters kept the faith and turned up every Saturday.

hindi: घर संभालना — पीछे से चूल्हा-चौका चलाते रहना
definition: maintaining steady work at home while other people stay distant, keeping ordinary responsibility alive
example: She kept the home fires burning for two years, letters arriving with sand still in the folds.

hindi: बात सँभालना — माहौल बिगड़ने से पहले शांत करा देना
definition: avoiding confrontation by calming angry tempers, quietly preventing quarrel from starting again
example: Uncle kept the peace at every reunion by seating the rival cousins at opposite ends of the table.

hindi: कई काम एक साथ सँभालना — सबको साधे रखना
definition: manage several busy demands simultaneously, constantly attending each before something collapses
example: Between night classes, two children and her mother's hospital visits, she somehow kept all the plates spinning.

term: keep the wolf from the door
hindi: दो जून की रोटी जुटाना — भुखमरी टालना
definition: manage with little, earning barely enough for food and rent while holding poverty away
example: Two evening shifts kept the wolf from the door until her proper contract finally came through.

hindi: पड़ोसी की होड़ — दिखावे की बराबरी
definition: spending competitively to match the neighbours' possessions and lifestyle, anxious never to appear less wealthy than them
example: They stopped trying to keep up with the Joneses and spent their savings on a garden instead.

hindi: हिम्मत बनाए रखना — मुश्किल में भी चेहरा न लटकाना
definition: stay cheerful under continuing difficulty, refusing to show despair while pressure lasts
example: He kept his chin up through the third round of rejections, still ironing a shirt each morning.

hindi: ठंडा दिमाग रखना — गुस्से में न आना
definition: holding personal calm steady during provocation, refusing anger despite deliberate insults
example: The autorickshaw driver kept his cool through ten minutes of shouting, then quietly pointed at the traffic signal.

hindi: दूरी बनाए रखना — नज़दीकी से बचना
definition: staying deliberately apart from somebody, refusing closeness, contact, further conversation
example: He kept his distance from his old business partner at the wedding, nodding politely across the lawn and choosing another table.

hindi: अपना मोर्चा संभाले रखना — अपनी ज़िम्मेदारी निभाना
definition: in British English, from cricket: perform your share properly and hold steady under pressure, never letting partners down
example: With his brother doing the cooking, Sam kept his end up by scrubbing every pot before the guests arrived.

term: keep your eyes on the prize
hindi: नज़र मंज़िल पर — लक्ष्य से ध्यान न हटाना
definition: staying focused on your ultimate goal, ignoring distractions and setbacks along the journey
example: Through two years of saving and skipping holidays, they kept their eyes on the prize: a house with a lemon tree in the yard.

hindi: आँखें खुली रखना — चौकन्ना रहना
definition: watching alertly, noticing immediately whenever something important finally appears
example: Keep your eyes peeled for the blue gate, he warned, because the driver always misses that turning.

hindi: दुआ करना — अच्छे नतीजे की उम्मीद रखना
definition: hoping quietly that something turns successful, silently wishing somebody luck without announcing anything
example: Everyone kept their fingers crossed while the results loaded, and Amma quietly lit another stick of incense.

hindi: दिमाग ठंडा रखना — घबराए बिना सोचना
definition: staying calm during frightening trouble, thinking clearly instead of panicking foolishly
example: The young conductor kept his head when the brakes failed, guiding passengers calmly toward the rear doors.

hindi: जैसे-तैसे निभाना — डूबे बिना मुश्किल दौर काट लेना
definition: barely surviving continued difficulty, exhausted and short of strength, still avoiding complete collapse
example: Between night classes and her mother's medicines, Fatima kept her head above water on tuition money and stubbornness.

hindi: सिर झुकाकर रहना — मुश्किल दौर में चुपचाप काम करते रहना
definition: avoid attracting hostile attention, working quietly until whatever dangerous trouble around you finally passes
example: New in the hostel, she kept her head down through the ragging weeks and quietly topped the term examinations.

hindi: नाक मत घुसाओ — दूसरों के मामले में दखल मत दो
definition: avoid interfering with private affairs that never concerned somebody outside them
example: Father kept his nose out of his daughter's flat-hunting entirely, offering only lunch and the occasional useful phone number.

hindi: रास्ते खुले रखना — अंतिम फैसला टाले रखना
definition: avoid final commitment deliberately, preserving several possible choices until better information arrives
example: He kept his options open until March, filling a notebook with pencilled plans nobody else understood.

hindi: मन की बात मन में रखना — योजना किसी से न कहना
definition: holding back private plans, staying quiet about opinions until decisions finally harden
example: He kept his own counsel about moving abroad until the tickets were printed and folded away.

hindi: बारूद सूखी रखना — तैयार रहना, पर वार सही मौके पर करना
definition: prepare quietly and stay watchful, holding resources back until trouble actually arrives
example: He had the evidence printed and filed, but kept his powder dry until the committee finally asked for it.

hindi: आराम रखो — गुस्सा थामो
definition: remain patient during irritation, controlling temper instead of shouting while waiting
example: Keep your shirt on, said the mechanic gently, the scooter will be ready before the rain even starts.

hindi: अपनी ज़बान बंद रखना — बेवजह न बोलना
definition: rude informal instruction telling someone to stop talking, especially before they reveal something
example: Keep your trap shut about the cake, hissed Kabir, as their mother walked into the kitchen singing.

hindi: अलग ही बखेड़ा — बिल्कुल दूसरी तरह की उलझन
definition: awkward troublesome situation entirely different from whatever everybody comfortably expected beforehand
example: Repainting the room was simple; discovering the leaking pipe behind the almirah was quite another kettle of fish.

hindi: मुँह पर तमाचा — बहुत बड़ा झटका
definition: cruel, unexpected setback or bitter disappointment arriving just when you most needed support and kindness
example: Losing the scholarship was a kick in the teeth, but her coach sat with her that evening and mapped out a new plan.

hindi: ठंडे बस्ते में डालना — मामले को चुपचाप टाल देना
definition: quietly shelving an awkward proposal, postponing decisions indefinitely until everyone forgets, said mostly in British English
example: When the village asked for a zebra crossing, the council kicked it into the long grass, so the grandmothers chalked their own stripes every morning.

hindi: किसी को दरवाज़ा दिखाना — बेरहमी से छोड़ देना
definition: ending relationship bluntly, dumping partner who has proved worthless or disloyal, in American usage
example: Her friends threw her a pizza party the night she finally kicked that liar to the curb.

hindi: गिरे को और मारना — मुसीबत में और चोट
definition: attack somebody already suffering badly, worsening their misfortune through needless public cruelty
example: Nobody mentioned the exam results at dinner; there was no sense kicking the boy when he was down.

hindi: टें बोल जाना — मृत्यु हो जाना, बेतकल्लुफ़ हँसी-मज़ाक के अंदाज़ में
definition: blunt comic euphemism about death, reached when solemn language feels excessive
example: Grandpa joked he would kick the bucket before the mangoes ripened, then ate two bowls of them.

hindi: हाय-तौबा मचाना — शिकायत का शोर करना
definition: complain loudly enough creating commotion, forcing everybody notice your unresolved personal grievance
example: Father kicked up a fuss about the broken fan until the landlord arrived himself, carrying tools and unexpected sweets.

hindi: खुलकर नाचना-गाना — बंधन छोड़ मस्ती करना
definition: relax completely and enjoy yourself freely, casting aside everyday worries and responsibilities awhile
example: With the harvest finally in, the farmers kicked up their heels at the village fair until the lanterns burned low.

hindi: बेकार इंतज़ार करना — खाली बैठे समय काटना
definition: waiting around idly with nothing useful to do, wasting time until something finally happens; British
example: We kicked our heels at the station for two hours, then made friends with the brass band waiting for the same train.

hindi: अपना सिर पीटना — अपनी गलती पर पछताना
definition: regret your careless mistake bitterly, blaming yourself repeatedly although that finished decision cannot change
example: He kicked himself the entire train journey for leaving the tickets beside the kettle, while his sister quietly charmed the conductor.

hindi: बच्चों का खेल — मामूली सा काम
definition: task so simple that even small children could manage, needing almost zero effort or skill
example: The old carpenter looked at the flat-pack wardrobe instructions, smiled, and called the whole thing kids' stuff.

hindi: मारे या तारे — जोखिम भरा आखिरी इलाज
definition: drastic remedy likely either rescuing somebody completely or ruining everything, British favourite
example: Selling the shop felt kill or cure, and his wife agreed only because the alternative looked slower and sadder.

hindi: समय काटना — खाली वक्त यूँ ही बिताना
definition: filling empty hours with trivial amusements while waiting, since nothing useful demands attention
example: They killed time counting kites over the rooftops until the power came back and the fans stirred.

term: kill two birds with one stone
hindi: एक पंथ दो काज — एक ही कोशिश में दो काम
definition: achieve both separate aims through single well-planned effort, saving trouble afterwards
example: She carried the tiffin to her father's shop before college, killing two birds with one stone and getting fresh jalebis besides.

hindi: थोड़ा एडजस्ट कीजिए — ज़रा सरक जाइए, समझौता कर लीजिए
definition: polite request asking someone to squeeze over, make room, or quietly accept small inconvenience, as said in Indian English
example: Kindly adjust, uncle, said the college boy, and somehow a fifth passenger fitted onto the auto-rickshaw's back seat.

hindi: हमख़याल — मन मिलता साथी
definition: someone sharing your character, tastes and outlook so closely they feel instantly familiar
example: At the pottery class she spotted another woman laughing at her own wonky bowl and knew she had found a kindred spirit.

hindi: सबसे ऊपर — शिखर पर बैठा व्यक्ति
definition: person holding the leading, dominant position, whom every rival keeps trying to knock down; American
example: After winning the chess club three years running, Priya was king of the hill, and every newcomer wanted a game with her.

hindi: बेशुमार रकम — राजा की फिरौती जितनी बड़ी कीमत
definition: enormously expensive amount, large enough that paying would ruin most ordinary households
example: Grandmother's little brooch turned out to be worth a king's ransom.

hindi: गले मिलकर सुलह करना — रूठे लोगों का फिर से मिल जाना
definition: settle a quarrel warmly and return to easy friendship, both sides forgiving the harsh words spoken
example: After an hour of sulking at opposite ends of the sofa, they kissed and made up over cold pizza.

hindi: प्रेम के राज़ खोलना — निजी रिश्ते की बातें उजागर करना
definition: reveal private details of a romantic affair publicly, often selling intimate secrets afterwards
example: He was a gentleman who would never kiss and tell, so the village had to guess why he whistled all spring.

hindi: चरण छूना — ताक़तवर के आगे झुकना
definition: submit publicly to someone powerful, showing obedience and accepting their authority to stay favoured
example: Every new cousin eventually kisses the ring, bringing Grandma's favourite sweets to the Diwali gathering.

hindi: क़रीबी रिश्तेदार जैसे — बहुत मिलती-जुलती चीज़ें
definition: things closely related or strikingly similar, belonging together like members of one family
example: Her grandmother's dal and the soup at the corner café were kissing cousins, and she ate both happily.

hindi: सगे-संबंधी — रिश्तेदार और जान-पहचान वाले
definition: friends and relatives together, the whole family circle plus everyone familiar living nearby
example: The whole village turned up for the wedding, kith and kin crammed around long tables under the mango trees.

hindi: काठ छूना — शुभ बात कहकर बुरी नज़र टालना
definition: hoping current luck continues, American superstition warding away misfortune after boasting
example: Nobody has forgotten their keys since March, knock on wood, said the watchman patting the wooden doorframe.

hindi: ऊँचे पायदान से गिराना — गद्दी छीनना
definition: humbling someone dominant in British usage, removing their proud position of superiority, often by beating them
example: The village team knocked the county champions off their perch with a last-minute header.

hindi: कहीं बेहतर होना — दूसरे को फीका कर देना
definition: defeat someone thoroughly or prove vastly better, leaving rivals looking clearly inferior; British
example: Her mother's handwritten recipe knocks spots off anything from the cookery books, and the whole family knows it.

hindi: जड़ ही काट देना — तर्क का आधार गिरा देना
definition: destroy the central support beneath an argument or plan, making everything built above collapse
example: The receipt in his jacket pocket knocked the bottom out of his story about working late at the office.

hindi: जमकर होने वाली — आर-पार की
definition: extremely fierce and prolonged, describing quarrels fought without restraint until exhaustion, American usage
example: The family had a knock-down drag-out argument about the holiday plans, then booked the same beach they always do.

hindi: छक्का खा जाना — सदमे से पूरी तरह हिल जाना
definition: left shaken completely by sudden unwelcome news, British cricket phrasing describing somebody floored
example: The village team was hit for six before lunch, so the losing captain bought everybody kulfi and promised revenge next Sunday.

hindi: ऊपर का बुलावा आना — मौत के क़रीब होना
definition: seriously weakened and close to dying, with the remaining time understood to be short
example: He joked that he was knocking on heaven's door, then beat us all at cards.

hindi: निर्णायक चोट — जो सब ख़त्म कर दे
definition: decisive final setback that finishes a fight, campaign or hope completely and permanently
example: The rained-off final day was nearly the knockout blow for the village fair, until everyone carried the stalls into the school hall.

hindi: ज़ुबानी याद होना — रटा हुआ होना
definition: remembering something perfectly from memory, reciting every detail without checking anything
example: Their grandmother knew forty songs by heart, and every wedding ended with someone begging her for another.

hindi: सारे पेच जानना — काम की बारीकियाँ समझना
definition: knows every step of a difficult practical system, taught through long personal experience
example: Ask Bela which counter opens first; she knows the ropes at that post office.

hindi: असलियत जानना — हालात की सच्चाई समझना
definition: understand the real facts of a situation, including the unpleasant parts nobody states openly
example: The old stray cat knows the score: sit by the fish stall looking pitiful and dinner always arrives.

hindi: समय रहते पत्ते रख देना — हार मान लेने की समझ
definition: recognise that withdrawing early prevents deeper losses than stubborn continuing would ever allow
example: He knew when to fold, closed the second stall quietly, and kept enough saved money to reopen the first properly.

hindi: अपने विषय का धुरंधर होना — पूरी जानकारी रखना
definition: understand your chosen subject thoroughly, British praise towards somebody genuinely knowledgeable
example: The tailor knows his onions, measuring shoulders once and cutting cloth that fits perfectly every time.

hindi: शौक़ की मेहनत — प्रेम से किया गया काम
definition: demanding work undertaken purely from pleasure or devotion, never mainly for money
example: Restoring his late father's old scooter was a labour of love that took him three years of Sunday afternoons.

hindi: एक ही बात रटना — समझी हुई बात बार-बार दोहराना
definition: keep stressing an argument listeners already understand, repeating it long after everyone agreed; British English, spelled 'labor' in American usage
example: "I don't want to labour the point," said Dad, before explaining the importance of seatbelts for the fourth time that trip.

hindi: बलि का बकरा — अनजाने ही ख़तरे में उतर जाना
definition: walking innocently toward serious harm, defenceless because nobody warned about waiting danger
example: The new player went into that argument like a lamb to the slaughter, and the older members later apologised over samosas.

hindi: दूध-घी की नदियाँ — सुख-समृद्धि की जगह
definition: region imagined offering living comfortably, plenty, without money worry, hunger, hardship troubling anyone
example: His letters home described the coast as a land of milk and honey, though he mostly washed dishes.

hindi: हर हाल में सँभल जाना — गिरकर भी अप्रत्याशित रूप से ठीक-ठाक निकल आना
definition: recovering unexpected fortune quickly after trouble, ending steadier than circumstances promised
example: The bakery closed in March and by June he had landed on his feet running the kitchen at the hotel down the road.

hindi: भारी बहुमत से जीत — एकतरफ़ा जीत
