definition: victory by an overwhelming margin, especially in elections, burying rivals beneath enormous support
example: The shy boy won the class election in a landslide victory, and he spent the afternoon shaking hands with everyone.

hindi: ऐशो-आराम की गोद
definition: wealthy comfort and extravagant ease, surrounded by every expensive pleasure and indulgence money could supply
example: Raised in the lap of luxury, Anaya still insisted on learning to cook from her grandmother's cook.

hindi: आख़िरी जलवा — विदा से पहले की अंतिम धूम
definition: final spirited effort or celebration before retiring or finishing, one last performance before leaving
example: The retiring bandleader's last hurrah was a Sunday concert where every former pupil came back to play.

hindi: आख़िरी चक्कर — बस अंतिम पड़ाव
definition: concluding final stage demanding steady endurance until tiring contest finally finishes
example: Thesis writing entered its last lap in February, and his flatmates started leaving quiet plates outside the bedroom door.

hindi: आख़िर तक टिका रहने वाला — अकेला बचा विजेता
definition: sole survivor finally victorious after every rival has dropped away or given up
example: After midnight the board game had only one survivor, and eight-year-old Rohan was the last man standing, beaming at everyone.

hindi: आख़िरी मोर्चा — हारी बाज़ी में अंतिम कोशिश
definition: final desperate effort defending a position almost certainly lost, also called a last-ditch stand
example: Their last stand was a handwritten petition, delivered by three retired teachers who refused to sit down.

hindi: सब्र का बाँध टूटना — आख़िरी झटका जो सहनशीलता तोड़ दे
definition: the final small annoyance collapsing patience, ending tolerance after accumulated earlier troubles
example: The missing teaspoon was the last straw, and my mother reorganised every drawer in the kitchen before breakfast ended.

hindi: आख़िरी पासा — अंतिम जोखिम भरी कोशिश
definition: desperate final attempt risking whatever remains, taken hopefully after every earlier effort failed; British
example: Entering the talent show was the band's last throw of the dice before they sold the drum kit and went back to college.

hindi: आख़िरी कोशिश — डूबते को तिनके का सहारा
definition: final desperate attempt made before defeat, trying everything when nearly every chance has vanished
example: In a last-ditch effort to rescue the soufflé, he opened the oven and prayed.

hindi: अकेले घर लौटने वाला बच्चा — कामकाजी माता-पिता की संतान
definition: child letting themselves into an empty house after school while both parents are working
example: As a latchkey kid she learned to make toast and do her sums before her mother's bicycle rattled up the lane.

hindi: देर से खिलने वाला — जिसकी प्रतिभा देर से निखरी
definition: person whose talent appears later than expected, finding success after unpromising beginnings
example: A late bloomer, he published his first novel at sixty-two and signed copies for his grandchildren's teachers.

hindi: बहुत देर से — जब मौका लगभग निकल चुका हो
definition: happening very belatedly, almost past the point where action could still help or change outcomes, mainly British English
example: It was late in the day to learn the choir's harmonies, but the whole family rehearsed in the car all the way there.

hindi: देर से पहुँचना — किसी चलन को देर से अपनाना
definition: arriving belatedly to something popular, discovering trends or ideas long after everyone else already embraced them
example: Grandad was late to the party with smartphones, but now he sends the family video calls every single morning.

term: laugh all the way to the bank
hindi: हँसते-हँसते तिजोरी भरना — मज़ाक के बावजूद मोटा मुनाफ़ा
definition: earning plenty of money from something others mocked or doubted, enjoying profits despite criticism
example: Everyone teased her about the pickle business, but now she laughs all the way to the bank.

hindi: रोने की जगह हँसना — दुख को मज़ाक में टालना
definition: find humour in grim, painful circumstances because otherwise the sadness and hurt would completely overwhelm you
example: When the roof leaked on moving day we could only laugh to keep from crying, setting out saucepans like a drum kit.

hindi: अपनी मर्ज़ी का मालिक — किसी नियम को न मानने वाला
definition: someone behaving entirely independently, ignoring rules, customs and authority that bind everybody else
example: Our cat is a law unto herself, sleeping on the laptop and ignoring every expensive bed we buy.

hindi: मुँह के बल गिरना — तमाशा बुरी तरह पिट जाना
definition: fail completely before watching audience, American theatre slang describing performance nobody enjoys
example: Their comedy sketch laid an egg at the annual function, though the same jokes had wrecked the hostel corridor for weeks.

hindi: कानून बघारना — सख़्ती से हुक्म सुनाना
definition: state household rules with firm authority, expecting family members obey decisions immediately
example: After the third broken window, their father laid down the law about cricket, then bought a softer ball the following weekend.

hindi: हथियार डाल देना — लड़ाई छोड़कर शांति मान लेना
definition: abandon fighting completely, accepting peace terms rather than continuing a quarrel already clearly hopeless
example: After nine months of silent birthdays, she laid down her arms and simply called her sister about the recipe.

hindi: दोष मढ़ देना — जिम्मेदारी दूसरे के दरवाज़े
definition: place blame firmly upon another person, treating them responsible regardless what actually happened
example: Every delay in the kitchen was laid at the new cook's door, though the oven had been failing for months.

hindi: ज़िम्मेदारी उनके दरवाज़े छोड़ देना — दोष जहाँ का वहीं
definition: placing responsibility exactly where it belongs, refusing blame that belongs entirely elsewhere
example: The trip collapsed because two people never booked anything, and she laid it at their door without a single speech.

hindi: दो टूक कहना — साफ़ शर्तें रख देना
definition: speak bluntly and plainly about consequences, stating exact demands without softening anything
example: The coach laid it on the line: turn up to training or watch Saturday's final from the stands with the parents.

hindi: चापलूसी की हद कर देना — बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर तारीफ़
definition: offer exaggerated praise obviously beyond honest measure, flattering somebody until listeners stop believing
example: The salesman laid it on thick about her excellent taste, and she quietly enjoyed every word while buying nothing.

hindi: हालात का जायज़ा — माहौल की समझ
definition: general understanding of how a place or situation works, learned before acting inside it, said in American English
example: On her first morning at the new school she wandered every corridor to get the lay of the land before classes began.

hindi: नींव रखना — बड़े काम से पहले पूरी तैयारी
definition: prepare essential foundations beforehand, building careful basis before larger effort becomes possible
example: They spent a quiet winter laying the groundwork, visiting every household before anybody mentioned the word library.

term: lay your cards on the table
hindi: पत्ते खोल देना — इरादे साफ़ बता देना
definition: reveal your true intentions and plans honestly, hiding nothing so everyone understands clearly
example: Over chai, he laid his cards on the table: he wanted to move back home and help run his father's bakery.

hindi: पक्की बात — तय जीत
definition: outcome so certain that success needs almost zero effort, Australian card-game phrase
example: With the whole family voting for the beach, the holiday destination was a lay-down misère.

hindi: पाप जितना आलसी — महा आलसी
definition: extremely lazy, unwilling to make any effort, happily idle while others handle everything else
example: The old farm dog was lazy as sin, but every evening he walked the children safely home from the school bus.

hindi: फुस्स — जिस बात पर कोई तालियाँ नहीं बजीं
definition: a British image for something disappointing that failed completely, impressing nobody among listeners
example: His pun about the vicar's hat went down like a lead balloon, so he offered around the biscuits.

hindi: नाक में नकेल डालना — किसी को अपने पीछे-पीछे चलाना
definition: made to obey another person meekly, following their wishes without question
example: He let the salesman lead him by the nose around the showroom and came home with a car nobody needed.

hindi: आगे बढ़ कर अगुवाई करना — ख़ुद पहले जोखिम उठाना
definition: guide others by bravely taking the hardest share yourself instead of giving orders from safety
example: The captain led from the front, first into the icy river to haul the stranded boat back to shore.

hindi: नाच नचाना — बेवजह दौड़ाते रहना
definition: trick someone into exhausting pointless chasing, causing endless trouble through deliberate evasion
example: The escaped puppy led the whole family a merry dance through three gardens before falling asleep under the hedge.

hindi: झूठी उम्मीद बँधाना — दिल बहलाकर लटकाए रखना
definition: encourage romantic hope deliberately while intending nothing serious, wasting someone's affection
example: She realised she had been leading him on for months, apologised properly over coffee, and both slept better afterwards.

hindi: सब्ज़बाग़ दिखाना — झूठे सपने दिखाकर भटकाना
definition: tricking hopeful victim with pleasant false promises that quietly lead absolutely nowhere
example: The producer praised her script for eight months, borrowed her scenes, and had been leading her up the garden path throughout.

hindi: ख़ुद को निशाने पर रखना — बेपरवाही से ख़तरा मोल लेना
definition: leave yourself dangerously exposed to attack or criticism through careless, reckless behaviour or speech
example: Opening his toast by admitting he'd forgotten the anniversary, Vikram was leading with his chin, and the whole room winced kindly.

hindi: तंगी के साल — अकाल जैसे दिन
definition: difficult period of scarcity when money, food and opportunity stay painfully thin
example: In the lean years Mum made birthday cakes from cornflakes and golden syrup, and we still ask for them now.

hindi: अंधी छलाँग — अनजाना जोखिम
definition: daring action taken without knowledge of consequences, trusting hope rather than certainty about the outcome
example: Moving to Lisbon without a job felt like a leap in the dark, yet by spring she was teaching English and learning to cook bacalhau.

hindi: भरोसे की छलाँग — बिना सबूत के विश्वास पर कदम
definition: brave decision to trust or believe something without proof, accepting uncertain outcome
example: Adopting the nervous rescue greyhound was a leap of faith, and now he sleeps curled beside the baby's cot every night.

hindi: रटना — बिना समझे याद करना
definition: memorise material through mechanical repetition, remembering words without understanding their meaning
example: They learned the multiplication tables by rote, chanting together until the classroom windows seemed to hum.

hindi: मन खट्टा कर देना — बुरी याद छोड़ जाना
definition: leave behind lingering disappointment or resentment long after an unpleasant event has ended
example: The argument at the reunion left a sour taste, until the two cousins shared an umbrella at the bus stop and made peace.

hindi: मंडप से भाग जाना — ऐन मौके पर विवाह तोड़ देना
definition: abandon your partner during the wedding, ending the romantic relationship publicly
example: Nobody in the family mentions the cousin who was left at the altar in 1998.

hindi: पीछे छोड़ देना — सबसे बहुत आगे निकल जाना
definition: outpace rivals in a contest until nobody else remains anywhere close behind
example: She trained through winter mornings and left the whole district in the dust by spring.

term: leave it all on the field
hindi: मैदान में सब झोंक देना — बिना बचाए पूरी ताक़त लगाना
definition: spend every last ounce of strength and effort during a contest, holding nothing back
example: The under-twelves lost the final by a goal, yet they had left it all on the field and walked off grinning, mud to their eyebrows.

hindi: कोई कसर न छोड़ना — हर संभव जगह खोज डालना
definition: search every possible place, making exhaustive effort until nothing important remains unchecked
example: The neighbours left no stone unturned looking for the old tabby, torches under every hedge until midnight.

hindi: मझधार में छोड़ना — मुसीबत में अकेला छोड़ देना
definition: abandon someone during difficulty after they trusted you to stay beside them and help
example: When the band cancelled, the couple were left in the lurch, so their friends formed a kazoo orchestra on the spot.

hindi: जो ठीक है उसे छेड़ना नहीं — दखल बंद
definition: chiefly British; stopping interference completely, letting a settled argument rest untouched
example: The sisters were speaking again, so their mother decided to leave well alone and stopped asking who apologised first.

hindi: मन ही न लगना — ज़रा भी न भाना
definition: failing completely interest someone, lacking appeal despite everybody around praising something enthusiastically
example: The celebrated film left her cold, though she smiled politely while her cousins argued about every scene.

hindi: शुरुआत में ही पिछड़ जाना — दौड़ शुरू होते ही पीछे
definition: hopelessly behind from the very beginning, outpaced before a race or contest properly starts
example: When the twins raced to unwrap their gifts, Dhruv was left at the post, still carefully saving the ribbon.

hindi: अधर में लटकना — बिना जवाब पाए बीच में छूट जाना
definition: waiting without answer, uncertain much longer than expected while someone withholds their reply
example: She was left hanging after the audition, and she cleaned the entire kitchen twice before the phone finally rang with good news.

hindi: गले में ढोल पड़ना — सब भाग गए, ज़िम्मेदारी तुम्हारी
definition: abandoned suddenly with unwanted blame plus responsibility after everybody involved quietly disappeared
example: Every cousin vanished toward the terrace, leaving Meera holding the baby when the caterer arrived demanding final payment.

hindi: अकेले फँस जाना — बाकी बचकर निकल गए
definition: abandoned carrying blame alone after others escaped, facing punishment their careless decisions created
example: Everybody vanished before the caterer arrived, leaving her holding the bag with an unpaid bill and forty empty chairs.

hindi: संदेश पढ़कर चुप्पी — जवाब देने की ज़हमत नहीं
definition: having messages visibly seen while nobody bothers replying, signalling casual romantic dismissal
example: Three thoughtful paragraphs left on read since Thursday, so he finally closed the chat and went downstairs for badminton.

hindi: भाग निकलना — रफ़ूचक्कर होना
definition: run away quickly on foot, escaping somewhere fast before trouble arrives; British informal
example: When the goose started hissing, all three of us legged it back across the field to the car.

hindi: पैर टिकाने की जगह — अपने पक्ष में कोई ठोस आधार
definition: credible argument or evidence supporting your position, usually said when someone completely lacks one
example: Having signed the lease without reading it, Tom didn't have a leg to stand on when the parking fees arrived.

hindi: सहारा — आगे बढ़ने में मदद
definition: helpful boost from someone else, giving opportunity and advantage toward progress
example: An old teacher gave him a leg up, quietly recommending him for the apprenticeship that changed everything.

hindi: पैरों तले ज़मीन खिसकना — सदमे से ताक़त निकल जाना
definition: strength draining suddenly in Irish usage, leaving somebody trembling weakly after shock
example: When the telegram came her legs went from under her, and the postman stayed standing awkwardly until a neighbour arrived.

hindi: हाथ बँटाना — मदद कर देना
definition: helping willingly with practical work, sharing someone's burden without being asked
example: Neighbours lent a hand carrying the almirah upstairs, refusing everything afterwards except cold water.

hindi: बीती ताहि बिसार दे — पुरानी बातें भूल जाना
definition: forgive past quarrels and grievances, choosing peace rather than dwelling upon old wrongs
example: At the reunion the two brothers agreed to let bygones be bygones and spent the evening laughing over old photographs.

hindi: बात को दबी रहने देना — दोबारा न उठाना
definition: letting a finished argument rest untouched, refusing further discussion, engagement, stirring
example: They both wanted the last word about the wedding seating, and both, wonderfully, decided to let it lie.

hindi: जीता हुआ फिर से लगा देना — मुनाफ़ा उठाने के बजाय दांव पर छोड़ देना
definition: leave every winning staked upon another risky round, keeping nothing safely aside
example: He had doubled his money by ten o'clock, grinned at his sister, and let it ride one more time.

hindi: बात को मन में उतरने देना — धीरे-धीरे समझना
definition: allow surprising or important news enough time until its full meaning is properly understood and felt
example: He read the acceptance letter twice, sat down on the stairs, and let it sink in that he was going to university.

hindi: नज़रअंदाज़ कर देना — बात को जाने देना
definition: deliberately ignoring minor mistakes or rudeness, choosing silence rather than making complaints
example: Her grandson forgot her birthday by one day, but seeing his flustered flowers, she smiled and let it slide.

hindi: बात को बहने देना — असर न लेना
definition: allowing insults, criticism, provocation to pass through without disturbing your composure
example: She learned to let the neighbour's remarks about her cooking wash over her, humming while she folded the rotis.

hindi: भड़ास निकालना — गुस्सा हल्का करना
definition: release building anger harmlessly through activity, avoiding quarrel with anybody nearby
example: After the exam results he ran eight kilometres to let off steam, then came home hungry and cheerful.

hindi: सोए हुए कुत्ते को न जगाना — शांत झगड़े को छेड़ना नहीं
definition: avoid reviving settled trouble, leaving quarrelling people undisturbed rather than risking fresh anger
example: Someone almost mentioned the property papers, until an aunt changed the subject and everyone gratefully let sleeping dogs lie.

hindi: मुँह से निकल जाना — अनजाने में राज़ खोल देना
definition: reveal a secret accidentally, mentioning hidden information carelessly without meaning to
example: She let slip that she was moving to Leeds, then laughed and admitted she had been bursting to tell everyone.

hindi: नरमी से मना करना — किसी का दिल दुखाए बिना इनकार करना
definition: refusing or disappointing someone kindly and gently, making painful news easier to hear
example: When the shy boy asked her to the dance, Zara let him down gently and promised to save him a slow song.

hindi: बरस पड़ना — ग़ुस्से में सब कह देना
definition: attacking someone verbally with sudden, furious criticism, holding nothing back whatsoever
example: When the plumber left the kitchen flooded a third time, Nana finally let him have it.

term: let the cat out of the bag
hindi: भांडा फोड़ देना — अनजाने में राज़ ज़ाहिर कर देना
definition: reveal a secret accidentally, often ruining a surprise others were guarding
example: He let the cat out of the bag when he asked her about the ring size.

hindi: जो होगा देखा जाएगा — नतीजा किस्मत पर छोड़ देना
definition: accepting whatever outcome follows your honest choice, refusing further interference afterwards
example: She posted the letter, decided against rewriting anything, and let the chips fall while making herself strong tea.

hindi: मामला ठंडा होने देना — हलचल थमने का इंतज़ार
definition: waiting patiently until confusion calms, delaying decisions after upheaval before acting again
example: After the big family quarrel, Nani told everyone to let the dust settle, then invited them all for Sunday lunch.

hindi: ढील देना — काम में देर करना
definition: delaying action lazily, wasting valuable time instead of getting moving; fuller form let the grass grow under your feet, usually negative
example: She did not let the grass grow under her feet; the morning after graduating she was already knocking on bakery doors.

hindi: चीज़ों को ढीला छोड़ना — लापरवाही से बिगड़ने देना
definition: allowing duties gradually to decline through neglect, avoiding necessary effort until matters become worse
example: During the busy season he let things slide at home, so his daughter gently organised a family cleaning party.

hindi: खुलकर जीना — संकोच छोड़ देना
definition: relax freely and behave informally, dropping your usual reserve, worries and responsibilities
example: The strict maths teacher let her hair down at the school picnic, leading a very loud game of antakshari.

hindi: बराबरी पर — दोनों एक जैसे
definition: equally matched throughout contest, British phrasing where neither participant clearly leads
example: Their carrom rivalry remained level pegging across three summers, which both brothers considered better than either winning outright.

hindi: बराबरी का मैदान — सबके लिए एक जैसे हालात
definition: conditions arranged under equal rules, letting everybody compete without unfair hidden advantage
example: Providing textbooks through school created a level playing field, and results improved among children whose families owned nothing spare.

hindi: अगले स्तर पर पहुँचना — खुद को निखारना
definition: advance your skills significantly, progressing into stronger stages much like games reward players
example: After a summer of practice, his chess really levelled up and he started beating his grandfather.

hindi: नोट छापने की मशीन
definition: a business or arrangement producing huge profits reliably and easily, almost guaranteed money without real risk, chiefly British
example: The only tea stall inside the railway station was practically a licence to print money.

hindi: तलवे चाटना — बेहद चापलूसी करना
definition: flatter someone powerful shamelessly, behaving with humiliating submission simply to gain favour
example: He refused to lick anyone's boots for the promotion, and his daughter framed that stubbornness as a family treasure.

hindi: ज़ख़्म सहलाना — हार के बाद सँभलना
definition: retreat quietly after defeat, recovering strength and pride before facing the world again
example: After losing the election, she spent a week licking her wounds in her sister's hill cottage.

hindi: चुपचाप सह लेना — बिना विरोध अपमान झेलना
definition: accept unfair treatment meekly, submitting without resistance instead of standing against your mistreatment
example: When the landlord raised the rent again, the tenants decided they would not lie down and take it.

hindi: काम में ढील देना — ज़िम्मेदारी से जी चुराना
definition: neglecting your duty through laziness, doing careless half effort while others depend upon you
example: The night porter swore he had not been lying down on the job, though the crossword beside him was finished in ink.

hindi: धड़ल्ले से झूठ बोलना — बेहिचक झूठ
definition: tell shameless lies constantly, speaking untruths without hesitation or embarrassment, American usage
example: My little cousin lies like a rug about bedtime, swearing Mum lets him stay up until midnight on weekdays.

hindi: दुबक कर बैठना — शोर थमने तक नज़रों से दूर रहना
definition: stay hidden quietly, avoiding attention from police, angry relatives, curious neighbours, until trouble fades
example: After breaking the temple lamp, both boys decided lying low near the canal beat facing Ammamma before dinner.

hindi: सफ़ेद झूठ बोलना — आँख में आँख डालकर झूठ
definition: telling deliberate falsehoods confidently while knowing the complete truthful story perfectly well
example: Standing beside the broken window with the cricket bat still warm, the boy lied through his teeth about a passing bird.

term: life and soul of the party
hindi: महफ़िल की जान — सबको हँसाने वाला
definition: a British phrase for the lively, sociable person whose energy and humour keep every gathering cheerful
example: Even at eighty, Nanaji was the life and soul of the party, telling stories that had the teenagers doubled over.

hindi: ऐश की ज़िंदगी — बेफ़िक्र आरामदायक जीवन
definition: living comfortably, luxuriously, without money worry, effort, hardship, enjoying carefree pleasant existence
example: Since retiring to the hills he swims each morning and naps each afternoon, living the life of Riley.

hindi: पर्दा उठाना — छिपी सच्चाई सामने लाना
definition: expose hidden truth, revealing publicly what powerful people wanted concealed from view
example: Her little podcast lifted the lid on the town's forgotten wartime heroines, and the library now holds a display.

term: light at the end of the tunnel
hindi: सुरंग के आख़िर में रोशनी — मुश्किल का अंत दिखना
definition: first visible sign that difficult journey nears finishing, hardship easing toward relief
example: After the third surgery there was finally light at the end of the tunnel, and her sister repainted the kitchen yellow.

hindi: बत्ती जल जाना — अचानक बात समझ में आ जाना
definition: moment when someone suddenly understands a confusing problem, realizing the answer without further help
example: Halfway through the walk home she had a light bulb moment about the leaking tap.

hindi: आँखों का नूर — ज़िंदगी की रौनक़
definition: beloved person bringing greatest happiness into your world, cherished above everyone else
example: Holding his newborn daughter, the gruff mechanic whispered that she was the light of his life.

hindi: चिंगारी लगा देना — झगड़े की शुरुआत
definition: deliberately provoke argument between others, adding remark certain drama follows quickly
example: One innocent question about the wedding seating lit the fuse, and dessert arrived amid raised voices.

hindi: आते ही रौशनी भर देना — मौजूदगी से माहौल खिल उठना
definition: brighten everybody's mood merely through arriving, warmth spreading across every conversation already happening
example: Whenever Meera pushed through that noisy doorway she lit up the room, and even the cousins arguing politics softened.

hindi: ऊपर से ठीक, भीतर ख़ाली — ध्यान कहीं और
definition: someone who looks alert but clearly understands nothing, their attention drifted somewhere absent
example: Monday morning in the maths class was all lights on but nobody home until the teacher mentioned a surprise test.

term: like a bat out of hell
hindi: आँधी की तरह — बेतहाशा तेज़ी से
definition: moving with wild, frantic speed, as though something frightening were chasing close behind
example: The moment the school bell rang, Arjun was out the gate like a bat out of hell, racing to catch the first bus home.

term: like a bear with a sore head
hindi: चिड़चिड़ा मिज़ाज — हर बात पर झल्लाना
definition: grumpy and snappish, irritably grumbling at everyone nearby because of some private discomfort or tiredness, British
example: Dad was like a bear with a sore head until his morning chai arrived, and then he sang along to the radio.

hindi: एक ही राग अलापना — वही बात दोहराते रहना
definition: repeating identical complaint again endlessly, tiresome even when everybody already agrees completely
example: Amma sounded like a broken record about the leaking tap until the plumber finally climbed the stairs.

term: like a cat on hot bricks
hindi: जैसे अंगारों पर पैर — बेचैनी से इधर-उधर होना
definition: restless and nervous, fidgeting constantly, unable to settle anywhere for long, in British English
example: Before his driving test he was like a cat on hot bricks, straightening the cushions and checking the clock every minute.

hindi: त्योहार से पहले के बच्चे जैसा — बेसब्र उत्साह
definition: eager, fidgeting excitement while waiting impatiently for something wonderful that hasn't started yet
example: The night before the trek, Grandma was like a child at Christmas, repacking her rucksack three times.

term: like a child with a new toy
hindi: नए खिलौने वाले बच्चे जैसा — नई चीज़ पर लट्टू
definition: absorbed and delighted by something newly acquired, playing with it constantly and showing everyone
example: Since getting the new camera, Grandma has been like a child with a new toy, photographing every flower on the balcony.

term: like a deer in the headlights
hindi: हक्का-बक्का — डर और उलझन से जड़ हो जाना
definition: frozen with confusion or panic, staring blankly and unable to react; British often say rabbit
example: When the teacher called his name for the school play, Arjun stood like a deer in the headlights until his best friend whispered the first line.

term: like a dog with a bone
hindi: जोंक की तरह चिपकना — किसी बात को न छोड़ना
definition: refusing stubbornly to abandon something, worrying persistently at a problem, never letting it drop
example: Once my daughter found the missing jigsaw piece was not under the sofa, she searched like a dog with a bone until dinner.

term: like a dog with two tails
hindi: फूला नहीं समाना — ख़ुशी छिपाए नहीं छिपती
definition: visibly delighted, showing bubbling happiness that everybody around immediately notices, chiefly British
example: When his daughter's results appeared, the tailor walked between shops like a dog with two tails, telling people who had not asked.

hindi: चुटकियों में — झटपट
definition: done with astonishing speed and efficiency, finished before anybody quite realises; British informal
example: Nani went through that pile of ironing like a dose of salts while the rest of us were still arguing over the remote.

hindi: मछली जैसे पानी में — स्वाभाविक रूप से
definition: taking naturally to something unfamiliar, learning quickly and comfortably without visible struggle
example: Their shy son took to the drama club like a duck to water and now sings in the corridors.

hindi: कटे मुर्गे की तरह भागना — घबराहट में बिना सोचे दौड़ना
definition: rushing about frantically without thinking, wasting effort while achieving almost nothing useful
example: He ran around like a headless chicken hunting the train tickets, which were resting inside the book he had carried downstairs.

term: like a kid in a candy store
hindi: जैसे मिठाई की दुकान में बच्चा — ढेरों पसंदीदा चीज़ों के बीच उत्साहित
definition: wildly delighted, surrounded by plenty of wonderful pleasures and unable to choose; British English says child in a sweet shop
example: Let loose in the secondhand bookshop, Tara wandered the aisles like a kid in a candy store, books stacked up to her chin.

hindi: बिना किसी रुकावट के — बड़ी सहजता से
definition: passing through an obstacle with smooth ease, meeting hardly any friction or pushback
example: The new ferry cut through the morning chop like a knife through butter, and nobody felt seasick.

hindi: आशिक़ मिज़ाज पिल्ले की तरह — प्यार में बेहाल
definition: following someone around with young, helpless romantic infatuation that everybody nearby can plainly notice
example: All summer he trailed after her like a lovesick puppy, carrying her bag and laughing at every joke.

term: like a rat up a drainpipe
hindi: मौक़ा मिलते ही लपक लेना — बिजली की तेज़ी से
definition: moving with eager, darting speed to seize something wanted; British and Australian informal
example: When the waiter mentioned free dessert refills, Uncle Ravi was up at the counter like a rat up a drainpipe.

hindi: जैसे बिच्छू ने डंक मारा हो — झटके से भागना
definition: moving with sudden startled speed, bolting away the instant something alarms you; British
example: The puppy shot off the sofa like a scalded cat when the vacuum cleaner roared into life beside him.

hindi: तीर की तरह — फ़ौरन
definition: instantly and eagerly, leaping forward without hesitation the moment an offer appears
example: Offer that dog a walk and he's at the door like a shot, lead already in his mouth.

hindi: फ़ालतू पुरज़े जैसा — बेकार खड़ा रहना
definition: british phrase describing awkward uncomfortable person standing around unwanted, belonging nowhere useful
example: I stood like a spare part beside the kitchen door until Dadi handed me a bowl of peas to shell.

hindi: बिन माँगे मुराद — अप्रत्याशित ख़ुशी
definition: unexpected, welcome pleasure arriving sooner than anybody hoped, leaving you delighted and grateful
example: When the landlord said he was fixing the geyser and lowering the rent, it felt like Christmas came early.

hindi: घड़ी की तरह — नियम से, बिना गड़बड़ी
definition: happening smoothly, reliably, regularly, without trouble, delay, mistakes, exactly following expected timing
example: Every evening at six the neighbour's dog barked twice and the street lamps flickered on, like clockwork.

hindi: बिजली की तरह — पलक झपकते ही निकल जाना
definition: moving extremely quickly, travelling with startling speed that leaves onlookers blinking afterwards
example: The puppy went like greased lightning the moment the gate swung open, and my father chased it down three gardens in his slippers.

hindi: दाँत उखाड़ने जैसा — बड़ी मुश्किल से कुछ निकलवाना
definition: extracting cooperation only through exhausting effort against stubborn resistance, making every small progress painfully difficult
example: Asking her teenager about school was like pulling teeth, four questions traded for a single shrugged syllable.

hindi: कभी न भूलने वाली चीज़ — एक बार सीखा, हमेशा याद
definition: skill once learnt that returns naturally and easily, never truly forgotten despite years unused
example: She hadn't played piano since school, but it was like riding a bike, and the old waltz came flooding back.

hindi: चुटकियों में — झटपट और आसानी से
definition: working through a long batch of chores rapidly and rhythmically, each item dispatched without hitch, said in British usage
example: The veteran nurse took blood from every patient on the ward like shelling peas, chatting the whole while.

term: like taking candy from a baby
hindi: बाएँ हाथ का खेल — बेहद आसान काम
definition: ridiculously simple task needing almost zero effort, victory taken from somebody unable to resist
example: Grandpa beat the grandchildren at carrom so often that he joked it was like taking candy from a baby.

term: like the back of your hand
hindi: हथेली की लकीरों की तरह जानना — पूरी तरह परिचित होना
definition: knowing something completely, remembering every detail through long familiar experience
example: She guided the visitors through the old bazaar lanes like the back of her hand, pausing only to greet the tailor.

hindi: हवा से बातें करते हुए — बहुत तेज़
definition: moving with tremendous speed and effort, running or working flat out; British informal
example: We ran like the clappers through the rain to the platform and threw ourselves aboard just as the doors closed.

hindi: कल की परवाह किए बिना
definition: spending, eating or acting recklessly and freely, as though consequences and future bills never arrive
example: The cousins ordered dessert like there's no tomorrow, then pooled every coin they had for the bill.

term: like two peas in a pod
hindi: एक ही साँचे में ढले — हमेशा साथ, एकदम एक जैसे
definition: people who closely resemble each other in appearance, habits, and constant companionship
example: The cousins arrived in matching yellow raincoats they had chosen separately, and the whole family agreed they were like two peas in a pod.

hindi: ऊँघ आने जैसा — इतना धीमा और उबाऊ कि नींद आ जाए
definition: moving painfully slowly and tediously, almost nothing visible happening across long stretches
example: The village council meeting was like watching paint dry until someone's goat wandered in and became the evening's main business.

hindi: क्या कहानी गढ़ी है — ऐसी बात कौन माने
definition: sarcastic reply dismissing an excuse as obviously invented, showing complete disbelief in the speaker
example: 'The cat opened the fridge by itself,' said the toddler, chocolate on his chin, and his father grinned and said, 'A likely story.'

hindi: शेर की माँद — ख़तरनाक जगह
definition: hostile place or gathering where you face danger and fierce opposition; usually 'walk into the lion's den'
example: Visiting her rival's bakery felt like walking into the lion's den, until the owner offered her a warm croissant and a job.

hindi: शेर का हिस्सा — सबसे बड़ा भाग हड़प लेना
definition: largest portion taken before others receive anything, leaving small remainder behind
example: The eldest cousin claimed the lion's share of the mangoes, then quietly refilled everyone's plates once the aunties noticed.

hindi: नशे की हिम्मत — शराब से आया झूठा साहस
definition: false boldness borrowed from alcohol, drunk beforehand to calm nerves before something frightening, American
example: He had planned on a little liquid courage before the speech, but his daughter handed him a mango lassi instead.

hindi: तंगी में गुज़ारा करना — बस ज़रूरत भर
definition: spend money only upon bare necessities, keeping nothing spare beyond simple food and shelter
example: The couple lived close to the bone in that attic, and still kept flowers on the windowsill.

hindi: ऐश की ज़िंदगी जीना — शान-शौकत से रहना
definition: to live lavishly, spending money on rich comfort and expensive daily pleasures
example: They lived high on the hog that summer, ordering breakfast to the room like film stars.

hindi: ऐश करना — खुलकर मौज मनाना
definition: celebrate life lavishly, spending freely on partying and pleasures without worrying about tomorrow
example: On their first holiday since the kids left home, Asha and Vikram lived it up with room service and a sunset cruise.

hindi: बहुत कम पैसों में जीवन चलाना
definition: manage daily living using money barely enough, spending almost nothing beyond essentials
example: They lived on a shoestring that first winter, heating one room and reading together inside it.

hindi: हवा खाकर जीना — लगभग बिना कुछ के गुज़ारा
definition: British humour for surviving on barely anything, somehow managing with almost no food or money
example: "Are you living on fresh air?" Mum asked, peering into the student fridge, and returned an hour later with enough curry for a week.

term: live rent free in your head
hindi: दिमाग़ में बसा रहना — बेवजह किसी का ख़याल छाया रहना
definition: occupy somebody's thoughts constantly, dominating their attention although nothing warrants such lasting obsession
example: That single sarcastic comment lived rent free in her head for weeks, until her sister finally made her laugh about it.

hindi: बाद में पछताना — किए पर पछतावा होगा
definition: come to deeply regret a decision later, often used as warning before somebody acts
example: You'll live to regret it if you skip your sister's recital, said Dad, so I went, and she waved at me from the stage.

hindi: ठाठ से जीना
definition: living lavishly and freely, spending money on comfort and pleasure while fortune smiles on you, chiefly American slang
example: Since the promotion, my brother has been living large, though he still borrows my umbrella.

hindi: दिमाग़ में बसे रहना — भुलाए न भूलना, याद बार-बार लौट आना
definition: occupying somebody's thoughts constantly afterwards, memorable enough that nobody manages forgetting whatever happened
example: One compliment from that teacher stayed living rent free, resurfacing whenever Anil doubted whether writing suited him.

hindi: सपनों की ज़िंदगी जीना — मनचाही ज़िंदगी
definition: enjoying exactly the contented, satisfied life you always wanted; also said wryly when things are going badly
example: Sipping coconut water on the beach where he now teaches surfing, Kabir laughed and said he was living the dream.

hindi: जी भर के जीना — बेझिझक अपनी ज़िंदगी का मज़ा लेना
definition: enjoying yourself openly without apology, savouring small pleasures while nobody's disapproval slows anything
example: Nani sent photographs from Goa, hair loose, plate piled high, clearly living her best life among strangers half her age.

hindi: छल भरा पासा — नतीजा पहले से तय
definition: contest dishonestly arranged beforehand, ensuring particular people cannot possibly finish first however hard
example: The village tournament felt like loaded dice until the retired postmaster volunteered as umpire and started rejecting every convenient decision.

hindi: सींग फँसाना — जिद में एक-दूसरे से टकरा जाना
definition: clash directly in stubborn dispute where opposing sides push hard against each other
example: The coach and the captain locked horns over the batting order until rain settled the argument for them.

hindi: पूरा सामान समेत — जड़ से लेकर पत्ती तक
definition: completely, including every single part together, leaving absolutely nothing behind
example: They moved lock, stock and barrel into the new flat, even the cracked pickle jar nobody would throw away.

hindi: बस अब बंद करो — इंटरनेट छोड़ो
definition: leave online arguments entirely, closing screens before the internet spoils your evening
example: His sister looked over his shoulder at the comment thread and told him kindly that tonight he should log off.

hindi: क़ानून के लंबे हाथ
definition: reach of police and justice, eventually catching wrongdoers however far they flee or hide
example: The long arm of the law caught up with the mango thief next door: his mother found the stones under his bed.

hindi: लंबी ठगी — धीरे-धीरे रचा गया धोखा
definition: elaborate swindle developed patiently, earning complete trust before finally cheating the victim
example: Her best friend's weekly compliments turned out to be a long con aimed at borrowing her favourite jacket.

hindi: लंबा रास्ता — शॉर्टकट का उल्टा
definition: joke opposite of shortcut, meaning a longer roundabout route, often chosen deliberately, as said in Indian English
example: They took the long cut home past the lake, pretending the main road was blocked, just to keep talking a little longer.

hindi: लटका हुआ मुँह — उदासी साफ़ दिखना
definition: gloomy unhappy expression worn openly, spirits sunk enough that everybody nearby notices immediately
example: He carried a long face through the whole picnic, and his cousins kept sliding extra samosas onto his plate without comment.

hindi: लंबी दौड़ — सब्र वाला सफ़र
definition: lengthy demanding effort, destination distant enough that patience matters across years
example: Rebuilding the library was always going to be a long haul, so the volunteers planted shade trees first.

hindi: दूर की कौड़ी — बहुत कम उम्मीद
definition: attempt or contender with only slight chance of success, though worth trying anyway
example: Writing to the author was a long shot, but three weeks later a signed postcard arrived for Maya's birthday.

hindi: संक्षेप में कहूँ तो — लंबी बात छोटी करना
definition: compress lengthy explanation deliberately, reaching conclusion without exhausting patient listeners further
example: To cut a long story short, the goat escaped, the neighbours helped, and everyone laughed about it for years.

hindi: बहुत इंतज़ार के बाद — देर से आई पर आई
definition: finally happening after lengthy waiting, something overdue that people hoped would arrive much sooner
example: The reunion was a long time coming, and when the sisters finally hugged at the airport, the whole arrivals hall clapped.

term: look a gift horse in the mouth
hindi: दान की बछिया के दाँत गिनना — तोहफ़े में खोट ढूँढना
definition: question or criticise a generous gift suspiciously, doubting something good freely offered
example: When the neighbour offered free apples, Ravi began asking about pesticides until his wife whispered not to look a gift horse in the mouth.

hindi: मौत से आँखें चार करना — मौत के क़रीब पहुँच कर भी न डरना
definition: confront mortal danger or dying calmly and bravely, without flinching or looking away
example: Having looked death in the face on the mountain, Uncle Sanjay now treats every sunrise as a small festival.

hindi: मुर्दे जैसा दिखना — बेहद बीमार और थका दिखाई देना
definition: appearing dreadfully unwell, drained and grey, although the actual sickness remains fairly minor
example: He looked like death warmed up at breakfast, then cheerfully asked for extra toast.

hindi: चुस्त हो जाओ — ज़रा फुर्ती
definition: hurry along immediately, becoming brisk and alert because something needs doing quickly; British
example: Look lively, everyone, the bride's car has just turned into the lane.

hindi: होशियार — जल्दी करो
definition: hurry along immediately, becoming quick and alert because something important approaches; mainly British
example: Look sharp, the bus is coming round the bend and it never waits long at this stop.

hindi: मुँह फेर लेना — जान‑बूझकर अनदेखा करना
definition: deliberately ignore misbehaviour happening openly, allowing wrongdoing continue rather than starting public trouble
example: Every guard looked the other way while the stray puppies slept beside the warm generator through January.

hindi: जमना — जैसा काम वैसा ही रूप
definition: appearing convincingly suited for the expected role, clothing and grooming matching everybody's assumptions
example: Borrowed spectacles, ironed kurta, folder under his elbow: he looked the part long before understanding the syllabus.

hindi: बेलगाम आदमी — जो कभी भी कुछ भी कर बैठे
definition: unpredictable person causing damage anywhere, ignoring warnings while nobody controls their behaviour
example: Everybody loved him and nobody invited him twice, because a loose cannon at a family dinner eventually finds the sore subject.

hindi: पेट में बात न पचना — राज़ न रख पाने की आदत
definition: careless talk revealing secrets, echoing wartime warnings that idle gossip could reveal plans to enemies
example: With loose lips like Uncle Ravi's at the table, we told him about the engagement only after the ring was on.

hindi: किसी पर हुकूमत जताना — ख़ुद को बड़ा दिखाना
definition: behave arrogantly toward others, flaunting your superior position and treating them as beneath you
example: Having passed her driving test first, Neha lorded it over her brothers for a month, jangling the keys at dinner.

hindi: हिम्मत हार जाना — दिल छोटा कर लेना
definition: become discouraged, losing courage and hope until the spirit to continue drains away
example: She nearly lost heart after the fifth rejection letter, but her grandmother pinned every one proudly to the fridge.

hindi: इसकी नींद नहीं उड़ने देना — परवाह न करना
definition: remaining calm about criticism, insults, mistakes, refusing to worry through sleepless nights
example: His uncle disapproved of the haircut loudly at dinner, and the boy lost no sleep over it, snoring by eleven.

hindi: रिश्ते की चिंगारी बुझना — प्यार में ताज़गी ख़त्म होना
definition: romantic attraction quietly fading between partners until affection feels ordinary rather than exciting
example: They still cooked together every Sunday, though both quietly admitted they had lost that spark around winter.

hindi: सिरा हाथ से छूट जाना — बात की समझ ही खो देना
definition: stops understanding a situation, growing confused and thinking thoughts that sensible listeners cannot follow
example: Three hours into the road trip, the map upside down, we had properly lost the plot.

hindi: तारतम्य टूटना — बात की कड़ी छूट जाना
definition: become confused during a conversation, unable to follow what the speaker is saying
example: Grandpa began with the fishing trip, drifted into the war, and lost the thread somewhere near his cousin's wedding.

hindi: दिशा भूल जाना — समझ न आना कहाँ जाना है
definition: become thoroughly confused about direction, losing track where progress should sensibly continue
example: Halfway through the second week of shifting house he lost his bearings entirely, and his daughter taped a simple list beside the door.

hindi: ऐन मौक़े पर हिम्मत हार जाना
definition: suddenly lose courage and back away from something frightening at the crucial moment, British and Cockney slang
example: He climbed to the top diving board, lost his bottle, and then climbed down to cheers from his little sister anyway.

hindi: धार कम पड़ जाना — पहले जैसी तेज़ी नहीं रही
definition: an American baseball phrase meaning losing sharpness, ability declining below your earlier strongest years
example: The old lawyer joked about losing his fastball, then dismantled the argument before lunch arrived.

hindi: पकड़ ढीली पड़ना — काबू धीरे-धीरे हाथ से निकलना
definition: gradually losing control and power over people once firmly commanded
example: By the third winter the old contractor was losing his grip, and his foremen began deciding things themselves.

hindi: आपा खो देना — घबराकर बेवकूफ़ी कर बैठना
definition: panicking badly during trouble, unable to think clearly about sensible choices
example: He lost his head at the sweet shop counter and ordered enough laddoos for three neighbouring streets.

hindi: दिल दे बैठना — किसी से प्रेम में पड़ जाना
definition: become completely enamoured with someone, surrendering ordinary caution to sudden romantic feeling
example: She lost her heart somewhere between the second dance and the last slice of birthday cake.

hindi: हिम्मत जवाब दे जाना — ऐन वक़्त पर डर जाना
definition: suddenly become frightened, abandoning something daring at the last moment through failing courage
example: He lost his nerve at the top of the water slide and climbed all the way back down the ladder.

hindi: आपा खोना — गुस्से में संयम टूटना
definition: lose your temper suddenly, snapping into furious anger after patience finally runs out, British and Irish
example: The referee finally lost his rag after the tenth complaint, then bought both captains a drink afterwards.

hindi: लुट जाना — दांव में सब कुछ गंवा बैठना
definition: forfeit almost every possession through reckless gamble that collapses, leaving nothing behind afterwards
example: He lost his shirt on the second horse, walked home, and never again explained racing to anyone at dinner.

hindi: डूबी नैया — जिसका बचना अब मुमकिन नहीं
definition: something hopeless from the beginning, where continued effort brings success to nobody involved
example: The rusted scooter was a lost cause, but he polished the mirror anyway and parked it proudly.

hindi: शब्द न सूझना — कहने को कुछ न बचना
definition: unable to speak, standing silent because words vanish exactly when they matter most
example: When the whole street turned up for his retirement tea, he stood lost for words beside the samosas.

hindi: बारीकियों में खोया — असल मुद्दे से भटका
definition: confused and bogged down among small details, losing sight of the main purpose in American English
example: The committee got lost in the weeds arguing about napkin colours until someone reminded them the party was for Grandma's ninetieth.

hindi: अनुवाद में अर्थ खो जाना — असली मतलब न पहुँचना
definition: misunderstanding created when meaning shifts between different languages and people miss sense
example: The joke about pickles delighted the family in Kerala and left the visitors politely blank, entirely lost in translation.

hindi: पहली नज़र का प्यार — देखते ही मोहब्बत हो जाना
definition: instant overwhelming romantic certainty felt immediately upon first meeting somebody
example: They insist it was love at first sight, although both remember different weather that afternoon.

hindi: बेवफ़ा आशिक़ — धोखेबाज़ प्रेमी
definition: unfaithful partner caught cheating, usually through secret affair, in British tabloid usage
example: The village gossip had the local love rat's name spread round every tea shop before lunch.

hindi: प्रेम त्रिकोण — एक दिल, दो दावेदार
definition: romantic tangle where three people desire each other, someone inevitably hurting or cheating
example: The summer camp love triangle ended when all three of them agreed to just go canoeing together.

hindi: प्यार की बौछार करना — जल्दबाज़ी में फुसलाना
definition: overwhelm new partner with excessive attention, gifts and flattery, rushing intimacy suspiciously quickly
example: Her sister warned that three bouquets in the first week might mean he was love-bombing her, not courting her.

hindi: शैतान जैसी क़िस्मत — गज़ब का भाग्य
definition: extraordinary fortune that keeps rescuing someone from situations deserving trouble
example: He has the luck of the devil: he missed the train, caught a lift, and still arrived before everyone else.

hindi: जैसी क़िस्मत — जो भी मिले, महज़ संयोग का नतीजा
definition: outcome decided purely by random chance rather than skill, effort, fairness, or personal control
example: Whether you got the window seat or the wheel arch was pure luck of the draw on that overnight bus.

hindi: क़िस्मत का दरवाज़ा खुलना — अचानक मिला सुनहरा मौक़ा
definition: sudden turn where fortune arrives unexpectedly, luck opening chance that effort alone never provided
example: She had been singing at weddings for nine years when a lucky break put her beside a microphone that was actually recording.

hindi: गला भर आना — भावना से गला रुँधना
definition: tight feeling caught in your throat when emotion is moving you close to tears
example: Watching his daughter wobble off on her bicycle alone, Dad felt a lump in his throat and waved until she turned the corner.

hindi: सिरफिरा होना — पूरी तरह सनकी
definition: completely irrational and eccentric, behaving strangely enough to worry watching relatives
example: The old professor was mad as a hatter about pigeons, and the entire building quietly enjoyed his morning announcements.

hindi: पारा सातवें आसमान पर — बेहद चिढ़ा और झल्लाया हुआ
definition: extremely furious and flustered, squawking complaints loudly like a soaked angry bird, American
example: Aunt June was mad as a wet hen when the sprinkler soaked her church hat, though she was laughing by lunch.

hindi: पैसों का पेड़ — जिससे बेहिसाब पैसा माँगा जाए
definition: supposedly wealthy enough that endless spending requests never trouble their money supply, often said indignantly by whoever keeps paying
example: When the children asked for a third holiday that summer, their father laughed and asked whether they thought he was made of money.

hindi: फ़ौलाद का बना — आसानी से न टूटने वाला
definition: having greater courage and resilience than others, able to endure hardship without breaking
example: Everyone expected the frail old teacher to retire after the fall, but she was made of sterner stuff and was back by Friday.

hindi: जादुई इलाज — एक ही झटके में पूरा समाधान
definition: hoped-for treatment solving complicated trouble instantly, usually imagined rather than actually existing
example: There was no magic bullet for his back, only stretching every morning while the radio played old film songs.

hindi: पहली यात्रा — किसी चीज़ का पहला प्रयोग
definition: first journey or outing of something freshly made, marking its very beginning in actual service
example: The homemade go-kart's maiden voyage ended gently in a hedge, with both brothers laughing too hard to steer.

hindi: अपनी कहानी का नायक बनना — खुद को केंद्र में रखने वाला आत्मविश्वास
definition: confident presence treating your ordinary routine like cinema, refusing quiet background roles anywhere
example: She walked into the wedding late, sunglasses still on, carrying enough main character energy that even the band turned around.

hindi: सीधे निशाने की ओर — बिना इधर-उधर देखे
definition: head straight towards something quickly and directly, ignoring everything else along the route
example: At every family wedding, my father makes a beeline for the dessert table before greeting anyone.

hindi: मौका देखकर भाग खड़ा होना — पहरा हटते ही दौड़ लगाना
definition: attempt a sudden escape from confinement by running while nobody watches
example: The goat had been eyeing the open gate all morning, and the moment the milkman turned his back it made a break for it.

hindi: दिल का बोझ उतारना — पूरा अपराध साफ़-साफ़ कबूल करना
definition: confess every detail of past wrongdoing, unburdening a heavy conscience through complete voluntary admission
example: Twenty years after the prank, the retired teacher made a clean breast of it at the reunion, and nobody could stop grinning.

hindi: बंटाधार कर देना — काम पूरी तरह बिगाड़ देना
definition: handling something badly through carelessness, turning straightforward work into a ruined, muddled mistake
example: She meant to trim the hedge into a neat rectangle and made a hash of it, leaving something between a cloud and a staircase.

hindi: चाँदी काटना — भारी मुनाफ़ा कमाना
definition: earning huge profits quickly, usually from a single clever deal, sale or perfectly timed investment
example: The family made a killing selling umbrellas outside the stadium during the surprise monsoon final.

hindi: घर भर लेना — ढेर सारा पैसा कमाना
definition: earning huge amounts of money, as though personally minting coins, usually from a popular product
example: The student who invented those foldable lunch tiffins made a mint and still sends the school free samples.

hindi: नाम कमाना — अपनी पहचान बनाना
definition: become well known and respected through talent, effort or distinctive achievements
example: He made a name for himself mending clocks, and people travelled from three towns with their broken heirlooms.

hindi: मोटी कमाई करना
definition: in British usage, earning large profits or money, often from a business venture or sale
example: Her grandfather made a packet selling bicycles after the war and spent most of it on his daughters' schooling.

hindi: किसी पर डोरे डालना — इशारों में इज़हार
definition: flirting boldly, making an obvious move signalling romantic interest toward someone, hoping they respond
example: He finally made a pass at her over dessert, and she laughed so warmly he knew it had landed.

hindi: बंटाधार कर देना — काम बिगाड़कर रख देना
definition: botching something clumsily in British usage, leaving messy results everybody notices
example: He made a pig's ear of the shelving, then hung pictures cleverly over every crooked joint.

hindi: बलि का बकरा बनाना — सबकी गलती एक के सिर
definition: choose innocent person deliberately, loading collective blame onto them while genuine culprits escape
example: The committee made a scapegoat of the youngest teacher, and the parents saw straight through the arrangement.

hindi: तमाशा खड़ा करना — सबके सामने हंगामा करना
definition: create embarrassing public commotion, forcing bystanders witness argument better handled quietly indoors
example: She refused to make a scene inside the crowded shop, saving her actual argument for the autorickshaw home.

hindi: धूम मचाना — पहली बार में ही सबका ध्यान खींचना
definition: earn sudden fame everywhere with a first success that impresses watching crowds
example: Her debut painting made a splash at the local fair and sold before lunch.

hindi: मोटा माल बनाना
definition: earning large amounts of money, usually from work, sales or clever hustling, in American slang
example: She makes bank tutoring maths online, and every month she treats her mother to a new sari.

hindi: जो है उसी में काम चलाना — मरम्मत करके निभाना
definition: manage with little, repairing worn belongings rather than replacing them with newer purchases
example: She taught the children to make do and mend, and every jumper carried a story in its patches.

hindi: गुज़ारा चलाना — मुश्किल से खर्च पूरा करना
definition: manage barely enough money covering essential household spending each month
example: Between two jobs and a jar of coins on the kitchen table, she just about makes ends meet.

hindi: नज़रें लड़ाना — इशारों से प्रेम-रुचि जताना
definition: glance repeatedly toward someone, signalling flirtatious romantic interest without speaking aloud
example: They spent the whole wedding making eyes at each other across the sweets table.

hindi: धूप रहते फ़सल सुखा लेना — मौके का पूरा फ़ायदा उठाना
definition: take full advantage of a favourable moment while good conditions last, because the chance will soon disappear
example: Their grandmother had one clear afternoon between the rains, so she made hay and dried every last chilli on the terrace.

hindi: आगे बढ़ना — प्रगति करना
definition: advance steadily toward a goal despite slow difficult conditions holding progress back
example: By the fourth evening they were finally making headway, the ridge closer and the water bottles lighter.

hindi: बड़ा नाम कमाना — खूब कामयाब होना
definition: become hugely successful, wealthy and famous, achieving everything you dreamed about
example: Everyone from the street gathered round the television when the lad who once delivered their newspapers made it big.

hindi: नोटों की बारिश करना
definition: throwing banknotes freely into the crowd, or generally spending money extravagantly and showily celebrating
example: When his band finally got paid, the drummer jokingly made it rain with ten-rupee notes.

hindi: चुटकियों में निपटाना — आसानी से पूरा करना
definition: complete something difficult quickly and easily, needing surprisingly little visible effort
example: With all six cousins helping, they made light work of the Diwali cleaning before lunch.

hindi: कचूमर निकाल देना — बुरी तरह परास्त करना
definition: defeat someone thoroughly and easily, destroying their argument or challenge completely and quickly
example: The quiet librarian made mincemeat of the pub quiz champions, answering every history question before they finished reading it.

hindi: खुलकर कहना — बिना झिझक मान लेना
definition: state something bluntly and plainly, never hesitating or softening an awkward admission or objection
example: Grandpa made no bones about hating the new sofa, yet he was the first one asleep on it every Sunday afternoon.

hindi: चुटकियों में निपटा देना — मुश्किल काम फुर्ती से खत्म करना
definition: finish demanding task quickly through brisk efficient action, saving considerable time
example: Four hungry teenagers made short work of the pakoras, leaving behind a plate that needed almost no washing.

hindi: बकरा बनाना — किसी को बेवकूफ़ बनाना
definition: used for fooling someone into being tricked, making them the target of pranks or blame, as said in Indian English
example: On April Fool's Day the whole office made the new intern a bakra, then treated him to samosas to make up for it.

hindi: दिन बना देना — छोटी सी बात से ख़ुश कर देना
definition: give someone welcome, unexpected pleasure that lifts their entire mood until evening; small kindness brightening someone's whole outlook
example: The toddler at the next table waved goodbye to the waiter, and it clearly made his day.

hindi: बवाल मचाना — ज़ोरदार झगड़ा
definition: start a fierce noisy quarrel or fight, causing uproar and angry commotion everywhere
example: When Mum found the muddy footprints on her new carpet, she really made the fur fly.

hindi: कसौटी पर खरा उतरना — ज़रूरी स्तर तक पहुँचना
definition: reach the required standard, proving good enough after being carefully tested
example: After three failed auditions, she finally made the grade and her mother cried quietly in the back row.

hindi: आगे रहकर रफ़्तार तय करना — अगुवाई करना
definition: in British English, from horse racing: setting the pace and leading a contest, forcing rivals to follow
example: In the family's walking challenge, Aunt Meena made the running, striding to the market and back twice a day.

hindi: चलते बनना — जल्दी निकल जाना
definition: leave quickly, heading away before staying longer becomes awkward or tiring
example: Once the last guests began yawning over their tea, Meera decided to make tracks and slipped away with a quiet wave.

hindi: खून खौलना — भयंकर गुस्सा आना
definition: cause intense furious anger, usually through injustice that someone finds deeply outrageous
example: Seeing litter dumped beside the river made his blood boil, so he came back Saturday with forty volunteers and sacks.

hindi: रूह काँप जाना — भीतर तक सिहर उठना
definition: filling you with chilling dread, horror creeping through you like icy water
example: The slow creak of footsteps in the empty attic made her blood run cold, until the cat strolled down the ladder.

term: make your hair stand on end
hindi: रोंगटे खड़े हो जाना — डर से सिहर उठना
definition: startling you with sudden fright, sending an electric jolt of alarm through your whole body
example: The fox's scream outside the tent made our hair stand on end, and we laughed about it over breakfast for years.

hindi: सिर चकरा देना — इतना कि समझ न आए
definition: confuse or overwhelm you with so much information or change that thinking clearly becomes impossible
example: The dozens of cereal choices made her head spin, so she bought the same porridge her mother always had.

hindi: अपनी छाप छोड़ना — पहचान बनाना
definition: achieve lasting recognition, leaving influence people remember long after your contribution ends
example: The young chef made her mark with a humble lentil soup that regulars still ask for years after she moved on.

hindi: मन को समझा लेना — हालात से समझौता कर लेना
definition: calmly accept something disappointing that cannot change, ending inner struggle against the loss
example: She made her peace with the grey hairs and started wearing them like silver ribbons.

hindi: अपना ही घर समझो — बेतकल्लुफ़ रहिए
definition: invitation telling guest to relax comfortably, treating another household with easy familiar belonging
example: Make yourself at home, she said, pushing the kettle towards him and pointing at the biscuit tin behind the radio.

hindi: खिसक लेना — नज़रों से ओझल हो जाना
definition: leaving quickly or keeping well away, avoiding somebody or something by disappearing from sight
example: When the aunties started planning the wedding seating, the groom wisely made himself scarce in the garden.

hindi: मोर्चा सँभालना — डटकर अपनी जगह बचाना
definition: rush energetically toward defending your position, resisting attack alongside everybody else willing to help
example: When developers measured the old banyan, half the colony manned the barricades with folding chairs and endless flasks.

hindi: ऊपरवाले की मदद — अचानक मिली राहत
definition: unexpected generous help arriving exactly when desperate people needed rescue badly
example: The neighbour's spare generator during that long blackout arrived like manna from heaven, and dinner happened after all.

hindi: लंबी दौड़ — धीरज से पूरा होने वाला काम
definition: long undertaking requiring patient, steady endurance rather than quick bursts of speed
example: Her mentor reminded her that learning Japanese was a marathon, not a sprint, and to enjoy the small victories.

hindi: चलता कर देना — जाने का सख़्त फ़रमान
definition: firm instructions about leaving or dismissal, delivered with authority nobody present expects anybody to question
example: After the third broken window, the boys got their marching orders and finished their cricket in the empty lot.

hindi: समय काटना — असली मौके का इंतज़ार
definition: making no progress while waiting, keeping busy until the real opportunity finally comes
example: He marked time in the family shop that summer, stacking tins and chatting, until the art college letter arrived.

hindi: नक़ाब उतरना — दिखावा टूट जाना
definition: careful pretence briefly failing, letting hidden reality show through the practised friendly presentation
example: His mask slipped for one second when the bill arrived, and everybody at the table pretended otherwise.

hindi: आँकड़ों से खिलवाड़ — हिसाब चमकाना
definition: adjust financial figures dishonestly, making accounts, records, or results appear better than reality
example: The school fete committee refused to massage the figures, proudly reporting a profit of eleven rupees.

hindi: जोड़ी ऊपर से बनकर आई — रब ने बना दी जोड़ी
definition: perfect partnership where both people suit each other completely, seemingly destined together
example: He loved crosswords and she loved correcting his spelling, a match made in heaven.

hindi: यारी का भाव — दोस्तों के लिए सस्ता दाम
definition: discounted price given as a favour to friends and connections, Australian and British usage
example: His plumber cousin fixed the leaking tap at mate's rates, which meant a cold drink and a slice of pie.

hindi: बीच का रास्ता निकालना — दोनों पक्षों का थोड़ा-थोड़ा झुकना
definition: settle a disagreement when both sides offer equal concessions and accept a fair compromise
example: The neighbours met halfway on the fence height and shared the cost of the timber.

hindi: ख़ुदा को प्यारा होना — मरकर ईश्वर के सामने हाज़िर होना
definition: religious euphemism about death, facing judgement once breathing stops
example: He said he would rather meet his maker with the garden weeded and every letter answered.

hindi: अंतिम पराजय — निर्णायक हार
definition: suffer final, decisive defeat after long success, finally beaten by a stronger opponent
example: Our undefeated quiz champion finally met her Waterloo on a question about garden birds, and applauded the winners herself.

hindi: रिश्ते की मरम्मत करना — बिगड़े संबंध दोबारा सुधारना
definition: repair a damaged friendship by reaching forward first, settling the quarrel that kept both sides apart
example: She spent the whole train ride writing the letter that would mend fences with her sister.

hindi: दिमाग़ से खेलना — उलझन में डाल देना
definition: confuse or unsettle you mentally, making you doubt what you understood, remembered or believed
example: The magician's final trick messed with everyone's heads, and the children spent the whole drive home trying to work it out.

hindi: तेज़ी से शिखर तक पहुँचना — अचानक मिली बड़ी कामयाबी
definition: astonishingly rapid climb toward fame or success, sudden and spectacular like shooting stars
example: The café's meteoric rise began when a food blogger stopped by for shelter from the rain.

hindi: पागलपन में भी तरीक़ा — बेतुकी हरकत के पीछे छिपी समझ
definition: hidden sensible reasoning behind confusing behaviour, understandable once somebody explains properly
example: His shelves looked chaotic until he found every spice instantly, proving there was method to the madness after all.

hindi: बोलती बंद कर देने वाला जवाब — धमाकेदार आख़िरी बात
definition: triumphant final remark ending an argument so decisively that nobody could possibly respond
example: Asked why she deserved the bigger room, my sister simply held up her report card: total mic drop.

hindi: ख़यालों में खोया — ध्यान कहीं और
definition: lost deep in thought, paying no attention to people or things happening nearby
example: Her husband asked twice about dinner, but she was miles away, remembering the summer they first met.

hindi: लाख टके का सवाल — जिसका जवाब किसी को नहीं पता
definition: crucial question everybody wants answered, though nobody present can possibly supply the answer
example: Whether the old car would survive the drive to the coast was the million-dollar question, but the family packed the boot and set off singing.

hindi: गले में पत्थर — भारी बोझ
definition: heavy burden or obligation dragging you down, making every forward step slower and harder
example: The old mortgage had been a millstone around their neck, so they burned the final statement in the garden with a bottle of cider.

hindi: याद रखना — चेतावनी भरा अंदाज़
definition: playful warning meaning remember this carefully, delivered with theatrical swagger after a boast, as said in Indian English
example: Next year I will beat you at carrom, mind it, the eight-year-old announced, flicking his hair like a film hero.

hindi: छलनी जैसा दिमाग़ — कुछ भी याद न रहना
definition: memory losing information constantly, remembering almost nothing despite genuine careful attention
example: Uncle has a mind like a sieve about birthdays, though he remembers every cricket score since childhood.

hindi: तेज़ दिमाग़ — फ़ौरन समझने वाली बुद्धि
definition: remarkably quick intelligence that understands instantly and remembers everything it learns
example: At ninety, Aunt Rosa still had a mind like a steel trap and could recite every birthday in the family.

hindi: अपने काम से काम रखो — दूसरों के मामले में दखल मत दो
definition: attend only your personal affairs, without interfering where nobody invited your concern
example: Auntie asked about their savings again, and Priya smiled and suggested everybody mind their business until the mangoes ripened.

hindi: अदब-क़ायदे का ध्यान रखना — तमीज़ से पेश आना
definition: behaving politely and carefully, watching manners and words, especially around important people
example: Before the visit to Rhea's parents, his sister reminded him to mind his Ps and Qs and compliment the dal.

hindi: ज़बान संभाल कर बोलना — सोच-समझकर बात करना
definition: speaking carefully and politely, avoiding rude words that might offend people listening nearby
example: Mind your tongue in front of your grandfather, whispered Mum, as the boys tumbled in from football.

hindi: रोतलू — हमेशा शिकायत करने वाला उदास इंसान
definition: gloomy, grumbling person who complains constantly and spreads miserable moods, mostly heard in British English
example: Come on, misery guts, said Nan, tossing him a paintbrush, the fence won't paint itself and the sun's out.

hindi: गाड़ी छूट जाना — मौका हाथ से निकल जाना
definition: lose a valuable chance through arriving late, after the opportunity already passed beyond recovery
example: Ravi thought about the corner flat for a fortnight, and missed the boat by a single afternoon.

hindi: निशाना चूकना — अंदाज़ा बिल्कुल गलत बैठना
definition: falling short of the intended target, when a guess proves completely mistaken about what somebody wanted
example: She guessed her grandmother wanted a quiet birthday, and missed the mark entirely: the old woman had already invited forty neighbours.

hindi: ग़ायब — ज़रूरत के वक़्त नदारद
definition: absent without explanation exactly when needed, disappearing from expected duties; borrowed from military language
example: My brother was missing in action all through the washing up, then reappeared asking what was for pudding.

hindi: फायदे में छिपा नुकसान — अच्छा भी बुरा भी
definition: fortunate development carrying obvious drawbacks alongside benefits, complicating your honest gratitude
example: The new highway was a mixed blessing: mangoes reached market faster, though nobody could nap through afternoons anymore.

hindi: उलझे हुए संकेत — कुछ समझ नहीं आना
definition: contradictory romantic messages leaving somebody unsure whether genuine interest actually exists
example: She collected his mixed signals like receipts, comparing them with her flatmate every Sunday morning.

hindi: बाद की समझदारी वाला आलोचक — बीत जाने पर राय देने वाला
definition: an American term for somebody offering confident criticism afterwards about decisions carrying none of the original responsibility
example: Every Monday he explained which plays would have saved the game, though nobody remembered hearing those ideas before kickoff.

hindi: मुफ़्त का माल — आराम की कमाई
definition: cash handed over for pleasant duties that hardly feel like labour, said in British usage
example: Judging the village dog show and eating cake afterwards was money for jam, she told her sister.

hindi: मुफ़्त की कमाई — बिना मेहनत का पैसा
definition: money earned through work demanding almost zero effort or skill, said in British usage
example: Being paid to sit with the neighbour's sleeping cat all afternoon felt like money for old rope.

hindi: पैसे की कोई परवाह नहीं
definition: declaring spending freely without limit, cost being completely unimportant compared with getting exactly what you want
example: For his mother's seventieth birthday, money is no object, he told the florist with shining eyes.

hindi: पैसे का कुआँ — जहाँ पैसा डूबता जाए
definition: property, project or possession swallowing endless money, always demanding more spending without any return
example: Their charming old farmhouse turned into a money pit, but the family still loved every leaking room.

hindi: फ़ालतू पैसा — ज़रूरत से कहीं ज़्यादा दौलत
definition: having plenty of spare money, wealth generous enough that waste causes little worry
example: After the bonus arrived he acted like a man with money to burn, gifting sweets to every neighbour.

hindi: शरारत — छिपी हुई गड़बड़
definition: mischievous or dishonest activity happening secretly, prompting suspicious adults to watch closely
example: The teacher sensed monkey business when the whole class smiled sweetly at once, and sure enough, a frog sat in her drawer.

hindi: जन्मों लग जाएँ — असंभव सा लंबा समय
definition: impossibly long period, years passing before something unlikely finally happens
example: He promised to whitewash the veranda, though everyone knew that would take a month of Sundays and possibly another monsoon.

hindi: आहें भरना — दूर से दीवाना बना रहना
definition: sighing dreamily about somebody romantically unreachable, imagining romance constantly instead of actually speaking
example: He mooned over the girl from the bookshop for months before finally asking about her favourite author.

hindi: रातों-रात घर खाली करना — किराया चुकाए बिना भाग जाना
definition: secret overnight household departure, escaping unpaid rent without telling anybody (British usage)
example: The tenants did a moonlight flit before Diwali, and the landlord found only a swept floor and three unwashed teacups.

hindi: विवादित या बेमानी सवाल — जिसका अब कोई मतलब न रहा
definition: question still open to debate and never settled, or one that has stopped mattering practically
example: Whether we should take the early train became a moot point once we realised the station was closed for repairs.

hindi: नैतिक जीत — हारकर भी सिर ऊँचा
definition: defeat that still feels like success, because you behaved honourably or proved something important
example: The village team lost to the county champions by one goal, but everyone called it a moral victory and cheered them home.

hindi: अक़्ल से ज़्यादा क़िस्मत से
definition: succeeding through fortune rather than skill or careful planning; British
example: The cake rose beautifully, though Dad admitted it was more luck than judgement after forgetting the baking powder.

hindi: पैसा ज़्यादा, अक़्ल कम — बेवकूफ़ी भरा ख़र्च
definition: having plenty of wealth but spending it foolishly on showy things nobody sensible would ever want
example: Only someone with more money than sense would fit a golden tap in a garden shed, Nani muttered fondly.

hindi: महीना लंबा, जेब छोटी — तनख़्वाह से पहले पैसे ख़त्म
definition: household budget running short before the month ends, money gone while bills and days still remain
example: With more month than money, the flatmates pooled their last coins into one enormous pot of dal that lasted until payday.

hindi: दाल में कुछ काला — दिखने से ज़्यादा कुछ
definition: hidden depth existing beneath the visible surface, where outward appearance reveals only part
example: There was more than meets the eye about the sleepy bookshop, whose owner had once sailed cargo ships.

hindi: अफ़सोस की बात है — क्या करें, दुख है
definition: used to admit something is unfortunate and regrettable, adding gentle sorrow to a statement
example: Grandma never learned to swim, more's the pity, but she sat on the beach and cheered louder than anyone.

hindi: सुबह-शाम — हर वक़्त
definition: constantly, throughout every waking hour, continuing without pause from early until late
example: She practised the violin morning, noon and night until the neighbours could hum the concerto themselves.

hindi: हद से ज़्यादा फ़िक्र करने वाला — सबकी देखभाल में लगा रहने वाला
definition: someone fussing protectively over others, anxiously looking after younger or weaker people in their care
example: On the school trip Priya played mother hen, counting heads at every stop and handing out plasters.

hindi: चमड़ी जाए पर दमड़ी न जाए — बेहद कंजूस
definition: Australian joke about someone hating spending money, wallet opened so rarely that moths live inside
example: "Careful, there are moths in his wallet," Priya laughed, as her father finally, proudly, paid for everyone's ice creams.

hindi: बकवादी — जिसकी ज़ुबान कभी नहीं रुकती
definition: person producing endless chatter, burying every listener under unstoppable talk nobody requested
example: Our cab driver was a cheerful motor mouth, and by the airport we knew his entire family tree.

hindi: राई का पहाड़ बनाना — छोटी बात को बहुत बड़ा कर देना
definition: exaggerating minor trouble enormously, creating loud argument about something genuinely unimportant
example: Making a mountain out of a molehill over one missing spoon kept the family group chat awake until midnight.

hindi: आसमान-ज़मीन एक करना — हर मुमकिन कोशिश कर डालना
definition: make every possible effort, overcoming enormous obstacles to achieve something deeply important
