example: She moved heaven and earth to reach the hospital before visiting hours ended, three buses and one borrowed bicycle.

hindi: ज़मीन-आसमान एक कर देना — असंभव कर दिखाना
definition: achieve seemingly impossible results through tremendous determination, effort, and persistence
example: The villagers moved mountains to get the clinic built, holding bake sales every weekend for two years.

hindi: बीच खेल में नियम बदलना — शर्तें चालाकी से बढ़ा देना
definition: change agreed rules midway, unfair trick denying somebody success already nearly earned
example: Every time she finished the chores her uncle moved the goalposts, adding another errand before the promised bicycle appeared.

hindi: दुनिया में ऊपर उठना — हैसियत बढ़ना
definition: rising into higher social status, gaining wealth or standing compared with earlier years
example: Their cousin has moved up in the world, but he still turns up for Sunday lunch with his mother's pickle jar.

hindi: ज़माने के साथ चलना — बदलते समय के अनुसार ढलना
definition: adapting your habits and ideas to modern changes instead of clinging stubbornly to older ways
example: Grandma moved with the times, learning video calls just to watch her great-grandson take his first steps.

hindi: बदनामी का दाग़ रह जाता है — इल्ज़ाम पीछा नहीं छोड़ता
definition: damaged reputation lingers stubbornly, since accusations survive longer than corrections reaching listeners
example: The charges collapsed within weeks, but mud sticks, and neighbours still lowered their voices around him.

hindi: पानी गँदला करना — मामला और उलझा देना
definition: make a situation more confusing by adding complications that hide what really matters
example: He didn't want to muddy the waters before the big match, so he kept his worries about the coach to himself until afterwards.

hindi: बेवकूफ़ों का काम — जिसमें नुकसान पक्का है
definition: in British usage, pursuit almost certain to lose money, attempted only by hopeful fools
example: Uncle called scratch cards a mug's game, then bought one every Diwali purely to annoy his very sensible brother.

hindi: चुप्पी साधे रहना — यह बात यहीं तक
definition: everybody stays silent, keeping the news secret and telling nobody outside
example: We are moving the party to the terrace, and mum's the word until she opens the door.

hindi: माँ का लाडला — माँ के पल्लू से बँधा
definition: grown son too attached to his mother, depending on her comfort and approval, British usage
example: Everyone called him a mummy's boy, until they tasted the parathas she had taught him to make.

hindi: जो बिगड़ सकता है वह बिगड़ेगा — क़िस्मत का उल्टा नियम
definition: joking principle that whatever can possibly misfire eventually will, usually at the worst moment
example: Murphy's law struck on picnic day: sunshine all week, then rain the moment the blanket was spread.

hindi: कानों में मिश्री घुलना — मनचाही ख़बर
definition: welcome news or words bringing great pleasure, precisely what you hoped someone would say
example: 'Dinner's on me tonight,' said Leela, words that were music to her brother's ears after a month of instant noodles.

hindi: कुर्सी दौड़ — पदों की लगातार अदला-बदली
definition: constant shuffling of people between positions, leaving somebody finally without place
example: Bedrooms became musical chairs once the guests arrived, and the youngest cousin ended up happily asleep beneath the dining table.

hindi: बुढ़ापे में जवानी का शौक — उम्र छिपाने की कोशिश
definition: older person pretending youthful glamour through clothing that hides their actual years unconvincingly
example: Aunty called her own reflection mutton dressed as lamb, laughed, and wore the sequinned jacket anyway.

hindi: ख़ाक — बिल्कुल नहीं, झूठ है
definition: scornful reply dismissing something another person just claimed, showing flat disbelief without debate
example: 'He says he was studying all night,' said Priya. 'Studying my foot,' laughed her sister, holding up his game controller.

hindi: मेरी ज़ुबान बंद है — राज़ मुझसे नहीं खुलेगा
definition: promise to stay silent, assuring someone their secret stays safely hidden and never escapes through you
example: "My lips are sealed," whispered Priya, as her sister showed her the ring hidden in the biscuit tin.

hindi: रही-सही कसर पूरी करना — पतन को पक्का करने वाली आख़िरी चोट
definition: another damaging blow pushing something nearer final collapse, making the ending certain
example: The flooded basement was the last nail in the coffin for the little bookshop, though the owner still waters its window plants.

term: nail your colours to the mast
hindi: डंके की चोट पर कहना — खुलेआम अपना पक्ष घोषित करना
definition: declare your loyalty publicly, refusing afterwards every chance quietly changing sides
example: She nailed her colours to the mast at the meeting, and afterwards three quieter neighbours admitted they agreed with her.

hindi: नंगा सच — बिना परदे की सच्चाई
definition: plain truth stripped bare, shown without disguise, comfort or flattering decoration
example: The naked truth was that he missed his old friends, so he picked up the phone and called every single one.

hindi: नाम लेकर बदनाम करना — सार्वजनिक भर्त्सना
definition: publicly expose wrongdoers, naming them openly until shame reaches every watching audience
example: The residents' page decided to name and shame whoever kept leaving bin bags beside the gate.

hindi: नाम लेना — ज़िम्मेदार लोगों की पहचान बताना
definition: identify responsible people publicly, revealing exactly who was involved in wrongdoing
example: The teacher asked who had started the paper-plane fight, but nobody would name names, so everyone tidied up together.

hindi: अपने सबसे प्यारे — करीबी परिवार और दोस्त
definition: your closest family and friends, the relatives and companions you love most dearly and trust completely
example: She kept the birthday small, just her nearest and dearest squeezed around the kitchen table with one slightly lopsided cake.

hindi: कांटे की टक्कर — बराबर चल रहे
definition: closely matched competitors advancing together through contest, neither gaining decisive separation
example: The cousins stayed neck and neck through every board game until their grandmother declared honourable peace before supper.

hindi: ज़रूरत भर की जानकारी — राज़ सिर्फ़ ज़रूरी लोगों तक
definition: sharing secret information strictly with those requiring it, keeping everybody else uninformed
example: The birthday plans are on a need-to-know basis, and Grandpa, bless him, does not need to know.

hindi: फ़ौलादी जिगर — कभी न घबराने वाला हौसला
definition: remarkable courage and calm, staying completely steady where others would panic or crumble
example: The midwife had nerves of steel, calmly guiding the delivery in the back of the taxi while the driver prayed aloud.

hindi: मंज़िल से पहले की घबराहट — आख़िरी पड़ाव का डर
definition: in Indian and British English, from cricket: anxious stretch just before reaching a milestone, when players and people often stumble
example: With ninety-four pages of her thesis written, Anjali was deep in the nervous nineties and reorganising her pencils instead.

hindi: घबराहट से टूटा हुआ — बेहाल इंसान
definition: anxious person reduced to shaky exhaustion, nerves frayed after long strain or worry
example: After a night searching for the lost puppy, Dad was a nervous wreck until it turned up asleep in the laundry basket.

hindi: जोड़-पूँजी — भविष्य के लिए बचाकर रखी रकम
definition: savings kept steadily in reserve, protecting against future hardship or sudden difficulty
example: Thirty years of tailoring had grown into a modest nest egg, enough to send both daughters through college.

hindi: ज़िंदगी भर ताना — भुलाया न जाने वाला शर्मनाक पल
definition: remaining unable to escape embarrassment because people keep remembering and mentioning your mistake forever
example: He fell into the wedding fountain in 1998 and the family has never let him live it down.

hindi: नया ख़ून — नए लोगों की ताज़ा ऊर्जा
definition: fresh people joining a group, bringing lively energy and different ideas that revive tired routines
example: The amateur dramatic society needed new blood, and the three teenagers who joined rewrote the pantomime overnight.

hindi: आते ही सब बदल डालने वाला नया मुखिया
definition: freshly arrived leader eager to change everything quickly, sweeping away older habits and people
example: The new broom at the library threw open the windows, moved the sofas and started a Saturday storytime.

hindi: नया चेहरा — हाल में आया नवागंतुक
definition: recent arrival still unfamiliar to everyone, lacking experience among people already established somewhere
example: As the new kid on the block, the young vet was surprised when the farmers brought her cake instead of complaints.

hindi: नई जान आ जाना — फिर से ताज़गी मिलना
definition: renewed energy and vigour, giving something tired or worn a fresh period of usefulness, chiefly British
example: A coat of yellow paint and new strings gave the old piano a new lease of life in the community hall.

hindi: नवधनाढ्य — हाल में आई दौलत
definition: recently acquired wealth, or families newly wealthy, often spending showily compared with established fortunes
example: The new money families on the hill threw the liveliest parties, and everybody secretly loved attending.

hindi: रात भर रंगरलियाँ — देर तक घूमना-पीना
definition: celebratory evening spent drinking, dancing, arriving home exhausted in Irish and British usage
example: After a night on the tiles the four of them shared chips on the harbour wall, watching trawlers leave without them.

hindi: चार दिन की चाँदनी — थोड़े दिन की चर्चा
definition: sensation everybody gossips about briefly, then forgets completely once something newer arrives, fleeting fame
example: The talking parrot at the corner shop was a nine days' wonder before the village went back to discussing the weather.

hindi: दस में नौ बार — लगभग हमेशा
definition: almost always, happening with overwhelming regularity apart from genuinely rare exceptions
example: Nine times out of ten the missing keys were inside her other bag, though nobody dared mention this aloud.

hindi: शुरू में ही खत्म करना — कली में मसल देना
definition: stop harmful trouble early, before growing quietly beyond comfortable control
example: The rumour about the missing cash was nipped in the bud when their aunt simply counted it aloud.

hindi: बिना दिखावे वाला — सादा और बेतकल्लुफ़
definition: friendly unpretentious manner, sensible person refusing superior behaviour despite wealth position
example: Their landlord has no airs and graces, sitting cross-legged on the veranda floor while everyone shares peanuts.

hindi: कोई मुक़ाबला ही नहीं — एकतरफ़ा बात
definition: situation where one side is so clearly superior that comparison or competition becomes pointless
example: Homemade samosas against the shop-bought ones? No contest — the plate was empty before the tea had even brewed.

hindi: कोई फ़ायदा नहीं — बात नहीं बनी
definition: in American English, from gambling: absolutely not, the request refused or the attempt producing nothing useful
example: Rohan asked to skip piano for the match; no dice, said his mother, handing him the sheet music with a smile.

hindi: इस लड़ाई में अपना कुछ नहीं — किसी पक्ष से मतलब नहीं
definition: having nothing personally invested in somebody else's quarrel, therefore refusing either side
example: Both cousins wanted him to declare a winner, but he smiled and said he had no dog in this fight, then went back to peeling oranges.

hindi: कोई कंजूसी नहीं — खुला ख़र्च
definition: done lavishly, spending freely without limit, every costly detail included regardless of total price
example: The school reunion was organised with no expense spared, right down to the old canteen's samosas.

hindi: मुँहफट — जो मन में आए कह देना
definition: habit of voicing every honest opinion openly, never pausing to censor private thoughts first
example: Her five-year-old has no filter, cheerfully telling the new neighbour that his moustache looks like a sleeping caterpillar.

hindi: कुछ ख़ास नहीं — साधारण, जिसमें दम नहीं
definition: disappointing, ordinary enough in British understatement that nobody feels particularly impressed
example: Dad admits his lasagne is no great shakes, but everybody keeps arriving on Tuesdays anyway.

hindi: कोई मलाल नहीं — दिल में कड़वाहट न रहना
definition: without resentment after a defeat or quarrel, the past grievance genuinely forgotten between both sides
example: They shook hands at the net, no hard feelings, and split a plate of chips afterwards.

hindi: आपस में बनती नहीं — पुरानी खटास
definition: mutual dislike between people, a lasting coolness neither side bothers hiding anymore
example: There was no love lost between the rival coaches, yet each quietly sent flowers when the other fell ill.

hindi: बिना झंझट — सीधा और साफ़
definition: promising something simple and tidy, done without bother, mess or complication, said in American usage
example: Dad's camping breakfast was toast on a stick over the fire, no muss, no fuss.

hindi: कोई खेल नहीं — आसान काम नहीं
definition: something decidedly difficult and unpleasant, demanding real effort, patience and endurance from everyone involved
example: Moving house with three cats and a piano was no picnic, but they laughed about it for years afterwards.

hindi: चैन कहाँ — काम कभी ख़त्म नहीं होता
definition: wry, joking complaint that endless work keeps arriving, leaving never a moment's peace
example: Just as she sat down with her tea, the washing machine beeped and she sighed, no rest for the wicked, grinning at her husband.

term: no room to swing a cat
hindi: तिल रखने की जगह नहीं — बेहद तंग जगह
definition: cramped living space offering barely enough floor room between crowded furniture
example: Their first flat had no room to swing a cat, so guests sat on the bed and everyone agreed it was cosy.

hindi: बुरा मत मानना — तंज़ से पहले सफ़ाई
definition: spoken before criticism, claiming friendly intention while delivering pointed insult anyway
example: No shade, but, she began, and everybody around the table reached for their drinks simultaneously.

hindi: अब जवान नहीं रहे — उम्र अपना असर दिखा रही
definition: noticeably beyond youthful years, older than energetic pursuits comfortably allow nowadays
example: He reminded everyone he was no spring chicken, then carried both suitcases upstairs before anybody could reach them.

hindi: कोई बड़ी बात नहीं — बिना मेहनत का काम
definition: something managed easily, without effort, worry, trouble, difficulty, hardly deserving anxious thinking beforehand
example: When she apologised about the extra guests, the cook waved a ladle and said no sweat.

hindi: सच कहता हूँ — ज़रा भी झूठ नहीं
definition: in British usage, insisting that something surprising really happened, honestly, without exaggeration or invention
example: No word of a lie, the fox strolled into the kitchen, sniffed the Sunday roast and walked straight back out.

hindi: घाट घाट का पानी पिया हुआ — जिसे कोई बहका नहीं सकता
definition: understands quickly when others attempt deception, remaining shrewd about details behind smooth promises
example: The landlord raised his voice, but Meera was nobody's fool and asked for the paperwork.

hindi: तुम्हारा काम नहीं — तुम्हें बताने की ज़रूरत नहीं
definition: playfully refusing questions about private affairs which never concerned somebody asking
example: Asked what she had spent on the guitar, Nandini said it was none of his beeswax and strummed something loud.

hindi: जस का तस — समझाने पर भी कुछ पल्ले न पड़ना
definition: remaining unaware after an explanation, holding exactly the same knowledge that the confusion started with
example: The mechanic talked about pistons for twenty warm minutes, and she drove away none the wiser but strangely reassured.

hindi: नाक कट गई — इज़्ज़त चली गई
definition: used for public disgrace falling upon family honour, losing respect before relatives and society, as said in Indian English
example: Mummy insisted their nose got cut when the sweets ran out at the wedding, though every guest remembered only the dancing.

hindi: किताब में डूब जाना — पढ़ाई में खो जाना
definition: study reading material intensively, ignoring conversation happening around your quiet corner
example: Whenever relatives arrived with questions about marriage, Anil kept his nose in a book until the subject changed.

hindi: मुँह फूलना — अपमान महसूस कर नाराज़ होना
definition: offended and sulkily irritated because someone seemed to ignore, slight, or overlook your feelings or importance
example: Dad had his nose out of joint when nobody asked for his chutney recipe, until Aunt Rita begged him for it at dinner.

hindi: जी-तोड़ मेहनत — बिना रुके लगातार काम
definition: steady tiring labour continued through many hours, refusing every pleasant distraction
example: With exams three weeks away she kept her nose to the grindstone, though the mangoes outside her window were ripening loudly.

hindi: ताक-झाँक करने वाला — दूसरों के मामलों में टोह लेने वाला
definition: excessively curious person, British informal, always prying into other people's private business
example: Our street's nosy parker, Mrs. Hale, was also the first to notice when the pensioner at number nine needed help.

hindi: एक धेला भी नहीं — पूरी तरह ख़ाली हाथ
definition: Australian for having absolutely no money, completely penniless, without even a single coin
example: Grandad arrived in Sydney with not a brass razoo, a borrowed coat, and a whistle that made every dog on the wharf follow him.

hindi: एक लफ़्ज़ भी नहीं — बिल्कुल कोई ख़बर नहीं
definition: absolutely nothing spoken, not a single word heard from someone, Cockney rhyming slang
example: He moved to Leeds in March and since then, not a dicky bird, not even a postcard for his mother's birthday.

term: not a dry eye in the house
hindi: सबकी आँखें नम — पूरा सभागार भावुक
definition: everyone present was moved to tears, the whole audience overcome with tender emotion together at a touching moment
example: When the retired teacher's former pupils stood up one by one to thank her, there was not a dry eye in the house.

hindi: चूँ तक नहीं — ज़रा सी भी आवाज़ नहीं
definition: absolutely nothing spoken, not the faintest sound or complaint heard from someone expected
example: The toddler had screamed for an hour, but once the story began there was not a peep from the cot.

term: not a penny to your name
hindi: कंगाल होना — नाम पर एक पैसा भी नहीं
definition: completely without money, savings, wages, or property that could cover ordinary living costs
example: She arrived in the city with not a penny to her name and a borrowed suitcase of winter clothes.

term: not all it's cracked up to be
hindi: जितना सुना था उतना नहीं — उम्मीद से फीका
definition: disappointing compared with its glowing reputation, falling well short of what everyone praised and promised
example: City life was not all it's cracked up to be, she wrote home, though the rooftop sunsets came close.

hindi: पलक तक न झपकाना — ज़रा भी न घबराना
definition: show absolutely no surprise, alarm or nervousness, remaining calm when something shocking happens; American 'not bat an eye'
example: When the goat wandered into the classroom, the headmaster did not bat an eyelid and simply asked someone to open the door.

hindi: बहुत पहले हो जाना चाहिए था — आख़िरकार
definition: relieved remark that something long overdue has finally happened, much later than it should have arrived, British English
example: "The new bridge opens Monday," said the postmistress, "and not before time — I've been rowing parcels across for years."

hindi: कच्ची गोलियाँ नहीं खेलीं — भोला नहीं
definition: experienced enough to recognise tricks, refusing belief in obvious excuses or clumsy flattery
example: The shopkeeper smiled at the boy's story about a lost wallet and handed him a free sweet anyway, but made it clear she was not born yesterday.

hindi: किसी से भनक तक न लगने देना — राज़ पूरी तरह छिपाना
definition: keeping a secret completely, refusing to reveal anything whatever questions come from anybody
example: She made her little brother promise not to breathe a word about the puppy until their father came home from work.

hindi: बात हज़म न होना — न मानना
definition: refusing belief in an explanation or excuse, firmly doubting that someone is honestly telling the truth
example: The twins swore they hadn't touched the cake, but with icing on both noses their mother was not buying it.

hindi: खेल भावना के ख़िलाफ़ — नाइंसाफ़ी वाली हरकत
definition: unfair conduct breaking unwritten decency rules, British phrasing disapproving somebody's sneaky behaviour
example: Reading his teammate's notes before the quiz was simply not cricket, and he confessed before the scores were announced.

hindi: तिनका तक न तोड़ना — बिल्कुल काम न करना
definition: doing absolutely no work whatsoever, idle while everybody else labours; British and Irish
example: My cousin never did a hand's turn on the farm, yet the old sheepdog followed him everywhere adoringly.

term: not for the faint of heart
hindi: कमज़ोर दिल वालों के लिए नहीं — हिम्मत का काम
definition: demanding real courage, far too frightening or intense for timid people easily unsettled
example: The rickety rope bridge was not for the faint of heart, yet Nana marched across it and waved from the far side.

hindi: कुछ अता-पता न होना — ज़रा भी जानकारी नहीं
definition: knowing absolutely nothing about something, without even the faintest hint pointing toward the answer
example: He didn't have a clue how to braid hair, but his daughter sat patiently while he watched a video and tried again and again.

hindi: कोई सुराग़ नहीं — कुछ भी पता नहीं
definition: knowing absolutely nothing, from cartoon Scooby-Doo rhyming with clue, British rhyming slang
example: My nephew asked me how cryptocurrency works and I had to confess I hadn't a scooby, so we looked it up together.

hindi: दुनिया भर में कोई अंदाज़ा नहीं — बिल्कुल पता नहीं
definition: having no possible idea or chance at all, short for no earthly idea in British English
example: Nobody had an earthly why the cat kept sleeping in the laundry basket, but the whole family learned to check before loading the machine.

hindi: रत्ती भर पता न होना — हल्का-सा भी अंदाज़ा नहीं
definition: lacking even the slightest idea about something, knowing absolutely nothing whatsoever about the matter
example: She hadn't the faintest what the new neighbours did for a living, but she baked them a cake anyway and knocked on their door.

hindi: ज़रा भी इल्म न होना — धुँधला-सा अंदाज़ा भी नहीं
definition: having not even the vaguest notion about something, knowing absolutely nothing whatsoever in British English
example: Asked where the spare key had gone, Dad said he hadn't the foggiest, then found it in his own coat pocket an hour later.

hindi: क ख ग भी न जानना — किसी विषय से बिल्कुल अनजान
definition: knowing nothing whatsoever about a particular subject, being entirely ignorant of its basics in American English
example: She didn't know beans about football when she married him, but by the third season she was shouting at the referee louder than anyone.

hindi: जान-पहचान तक न होना — बिल्कुल अजनबी
definition: having absolutely no idea who a person is, never having seen or heard of them
example: The woman who returned his wallet didn't know him from Adam, yet she drove across town to hand it back in person.

hindi: ख़ाक भी न जानना — कुछ भी मालूम नहीं
definition: knowing nothing useful whatsoever about a subject, despite perhaps pretending otherwise in American English
example: He admitted he didn't know squat about gardening, yet his first tomatoes came up fat and red because he watered them every single morning.

term: not know the first thing about
hindi: अलिफ़-बे भी न जानना — बुनियादी बात से भी अनजान
definition: being completely ignorant of even the most basic facts about a particular subject or practical skill
example: He didn't know the first thing about babies, yet the night his son arrived he learned to change nappies faster than the nurse.

hindi: क्या है क्या नहीं, पता न होना — मामले की समझ न होना
definition: lacking understanding of how things really work, unable to judge what matters or what is happening
example: On her first day in the busy kitchen she didn't know what's what, so the old cook kept her beside him and explained every station.

term: not know which way is up
hindi: उल्टा-सीधा कुछ न सूझना — पूरी तरह बौखलाया हुआ
definition: feeling so thoroughly confused and overwhelmed that you cannot tell which direction anything points
example: After the twins arrived, the new parents didn't know which way was up, so both grandmothers moved in for a fortnight.

hindi: उँगली तक न हिलाना — ज़रा भी मदद न करना
definition: making absolutely no effort to help, leaving every piece of work to other people
example: He did not lift a finger during the move, but he made everyone the best sandwiches they had ever tasted.

hindi: लाग-लपेट न रखना — साफ़-साफ़ बोलना
definition: speak bluntly and plainly, choosing harsh direct words without softening anything to spare feelings
example: When her brother asked about his wobbly business plan, Meera did not mince words, then spent the whole evening helping him fix it.

hindi: मेरे मतलब की चीज़ नहीं — शौक़ मेरा नहीं
definition: declining something politely in British usage because personal taste finds nothing appealing there
example: Opera really isn't my bag, she said, though she happily held everybody's coats outside the theatre.

hindi: मेरा सिरदर्द नहीं — दूसरों का झगड़ा दूसरों का
definition: declaring somebody else's quarrel entirely their responsibility, refusing involvement without apology
example: Their neighbours were fighting about parking again, and Meera shrugged, said it wasn't her circus, and went back inside.

hindi: मेरे मिज़ाज का नहीं — अपनी पसंद से बाहर
definition: something personally disliked without judgement, simply lacking appeal despite others enjoying enormously
example: Loud rooftop parties are not my cup of tea, so I stayed downstairs with the dog and a paperback.

hindi: बोलचाल बंद — आपस में अबोला
definition: refusing to talk after a quarrel, the silence lasting until someone finally relents
example: My aunts were not on speaking terms for a whole summer, communicating only through pointed notes stuck on the fridge.

term: not playing with a full deck
hindi: दिमाग़ का पेच ढीला — कुछ सनकी और नासमझ
definition: describes a person lacking intelligence or ordinary judgement, foolish and mentally unreliable
example: The landlord painted the windows shut for warmth, and the tenants agreed he was not playing with a full deck.

hindi: कोई बड़ी बात नहीं — बहुत आसान काम
definition: a task or idea so simple that anybody could manage it easily, needing no special training
example: Making a good cup of tea is not rocket science, Mum insisted, but she still watched me warm the pot.

term: not see the wood for the trees
hindi: बारीकियों में उलझकर असल बात न देख पाना
definition: so absorbed in small details that you cannot understand the larger situation, British English; Americans say forest
example: Planning every minute of the holiday, she couldn't see the wood for the trees until her son asked if they could just visit the beach.

hindi: कम अक्ल — तेज़ दिमाग़ नहीं
definition: someone rather slow to understand things, affectionately described as lacking quick intelligence
example: Our Labrador is not the brightest bulb, but he has never once forgotten where the treats are kept.

hindi: ज़रा भी अंदाज़ा नहीं — कुछ पता नहीं
definition: absolutely without any idea or clue about something, completely ignorant of the answer, said in British English
example: Asked where he had parked the car, Grandad cheerfully admitted he had not the foggiest.

hindi: पूरा होश नहीं — कुछ कम अक़्ल
definition: limited intelligence, somebody considered slightly foolish, hardly sensible under pressure, said across Australia
example: Neighbours whispered that the fellow was not the full quid, though nobody mended fences faster after every storm.

hindi: पूरा सिक्का नहीं — अक्ल थोड़ी कम
definition: considered slightly foolish in Irish and Scottish usage, missing ordinary practical sense
example: The neighbours decided he was not the full shilling when he painted the gate three different colours, though the garden looked cheerful afterwards.

hindi: फूटी कौड़ी भर का नहीं — बिलकुल बेकार
definition: worth nothing whatever, holding value nobody sensible would spend actual money upon
example: The scooter warranty proved not worth a red cent, so their mechanic fixed everything himself over three patient evenings.

hindi: यह बोझ तुम्हारा नहीं — किसी और की ज़िम्मेदारी
definition: somebody else's burden entirely, therefore refusing responsibility, guilt, carrying, repair
example: She grieved for her friend's failing marriage until her mother reminded her it was not her cross to carry.

hindi: कोई ख़ास बात नहीं — मामूली, उम्मीद से कम
definition: ordinary and unremarkable, leaving people disappointed who expected something special, exciting or impressive
example: The famous café's coffee was nothing to write home about, but the old owner's stories made the trip worthwhile.

hindi: कहीं ठौर न होना — कोई सहारा नहीं
definition: without anyone left who can help, every source of support already exhausted
example: When the flood took their house and they had nowhere to turn, the mosque opened its hall and cooked for three weeks.

hindi: इशारों-इशारों में — बिना कहे सब समझा देना
definition: joking phrase hinting knowingly at something secret or suggestive without stating it openly, British
example: Your sister says she's just studying at Sam's house, nudge nudge, wink wink, teased their cousin over dinner.

hindi: नट बोल्ट की बात — काम की बुनियादी बारीकियाँ
definition: practical essential details making something actually function, rather than grand vague theory
example: Her father skipped the speeches and asked about the nuts and bolts, mainly rent, wiring and honest monthly numbers.

hindi: पगला जाना — हर बात में सनक
definition: thoroughly eccentric and irrational, cheerfully strange about nearly every ordinary domestic matter
example: He labels every jar in three languages and calls himself organised; his sisters call him nutty as a fruitcake.

hindi: सबसे अलग पड़ जाना — भीड़ में बेजोड़
definition: single person left outside belonging, different from everybody around, awkwardly unmatched within group
example: She arrived as the odd one out, the only cousin without a cricket story, and left holding somebody's bat.

hindi: पक्का दावेदार — जीतने की सबसे ज़्यादा उम्मीद
definition: competitor widely expected succeed, whose chances look better than everybody else's chances
example: The odds-on favourite for the singing prize spent the interval calming a nervous younger boy who eventually finished second.

hindi: पटरी से उतरा हुआ — तथ्यों से कोसों दूर
definition: badly mistaken about the facts, standing completely apart from what the situation actually requires
example: Every guess about why the bakery closed was wildly off base; the owner had simply gone to visit her sister for a month.

hindi: रंग उड़ा होना — चेहरा उतरा और बीमार लगना
definition: looking pale and unwell, showing mild temporary sickness that friends notice before complaint
example: You look rather off colour, Dad said, already reaching for the thermometer in the drawer.

hindi: अनजानी राह पर — भीड़ से दूर
definition: somewhere remote, away from routes ordinary travellers usually follow (British; American: beaten path)
example: They found a village well off the beaten track, where the bus arrived twice weekly and everybody waved.

hindi: बही-खाते से बाहर — बिना लिखा-पढ़ी के
definition: unrecorded and unofficial, arranged secretly outside formal accounts so nobody tracks it
example: The carpenter mended the church bench off the books, refusing payment and asking only for a slice of harvest pie.

hindi: बिना तैयारी कहा गया — तुरंत सूझा जवाब
definition: spoken without preparation, invented immediately instead of following planned written remarks
example: His off the cuff toast at the engagement was warmer than anything the printed programme had promised.

hindi: दुनिया से कटकर — बिना संपर्क रहना
definition: living without screens, networks, or offline reachability, deliberately outside ordinary connection
example: They spent April off the grid at his grandfather's farm, learning that goats never once asked about notifications.

hindi: फंदे से छूटना — इल्ज़ाम या ज़िम्मेदारी से बरी हो जाना
definition: released from blame, punishment, or heavy obligation that once seemed unavoidable
example: When the neighbour admitted his own dog had dug up the tulips, my brother was suddenly off the hook and grinning into his teacup.

hindi: नज़रों से ओझल — कोई पता नहीं, कोई जवाब नहीं
definition: gone completely quiet and unreachable, vanished from public notice, also heard as under the radar
example: She stayed off the radar for three weeks, painted the spare bedroom, and returned with nothing whatsoever to report.

hindi: दबी ज़ुबान से — बिना हवाला
definition: said privately, journalism phrase meaning information cannot be published, quoted, or attributed
example: Off the record, he admitted the whole department already knew, then changed the subject firmly.

term: off the top of your head
hindi: जो याद आया वही — बिना सोचे-समझे तुरंत
definition: answering immediately from memory, guessing roughly without checking written records
example: Off the top of his head he named nine cousins, then admitted he had forgotten the twins entirely.

hindi: काम चल पड़ा — रफ़्तार पकड़ ली
definition: in American English: underway at last and progressing quickly, after a slow or uncertain beginning
example: Once the bakery's oven finally warmed up, they were off to the races, trays of buns coming out every ten minutes.

hindi: ख़यालों में गुम — कहीं और खोया हुआ
definition: daydreaming vacantly, thinking muddled distant thoughts, hardly sensible whenever addressed, said across Australia
example: Halfway through the maths lesson she went off with the pixies, drawing seabirds along the margin of every page.

hindi: अपने बूते पर — बिना किसी के कहे
definition: in British English, from cricket: acting entirely through personal initiative, without anybody asking, prompting or instructing you
example: Nobody asked her to, but off her own bat Meera repainted the faded classroom mural over the holidays.

hindi: पुराने साथियों का जाल — अपनों की सिफ़ारिश
definition: influential connections among former schoolmates who quietly trade favours and opportunities, British usage
example: She broke into the rowing club without the old boys' network, just by turning up at dawn every single day.

hindi: पुराना प्यार — बीते दिनों का इश्क़
definition: former partner or sweetheart from years before, someone whose romance ended long since
example: At the reunion he spotted an old flame by the punch bowl and suddenly forgot every word he knew.

hindi: पुराना खिलाड़ी — लंबे अनुभव वाला माहिर व्यक्ति
definition: someone whose long practical experience makes difficult work look calm and unhurried
example: An old hand at monsoon leaks, our neighbour arrived with buckets before the ceiling gave way.

hindi: बासी बात — जो अब नई नहीं रही
definition: familiar, unexciting, outdated because everybody already knows everything thoroughly
example: Her card tricks were old hat among the cousins, so she learned three new ones before the winter holidays began.

hindi: पुश्तैनी दौलत — पीढ़ियों से चली आती संपत्ति
definition: family wealth inherited across generations, carrying quiet privilege and established social standing
example: Their house smelled of beeswax and old money, and nobody in it had bought a new dining chair since the war.

hindi: पुराने स्कूल की यारी — रसूख वाला जाल
definition: privileged British network where former schoolmates quietly favour each other's advancement
example: The appointment smelled faintly of the old school tie, since both men remembered the same cricket pavilion fondly.

hindi: दादी-नानी की बात — पुराना अंधविश्वास
definition: traditional belief passed down through generations, widely repeated though proven false, often superstitious
example: Her grandmother insisted cutting nails at night brought bad luck, and nobody minded humouring the old wives' tale.

hindi: सुलह का पैग़ाम — शांति का प्रस्ताव
definition: a gesture offered to calm the hostility between opposing sides, easing tension towards peaceful agreement
example: He arrived with mangoes from the garden, an olive branch nobody in the family could refuse.

hindi: बात-बात पर भड़कना — ज़रा सी चिंगारी से फटना
definition: ready to explode into anger instantly, the temper primed so that slight provocation sets it
example: After the sleepless week, the whole family was on a hair trigger, so Grandma declared a silent movie night.

hindi: ख़ुशी के शिखर पर — जोश में
definition: elated and energised, still thrilled long after a success, the excitement lingering beyond the moment
example: The band was still on a high at midnight, replaying the encore in the van all the way home.

hindi: तलवार की धार पर — नतीजा ज़रा से तय
definition: balanced precariously between rescue and disaster, where slightest change decides everything remaining uncertain
example: The last over left the whole colony on a knife edge, radios pressed against seven different balcony railings.

hindi: ज़रूरत भर की जानकारी — सिर्फ़ उसे बताना जिसे जानना ज़रूरी हो
definition: sharing secret information only with people who truly require it, keeping everyone else uninformed
example: The proposal plans were strictly on a need-to-know basis, so only the florist and the violinist knew the date.

hindi: सत्ता के नशे में — अधिकार का घमंड
definition: enjoying newly gained authority far too much, bossing others around simply because you finally can
example: Made hall monitor for a day, little Kabir went on a power trip, issuing tickets for walking too slowly.

hindi: क़िस्मत चमकना — लगातार कामयाबी का दौर चलना
definition: stretch where fortune keeps arriving, luck stacking success after success without visible effort
example: Four sales before lunch, and the new boy was so clearly on a roll that nobody dared send him on a tea run.

hindi: बैठे-बिठाए मिलना — बिना कोशिश के हासिल
definition: handed over freely without any struggle or earning, arriving ready and waiting for lucky recipients
example: Nobody gave her the bakery on a silver platter; she saved every coin for twelve years.

term: on a wing and a prayer
hindi: राम भरोसे — बस दुआ के सहारे
definition: managing with almost nothing except hope, pressing onward without proper resources or certainty of landing safely
example: The band drove to the festival on a wing and a prayer, a cracked van, half a tank and a borrowed amplifier strapped on top.

hindi: संतुलन में — शांत और स्थिर
definition: steady, calm, balanced again after trouble, nothing wobbling dangerously anymore
example: Three quiet months after the hospital stay, the household felt on an even keel again, mornings unhurried and the radio playing.

hindi: मशीनी ढंग से — बिना ध्यान दिए
definition: acting mechanically without attention or thought, neglecting what you are supposedly doing
example: Running on autopilot after the night shift, the nurse put her keys in the fridge and the milk in her handbag.

hindi: उधार की ज़िंदगी — गिने-चुने दिन
definition: surviving beyond what anyone expected, lasting only temporarily before inevitable failure or ending arrives
example: Our ancient kettle has been on borrowed time for years, yet every morning it still whistles us awake.

hindi: ख़ुशी से फूला न समाना — सातवें आसमान पर होना
definition: feeling extremely delighted, floating through ordinary hours because something wonderful finally happened
example: She was on cloud nine for a week after the results, distributing sweets to neighbours who had already congratulated her twice.

hindi: बिना ज़ोर लगाए — अपनी रफ़्तार से
definition: proceeding smoothly and steadily with minimal exertion, everything running along without close attention
example: Once the choir learnt the harmonies, rehearsals ran on cruise control and everybody relaxed.

hindi: अलग-अलग तार पर होना — सोच का मेल न बैठना
definition: constant misunderstanding between people whose thinking follows completely different lines
example: He wanted quiet mountains, she wanted markets and music; about holidays they were always on different wavelengths.

hindi: चैन की बंसी बजाना — पैसों की चिंता से मुक्त
definition: living comfortably, securely, without money worry, thanks toward steady wealth covering every expense
example: Two good harvests and the loan cleared, and suddenly the family found themselves on easy street.

hindi: बेचैन रहना — छोटी बात पर भी चौंक जाना
definition: tense and jumpy, nerves stretched thin, expecting trouble from every small noise or remark
example: Waiting for his exam results had left him on edge all week, snapping at the kettle whenever it clicked off.

hindi: काँटों पर लोटना — बेचैनी में होना
definition: restless and nervous, unable to settle, fidgeting while something important hangs undecided
example: We were on pins and needles while the judges added up the scores for our little choir.

hindi: एकदम सही — हर बात नपी-तुली और सलीक़ेदार
definition: exactly correct, stylish, faultless, every small detail judged where careful taste demanded
example: The eyeliner, earrings, even the borrowed scarf were entirely on point, though she swore everything happened accidentally.

hindi: बोलचाल होना — रिश्ता अभी बचा हुआ
definition: still friendly enough to talk politely, a relationship surviving despite quarrels, often used negatively
example: The brothers were barely on speaking terms after the argument, but both turned up to paint their mother's fence.

hindi: साँस अटकी रहना — बेचैनी से इंतज़ार करना
definition: waiting anxiously, unable to relax until uncertain news or an outcome finally arrives
example: The whole family sat on tenterhooks around the phone until the hospital called to say the baby had arrived safely.

hindi: तैयारी में — बन रहा है
definition: newspaper phrase meaning something planned is being prepared, taking shape before public announcement, as said in Indian English
example: A new library for the village school is on the anvil, the headmaster told the parents, and the children cheered loudest.

hindi: ठंडे बस्ते में डालना — किसी काम को टालकर बाद के लिए रख देना
definition: postponed for later, receiving little attention while other matters keep moving ahead
example: Her novel sat on the back burner through three winters, the notebook still under the bed, until a quiet January finally gave it back to her.

hindi: बैकफ़ुट पर — बचाव में सिमटा हुआ
definition: forced defensive position, struggling awkwardly against difficult attacks from stronger opponents
example: The debating team spent twenty minutes on the back foot before their quietest speaker turned the whole argument around.

hindi: चौकस — पूरी तरह सतर्क और काबिल
definition: alert competent attentive, noticing important details quickly instead of drifting through duties
example: The young pharmacist was thoroughly on the ball, spotting the wrong dosage before anybody swallowed anything unfortunate.

hindi: दारू के पीछे पड़ जाना — कई दिन शराब में डूबे रहना
definition: drinking heavily across several days in Irish usage, neglecting work entirely
example: His cousin had been on the batter since the wedding, and the whole family took turns minding the shop until he surfaced.

hindi: रोटी के लाले पड़ना — ग़रीबी रेखा पर जीना
definition: British for living in poverty, earning barely enough for food and basic necessities, household hardship constant
example: Families on the breadline queued at the community kitchen, where volunteers made sure every child left with a warm scone and a joke.

hindi: होने के आसार — जल्द होने की संभावना
definition: in British English: likely or probable, expected to happen soon given present circumstances
example: With the cousins arriving and the sky clearing, a cricket match in the lane was definitely on the cards.

hindi: तलब किया जाना — डाँट के लिए बुलाया जाना
definition: summoned before somebody powerful for scolding, facing severe criticism about something you did wrong
example: The prefects were called on the carpet after the midnight feast was discovered in the chapel.

hindi: सस्ते में निपटाना — कम ख़र्च में काम चलाना
definition: done while spending very little money, carefully cutting costs, sometimes sacrificing quality along the way
example: They renovated the café on the cheap, painting mismatched chairs sunflower yellow until the patchwork became its charm.

term: on the crest of a wave
hindi: सफलता की लहर पर — अच्छे दौर में
definition: enjoying great success at its highest point, flourishing while fortune keeps carrying you forward
example: Fresh from winning the regional final, the brass band was on the crest of a wave and played every street party in town.

hindi: ठीक समय पर — एकदम सही वक़्त
definition: exactly punctual, arriving precisely when promised without keeping anybody waiting
example: The milkman arrived at half past five on the dot, and the household set every other chore around him.

hindi: फ़ौरन — बिना देर
definition: very quickly and immediately, obeying an order without delay; American, from military drill
example: Grandma called that lunch was served, and the cousins came in from the yard on the double.

hindi: चुपके चुपके — गुप्त रूप से
definition: arranged quietly between trusted people, American phrase keeping matters hidden from gossip
example: They kept the engagement on the down low until both grandmothers could hear about it directly.

term: on the edge of your seat
hindi: साँस रोके बैठना — रोमांच से उत्सुक
definition: gripped by thrilling suspense, eagerly desperate to learn what happens next in a story
example: Grandad's tale of the storm at sea kept every grandchild on the edge of their seat until the final line.

hindi: हेराफेरी में लगा — चुपके से ठगी करना
definition: cheating dishonestly for money, quietly fiddling expenses, accounts, or payments, British usage
example: The club treasurer was on the fiddle for years, buying biscuits with funds meant for new nets.

term: on the flat of your back
hindi: बिस्तर पकड़ लेना — बीमारी से चारपाई पर पड़ जाना
definition: flattened completely in Irish usage, bedridden through serious illness or utter exhaustion
example: She spent February on the flat of her back with fever, and half the street called round carrying soup nobody had requested.

hindi: चलते-चलते — मौक़े पर ही
definition: done quickly while things are already moving, improvising changes instead of stopping to plan carefully first
example: Our map blew away, so we planned the rest of the road trip on the fly and found the loveliest village by accident.

hindi: आगे बढ़कर खेलना — पहल करके आत्मविश्वास से डटना
definition: in British English, from cricket: acting confidently and assertively, taking initiative rather than waiting defensively for trouble
example: This time Priya stayed on the front foot, calling the landlord about the leak before he could make excuses.

hindi: क्षितिज पर — आने वाला दिखाई देना
definition: becoming visible ahead, expected soon although still considerable distance away
example: With exams on the horizon, their mother quietly stopped inviting relatives and kept the study lamp burning until midnight.

hindi: फ़रार होना — पुलिस से छिपकर भागते रहना
definition: fleeing constantly from police pursuit, hiding across towns after committing serious wrongdoing
example: Grandfather loved retelling how their village barber went on the lam for stealing goats, then returned selling insurance.

hindi: सच्चा — ईमानदारी वाला
definition: honest and genuine, dealing fairly without trickery, hidden motives or deception
example: The offer sounded too generous, but the farmer was on the level and the calf he sold them thrived.

hindi: तबीयत सँभलना — धीरे-धीरे सेहत सुधरना
definition: steadily recovering from illness or injury, with health improving quietly after proper treatment
example: Three weeks after the surgery Nani was on the mend, scolding everyone about the salt again.

hindi: बिल्कुल सही — अनुमान एकदम ठीक बैठा
definition: exactly correct about details, matching reality closely enough that further argument stops
example: His guess about the wedding budget turned out completely on the money, which annoyed his brother more than being wrong would have.

hindi: किस्तों पर — धीरे-धीरे चुकाने वाला उधार
definition: British for buying goods on credit through hire purchase, paying slowly over many instalments later
example: Their first television came on the never-never, and the whole street crowded into the front room to watch the match.

hindi: मौज में होना — सब कुछ बढ़िया
definition: in Irish usage, comfortably prosperous and fortunate, living easily with plenty of money and contentment
example: With the farm sold and the grandchildren nearby, Seamus reckoned he was on the pig's back.

hindi: जोड़ी ढूँढने निकलना — शाम को साथी तलाशना
definition: actively seeking casual romantic partners during evening outings, British informal register
example: His flatmates went into town on the pull, while he stayed behind happily reheating leftover khichdi and watching cricket.

hindi: चुपके-चुपके — किसी को ख़बर किए बिना
definition: done quietly in secret, without telling anyone who might spread the news further
example: The neighbours organised the fence repair on the QT so the widow next door would wake to find it finished.

hindi: चुपके-चुपके — बिना किसी को बताए
definition: secretly and discreetly, arranged privately without telling anybody or attracting attention
example: Dad had been taking piano lessons on the quiet all winter, and played Mum's favourite song at her birthday.

hindi: टूटे दिल के सहारे — पुराने ग़म में नया रिश्ता
definition: starting fresh romance soon after painful breakup, seeking comfort while still hurting from former partner
example: Everyone worried she had married him on the rebound, but forty years later they still hold hands.

hindi: सेहत सुधरने की राह पर — धीरे-धीरे ठीक होना
definition: steadily regaining health after serious illness, improving gradually although still fragile
example: Three weeks after the surgery she was clearly on the road to recovery, walking the corridor twice each evening with her son.

hindi: रिश्ते में दरार — संबंध टूटने के कगार पर
definition: describing a romantic relationship failing badly, probably ending within coming months
example: Everyone guessed the marriage was on the rocks when they arrived separately at the reunion.

hindi: घुटनों पर आना — हार के कगार पर होना
definition: close to losing power completely, barely surviving against stronger opponents
example: The little bookshop was on the ropes until the neighbourhood started holding its poetry evenings there.

hindi: एक जैसी सोच — विचार मिलना
definition: understanding each other easily because you share similar thoughts, humour and feelings
example: The two grandmothers were on the same wavelength within minutes, finishing each other's stories about their naughty grandchildren.

hindi: चोरी-छिपे — लुक-छिपकर कोई काम करना
definition: sneakily and furtively, doing something forbidden while making sure nobody around notices
example: The children had been feeding the neighbour's cat on the sly, which explained why it now refused to go home.

hindi: हाथों-हाथ — मौके पर ही फ़ैसला कर देना
definition: deciding instantly, acting within moments while everyone present waits, giving immediate answer
example: The tailor measured the boy and, on the spot, promised the shirt would be ready before the festival.

hindi: रिश्वतखोर — नियमित घूस लेने वाला
definition: regularly accepting secret payment while holding official position, betraying honest public duty
example: Everybody suspected the inspector stayed on the take, which explained those three trucks parked nightly beside the closed weighbridge.

hindi: चढ़ाव पर — हालात सुधर रहे हैं
definition: steadily rising, improving circumstances where fortunes grow better each month, British usage
example: Things are on the up for the corner café, with a new awning and a regular crowd of students.

hindi: सच्चा और जायज़ — बिना धोखे के
definition: in American usage, genuinely legitimate and honest, dealing openly without scams or trickery
example: Grandma checked twice that the online knitting club was on the up and up before signing up for every class.

hindi: तलवारें खिंचना — किसी पर टूट पड़ने को तैयार
definition: angrily hunting for whoever caused trouble, determined to confront and punish the culprit
example: The principal was on the warpath about the missing trophy until the cleaner found it polished in the staffroom.

hindi: पतली बर्फ़ पर चलना — ज़रा-सी चूक से बड़ा नुकसान
definition: occupying risky position where slight mistakes bring serious trouble with immediate, harsh consequences
example: After two missed rehearsals the drummer knew he stood on thin ice, so he arrived an hour early with chai for everyone.

hindi: झुँझलाहट में बेकाबू — हार के बाद गलत फ़ैसले
definition: frustrated and angry after setbacks, playing recklessly because emotions have overtaken judgement, from poker
example: After losing three rounds of carrom he was on tilt, so his grandmother made him take a biscuit break.

hindi: जीत की राह पर — सफल चीज़ हाथ लगना
definition: having found something certain to succeed, whether plan, product or idea; British
example: When the whole street asked for seconds of his mango chutney, Uncle Ravi knew he was on to a winner.

hindi: पूरे रंग में — बेहतरीन फ़ॉर्म में
definition: performing at peak ability, showing your finest skill and energy, a British expression
example: Grandad was on top form at the wedding, telling jokes and dancing until the band packed up.

hindi: सातवें आसमान पर — ख़ुशी से भरपूर
definition: delighted, glowing with cheerful happiness because everything currently feels wonderfully successful and light
example: After the letter arrived she felt on top of the world, and spent the evening telephoning relatives who pretended surprise.

hindi: डूबने की कगार पर — लगभग कंगाल
definition: British nautical image for barely surviving, nearly destitute with almost no money left, close to capsizing
example: On his beam ends after the shop closed, Tom took a bus to his brother's, who simply handed him an apron and a spot at the stove.

hindi: आख़िरी साँसें गिनना — बिलकुल चुक जाना
definition: barely standing, close to collapse or death after exhaustion, illness, or long overuse
example: The village bus was on its last legs, wheezing up every slope while the driver patted the dashboard like an old horse.

hindi: दाने-दाने को मोहताज — बेहद तंगी में
definition: reduced to poverty, completely without money, wearing shoes and clothes worn beyond decent repair
example: Grandad was on his uppers that winter, yet he still brought jam whenever he visited us.

hindi: कभी हाँ कभी ना — टूटता-जुड़ता रिश्ता
definition: describing relationship repeatedly breaking apart then reuniting, never settling into lasting stability
example: Their on-again off-again romance kept the whole street guessing for three summers straight.

hindi: कभी-कभार — बहुत लंबे अंतराल पर होना
definition: happening extremely rarely, occurring perhaps once across several years instead of regularly
example: Once in a blue moon the cousins reach the same city together, and nobody sleeps before three.

hindi: जीवन में एक बार — दोबारा न मिलने वाला मौका
definition: happening only once across an entire life, most unlikely ever coming round again
example: She called the scholarship letter a once in a lifetime thing and framed it beside her grandmother's photograph.

hindi: एक पैर क़ब्र में होना — मौत के बेहद क़रीब
definition: extremely frail and close to dying, weakened by serious illness or advancing years
example: With one foot in the grave, said Uncle at eighty, before climbing onto the roof.

hindi: लाखों में एक — बेहद विरला
definition: rare person or chance appearing seldom among enormous numbers, remarkably exceptional
example: The old tailor stitched the torn sherwani overnight and refused payment, which his neighbours agreed made him one in a million.

hindi: अपनी तरह का अकेला — बेजोड़
definition: utterly unique, having nothing comparable anywhere, unmatched among everything otherwise similar
example: Her father's hand-painted trunk was one of a kind, and every child in the family wanted it eventually.

hindi: घर का ही आदमी — परिवार जैसा अपनापन
definition: accepted with warmth into household belonging, treated exactly like relatives rather than visiting guest
example: By the second monsoon the lodger was one of the family, arguing about cricket and knowing where the spare keys hung.

term: one sandwich short of a picnic
hindi: अक्ल से पैदल — बुद्धि में कमज़ोर
definition: describes a person lacking intelligence, foolish and slow about ordinary everyday matters
example: He tried to defrost the chicken with a hairdryer, and his sister decided he was one sandwich short of a picnic.

hindi: जो हाथ से निकल गया — अधूरा प्यार
definition: former partner or missed romance you still wonder about, regretting what might have been
example: Whenever that song came on the radio, Dad would go quiet, and Mum would tease him about the one that got away.

hindi: एक क़दम आगे — बढ़त बनाए हुए
definition: holding a slight advantage over someone, having done something they have not yet managed
example: Having learned to whistle before her cousin, Maya felt one up on him for the entire summer holiday.

hindi: एकतरफ़ा मुक़ाबला — जिसमें जीत पहले से तय
definition: contest so uneven that victory looks certain, with only a single competitor standing any real chance
example: Once Ishaan's tortoise refused to move, the backyard pet race became a one-horse race won by the family spaniel.

hindi: दोहरी मार — एक के बाद एक दो झटके
definition: pair of forceful blows or events arriving quickly together, doubling their combined effect
example: Rain followed by a power cut was a one-two punch for the picnic, so the cousins played cards by candlelight instead.

hindi: बस एक ही दिखना — किसी और पर नज़र न जाना
definition: feel romantic attention fixed entirely upon somebody, noticing nobody else present
example: The hall was full of cousins in silk, but he only had eyes for the woman arranging marigolds near the door.

hindi: बर्रे के छत्ते में हाथ डालना — नई उलझनें खोल देना
definition: triggering complicated hidden troubles, creating messy situation growing beyond original harmless innocent question
example: Asking gently about the missing photograph opened a can of worms that occupied three aunts until midnight.

hindi: खुली किताब — जिसके मन में कुछ छिपा न हो
definition: person whose thoughts remain completely visible, hiding nothing from watching friends
example: Their youngest cousin is an open book, announcing every secret plan before anybody thinks about asking.

hindi: हाथ आया मौका — जिसे चूकना नामुमकिन हो
definition: opportunity so simple that missing would seem almost impossible, British football phrase
example: When the interviewer asked about his favourite hobby, it was an open goal, and he talked about birds happily for ten minutes.

hindi: खुला दरवाज़ा — जहाँ कोई भी बेझिझक आ सके
definition: household welcoming every visitor freely, keeping doors unlocked for casual arriving guests
example: Their grandmother kept open house every Sunday, so lunch was never for six people and somehow never ran short either.

hindi: खुला भेद — छिपी बात जो सबको मालूम
definition: widely known private matter everybody discusses quietly although nobody announces publicly
example: Their engagement stayed an open secret through Diwali, discussed over every plate of ladoo and denied at every doorway.

hindi: आँखें खोलना — सच्चाई दिखाना
definition: make somebody suddenly realise and understand a truth they had never noticed before
example: Volunteering at the shelter opened her eyes to how many families in her own town went hungry.

hindi: पहली पेशकश — असली आकर्षण से पहले
definition: smaller performance appearing before main attraction, warming audience while nearly nobody remembers afterwards
example: Their band spent three summers as the opening act, playing beautifully to people still queueing outside.

hindi: पहली चाल — शुरुआत में फ़ायदे का दाँव
definition: calculated first move in a negotiation or conversation, designed to gain an early advantage
example: His opening gambit at the parents' meeting was a tin of homemade cookies, and the teacher laughed before he said a word.

hindi: घरवाला या घरवाली — जीवनसाथी
definition: your husband, wife or partner, the person completing your life together, mostly British usage
example: She said she would check with her other half before agreeing to host Christmas for all fourteen cousins.

hindi: दूसरी मार का इंतज़ार — अगली बुरी ख़बर का डर
definition: anxiously waiting for trouble expected next, certain further unwelcome news must follow soon
example: After the flood came a storm warning, and the family sat waiting for the other shoe to drop, then laughed when the sun came out instead.

hindi: कोहनी से फटा कोट — गरीबी की निशानी
definition: wearing threadbare clothing worn through, showing poverty despite respectable earlier circumstances
example: Uncle arrived out at the elbows but insisted on paying for everybody's tea, which nobody had the heart to refuse.

hindi: चारों ख़ाने चित — पूरी तरह पस्त
definition: defeated and finished, from boxing, unable to recover from a final crushing blow; also deeply asleep
example: After the wedding dancing, Uncle Ravi was out for the count on the sofa, still wearing his sparkly tie.

hindi: किसी अनजान पिछड़े कोने में — नक़्शे से बाहर
definition: somewhere extremely remote in mocking Australian usage, distant, unfashionable, barely worth visiting
example: He grumbled about being posted out in Woop Woop until the neighbours arrived with mangoes and stayed until midnight.

hindi: पलक झपकते सो जाना — गहरी नींद में गुम
definition: falling asleep instantly, tired body sleeping deeply seconds after reaching comfortable bedtime pillow
example: The toddler was out like a light halfway through the story, still clutching the wooden elephant.

hindi: कहीं से भी अचानक — बिल्कुल अनपेक्षित बात
definition: arriving suddenly from unexpected direction, surprising everyone with something completely unrelated
example: The question about her childhood dreams came out of left field, and she laughed before answering honestly.

hindi: तबीयत ढीली होना — मन और देह दोनों बेमन
definition: mildly unhappy, gloomy mood mixed with slight illness, neither cheerful nor properly comfortable within yourself
example: Amma was out of sorts all afternoon, so nobody argued when she declared the evening belonged to blankets and old radio songs.

hindi: शहर से बाहर — घर पर न होना
definition: meaning away travelling from your home town, temporarily unavailable until returning later, as said in Indian English
example: Papa is out of station till Friday, so the landlord will have to settle for Mummy's very firm handshake instead.

hindi: सिलेबस से बाहर — जिसकी तैयारी ही न हो
definition: describing anything unexpected beyond what someone prepared, like examination questions outside assigned chapters, as said in Indian English
example: When his daughter asked where babies come from, the young father decided that question was completely out of syllabus and called his wife.

hindi: नूह के ज़माने का — बेहद पुराना
definition: comically outdated, British phrase describing something everybody considers absurdly antiquated
example: The scooter looked out of the ark, though it still carried three brothers and a tiffin box uphill every morning.

hindi: अचानक बिन बुलाए — कहीं से टपक पड़ना
definition: happening suddenly without warning, surprising everybody because nothing suggested beforehand
example: Out of the blue, her college roommate rang after eleven years and asked whether the tamarind tree still stood.

hindi: आसमान से गिरे खजूर में अटके — एक मुसीबत से बड़ी मुसीबत
definition: escaping serious trouble while landing somewhere considerably worse, exchanging difficulty for greater immediate danger, usually 'out of the frying pan into the fire'
example: Leaving the leaking room for his cousin's noisy terrace took him out of the frying pan into the fire, cheerfully.

hindi: ख़बर से बाहर — अनजान रखा जाना
definition: uninformed and excluded, lacking insider information others share about private plans
example: Being out of the loop, Dad was the only one genuinely surprised when the whole family arrived for his birthday.

hindi: दौड़ से बाहर — जीत की कोई गुंजाइश नहीं
definition: having no remaining chance of winning, eliminated from contention while others continue competing
example: Our pumpkin was out of the running once we saw the giant one from the next village.

hindi: खतरे से बाहर होना — संकट का दौर बीत जाना
definition: past the dangerous stage of illness and recovering, although complete health still lies ahead
example: The doctor said she was out of the woods, and the whole waiting room exhaled together.

hindi: गहरे पानी में — मुश्किल जो बस से बाहर
definition: caught within serious trouble beyond your abilities, unable handling worsening difficulty alone, also 'in deep water'
example: Two missed payments and a broken tractor later, Baba admitted he was out of his depth and telephoned his uncle.

hindi: दिमाग़ ठिकाने नहीं — बेतुका बरताव करना
definition: behaving wildly in Irish usage, talking nonsense nobody sensible would believe
example: You would think he was out of his tree, swimming in November, but he came out grinning and swore it cured everything.

hindi: अकेले जोखिम में — बिना सहारे टहनी पर
definition: stranded alone holding risky position nobody else supports, exposed without helpful allies
example: She went out on a limb defending the new schedule, and stood there quietly until two colleagues joined her.

hindi: खड़े-खड़े हारा हुआ — बस नाम का खड़ा
definition: completely beaten and exhausted yet still standing, unable to continue struggling, from boxing
example: By the last mile of the marathon he was out on his feet, but the crowd cheered him home.

hindi: खोया-खोया — ध्यान कहीं और
definition: mentally absent and inattentive, missing obvious things happening right around you, often dreamily
example: After three nights with the new baby, Dad was so out to lunch he poured orange juice onto his cornflakes.

hindi: बोल भी दो — अब कह डालो
definition: urging someone hesitating nervously to finally reveal whatever truth they keep holding back
example: Her grandmother put down her knitting and said, 'Out with it, child, who is this boy you keep smiling about?'

hindi: गुस्से की मशीन — रोज़ नया बवाल, वही मुनाफ़ा
definition: arrangement of accounts feeding constant public anger, harvesting attention from furious strangers
example: Her uncle deleted three applications, called the outrage machine exhausting, and joined the morning walking group instead.

hindi: हल्की सी उम्मीद — मुश्किल से मुमकिन
definition: slight but genuine chance of success, unlikely though still possible under lucky circumstances
example: There's an outside chance the rain clears by noon, so Grandpa packed the picnic basket just in case.

hindi: किसी के रहम पर होना — मजबूर होना
definition: completely at someone else's mercy, forced to accept whatever terms they choose
example: The only mechanic for fifty miles had us over a barrel, though he charged fairly and threw in a thermos of tea.

hindi: ढलान पर — बेहतरीन दिन बीत चुके
definition: an American phrase describing somebody past their strongest years, ability quietly declining beyond earlier peak
example: They teased Dad about being over the hill until he beat every grandchild across the swimming pool.

hindi: बाग़-बाग़ हो जाना — बेहद ख़ुश
definition: completely delighted about welcome news, unable to stop smiling before everyone
example: Grandfather was over the moon when the letter arrived, and read it aloud to the milkman as well.

hindi: सिर के ऊपर से निकल जाना — बात समझ में ही न आना
definition: beyond someone's understanding, leaving an ordinary listener confused about a situation full of difficult ideas
example: The lecture on quantum spin went cheerfully over my head, though the biscuits were excellent.

hindi: रातोंरात कामयाबी — अचानक मिली शोहरत
definition: sudden fame appearing instant, though usually hiding years of unseen struggle and effort
example: Everyone called the author an overnight success, never knowing about the twelve rejected manuscripts under her bed.

hindi: अपने ही पैर पर कुल्हाड़ी — अपनी चाल अपने खिलाफ
definition: careless action damaging nobody except yourself, harming your position through avoidable mistake
example: Announcing the surprise party inside the family group chat was a spectacular own goal.

hindi: महफ़िल लूट लेना — मौजूदगी भर से सबका ध्यान खींच लेना
definition: command everybody's attention immediately through presence alone, steering surrounding conversation without raising volume
example: Her father barely spoke twenty sentences all evening, yet somehow owned the room from beside the samosa tray.

hindi: मुँह फुलाकर बैठ जाना — रूठ जाना
definition: lose temper quietly, sulking childishly after minor setback, said across New Zealand
example: The toddler packed a sad about wearing gumboots, then wore them indoors proudly for the rest of the weekend.

hindi: बोरिया-बिस्तर बाँधना — काम छोड़कर चल देना
definition: abandon an activity completely, leaving the unfinished work behind without further regret
example: After the fourth burnt batch of caramel, Nadia packed it in, opened the window, and ordered dessert instead.

hindi: झूठ का पुलिंदा — शुरू से आख़िर तक गढ़ी कहानी
definition: story built entirely from deliberate falsehoods without single truthful detail anywhere inside
example: Her brother's account of the missing sweets grew longer with every question until it stood exposed as a pack of lies.

hindi: भेड़-बकरियों की तरह ठुँसे हुए — बहुत भीड़ में दबे हुए
definition: crowded tightly together inside narrow space, pressed against everybody standing around
example: Fourteen relatives packed like sardines onto one sofa for the photograph, and nobody moved until the flash finally worked.

hindi: अपनी नाव खुद खेना — अपने काम खुद निपटाना
definition: manage personal affairs independently, without help, advice, or interference from other people
example: Grandmother sold her jewellery, bought a sewing machine, and paddled her own canoe for forty years without ever asking anybody for anything.

hindi: तस्वीर खींचना — बातों से दृश्य समझाना
definition: describe something so vividly and clearly that listeners easily imagine and understand it
example: The old sailor painted such a picture of the stormy night that the children pulled their blankets tighter.

hindi: जश्न मनाना — रात भर मौज-मस्ती
definition: celebrate noisily, going partying from place to place late into the night
example: The night their exam results came out, the whole hostel floor painted the town red, ending up eating kebabs at dawn.

hindi: अपने ही जाल में फँसना — ख़ुद बनाई मुश्किल
definition: become trapped by your own earlier choices, leaving no graceful route out of the situation you created
example: Having promised everyone a spare bedroom, he had painted himself into a corner and slept happily on the sofa all week.

hindi: पैसा वसूल — पूरी क़ीमत का मज़ा
definition: describing something giving full value, well worth every rupee spent on enjoying it, as said in Indian English
example: The film was three hours long with six songs and a train fight, and Dadaji declared it completely paisa vasool.

hindi: अंदरूनी तख़्तापलट — घर के भीतर से सत्ता छीनना
definition: sudden seizure of power by insiders, removing a leader from within rather than outside
example: There was a palace coup in the kitchen when the teenagers took over Sunday lunch and banished Dad to the sofa.

hindi: भूत जैसा पीला — डर से चेहरा बेरंग होना
definition: colourless frightened appearance suggesting terrible shock, leaving somebody looking bloodless and slightly unsteady
example: He stepped off the roller coaster pale as a ghost, insisting cheerfully that he wanted another turn.

hindi: मुसीबतों का पिटारा — खोलते ही आफ़तें
definition: source of countless unforeseen troubles, released once someone starts meddling, from Greek myth
example: Asking who had eaten the last biscuit opened a Pandora's box of family grievances dating back to 1998.

hindi: दरारों पर कागज़ चिपकाना — दोष छिपाकर ठीक दिखाना
definition: conceal serious underlying damage cosmetically, treating appearance instead repairing genuine broken structure
example: They papered over the cracks before the guests arrived, and only the uncle who tapped walls noticed anything.

hindi: कागज़ी शेर — डरावना दिखने वाला कमज़ोर
definition: threatening surface appearance covering real weakness, frightening nobody once somebody actually tests substance
example: The landlord's eviction notices turned out to be a paper tiger, and the tenants stayed another eleven years.

hindi: दरार पर पुताई — असली खराबी ऊपर से ढँकना
definition: hiding serious underlying problems with temporary cosmetic repair that solves absolutely nothing
example: Fresh paint before the inspection was papering over the cracks, and everyone avoided leaning against that wall.

hindi: रोज़ का क़िस्सा — उम्मीद के मुताबिक़
definition: exactly what you would expect, normal and typical however disappointing, from golf scoring
example: Muddy boots in the hallway were par for the course during football season, so Mum just laid down more newspaper.

hindi: तोते की तरह रटना — बिना समझे दोहराना
definition: repeat memorised words mechanically, British phrase describing reciting without understanding anything
example: He recited the safety rules parrot fashion, then asked which button actually stopped the machine.

hindi: घर का पुराना सामान — इतना पुराना कि किसी का ध्यान नहीं जाता
definition: somebody present so long they belong completely, comfortable familiar fixture nobody consciously notices anymore
example: After nineteen winters the old caretaker was part of the furniture, and the students greeted him before greeting each other.

hindi: राहें जुदा होना — अलग-अलग रास्ते चुनना
definition: point where people separate and follow different paths after sharing something together for years
example: University brought a gentle parting of the ways for the three school friends, though they still share every birthday.

hindi: हमराज़ साथी — शरारतों का साथी
definition: close friend who joins your harmless mischief, schemes and adventures, always ready together
example: My sister was my partner in crime every summer, sneaking extra mangoes from the fridge while the grown-ups napped.

hindi: जाँच में पास होना — मानक पर खरा उतरना
definition: satisfy inspection, judged good enough against the required standard expected
example: His handwritten thank-you card passed muster with his grandmother, who kept it propped beside her tea tin.

hindi: ज़िम्मेदारी की मशाल सौंपना
definition: hand leadership or responsibility over to someone else, especially a younger successor
example: After thirty years at the dhaba stove, Baba passed the baton to his daughter, then hovered nearby tasting everything.

hindi: ठीकरा दूसरे के सिर फोड़ना — ज़िम्मेदारी दूसरे पर डालना
definition: shifting responsibility toward other people, avoiding work that properly belongs with yourself
example: The form travelled from window seven back to window three; everybody passed the buck beautifully.

hindi: चंदा इकट्ठा करना — सबसे मदद जुटाना
definition: collect money informally from people gathered together, asking everyone present to help someone needing it
example: When the drummer's van was stolen, the pub passed the hat and raised enough by closing time to rent him another.

hindi: ज़िम्मेदारी इधर-उधर सरकाना — टालते रहना
definition: passing responsibility endlessly between people, everyone avoiding the problem and nobody finally dealing with it; British
example: The broken swing played pass the parcel between three committees until the grandparents simply mended it themselves.

hindi: परख में खरा उतरना — पहली नज़र में सही लगना
definition: seem honest or believable on first inspection, surviving initial doubt; American English also says smell test
example: The charity's plan passed the sniff test with the village elders, who then helped raise twice the money asked.

hindi: अव्वल दर्जे से पास होना — शानदार सफलता पाना
definition: succeed brilliantly in examinations, finishing well above every expected standard
example: Sunita passed her driving test with flying colours and drove her father home very slowly, grinning.

hindi: दिन लद जाना — उपयोगिता चुक जाने के बाद भी बचा रह जाना
definition: stale and unwanted, having outlived whatever usefulness once made something worth keeping
example: He said his cricket bat was past its sell-by date, then scored forty runs with it at the Sunday match.

hindi: शाबाशी — काम की सराहना
definition: small gesture of approval, words of praise given because somebody's effort deserves recognition
example: After the difficult first week, a pat on the back from the head nurse meant more to him than any bonus.

hindi: सुलह करना — रिश्ते की मरम्मत
definition: repair a damaged friendship after a quarrel, restoring peace between both people again
example: The two old friends patched things up over a plate of samosas at the same cafe where they had fallen out.

hindi: सबसे आसान रास्ता — मेहनत से बचने वाला तरीक़ा
definition: easiest course available, chosen because it avoids effort, difficulty or confrontation with others
example: Taking the path of least resistance, the kids agreed to pizza again, and the argument ended before it began.

hindi: अय्यूब जैसा धैर्य — घोर दुख में भी शांति
definition: extraordinary endurance shown during prolonged suffering, never complaining about unfair hardship
example: Teaching forty restless children through three broken fans took the patience of Job, which she somehow found daily.

hindi: रास्ता बनाना — आगे के लिए ज़मीन तैयार करना
definition: prepare conditions carefully beforehand, making later progress easier for somebody following behind
example: Her aunt paved the way years earlier, arguing with relatives until studying abroad stopped sounding scandalous.

hindi: मोहरा बनना — दूसरों के हाथ की कठपुतली
definition: person manipulated and used by more powerful players pursuing private schemes, holding little control themselves
example: Little Tara realised she'd been a pawn in the game when her brothers sent her to ask Dad for the car keys.

hindi: ज़ुबानी जमाख़र्च — सिर्फ़ कहने भर को मानना
definition: pretend support through words alone, while actions secretly show little genuine intention
example: He paid lip service to the family diet, then quietly kept a packet of samosas in the glovebox.

hindi: किए की कीमत चुकाना — पुरानी लापरवाही का हिसाब
definition: accept delayed consequences finally arriving, paying heavily afterwards through earlier reckless borrowed enjoyment
example: Three festival weekends of borrowed money were lovely, and paying the piper arrived quietly with January's electricity bill.

hindi: कीमत चुकानी पड़ती है — नतीजा भुगतना
definition: suffer painful consequences later, punished eventually because earlier choices proved reckless
example: He skipped every practice through summer and paid the price during the very first match.

hindi: मुँहमाँगी कीमत चुकाना — मजबूरी में हद से ज़्यादा दाम देना
definition: hand over an outrageously expensive amount, usually because paying elsewhere remains impossible
example: We forgot to book early and paid through the nose for the last two seats.

hindi: अपना हिस्सा चुकाना — संघर्ष के दिन काटना
definition: endure hard experience and humble work before gaining respect, success or recognition
example: She paid her dues playing half-empty pubs for a decade, so the sold-out night felt earned.

hindi: महीने-दर-महीने गुज़ारा — बचत के बिना जीना
