definition: talk too much and too carelessly, often saying things better left unsaid; chiefly American English
example: Nervous at the wedding, the best man ran off at the mouth and told the story he had promised never to tell.

hindi: दम टूट जाना — ऊर्जा ख़त्म हो जाना
definition: an American phrase meaning strength declining midway, ability finished before reaching intended destination
example: The choir ran out of gas somewhere during the fourth encore, laughing through the final wobbly chorus.

hindi: वक़्त पूरा करना — समय ख़त्म होने तक बात खींचते रहना
definition: deliberately delaying until remaining time expires, stalling rather than taking action
example: The children ran out the clock at bedtime with water, questions about dinosaurs, and one urgent story that could absolutely not wait.

hindi: उँगलियों पर नचाना — बहुत आसानी से मात देना
definition: defeat rivals in a contest so completely that the result never looks close
example: Grandfather still runs rings around us at carrom, laughing between every impossible shot.

hindi: डर के मारे भागना — घबराकर पीछे हटना
definition: backing away in panic, courage failing because some rival or threat seems overwhelming
example: The corner shop never ran scared of the new supermarket; it simply kept knowing every customer by name.

hindi: कोड़ों की क़तार से गुज़रना — चारों तरफ़ से ताने सुनते हुए निकलना
definition: endure hostile criticism from crowds lining your path, suffering repeated attacks throughout the whole passage
example: Carrying his failed report card, he ran the gauntlet of relatives between the gate and his own bedroom door.

hindi: गाड़ी अपने हिसाब से चलाना — सारा इंतज़ाम अपने हाथ में रखना
definition: control every important daily decision, deciding what other people must follow
example: The head chef was on holiday, so the twenty-two-year-old sous chef ran the show for a fortnight.

hindi: बेलगाम होना — बिना रोक-टोक मनमाना बर्ताव
definition: behave with complete freedom, without restriction, discipline, or supervision from anyone
example: For three weeks of holidays the cousins ran wild through the mango grove, returning only when hunger and mosquitoes drove them indoors.

hindi: बकबक करना — बिना सोचे सब बोल देना
definition: repeat private gossip carelessly, talking about others without considering damage caused afterwards
example: He ran his mouth about the engagement before the couple had told either family, and spent weeks apologising.

hindi: थककर चूर होना — भाग-दौड़ में पस्त
definition: exhaust yourself completely through endless rushing around, leaving yourself tired and frayed
example: She had run herself ragged planning her son's birthday, so her friends turned up early and sent her to sit in the garden.

hindi: लगातार चलती लड़ाई — पुराना सिलसिलेवार झगड़ा
definition: long continuing quarrel that flares repeatedly over months, neither side ever quite winning
example: Dad has fought a running battle with the squirrels over the bird feeder for three summers now.

hindi: फिरकी की तरह चलना — बिल्कुल सधी हुई चाल
definition: working smoothly without trouble, steady performance continuing exactly like properly maintained machinery
example: Grandfather's scooter was still running like a top, and he refused every offer of something newer.

hindi: दम टूटने पर भी खटना — ताक़त ख़त्म, काम जारी
definition: continuing to function while completely exhausted, energy reserves already spent entirely
example: With a newborn and a toddler, they were running on empty, so the neighbours organised a dinner rota for a fortnight.

hindi: आख़िरी साँस पर चलना — बची-खुची ताकत से काम चलाना
definition: continuing while exhausted, strength nearly finished, moving forward only slightly before collapse becomes certain
example: By the fourth day of the festival kitchen the volunteers were running on fumes, stirring pots and laughing at nothing.

hindi: उतावली में काम बिगाड़ना — धैर्य वाले काम में हड़बड़ी
definition: hurrying something that needs patience, starting before careful preparations properly finish
example: Don't rush your fences with the sourdough; the starter needs another quiet night on the windowsill.

hindi: साँस लेने की फ़ुर्सत नहीं — बेहद व्यस्त
definition: extremely busy, hurrying constantly with barely a moment to stop and sit down; British informal
example: The café was rushed off its feet on the first sunny Saturday, yet Maria still found time to draw hearts on every latte.

hindi: सास-बहू ड्रामा — घरेलू नाटकबाज़ी
definition: used for exaggerated melodramatic family quarrels, named after television serials about mothers-in-law, as said in Indian English
example: A missing ladle turned into full saas-bahu drama until Bhabhi found it inside the pressure cooker, and everyone laughed.

hindi: खुलेआम पश्चाताप का दिखावा — ग़लती पर ज़ोर-शोर से अफ़सोस जताना
definition: public display of deep remorse and humble repentance for something wrong, often exaggerated for effect
example: No need for sackcloth and ashes over the burnt cake, said Mum, scraping off the top and serving it with extra cream.

hindi: मनहूस-सा इंसान — हमेशा उदास, बेचारा
definition: gloomy, hapless person who always seems miserable and rarely manages anything cheerful, mostly heard in American English
example: He called himself a sad sack after the breakup, so his friends kidnapped him for a weekend of fishing and bad jokes.

hindi: पक्की बात — जिसमें हारने का डर नहीं
definition: choice almost certain to succeed, carrying very little genuine risk worth worrying about
example: Ordering extra rasgullas was always a safe bet at family gatherings, because even the fussiest cousins finished their plates.

hindi: भरोसे के हाथ — काम सौंपकर निश्चिंत
definition: thoroughly dependable person trusted with important responsibility, steady, reliable, never dropping anything crucial
example: They handed her the accounts because she was a safe pair of hands, and slept better than they had all year.

hindi: सुरक्षा जाल — गिरने पर बचा लेने वाला सहारा
definition: arrangement kept in reserve, protecting someone against sudden hardship or complete failure
example: He quit the bank to paint, knowing his brother's spare room was the safety net beneath him.

hindi: ख़तरे की हद तक जाना
definition: behave riskily, coming dangerously near breaking rules or causing trouble without quite crossing
example: The comedian sailed close to the wind with his jokes about the mayor, who laughed loudest of all.

hindi: झूठा भेस धरना — पहचान छिपाकर चलना
definition: operating behind borrowed identity, hiding hostile intentions beneath harmless friendly outward appearance
example: He sailed under false colours through three weddings before somebody recognised him from the missing bicycle poster.

hindi: जवानी के दिन — बेफ़िक्री का शुरुआती दौर
definition: youthful carefree early years remembered fondly, before heavy responsibility arrived
example: In her salad days she shared one room with four girls, and still calls that year the happiest.

hindi: नेक इंसान — सीधा-सादा और भरोसेमंद व्यक्ति
definition: honest, reliable, unpretentious people whose decency, kindness, kept promises earn lasting trust
example: The couple running the corner bakery remembered every child's birthday: salt of the earth, everybody agreed.

hindi: वही ढाक के तीन पात — हर बार वही किस्सा
definition: familiar tiresome situation repeating again predictably, disappointing everybody exactly like before
example: Late buses and full seats, the same old story, so the neighbours shared an autorickshaw and laughed about it.

hindi: हूबहू — बिलकुल एक जैसा
definition: meaning exactly identical, matching another thing completely down to every small detail, as said in Indian English
example: The little girl had copied her grandmother's rangoli same to same, right down to the wobbly petal in the corner.

hindi: बुरे दिनों के लिए जोड़ना — मुश्किल वक्त के वास्ते बचत करना
definition: keep money quietly in reserve, protecting yourself against harder times arriving later
example: Every month she folded two notes into the tin behind the rice, saving for a rainy day nobody wanted to name.

hindi: ऐन मौक़े पर बच जाना — घंटी ने बचा लिया
definition: rescued from trouble at the last possible moment by a timely interruption, like a boxer when the round finishes
example: Halfway through his fumbled excuse to the teacher, the fire drill rang and Kabir was saved by the bell.

hindi: सीना ठोककर कहना — पूरे आत्मविश्वास से बोलना
definition: voice an honest opinion openly and confidently, owning every word instead of hedging nervously
example: If you think pineapple belongs on pizza, her roommate grinned, then say it with your chest.

hindi: बस, समझ गया — आगे कहने की ज़रूरत नहीं
definition: cheerful reply showing complete understanding, sparing someone the awkwardness of explaining further
example: I need the car Saturday, it's our anniversary, began Vikram, and his brother tossed him the keys: say no more.

term: say the quiet part out loud
hindi: मन की बात मुँह पर आ जाना — जो सब सोचते थे वही बोल देना
definition: state openly the embarrassing truth everybody understood although nobody intended mentioning
example: The youngest cousin said the quiet part out loud about who really cooked lunch, and three aunts suddenly needed water.

hindi: अपनी बात कह डालना — मन का कह देना
definition: state your honest opinion openly and fully, usually once, before letting others decide
example: Uncle Raj said his piece about the wedding venue, then happily danced at the one they chose anyway.

hindi: आँखों से पर्दा हटना — सच दिखाई देना
definition: suddenly understand clearly a truth that you were previously blind to or had refused to believe
example: When she found the letters in the drawer, the scales fell from her eyes and she saw why he was always late.

hindi: होश उड़ जाना — बेहद डर जाना
definition: frightened so badly that all sense and reason desert you completely for a moment
example: The kids were scared out of their wits when the garden gnome's eyes lit up, until Dad owned up to the batteries.

hindi: डर से सुन्न हो जाना — बुरी तरह डरना
definition: so terrified that your body freezes, unable to move, think clearly or respond
example: She was scared stiff on the high diving board, but her little brother's cheering from the pool finally coaxed her off the edge.

hindi: ज़िंदगी की पाठशाला — ठोकरों से सीखना
definition: practical education gained through struggle, poverty and hardship rather than formal study
example: Grandpa never finished school, but the school of hard knocks taught him to fix anything and never to waste a kindness.

hindi: सारी बाज़ी जीत लेना
definition: claim everything available, taking every prize or reward in one sweeping success; British
example: The village choir scooped the pool at the festival, carrying home every trophy on the bus.

hindi: नीचा दिखाकर वाहवाही लूटना — बहस में चतुराई से मात देना
definition: make clever remarks in an argument mainly to embarrass an opponent rather than reach truth; chiefly British English
example: The brothers spent dinner scoring points off each other until their mother reminded them it was Grandpa's birthday.

hindi: पक्का वादा — ईमान से
definition: playful solemn promise that every word spoken is truthful, sworn upon personal honour
example: 'Scout's honour, I only ate one laddoo,' said Grandpa, crumbs still clinging to his cardigan.

hindi: मुश्किल से रोज़ी कमाना
definition: manage with little, surviving upon small earnings from whatever work happens to become available
example: He scraped a living mending bicycles, and half the village learned to ride on his repairs.

hindi: ऊपर-ऊपर देखना — गहराई तक नहीं पहुँचना
definition: examine only shallow outer portion, missing larger complicated problem lying underneath
example: Their weekend cleaning barely scratched the surface, because every cupboard opened onto another decade of saved carrier bags.

hindi: सिर खुजाना — उलझन में पड़ जाना
definition: feel puzzled and confused, unable to understand something that makes little obvious sense
example: The recipe called for two cups of flour and then, four lines later, none at all; Meera scratched her head.

hindi: हिम्मत जुटाना — डर पर क़ाबू पाना
definition: forcing yourself past fear, gathering courage deliberately before doing something daunting
example: He screwed up his courage and asked her to dance, and forty years later they still waltz in the kitchen.

hindi: पेट काटकर बचाना — कम खर्च कर जोड़ना
definition: spend money sparingly and hoard small amounts, refusing ordinary comforts to build modest savings
example: Mum scrimped and saved for years, and the piano that arrived was worth every skipped holiday.

hindi: नहा-धोकर पहचान बदल जाना — तैयार होते ही रूप निखर आना
definition: said mainly across British households: transforming surprisingly handsome once washed, dressed properly beyond weekday scruffiness
example: His sister laughed that farmhands scrub up well, then straightened his collar twice before the photographer noticed anything.

hindi: मंसूबे डुबो देना — काम शुरू होने से पहले ख़त्म
definition: sinking somebody's arrangements in British usage, ruining plans before they ever sail
example: A single missing signature scuppered their plans, so they spent the afternoon feeding ducks instead.

hindi: कायापलट — पूरा बदलाव
definition: profound dramatic transformation, shifting attitudes completely so nothing afterwards remains quite the same
example: There was a sea change in the team once the new captain started learning everyone's names and birthdays.

hindi: मुझसे मत पूछो — मुझे कोई ख़बर नहीं
definition: casual reply to a question, admitting you have absolutely no idea what happened or where something went
example: Who ate the last samosa? Search me — I was asleep on the sofa the whole afternoon.

hindi: आदत में शुमार होना — बिना सोचे सहज हो जाना
definition: behaviour performed easily, automatically, without thinking, effort, conscious attention, following years repeated practice
example: Checking the stove twice before leaving became second nature after that winter kitchen fire.

hindi: लासानी — जिसका कोई सानी नहीं
definition: better in quality than everyone else, ranked above every rival within the group
example: The old baker's morning bread was second to none, and the queue proved it daily.

hindi: नई ऊर्जा का संचार — थकान के बाद दोबारा जोश आना
definition: renewed energy that lets somebody continue a difficult effort after exhaustion nearly stopped them
example: Twenty kilometres into the walk her legs were gone, then the smell of pine hit and she found a second wind.

hindi: माल पक्का करना — अच्छी कमाई हासिल करना
definition: modern internet slang for successfully obtaining money, especially landing well-paid work, deals or contracts
example: After three nervous interviews, Rohan finally secured the bag and called his mother before anybody else.

hindi: एक राय होना — सोच में पूरी सहमति
definition: reach complete agreement with somebody, sharing similar opinions instead of arguing about differences
example: The sisters rarely saw eye to eye about music, though both agreed the neighbours played theirs far too loudly.

hindi: अंत तक निभाना — शुरू किया काम पूरा करके ही छोड़ना
definition: continue a difficult commitment until the finish, refusing to quit partway through
example: He promised his grandmother he would finish the boat they started together, and he saw it through, plank by crooked plank.

hindi: खून खौलना — गुस्से में अंधा हो जाना
definition: become instantly furious, losing clear judgement when blinding anger overwhelms reason
example: She usually stays gentle, but she saw red when the boys started throwing stones at the street dogs.

hindi: किसी की चाल भाँप लेना — नीयत पहचान लेना
definition: instantly recognise a person's hidden motives or deception, however cleverly they pretend otherwise
example: The toddler insisted his sister broke the vase, but his mother saw right through him and his chocolate-smeared grin.

hindi: आँख खुलना — उलझन के बाद अचानक सच दिख जाना
definition: suddenly understands truth after confusion, realizing something obvious that stayed puzzling before
example: After the third burnt batch, she finally saw the light and lowered the oven temperature.

term: see the wood for the trees
hindi: बड़ी तस्वीर देख पाना — ब्योरों में न उलझना
definition: understand the overall situation clearly instead of becoming lost among small confusing details, said in British English
example: Buried in seating charts and napkin colours, the bride could not see the wood for the trees until her father reminded her why they were celebrating.

term: see which way the wind blows
hindi: हवा का रुख़ भाँपना — माहौल समझकर चलना
definition: understand how opinions or circumstances are developing before deciding what action to take
example: Before asking for the car keys, the teenager watched his father over breakfast to see which way the wind was blowing.

hindi: नाम रोशन होना — शोहरत पाना
definition: achieve public fame and recognition, seeing yourself celebrated prominently where everyone notices
example: As a girl she practised bows in the mirror, dreaming of seeing her name in lights above the town theatre.

hindi: आज का दिन जी लेना — वर्तमान क्षण का पूरा उपयोग करना
definition: grasp the present moment completely and take action today, rather than saving every chance for some safer, later moment
example: He had circled the ferry timings for three summers running; this year he seized the day, packed nothing, and simply went.

hindi: ख़राब माल टिका देना — नुक़्स छिपाकर बेच देना
definition: cheating hopeful buyer with defective goods while hiding faults, taking honest money dishonestly
example: The scooter shone beautifully in the photographs, and the engine died before the second monsoon; they had sold him a lemon.

hindi: बेच खाना — भरोसा करने वाले को धोखा देना
definition: betraying trusted friends secretly, harming loyal people seeking personal profit, comfort, advantage
example: He promised to protect his cousin's share, then sold him down the river for a slightly larger room.

hindi: हाथों-हाथ बिकना — माल उड़ जाना
definition: an American phrase meaning goods selling extremely quickly, eager buyers emptying stock almost immediately
example: Her hand-painted mugs sold like hotcakes at the school fair, leaving nothing behind except paint under her fingernails.

term: sell someone a bill of goods
hindi: झूठे वादे बेचना — धोखे से मनवाना
definition: deceive someone into accepting something false, worthless, or dishonestly promised, American usage
example: The brochure sold us a bill of goods about ocean views, though the balcony faced a car park and one hopeful palm tree.

hindi: चकमा देना — झूठा इशारा करके छलना
definition: trick someone with a feint, deceiving them about your real movement, British usage from rugby and football
example: Our toddler sold me a dummy, reaching for the spinach before swiping the chocolate the moment I turned around.

hindi: घटिया माल थमाना — ठगकर बेचना
definition: cheat someone by selling something worthless that seemed valuable when bought, British usage
example: The bicycle looked shiny in the shop window, but Dad soon realised he'd been sold a pup when the chain fell off at the gate.

hindi: पुश्तैनी ज़ेवर बेचना — मजबूरी में क़ीमती चीज़ें बेचना
definition: British for selling valuable prized assets to raise quick money during financial hardship
example: The club refused to sell the family silver, keeping its old pavilion and raising the money with a legendary cake sale instead.

term: send a shiver down your spine
hindi: सिहरन दौड़ जाना — डर से काँप उठना
definition: causing chilling dread, a sudden cold tremor of horror running right through you
example: Her grandmother's ghost story still sends a shiver down my spine, even though I now tell it to my own children.

hindi: जेल भेज दिया जाना — अदालत से सज़ा पाकर
definition: ordered into prison punishment directly from courtroom sentencing, British phrasing
example: Their Manchester landlord was sent down that winter, and nobody along the terrace could stop discussing it over fences.

hindi: कुंभ के मेले में बिछड़े — बरसों बाद मिले
definition: joke, borrowed from Hindi cinema, about lookalike strangers resembling siblings parted long ago at birth, as said in Indian English
example: The two strangers wore identical kurtas to the party, and everyone teased that they were brothers separated at the Kumbh Mela.

hindi: अदा दिखाना — एक के बाद एक शानदार पहनावा पेश करना
definition: displaying strikingly stylish appearance confidently, outfits assembled purely for maximum admiring attention
example: Across four wedding days Rhea kept serving looks, while her brother rotated between exactly whichever shirt smelled cleanest.

hindi: रफ़्तार तय करना — दूसरों के लिए मानक बनाना
definition: lead rivals and competitors, establishing the speed or standard everyone else follows
example: Their grandmother set the pace on the hill walk, leaving the teenagers puffing and laughing behind her.

hindi: ग़लतफ़हमी दूर करना — असली बात सामने रखना
definition: correct false stories publicly by revealing true facts, clearing away rumours and misunderstanding
example: At the reunion, Priya set the record straight: she had not eloped in college, she had simply missed the last bus home.

hindi: पहिया घुमाना — काम शुरू करवा देना
definition: taking the first practical action that starts a project or process moving forward toward completion
example: One phone call to the council set the wheels in motion, and by autumn the street had its first proper crossing.

hindi: तहलका मचा देना — चारों ओर हलचल और वाहवाही
definition: achieve something dazzling enough to earn sudden fame and excited admiration everywhere
example: He never set the world on fire, yet every student remembered his chemistry classes.

hindi: चर्चा का विषय बनना — लोगों में कानाफूसी शुरू होना
definition: cause gossip and rumours informally, making people whisper eagerly about something surprising
example: When the retired headmaster bought a red motorbike, it set tongues wagging from the post office to the pub.

hindi: खीज पैदा करना — सुनते ही चिढ़ होना
definition: irritate someone sharply, some grating sound or habit making their patience fray instantly
example: The squeak of chalk on the blackboard set the whole class's teeth on edge until the teacher switched to a marker.

hindi: हिसाब चुकता करना — पुराना बदला लेना
definition: take revenge for an earlier wrong, repaying someone for injuries long remembered
example: Years later she settled a score with her old debating rival by beating him fairly, then shaking his hand warmly.

hindi: सात साल की बेचैनी — पुराने रिश्ते से ऊब
definition: restless boredom supposedly striking long marriages, tempting partners toward straying after several years
example: Instead of a seven-year itch they took up salsa lessons, and now they bicker only about footwork.

hindi: हवा में तलवार चलाना — बेमतलब की लड़ाई
definition: fighting imaginary enemies or arguing against positions nobody actually holds, wasting effort
example: Rehearsing his complaint in the mirror, Neel realised he'd spent an hour shadow boxing over a leak the landlord had already fixed.

hindi: रत्ती भर शक — ज़रा-सा संदेह
definition: even the slightest uncertainty, usually denied firmly to show complete confidence in something
example: She knew beyond a shadow of a doubt that her son had left the cookies on the doorstep for the new neighbours.

hindi: लंबा खिंचा चुटकुला — जिसका अंत फुस्स हो
definition: long rambling story or joke, full of needless detail, ending deliberately with pointless anticlimax
example: Dad's shaggy dog story lasted the entire car journey, and the groan at the punchline was the best part.

hindi: उठो, जल्दी करो — सुस्ती छोड़ो
definition: hurry along immediately, getting moving quickly instead of lingering lazily around
example: Shake a leg, you two, the pancakes are going cold and the beach will be packed by noon.

hindi: पत्ते की तरह काँपना — डर से थरथराना
definition: trembling uncontrollably with fear, whole body quivering visibly from sheer terror
example: I was shaking like a leaf when I stood up to give the toast, but everyone raised their glasses before I finished.

hindi: अक्ल का धनी — जिसकी बुद्धि उम्र के साथ भी तेज़ बनी रहे
definition: understands things quickly and remembers small details, staying mentally alert despite advanced years
example: Grandmother beat every one of us at cards again, sharp as a tack at ninety-one.

hindi: अक्ल का पैदल — समझ में कुछ धीमा इंसान
definition: mildly foolish person lacking quick intelligence, kindly phrased judgement about slower thinking
example: He was never the sharpest tool in the shed, but he remembered every birthday and always arrived carrying something warm.

hindi: सब ठीक हो जाएगा — चिंता मत करो
definition: reassurance, common across Australia, that present trouble will settle itself without anxious worry, also heard as she'll be apples
example: The tent pole snapped, but Dad said she'll be right, then propped everything with a cricket bat until morning.

hindi: तलवार म्यान में रखना — लड़ाई अपनी मर्ज़ी से रोकना
definition: stop fighting deliberately, ending a lengthy quarrel while both sides still keep their strength
example: The brothers sheathed the sword over the mango tree the winter their mother fell ill, and never raised it again.

hindi: रोशनी डालना — किसी बात को स्पष्ट करना
definition: reveal hidden facts, making something mysterious clearer by explaining truth previously unknown
example: Grandma's old letters shed light on why she always set an extra place at Christmas.

hindi: हाथ की सफ़ाई का खेल — चकमेबाज़ी
definition: deceitful swindle moving things around quickly, confusing people about where something really went
example: Tracking who had borrowed the lawnmower became a shell game, each neighbour naming someone further down the street.

hindi: दोष दूसरे पर डालना — अपनी गलती किसी और के सिर
definition: move blame onto another person, escaping punishment for your genuine fault
example: Rather than admit the numbers were wrong, he shifted the blame onto the intern who had merely typed them.

hindi: अब गाड़ी छूट गई — मौका हाथ से निकल गया
definition: opportunity gone permanently, since acting became impossible after everybody moved beyond that particular chance
example: He finally decided to apply for the hostel room, but the ship had sailed and even the warden looked apologetic.

hindi: धज्जियाँ उड़ा देना — प्रस्ताव को पूरी तरह ठुकरा देना
definition: destroy someone's argument or proposal completely and publicly, leaving nothing worth defending
example: My plan for a family camping holiday was shot down in flames the moment I mentioned there would be no showers.

hindi: बिना सोचे तीर चलाना — तुरंत प्रतिक्रिया दे देना
definition: acting hastily without proper thought, reacting immediately instead of weighing careful judgement
example: Asked about the recipe, Nani shoots from the hip, and somehow the answer always tastes right.

hindi: बातों में समय बिताना — बेमतलब सुखद गपशप
definition: pass time chatting idly about unimportant subjects, enjoying easy conversation rather than useful discussion
example: We stood shooting the breeze beside the tea stall while the rain decided whether it wanted to start again.

hindi: गप्पें हाँकना — बेमतलब की बातचीत करना
definition: an American phrase, also heard as shoot the breeze, meaning relaxed aimless chatter about unimportant everyday matters
example: They stood beside the pickup shooting the bull about fishing until the sunlight finally slipped behind the grain silo.

hindi: सब कुछ दाँव पर लगाना — बड़ा सपना
definition: attempt something wildly ambitious, risking everything for the largest possible reward; American
example: Instead of a modest stall, the twins decided to shoot the moon and rented the whole market hall for their bakery.

hindi: बड़बोलापन करना — ज़ुबान चलाना
definition: talking carelessly or boastfully, saying things loudly without thinking about consequences
example: He shot his mouth off about winning the quiz, then spent the evening cheerfully buying the winning team their drinks.

hindi: हिम्मत करके बोल देना — मौका हाथ से न जाने देना
definition: approach somebody attractive despite likely refusal, risking rejection rather than wondering forever
example: He shot his shot beside the library photocopier, mumbled everything wrong, and somehow received a phone number anyway.

hindi: अपने पैर पर कुल्हाड़ी मारना — अपना ही नुक़सान कर बैठना
definition: someone damages their cause through careless actions that harm nobody except themselves
example: He shot himself in the foot arguing with the referee, and watched the rest of the match from the bench.

hindi: मटके में मछली मारना — बिलकुल आसान शिकार
definition: absurdly easy, aimed against defenceless targets that cannot possibly escape harm
example: Beating his little sister at carrom felt like shooting fish in a barrel, so he started letting her open the board.

hindi: थककर चूर होने तक ख़रीदारी
definition: shopping freely and tirelessly for hours, spending money until exhaustion finally forces you home
example: The sisters shopped till they dropped at the Diwali mela, then fell asleep on the bus clutching bangle boxes.

hindi: गागर में सागर — थोड़े में पूरी बात
definition: brief and pleasantly simple, lasting only long enough without tiresome extra detail
example: The best man kept his speech short and sweet, and everyone was back on the dance floor in minutes.

hindi: मक्खीचूस — पैसा होते हुए भी ख़र्च न करना
definition: Australian and British teasing for someone hating spending money, stingy despite having plenty tucked away
example: Uncle Ray had short arms and deep pockets, yet every birthday he somehow found a crisp note hidden inside a very thin card.

hindi: नाक पर गुस्सा — जल्दी भड़कने वाला स्वभाव
definition: quick temper that explodes into anger almost instantly with very little provocation needed
example: The chef had a short fuse in the kitchen, yet he was the first to stay late helping anyone who struggled.

hindi: कम तौलना — हक़ से कम देकर ठगना
definition: cheating trusting person deliberately, returning less honest money than the buyer rightfully deserved
example: The vegetable seller weighed the tomatoes with a thumb resting on the scale, short-changing every customer in the evening rush.

hindi: चेतावनी की गोली — पहले से आगाह करना
definition: sharp early warning, chiefly British wording, showing punishment follows unless behaviour changes
example: The landlord's letter was a shot across the bows, polite enough, though everybody upstairs began paying rent promptly afterwards.

hindi: अंधेरे में तीर — बेतुका अनुमान
definition: an American phrase for wild uncertain guess offered without information, hoping approximate answer somehow lands correctly
example: Her answer during the quiz final was pure shot in the dark, and the entire table erupted when it landed.

hindi: दोष अपने सिर लेना — जिम्मेदारी खुद उठाना
definition: accept responsibility openly, carrying blame yourself instead of naming other people
example: She shouldered the blame for the missed deadline, though half the team knew she had warned everybody twice.

hindi: कंधा देने वाला — दुख कहने की जगह
definition: dependable sympathetic listener offering comfort, letting somebody release unhappy feelings without judgement
example: She wanted advice from nobody, only a shoulder to cry on, and her friend understood without being told.

hindi: कंधे से कंधा मिलाकर — एकजुट होकर
definition: standing together united, supporting each other firmly while facing trouble as one group
example: When the storm tore the school roof off, parents and teachers worked shoulder to shoulder to clear the classrooms by Monday.

hindi: ढिंढोरा पीटना — ख़ुशी सबको बताना
definition: announce happy news excitedly to everybody, openly delighted and unwilling to keep good tidings secret
example: Once the adoption was official, Farah wanted to shout it from the rooftops and rang every relative before breakfast.

hindi: बाहर का रास्ता दिखाना — अवांछित मेहमान को विदा करना
definition: dismiss an unwelcome visitor firmly, forcing them outside your household immediately
example: After the third rude remark about the cooking, grandmother showed him the door with a smile nobody dared argue against.

hindi: पीठ दिखाना — कायरता दिखाना
definition: reveal cowardice by backing away from danger or a fight when courage is needed, chiefly British
example: The old sailor swore he had never shown the white feather, though he admitted he still feared his wife's temper.

hindi: पत्ते खोलना — अपनी योजना खुलकर सामने रख देना
definition: reveal your hidden position openly, letting others finally learn the secret plans held back earlier
example: After an hour of polite circling, he finally showed his cards and admitted the family wanted to sell the orchard.

hindi: असली रंग दिखाना — छिपा चेहरा सामने आना
definition: revealing hidden character once careful pretence becomes impossible, exposing reality behind long presentation
example: The quiet neighbour showed his true colours during the flood, carrying strangers' children upstairs until midnight.

hindi: शर्मीला स्वभाव — भीड़ से कतराने वाला
definition: painfully timid person avoiding attention, retreating whenever unfamiliar strangers notice them
example: The shrinking violet of the family sang beautifully, but only after every guest had gone home.

hindi: इस नश्वर देह से मुक्ति — दुनिया छोड़ जाना
definition: dying, leaving worldly troubles behind through death, from British literary usage
example: Uncle read Hamlet aloud, announcing that whenever he shuffles off this mortal coil somebody must inherit his slippers.

hindi: सीप की तरह बंद हो जाना — अचानक चुप्पी साध लेना
definition: suddenly falling completely silent, refusing further conversation once an uncomfortable subject arises
example: Ask Arjun about his exam results and he shuts up like a clam, suddenly fascinated by his shoelaces.

hindi: अपना मुँह बंद करो — चुप हो जाओ
definition: playfully rude command telling someone to stop talking right away, American slang
example: Shut your pie hole and pass the popcorn, laughed Jess, as her brother spoiled yet another plot twist.

hindi: बहुत बीमार — उठने तक की हालत नहीं
definition: violently unwell with nausea and dizziness, barely able to stand upright anywhere
example: He arrived from the wedding sick as a dog, and his mother blamed the roadside kulfi without waiting for evidence.

hindi: बुरी तरह मायूस — हार से टूटा हुआ
definition: bitterly disappointed, especially after losing a match or narrowly missing a prize, mostly heard in British English
example: Dad was sick as a parrot when the penalty sailed over the bar, but he still clapped the young striker off the pitch.

hindi: बीच का भटकाव — असली काम पड़ा रह गया
definition: unplanned detour swallowing attention while important chapters of your life wait unfinished
example: The pottery classes became a lovely side quest, though her half-written thesis watched from the same table.

hindi: तमाशबीन निरीक्षक — काम देखकर मुफ़्त राय देने वाला
definition: an American term for onlooker watching workers closely, offering criticism without holding real responsibility
example: Two retired neighbours became sidewalk superintendents outside the building site, bringing folding chairs and strong coffee every morning.

hindi: आँखों को ठंडक — जिसे देखकर मन ख़ुश हो
definition: person or thing whose welcome arrival brings great pleasure and relief after long waiting
example: After six hours stuck at the airport, her father's battered old car pulling up outside was a sight for sore eyes.

hindi: क़ब्र जैसी ख़ामोशी — पूरी तरह सन्नाटा
definition: completely soundless, holding quiet secrecy however long anybody keeps listening nearby
example: The classroom went silent as the grave when the headmaster asked who had drawn the moustache on the founder's portrait.

hindi: सिरफिरा जैसा — बेवजह उछल-कूद करने वाला
definition: scatty foolish behaviour, somebody cheerfully unreliable, hardly sensible about anything, Australian simile
example: Their cousin acted silly as a two-bob watch at the party, and by midnight even the grandparents were dancing.

hindi: अँधेरे में उजाले की किरण — बुरे में भी अच्छा
definition: consoling advantage hidden inside genuinely unfortunate circumstances, offering comfort during obvious difficulty
example: The cancelled train had a silver lining, because they finally walked through the old bazaar together.

hindi: ज़ुबान में जादू — बातों से किसी को भी मना लेने का हुनर
definition: persuasive talent for charming speech and flattery, able to convince almost anyone of anything
example: With her silver tongue, Priya talked the shopkeeper into opening again five minutes after he had locked up.

hindi: सदियों से — जब से याद है
definition: covering extremely long period, since remembered history began, British phrase
example: The sweetshop had stood beside the bus stand since the year dot, weighing laddus with the same brass scales.

hindi: रोटी के बदले गाना — सेवा देकर पाना
definition: performing some service before receiving reward, entertaining hosts instead of accepting plain charity
example: The travelling puppeteer sang for his supper every winter, trading two shows for a warm room.

hindi: सब कुछ उगल देना — पकड़े जाने पर साथियों के सारे भेद खोल देना
definition: reveal secrets eagerly to authorities, American crime slang, informing freely against accomplices once questioning begins
example: Caught with the missing trophy, the youngest scout sang like a canary and named the whole cabin within a minute.

hindi: गुणगान करना — किसी की बार-बार तारीफ़ करना
definition: praising someone enthusiastically and repeatedly, telling friends and strangers alike how wonderful, talented or generous they are
example: Ever since the nurse sat with her through the night, Nani has sung her praises to every visitor.

hindi: दुखड़ा सुनाना — अपनी उदासी बार-बार गिनाना
definition: complain repeatedly about personal sadness and misfortune, sharing gloomy feelings with anybody listening
example: Grandfather sang the blues about his knees until the children dragged him outside to umpire their match.

hindi: तैरो या डूबो — अपने बल पर ही बचना
definition: surviving entirely alone without help, either managing somehow otherwise failing completely
example: They handed him the accounts ledger, said sink or swim, and by Diwali he understood the figures better than anybody expected.

hindi: गुमनामी में खो जाना — बिना निशान मिट जाना
definition: in British usage, fail quietly and vanish completely, forgotten without leaving lasting impression
example: My first novel sank without trace, but my mother still keeps a copy on her bedside table.

hindi: दिल बैठ जाना — बुरी ख़बर का आभास
definition: sudden heavy dread or disappointment settling in your stomach when you realise something important has gone wrong
example: I had a sinking feeling when I saw the empty platform, until the stationmaster pointed to a later train and offered me tea.

hindi: डूबता जहाज़ — बर्बादी की ओर जाता संगठन
definition: business or organisation heading towards collapse and bankruptcy, which sensible people quietly start abandoning
example: Half the band had quit, but Mira refused to leave a sinking ship and kept booking gigs in village halls.

hindi: सिर पर सवार होना — पीछे पड़े रहना
definition: used for hovering over someone constantly, pestering and nagging until they finish something, as said in Indian English
example: His mother sat on his head all evening until the thank-you letters to the relatives were finally written and stamped.

hindi: दो नावों में पैर रखना — किसी एक पक्ष में फैसला नहीं लेना
definition: refusing deliberately to choose either side, staying neutral while everyone waits impatiently for your decision
example: Every cousin argued about the wedding venue while Nanaji sat on the fence, sipping chai and admiring the ceiling fan.

hindi: किनारे बैठकर तमाशा देखना — शामिल न होना
definition: watching events without taking part, avoiding involvement while other people take action; variant watch from the sidelines
example: Rather than sit on the sidelines, Grandma joined the protest with a flask of tea and a hand-painted sign.

hindi: हाथ पर हाथ धरे बैठना — कुछ न करना
definition: doing nothing useful while work needs doing, lazily leaving every effort to other people
example: Instead of sitting on his backside, the teenager surprised his parents by repainting the fence before breakfast.

hindi: टस से मस न होना — जान-बूझकर कोई कदम न उठाना
definition: deliberately delaying every response, refusing action while other people await movement
example: Everyone sat on their hands about the leaking roof until October rain settled the argument in a single loud afternoon.

hindi: जमे रहना — हिले-डुले बिना धीरज से प्रतीक्षा करना
definition: waiting patiently without moving, resisting every urge toward rushing into hasty action
example: Sit tight until the rain passes, her mother said, pouring another cup and pulling the shutters closed.

hindi: बैठा शिकार — बिना बचाव खुला निशाना
definition: completely defenceless target, easily harmed because nobody provides shelter against obvious danger
example: Parked under the mango tree during the storm, the little car was a sitting duck, and the branch found it by midnight.

hindi: बारूद के ढेर पर बैठना — कभी भी फट सकने वाली हालत
definition: waiting inside dangerously unstable situation where sudden violent trouble could explode almost anytime
example: With both brothers seated beside the property papers, everyone realised dinner was sitting on a powder keg and served extra sweets.

hindi: मज़े में होना — आराम की हालत में
definition: enjoying a comfortable, advantageous position, needing little further effort or worry
example: With the harvest safely stored before the storm, the farmers were sitting pretty for winter.

hindi: मिट्टी में मिल जाना — कब्र में दफ़्न होना
definition: buried underground after death, describing a person who passed away and lies beneath grave soil
example: She still argues with her father, though he has been six feet under since the winter she turned thirty.

term: six of one, half a dozen
hindi: वही ढाक के तीन पात — दोनों बराबर
definition: either option amounts to exactly the same result, difference hardly worth further argument
example: Train or bus, it was six of one, half a dozen, so they picked whichever left before dinner.

hindi: छठी इंद्रिय — बिना प्रमाण के सच भाँप लेना
definition: senses hidden danger or meaning without evidence, catching what ordinary careful observation misses
example: Some sixth sense made her turn back for the stove; the flame was still burning.

hindi: पतली बर्फ़ पर चलना — खतरे के बिलकुल किनारे होना
definition: behave carelessly in a dangerous position, inviting serious trouble from slight mistakes
example: Borrowing the neighbour's scooter without asking again, he knew he was skating on thin ice.

hindi: घर का भेद — छिपाया हुआ पारिवारिक राज़
definition: shameful family secret hidden from outsiders, embarrassing relatives across several generations
example: Sorting the attic, they found letters revealing a skeleton in the closet nobody had mentioned across three generations of Sunday lunches.

hindi: परदे में छिपी बात — अतीत का शर्मनाक राज़
definition: shameful secret hidden in your past, British wording of the American skeleton in the closet, kept concealed because discovery would bring disgrace
example: When Gran finally admitted she had once eloped with a trumpet player, the family's only skeleton in the cupboard turned out to be rather romantic.

hindi: ऊपरी चमक — सिर्फ़ सतह तक
definition: existing only across the outward surface, with nothing beneath the pleasant appearance worth trusting
example: Their friendship looked skin deep until the hospital night proved everybody comfortably wrong.

hindi: ज़मानत तोड़कर भागना — पेशी पर हाज़िर न होना
definition: vanish before promised courtroom appearance after release, abandoning money pledged toward guaranteed attendance
example: The contractor skipped bail, and his brother-in-law spent that whole monsoon apologising to everybody who had signed papers.

hindi: शहर छोड़कर भाग जाना — ज़िम्मेदारी से बचकर निकलना
definition: leaving somewhere suddenly and secretly, escaping obligations or trouble you would rather avoid; American
example: Dad joked about skipping town before the school play, then cried proudly through every single scene.

hindi: मुद्दे से कतराना — बात टालना
definition: avoiding an uncomfortable topic deliberately, discussing everything nearby without addressing the actual problem directly
example: The children skirted the issue of the broken vase until the youngest blurted everything out and burst into giggles.

hindi: गाली-गलौज — तू-तू मैं-मैं
definition: noisy quarrel where both people trade insults loudly, neither listening at all, British usage
example: The disagreement over the parking space turned into a slanging match before someone's grandmother stepped between them.

hindi: हल्की डाँट — गंभीर गलती पर मामूली सज़ा
definition: punishment gentle enough that serious wrongdoing carries almost nothing painful, discouraging nobody afterwards
example: Breaking the neighbour's window earned nothing worse than a slap on the wrist, so both boys were back with the bat by evening.

hindi: चूल्हे पर खटना — रसोई में घंटों मेहनत
definition: spend long, laborious hours cooking, often feeling underappreciated by those eating
example: Mum had slaved over a hot stove all afternoon, so the children cleared every plate and did the washing-up without being asked.

hindi: मच्छर पर तोप — छोटी बात पर बड़ा ज़ोर
definition: enormous excessive force applied against trivial problem needing only gentle careful handling
example: Calling three lawyers over a broken flowerpot was a sledgehammer to crack a nut, and both families later laughed about it.

hindi: नींद का उधार — कम सोने का हिसाब चुकता होना बाक़ी
definition: accumulated exhaustion from months of short nights, quietly draining concentration, patience, humour
example: Two quiet weekends barely dented the sleep debt he had gathered across a whole examination season.

hindi: सोच-विचार कर बताना — रात भर सोचना
definition: postpone decisions overnight, letting tired judgement recover before choosing anything important
example: She wanted to accept immediately, but her aunt insisted she sleep on it, and morning brought three sensible questions.

hindi: ड्यूटी पर सोना — काम से बेपरवाह होना
definition: neglecting your duty through inattention or laziness, letting important things pass while supposedly watching
example: Grandpa claimed the garden gnome slept on the job, since the pigeons had eaten every single seedling again.

hindi: आँख मूँदकर गड्ढे में गिरना — अनजाने में मुसीबत मोल लेना
definition: drifting heedlessly toward serious trouble without noticing, attention elsewhere until things become impossible to escape
example: We nearly sleepwalked into disaster with the wedding budget until Auntie sat us down with a calculator and a pot of chai.

hindi: हाथ की सफ़ाई — चतुराई भरा छल
definition: skilful deceitful trickery performed quickly, fooling watching people without their noticing anything
example: With a little sleight of hand, Mum swapped the dropped ice cream for a fresh one before the toddler even noticed.

hindi: चुपके से संदेश भेजना — निजी बातचीत शुरू करने की कोशिश
definition: approach someone privately through direct messages, hoping romantic conversation begins without public attention
example: He slid into her dms with a question about her bookshelf, which everybody agreed showed considerable strategic patience.

hindi: कीचड़ उछालना — बदनाम करना
definition: spreading damaging accusations about someone, attacking their reputation with insults rather than honest argument
example: Both candidates promised a clean campaign, then slung mud at each other within a week.

hindi: बंधन तोड़ना — पट्टा छुड़ाकर आज़ाद घूमना
definition: escape from close control or confinement and enjoy sudden unsupervised freedom
example: For one golden afternoon the children slipped the leash, wandering the orchard until the light went orange and somebody rang a bell for dinner.

hindi: हाथ आया मौका गँवाना — मौका फिसल जाना
definition: allowing valuable opportunity escape through carelessness, losing chance nobody offers anybody twice
example: The scholarship slipped through his fingers over one unsigned form, and his teacher marked the deadline on next year's calendar.

hindi: मछली की तरह फिसलने वाला — पकड़ में न आने वाला
definition: dishonestly evasive, impossible to catch or corner, always escaping promises, blame, or questions
example: Ask him when he'll return the ladder and he turns slippery as an eel, suddenly remembering an urgent phone call.

hindi: ख़ून-पसीना एक करना — थका देने वाली मेहनत
definition: British: labour extremely hard at exhausting, tedious tasks, spending every scrap of energy
example: Her dad slogged his guts out on night shifts for years, and he cried quietly when she crossed the stage in her graduation gown.

hindi: निराशा का दलदल — गहरी हताशा
definition: deep swamp of hopelessness and gloom, a miserable mood that feels impossible to climb back out of
example: Stuck in a slough of despond after the rejection letters, she finally laughed again when her nephew mailed her a crayon trophy.

hindi: कछुए की चाल — बहुत सुस्त और धीमी गति
definition: moving painfully slowly, taking forever before making even small forward progress
example: Their old dog was slow as molasses on the stairs, and the whole family learned to wait halfway down for him.

hindi: धीरे-धीरे किनारा — रिश्ता चुपचाप ठंडा पड़ना
definition: gradual reduction of romantic contact replacing honest ending, replies arriving slower until silence
example: It was a slow fade rather than a breakup, weekly calls becoming monthly, until neither remembered who stopped calling first.

hindi: पीछे रह जाना — शुरुआत में सुस्ती दिखाना
definition: slow reacting or starting, missing chances because others moved much quicker, mainly British
example: He was slow off the mark asking her to dance, but she waited by the punch bowl anyway.

hindi: देर से समझने वाला — ज़रा मंद
definition: taking longer than others to understand things, especially jokes, hints or explanations
example: I'm a bit slow on the uptake before my first coffee, so my sister has to tell me every joke twice.

hindi: थोड़ा सब्र रखो — जोश ठंडा करो
definition: calming excitement, slowing enthusiasm before rushing ahead too quickly, casual American slang
example: Slow your roll, kiddo; the puppy is ours, but first we have to buy him a bed.

term: small cog in a big wheel
hindi: बड़े चक्के का छोटा दाँता — तंत्र में नगण्य हैसियत
definition: minor insignificant person inside large organisation, holding almost none of genuine authority
example: She joined feeling like a small cog in a big wheel, until the senior clerk began saving her the window seat.

hindi: रात के पिछले पहर — आधी रात के बाद
definition: quiet hours after midnight, when night stretches toward morning without sleeping
example: They talked into the small hours about cousins nobody had seen for years, until the kettle finally went cold.

hindi: मामूली बात — बड़ी परेशानियों के आगे कुछ नहीं
definition: trivial unimportant matter beside genuinely serious concerns, hardly worth anybody's continued attention
example: Losing the deposit felt enormous until the harvest failed, after which it became small potatoes nobody mentioned again.

hindi: इधर-उधर की बातें — औपचारिक हल्की-फुल्की गपशप
definition: polite casual conversation about unimportant subjects, filling time pleasantly without discussing anything serious
example: They made small talk about the monsoon and the price of tomatoes until the doctor finally called their number.

hindi: बदनाम करने की मुहिम
definition: deliberate organised effort spreading damaging claims, often false, destroying someone's public reputation
example: The candidate refused to answer the smear campaign, and simply kept knocking on doors to meet people.

hindi: दाल में कुछ काला है — गड़बड़ी की बू आ जाना
definition: senses hidden dishonesty behind smooth words before evidence proves that anyone actually lied
example: Three cousins suddenly offering to help move the almirah, and Papa began to smell a rat.

hindi: दाल में कुछ काला होना — बात संदिग्ध लगना
definition: seem suspicious or dishonest, making listeners doubt the explanation offered; also said as sound fishy
example: Her brother's excuse about the neighbour's dog eating his homework smelled fishy, especially since the neighbours kept only goldfish.

hindi: कम में गुज़र-बसर — बेहद किफ़ायत से जीना
definition: Australian for surviving on barely anything, living thriftily with extremely little money or food, usually 'live on the smell of an oily rag'
example: Aunty Mags ran her little farm on the smell of an oily rag and still found enough to fix the neighbours' fence.

hindi: बू आना — साफ़ गड़बड़ दिखना
definition: seem obviously dishonest or corrupt, arousing strong suspicion that something shameful is happening
example: The club's accounts smelled to high heaven, so the members quietly asked the retired teacher to check every page over biscuits.

hindi: आँखों में धूल झोंकना — नज़र का धोखा
definition: dazzling surface display covering hollow substance, making real weakness appear impressive instead
example: Grandfather revealed his card trick as smoke and mirrors, then taught the children the whole clumsy secret.

hindi: पक्का सबूत — जुर्म साबित करने वाला निर्णायक प्रमाण
definition: conclusive evidence exposing hidden guilt, proving beyond argument the secret wrongdoing somebody worked carefully to conceal
example: The auditor found the smoking gun in a dull spreadsheet, one payment dated a Sunday nobody worked.

hindi: नाराज़गी दूर करना — मान-मनौव्वल
definition: calm people upset after a quarrel, soothing wounded pride and restoring peace gently
example: The host smoothed ruffled feathers at the wedding by seating the feuding uncles at opposite ends with extra dessert.

hindi: गाड़ी पटरी पर होना — सब सहज चलना
definition: period where everything continues smoothly, without trouble, resistance, obstacles, problems, unexpected delay
example: The first month of the bakery was chaos, but after they hired Meera it became smooth sailing.

hindi: आस्तीन का साँप — भरोसे में छिपा दुश्मन
definition: trusted companion hiding hostile intentions behind harmless friendly behaviour until betrayal finally arrives
example: She fed him lunch every Sunday for years before learning what a snake in the grass he had been about the land papers.

hindi: झूठी दवा — बेअसर चमत्कारी नुस्ख़ा
definition: worthless remedy sold with extravagant healing promises, curing nothing beyond seller's poverty
example: The stall promised height, memory and marriage from one bottle, which even the neighbours recognised as snake oil.

hindi: मन में खटका — धीमा-धीमा शक
definition: quiet growing doubt that something is wrong or untrue, felt before proof arrives
example: She had a sneaking suspicion her friends were planning a surprise party, since nobody would meet her eyes all week.

hindi: रत्ती भर उम्मीद नहीं — नामुमकिन
definition: absolutely hopeless chance of success, practically impossible whatever effort anyone makes; informal
example: The puppy had a snowball's chance in hell of staying off the sofa once the children started patting the cushions.

hindi: काम के बोझ तले दबना — फ़ुर्सत ही न मिलना
definition: buried beneath overwhelming quantity of tasks, unable to answer anybody properly
example: She was snowed under with wedding invitations, so her mother quietly took over addressing every envelope.

hindi: रजाई में दुबका होना — गर्म और आरामदेह
definition: extremely comfortable, relaxed, warm, settled somewhere sheltered, protected against cold weather outside
example: The children burrowed under three quilts while sleet rattled the window, snug as a bug.

hindi: अब तक सब ठीक — यहाँ तक तो निभ गया
definition: matters progressing acceptably until this moment, though nobody dares promising continued smoothness
example: Half the guests were fed and nothing had burned, so far so good, and Mummy allowed herself one cup of tea.

term: so near and yet so far
hindi: मंज़िल पास, फिर भी दूर — हाथ आया पर मुँह न लगा
definition: painfully close to success or something longed for, yet still disappointingly unable to reach or grasp it
example: The last bus pulled away as we reached the stop, so near and yet so far, and we ended up walking home under the stars.

hindi: क़िस्मत की उल्टी चाल — बुरा ही होगा
definition: joking principle that whatever can possibly misfire will, especially when least convenient; British
example: It's sod's law that the bus arrives the second you've given up and started walking.

hindi: रिश्ते का इशारा भर — आधी तस्वीर से हिंट देना
definition: hinting about your relationship quietly online, showing your partner partially before announcing anything
example: The soft launch was one blurred elbow beside her coffee cup, which her hostel friends decoded within about four minutes.

hindi: आसान रास्ता — कम तकलीफ़ वाला विकल्प
definition: the choice demanding least effort, often chosen instead of harder, better paths, said in British usage
example: Staying home felt like the soft option, but she packed her bag and caught the early train to the interview.

hindi: दिल का कोना — किसी के लिए ख़ास नरमी
definition: quiet unreasonable affection toward somebody, forgiving faults nobody else would tolerate patiently
example: Grandmother has a soft spot for the neighbour's grandson, so his terrible singing receives applause nobody else earns.

hindi: नरम दिल — जिसे आसानी से मनाया जा सके
definition: kindly person easily persuaded into giving money, favours or help
example: Every stray cat on the street knew Mrs Khan was a soft touch for a saucer of milk.

hindi: मक्खन लगाना — चापलूसी से नरम करना
definition: persuade someone through smooth flattery and gentle charming words, softening their resistance first
example: He soft-soaped the landlady with praise for her roses before mentioning that the rent would be a little late.

hindi: चोट को हल्का करना — बुरी ख़बर नरमी से देना
definition: delivering painful news gently and kindly, making disappointment easier for someone hearing it
example: To soften the blow of cancelling the holiday, Dad set up a tent in the garden and cooked sausages outside.

hindi: धीरे-धीरे का तरीक़ा — बड़ी सावधानी और नरमी से काम लेना
definition: handling delicate situations cautiously and patiently, avoiding sudden forceful moves, British phrase
example: With the nervous rescue cat, they took a softly-softly approach, leaving treats by the sofa and waiting days for trust.

hindi: डटे रहना — तकलीफ़ में भी काम जारी रखना
definition: continuing steadily despite hardship, discomfort or illness, carrying your duties onward without complaint
example: With a streaming cold and a sleepy toddler on her shoulder, Meera soldiered on through the last batch of wedding invitations.

hindi: चट्टान की तरह मज़बूत — भरोसे में कभी न डगमगाने वाला
definition: completely dependable, reliable, honest, steady, someone whose promises never weaken under pressure
example: Through the whole hospital month, her uncle stayed solid as a rock, arriving early, staying late, never once complaining.

hindi: गोलमोल बहाना — लंबी-चौड़ी सफ़ाई
definition: elaborate invented story or excuse, deliberately evasive, distracting listeners from plain truth
example: She gave the landlord a whole song and dance about the rent, then quietly paid it the next morning.

hindi: बिल्कुल दुरुस्त होना — कोई तकलीफ़ नहीं
definition: enjoying excellent health, thoroughly examined afterwards with nothing whatever found wrong anywhere
example: Heart sound as a bell, the doctor said, and Papa forwarded that sentence to everyone.

hindi: वापसी का बिगुल बजाना — सबको पीछे हटने का इशारा
definition: signal that everybody should withdraw, admitting the attempted advance cannot possibly succeed against present resistance
example: Two hours into the leaking pipe, the plumber sounded the retreat and promised somebody stronger by Tuesday morning.

hindi: अंगूर खट्टे हैं — न मिलने पर बुरा कहना
definition: pretending scorn toward something desirable, disguising envy after failing to obtain
example: Calling the trophy cheap plastic was pure sour grapes, and even his younger sister said so at dinner.

hindi: बीज बोना — आगे के नतीजों की शुरुआत करना
definition: begin quiet actions certain to produce large consequences much later
example: That first shared tiffin box sowed the seeds of a friendship their families still talk about decades later.

hindi: जवानी की मस्ती — बेफिक्री भरे शौक
definition: indulging reckless youthful pleasures before settling toward responsible steady quieter living
example: He sowed his wild oats across two cities, then came home and grew tomatoes with startling seriousness.

hindi: काम में अड़ंगा — बनी बनाई योजना बिगाड़ देना
definition: sudden obstacle that wrecks carefully arranged plans, British phrasing for ruined arrangements
example: The power cut was a spanner in the works, so the wedding photographer shot the whole ceremony by lantern light.

hindi: जैसा पाया वैसा कहना — अनुभव से परखना
definition: in British, especially Northern English, usage, judge people honestly by experience, voicing opinions bluntly without flattery
example: Our Yorkshire landlady speaks as she finds, and she found our muddy boots unacceptable but our company delightful.

hindi: नाम लिया और हाज़िर — चर्चा करते ही आ जाना
definition: cheerful remark thrown when somebody appears exactly while people discuss them
example: Speak of the devil, said Amit, as the very cousin they had been gossiping about walked through the gate carrying mangoes.

hindi: बिना बारी बोल पड़ना — बेमौका बात कहना
definition: offer unwelcome words at an improper moment, saying something tactless that others consider disrespectful
example: The youngest cousin spoke out of turn about the missing jewellery, and every spoon stopped moving at once.

hindi: एक ही भाषा बोलना — आपसी समझ पूरी
definition: share similar opinions and understanding with somebody, agreeing naturally without lengthy explanation
example: Two minutes into discussing bicycles they were speaking the same language, and nobody else understood another word.

hindi: सत्ता के सामने सच कहना — ताक़तवर को आईना दिखाना
definition: courageously tell powerful people uncomfortable facts they would rather ignore, whatever the personal risk
example: The student journalist spoke truth to power in her school paper, and the head teacher, to everyone's surprise, thanked her.

hindi: बिना कहे सब कह देना — चुप्पी भी बहुत कुछ बताती है
definition: revealing a great deal without words, silence or gesture expressing meaning more clearly than speech
example: He said nothing when she showed him the old photograph, but his wet eyes spoke volumes.

hindi: मन की बात कहना — अपनी राय खुलकर रखना
definition: state your honest opinion openly, even when listeners would rather hear something more comfortable
example: At the family meeting, shy little Anika finally spoke her mind, and everyone agreed the holiday should include the beach after all.

hindi: रफ़्तार का दीवाना — तेज़ चलाने वाला
definition: someone who loves going extremely fast, especially driving or riding with reckless enthusiasm
example: Nobody expected Great-Aunt Kamala to be a speed demon on the go-kart track, but she lapped us all twice.

hindi: जल्दी करवाने के पैसे — रिश्वत
definition: used for a bribe paid to officials so paperwork moves faster through slow offices, as said in Indian English
example: Her father never paid speed money, so the family learned patience, and the licence arrived on a proudly honest schedule.

hindi: साफ़-साफ़ समझाना — खोलकर बताना
definition: explain something very clearly and simply, stating every point because the listener missed hints
example: When the hints about her birthday failed, she spelled it out: dinner, flowers and absolutely no football on television.

hindi: अंधाधुंध ख़र्च — बिना सोचे पैसा फूँकना
definition: spending money wildly and recklessly, like sailors blowing their wages ashore after months away
example: On his first trip to the city market, Grandpa spent like a drunken sailor and came home with four identical kettles.

hindi: पैसा पानी की तरह बहाना — बेहिसाब खर्च करना
definition: to spend money freely and lavishly, wasting large amounts without careful thought
example: During festival week the twins spend money like water, then survive on rice until the month turns.

hindi: राज़ खोल देना — छिपी बात मुँह से निकल जाना
definition: reveal secret information carelessly, usually before the proper moment arrives
example: Grandma spilled the beans about the surprise party while pouring the tea.

hindi: पूरी कहानी उगल देना — छिपी गपशप खोल देना
definition: share juicy private gossip eagerly, telling friends exactly what really happened
example: The moment the aunties left, my sister spilled the tea about the wedding budget while pouring everyone another round.

hindi: दिल खोलकर रख देना — सारे राज़ कह डालना
definition: reveal every secret and private feeling, confessing everything freely after long holding back
example: Two cups of cocoa in, my shy roommate spilled her guts about the boy from her pottery class.

hindi: किस्सा गढ़ना — मनगढ़ंत कहानी सुनाना
definition: telling a long, colourful story, often invented or embellished, meant purely to entertain listeners
example: Every monsoon evening Grandpa would spin a yarn about the tiger he once met, and the tiger grew larger each year.

hindi: जहाँ के तहाँ रहना — मेहनत के बाद भी वहीं का वहीं
definition: expending steady effort without progress, working furiously while achieving nothing worthwhile
example: She spun her wheels rewriting the first paragraph until her sister took the pencil away.

hindi: उगल दो — जल्दी से बोल दो
definition: impatient urging for someone hesitating nervously to finally reveal what they keep holding back
example: Spit it out, laughed his best friend, as Arjun stammered through the story of how he got engaged.

hindi: बच्चों जैसा गुस्सा दिखाना — मुँह फुलाकर बिगड़ना
definition: lose temper childishly, sulking loudly whenever minor plans disappoint, said across Australia
example: Uncle spat the dummy over losing carrom, then sheepishly rejoined the game once someone poured him lemonade.

hindi: गुस्से से फुंफकारना — झल्लाहट में बोल न पाना
definition: absolutely furious, so angry that words come spluttering out in outrage, British
example: Gran was spitting feathers after the bakery sold out of her favourite loaf, until the baker saved her one the next day.

hindi: हूबहू नक़ल — शक्ल-सूरत में बिल्कुल एक जैसे
definition: person whose features closely resemble those of a relative, appearing almost identical
example: Grandmother held the wedding photograph beside her granddaughter and went quiet, because the girl was the spitting image of her at nineteen.

hindi: दिल खोलकर ख़र्च करना
definition: spending money freely and generously on something special, treating yourself or others without counting
example: For their twentieth anniversary they decided to splash out on a houseboat weekend instead of the usual dinner.

hindi: पैसे लुटाना — खुलकर ख़र्च करना
definition: in British usage, spending money freely and showily, often buying rounds, gifts or treats for everyone
example: After the lottery scratchcard paid out, Uncle Dev splashed the cash on ice creams for every child on the beach.

hindi: बाल की खाल निकालना — मामूली बातों पर बहस करना
definition: argue over trivial distinctions during debate, ignoring the real question everyone cares about
example: The twins split hairs over whether ten past eight counted as 'about eight' while their pancakes went cold.

hindi: बीच का हिसाब कर लेना — दोनों तरफ़ बराबर छूट देना
definition: settle a haggle by taking the midpoint, so both sides make equal concessions and the compromise holds
example: The buyer wanted forty, the seller sixty, and they split the difference before the tea went cold.

hindi: लड़ने पर उतारू — झगड़े की तलाश
definition: angrily eager for confrontation, restlessly looking for any excuse to start a quarrel with somebody
example: Returning from the tense meeting, he was spoiling for a fight, but his wife's joke about his tie disarmed him.

hindi: एकदम दुरुस्त — रत्ती भर फ़र्क नहीं
definition: entirely accurate about something, chiefly British, correct enough that rechecking seems unnecessary
example: The tailor's guess about her sleeve length was spot on, measured only by looking, and she wore the kurta that evening.

hindi: आग की तरह फैलना — खबर बहुत तेज़ी से हर तरफ पहुँचना
definition: travel through crowds extremely quickly, reaching everybody before anybody bothers checking accuracy
example: News about the engagement spread like wildfire through the colony, arriving at her aunt's house before her own message did.

hindi: सौ काम अधूरे — हर तरफ बँट कर कुछ न कर पाना
definition: accepting excessive commitments simultaneously, performing every difficult task poorly through constantly overwhelmed hurrying
example: Between tuitions, temple duty and her brother's shop, she had spread herself too thin and slept through Sunday.

hindi: चाल में उमंग — ख़ुशी से भरी चाल
definition: lively, cheerful energy visible in someone's walking, showing happiness or renewed confidence
example: Since joining the dance class, Mum has had a spring in her step that the neighbours keep remarking on.

hindi: खरा सौदा — ईमानदारी का बर्ताव
definition: fair and honest treatment, giving everyone involved equal chances without tricks
example: The old shopkeeper always gave children a square deal, counting every sweet twice so nobody went short.

hindi: चौकोर आँखें — बहुत देर स्क्रीन देखने का ताना
definition: tired eyes blamed on watching screens endlessly, British teasing about staying indoors scrolling
example: Mum warned them about square eyes, then joined the film herself and stayed awake through both sequels.

term: square peg in a round hole
hindi: बेमेल जगह — जहाँ आदमी फिट न बैठे
definition: person badly fitted where placed, unable belonging comfortably within surroundings that suit everybody else
example: He was a square peg in a round hole among the accountants, and blossomed the week he moved downstairs to the workshop.

hindi: किसी के सामने डट जाना — भिड़ने को तैयार
definition: stand facing someone boldly, ready to quarrel or trade blows, provoking a confrontation
example: The two cats squared up to each other on the garden wall, tails puffed, until the rain sent them both running.

hindi: झगड़ा ख़त्म करना — दुश्मनी मिटाना
definition: settle a long-running feud or grudge and make peace again, American hip-hop slang
example: The two rappers squashed the beef live on stage, hugging while the whole crowd cheered.

hindi: साँसें अटकी रहने का वक़्त — निर्णायक घड़ी की बेचैनी
definition: nerve-shredding final stretch of a close contest, everyone waiting anxiously for the uncertain outcome, in British English
example: With two balls left and three runs needed, it was squeaky bum time for everyone crowded round the village radio.

hindi: पाक-साफ़ — बेदाग़ छवि
definition: thoroughly honest and morally spotless, reputation free of scandal, wrongdoing or dishonesty
example: The new mayor's squeaky clean record meant the whole town trusted her with the flood relief fund.

hindi: निचोड़ लेना — आख़िरी पैसा तक वसूलना
definition: British for extracting money from someone relentlessly, taxing or charging them right to breaking point
example: The landlord squeezed tenants until the pips squeaked, so the neighbours banded together and bought the building themselves.

hindi: पीठ में छुरा — भरोसेमंद दोस्त का विश्वासघात
definition: secretly betraying trusted friends, harming someone loyal behind their unsuspecting, undefended back
example: Reading the forwarded messages, he understood that the compliment at dinner had only been decoration on a stab in the back.

hindi: पत्ते पहले से जमा लेना — छिपकर अपने पक्ष में इंतज़ाम
definition: arrange conditions secretly beforehand, unfair advantage bending rules against unsuspecting rivals
example: The quiz master had stacked the deck with questions about his favourite poet, which nobody discovered until round three.

hindi: बेईमानी भरी बाज़ी — पासा पहले से पलटा हुआ
definition: situation arranged unfairly beforehand, giving certain people advantages others cannot possibly overcome
example: Every applicant guessed the interview involved a stacked deck when the manager greeted the third candidate by his childhood nickname.

hindi: आड़ का मोहरा — असली इरादा छिपाने वाला
definition: person or pretext used deceitfully, concealing someone's real intentions until their moment arrives
example: The quiet candidate turned out to be a stalking horse, stepping aside the moment the favourite joined the race.

term: stand on your own two feet
hindi: अपने पैरों पर खड़ा होना — बिना सहारे खुद को संभालना
definition: support yourself independently, without money, help, or guidance from other people
example: After two years of tuition classes and cheap rent, he was finally standing on his own two feet and sending a little money back home.

hindi: खुल कर पक्ष लेना — सबके सामने अपना मत रखना
definition: publicly declare your beliefs or support when doing so takes courage and invites opposition
example: When the council threatened the library, the town's pensioners stood up and were counted, filling every seat in the hall.

hindi: अपनी जगह पर अड़े रहना — दबाव में पीछे न हटना
definition: refuse to retreat from your position despite considerable pressure from people opposing
example: The landlord raised his voice twice, but Priya stood her ground and read the tenancy clause aloud, slowly.

hindi: आँख मूँदकर भी — बड़ी आसानी से
definition: managing something with total ease, even under ridiculous handicaps, because practice made it simple
example: She has baked that birthday cake so many times she could do it standing on her head.

hindi: क़िस्मत के मारे आशिक़ — बिछड़े प्रेमी
definition: couple whose love seems doomed from beginning, thwarted by fate, families or circumstance
example: The two rival bakers' children became the town's star-crossed lovers until their parents merged the shops.

hindi: सिर पर तलवार लटकना — बड़ी मुसीबत सामने होना
definition: face imminent defeat, disaster or serious trouble that seems almost impossible to avoid, usually 'staring down the barrel of'
example: Staring down the barrel of relegation, the club invited schoolchildren to training, and the players rediscovered their joy.

hindi: अपनी हद में रहो — जो आता है वही करो
definition: restrict yourself toward personal affairs and proven skills, without interfering elsewhere
example: The cousin who repairs scooters began advising surgeons at dinner, until somebody gently told him to stay in his lane.

hindi: राह पर अडिग रहना — तय रास्ते से न भटकना
definition: continue with the original plan despite difficult conditions, refusing to quit before finishing
example: Everyone told the bakery to switch to cheaper flour, but the family stayed the course, and the queue outside kept growing.

hindi: चट्टान की तरह अडिग — भरोसेमंद और स्थिर
definition: completely reliable and calm, staying untroubled while difficult pressure keeps building
example: Everybody else fussed about the hospital paperwork, while her brother stayed steady as a rock and simply queued.

hindi: जैसा चल रहा है वैसा ही चलने दो — कोई बदलाव नहीं
definition: keeping present course calmly, changing nothing while everything continues working steadily
example: The shop was finally paying its rent, so his father said steady as she goes, and refused every offer of expansion.

hindi: पतवार थामे हाथ — डगमगाती नाव में स्थिर दिशा
definition: calm dependable guidance keeping everything steady, reliable direction through confusing frightening conditions
example: During the flood the headmaster was a steady hand on the tiller, sorting blankets and children with the same unhurried voice.

hindi: बाज़ी मार लेना — चुपचाप आगे निकल जाना
definition: gain an early advantage over rivals by acting quietly before they realise what is happening
example: She stole a march on the other stallholders by arriving at dawn, and her flowers were sold before they unpacked.

hindi: दिल चुरा लेना — मन मोह लेना
definition: winning someone's deep affection, often unexpectedly, until their heart belongs completely elsewhere
example: The rescue puppy stole everyone's heart, but the new vet stole Meera's.

hindi: छा जाना — दूसरों की चमक अपने नाम कर लेना
definition: attract complete attention, overshadowing performers whom audiences originally arrived hoping would impress them
example: The bride's small nephew stole the show, dancing alone through the entire second song while photographers abandoned everybody else.

hindi: श्रेय झटक लेना — दूसरे की तालियाँ लूट लेना
definition: claim attention or credit somebody else earned, spoiling their planned announcement
example: Her cousin stole her thunder by announcing the engagement first, then apologised with an enormous chocolate cake.

term: steam coming out of your ears
hindi: कानों से धुआँ निकलना — भीतर ही भीतर उबलना
definition: visible fury barely held back, someone so angry they seem ready to burst
example: Waiting three hours at the passport office, Rohan had steam coming out of his ears until a clerk brought him chai.

hindi: बीच का रास्ता निकालना — दोनों पक्षों से बराबर दूरी
definition: moving carefully between opposing sides, refusing either quarrel while keeping friendship with both
example: The eldest brother steered a middle course through the property argument, agreeing with nobody loudly and losing nobody's respect.

hindi: मोर्चा सँभालना — संकट में ख़ाली जगह भरना
definition: bravely take over a difficult role when someone else suddenly cannot, filling the dangerous gap
example: When the lead singer lost her voice, the shy backing vocalist stepped into the breach and brought the whole hall to its feet.

hindi: गाड़ी भगाओ — जल्दी करो
definition: drive faster immediately, pressing harder on the accelerator because time is running short
example: Step on it, the flight boards in forty minutes and we still have to find somewhere to leave the car.

hindi: लक्ष्मण रेखा लाँघना — तय हदों से बाहर निकलना
definition: behave against accepted rules, openly defying those holding authority
example: One cadet stepped out of line to help a fallen classmate, and the instructor pretended not to notice.

hindi: आगे बढ़कर ज़िम्मेदारी लेना — मोर्चा सँभालना
definition: an American baseball phrase meaning accepting difficult responsibility willingly when everybody around hesitates nervously
example: When the caretaker fell ill, three neighbours stepped up to the plate before anybody thought about asking.

hindi: काम तमाम — अब यह ख़त्म है
definition: declaring something completely finished or defeated, beyond saving like thoroughly cooked food, American informal
example: After the third rain delay, Dad looked at the soggy barbecue and said stick a fork in it.

hindi: डटे रहना — मुश्किल के बीच अंत तक टिके रहना
definition: continue with a difficult effort until the finish instead of quitting early
example: The first winter in the mountain village was brutal, but Amina stuck it out, and by spring the neighbours were bringing her bread.

term: stick out like a sore thumb
hindi: भीड़ में अलग दिखना — बेमेल नज़र आना
definition: glaringly obvious and instantly noticeable among surroundings, because nothing else looks similar
example: His bright orange kurta stuck out like a sore thumb among the grey suits, which was exactly why his cousins loved it.

hindi: पीठ में छुरा — जानबूझकर चोट पहुँचाना
definition: criticising someone deliberately and cruelly in British usage, attacking where their feelings hurt most
example: Her ex stuck the knife in by praising the new girlfriend's cooking in front of everyone.

hindi: अपनी बात पर अड़े रहना — दबाव में भी अपना पक्ष न छोड़ना
definition: refuse to abandon your position under pressure, continuing to hold it despite difficulty
