example: He could have twisted the knife about the forgotten tickets, and instead poured chai and mentioned tomorrow's show.

hindi: एक ही मिट्टी के बने — बिल्कुल एक जैसे
definition: people so similar in character, habits and tastes that they seem perfectly matched together
example: Both grandfathers insisted on fixing the gate themselves and refused help; the family agreed they were two of a kind.

hindi: एक ही थैली के चट्टे-बट्टे — हूबहू एक जैसे साथी
definition: close friends remarkably similar, constantly together, sharing identical habits, tastes, stubborn opinions
example: Both order the same chai, both hate crowds, both laugh before the joke lands: two peas in a pod.

hindi: फूटी कौड़ी भी न होना — बिल्कुल ख़ाली जेब
definition: usually negative, having almost no money whatsoever, completely penniless and owning nothing spare
example: They hadn't two pennies to rub together when they married, yet Nani still remembers the wedding as the richest day of her life.

term: two sides of the same coin
hindi: एक ही सिक्के के दो पहलू — अलग दिखते, जुड़े हुए
definition: aspects belonging together inseparably, seeming opposite while sharing exactly the same source
example: His shyness and his careful listening were two sides of the same coin, something his teacher noticed before anyone else.

hindi: दो मुँहा — सामने कुछ, पीठ पीछे कुछ
definition: secretly betraying trusted friends, praising them warmly while harming their reputation privately
example: The compliments about her cooking sounded warm until she overheard the same guest being wonderfully two-faced beside the sink.

hindi: दो नंबर का — ग़ैरक़ानूनी, काला
definition: describing illegal, shady or undeclared dealings, especially money earned outside honest accounts, as said in Indian English
example: Grandfather refused every two-number offer his whole life, and the neighbours still come to him when they need an honest witness.

hindi: दो नावों पर सवार होना — दोहरा इश्क़
definition: cheating on partner by secretly dating another person, running parallel affair behind their back
example: She discovered he was two-timing her when both girlfriends turned up with the same birthday card.

hindi: बिलख-बिलखकर रोना — बेपरवाह, बेहाल रोना
definition: weeping with heavy, messy tears and a crumpled face, well beyond caring who sees
example: The wedding speech reduced the groom's father to a full ugly cry, and nobody at the table thought less of him.

hindi: शुरू में बेढंगा, बाद में निखरने वाला
definition: someone unpromising early, overlooked during beginnings, who later blossoms into remarkable beauty or success
example: The ugly duckling of the litter, all ears and wobbly legs, grew into the gentlest, handsomest dog in the neighbourhood.

hindi: अनजानी राह — जहाँ पहले कोई गया नहीं
definition: unfamiliar situation nobody around here handled before, offering neither maps nor precedent
example: Teaching sixty children over a patchy video call was uncharted waters, so she invented rules nightly and apologised cheerfully every morning.

hindi: शक के घेरे में — बदनामी के साये में
definition: suspected of wrongdoing, your reputation damaged while people doubt your honesty
example: The treasurer left the cricket club under a cloud, though the missing money later turned up in a biscuit tin.

hindi: झूठे बहाने से — झूठ बोलकर काम निकालना
definition: tricking trusting victim into handing over valuables through deliberate false claims
example: He borrowed the wedding jewellery under false pretences, promising photographs that were never taken.

hindi: चौतरफ़ा हमले में — हर तरफ़ से आलोचना
definition: facing sustained criticism from many directions while still trying to continue working calmly
example: Under fire from every neighbour, the committee secretary kept watering the shared garden as though nothing troubled him.

hindi: ताले में बंद — कड़ी निगरानी में
definition: shut securely away under guarded confinement, whether prisoners, evidence, jewellery, dangerous documents
example: Amma kept the wedding gold under lock and key, though everybody knew exactly which cupboard hid that squeaking drawer.

hindi: एक ही छत के नीचे — साथ रहते हुए
definition: living together within the same household, sharing rooms, meals and daily expenses
example: Three generations lived under one roof, which meant arguments about the fan speed but also nobody ever ate dinner alone.

hindi: तैयार खड़े — बस शुरुआत का इंतज़ार
definition: in British English, from horse racing: fully prepared and waiting eagerly for something to begin at any moment
example: By six in the morning the children were under starter's orders by the door, wellies on, waiting for the beach trip.

hindi: इलाज के अंतर्गत — डॉक्टर की निगरानी में
definition: receiving continuing medical treatment for ongoing illness, British phrasing meaning still supervised
example: He explained he was under the doctor about his knee, which excused him from carrying trunks up three floors.

hindi: चीर-फाड़ के नीचे — ऑपरेशन के दौरान
definition: undergoing surgical operation, lying helpless while doctors repair something dangerous inside
example: While his mother was under the knife, he counted floor tiles outside and answered relatives with the same three sentences.

hindi: किसी की नज़र में आए बिना — चुपचाप अपना काम करते रहना
definition: moving quietly without attracting official attention, avoiding notice while continuing whatever interests you
example: Their little terrace library ran under the radar for years, lending paperbacks to half the street without a single sign.

hindi: मेज़ के नीचे से — चोरी-छिपे लेन-देन
definition: arranged secretly through hidden payment, avoiding records, taxes, honest official permission
example: The clerk suggested settling things under the table, and Papa stood, thanked him politely, and joined the longer queue.

hindi: तबीयत नासाज़ होना — हल्की सी बीमारी
definition: feeling slightly unwell with minor temporary sickness, usually needing rest rather than medicine
example: She was under the weather all Sunday, so we moved the picnic and sent soup instead.

hindi: बाल-बाल बचना — समय सीमा से ठीक पहले पहुँच जाना
definition: finished barely before the deadline, arriving during the last permitted moment
example: Her application slid under the wire at the post office counter, the clerk stamping it while already reaching for his coat.

hindi: गुप्त रखा हुआ — समय आने तक सबसे छिपाकर
definition: kept completely secret from outsiders, hidden carefully until some chosen moment permits wider public knowledge
example: The bakery kept the wedding cake under wraps for three days, curtains drawn against the neighbours.

hindi: दबी ज़ुबान से — धीरे से बुदबुदाना
definition: whispering quietly so others cannot hear, muttering words meant privately for yourself
example: She counted to ten under her breath as the toddler poured cereal, carefully and gloriously, all over the floor.

hindi: मुट्ठी में होना — किसी के पूरे दबाव में रहना
definition: forced to obey another person, following their wishes without visible protest
example: The whole cricket team was under the captain's thumb until a quiet spinner finally suggested a different field.

hindi: मौक़ा पहचान लेना — बिना बताए ठीक वैसा ही कर देना
definition: deliver exactly whatever the occasion demanded, judging clothing, timing, effort perfectly without instruction
example: Everybody else wore black, while Priya arrived embroidered head to toe and clearly understood the assignment.

hindi: बेवक़्त — अजीब सा असुविधाजनक समय
definition: inconvenient hours, unreasonably early morning timing which nobody willingly chooses
example: The flight left at some ungodly hour, so her brother drove through empty streets with flasks of tea beside him.

hindi: अनजाना पहलू — जिसके बारे में कुछ पता नहीं
definition: person or thing whose abilities, nature or likely behaviour nobody knows anything about yet
example: The new goalkeeper was an unknown quantity until the final minute, when he dived full length and saved the penalty.

hindi: क़यामत के दिन तक — अनंत काल तक
definition: endlessly, lasting forever, waiting through time that never seems finished
example: The two old friends could argue about cricket until kingdom come, and nobody at the café would ever want them to stop.

hindi: कड़वा सच — बिना मुलम्मे की सच्चाई
definition: plain truth presented without polish, decoration or flattering spin to soften anything
example: She asked her mentor for the unvarnished truth about her novel, then rewrote it gladly over one long winter.

hindi: अधर में लटकना — फँसी हुई हालत
definition: stuck inside an awkward predicament with no obvious escape, a British and Australian phrase
example: With the ferry cancelled and every hotel full, we were up a gum tree until the harbourmaster offered his spare room.

hindi: कठिन दौर में — भारी दबाव से जूझना
definition: facing difficult pressure with slender resources, position straining under overwhelming demands
example: With rain flooding the courtyard and guests arriving, her mother was truly up against it, yet somehow served everybody lunch.

hindi: उठो और लग जाओ — नया दिन शुरू
definition: cheerful call urging someone to get started quickly, especially rising energetically from bed; American
example: Up and at 'em, sleepyheads, the lake is perfectly still and the fish are biting.

hindi: बिफरे हुए — नाराज़गी में एकजुट
definition: loudly furious about some decision, protesting together with shared indignant anger
example: The whole colony was up in arms over the felled neem tree, and by evening they had planted three saplings.

hindi: अधर में लटका होना — कोई बात तय नहीं हुई
definition: still completely undecided and unsettled, waiting without any firm decision being reached
example: The picnic date stayed up in the air until Meera printed a calendar and made everyone circle a Sunday.

hindi: बोरिया-बिस्तर बाँधना — अचानक घर बदल लेना
definition: move your household suddenly elsewhere, abandoning settled arrangements without preparation (British usage)
example: One rainy Tuesday they upped sticks for the coast, leaving behind curtains, a garden gnome and a very confused milkman.

hindi: दाँव बढ़ाना — शर्त और जोखिम ऊँचा कर देना
definition: increase whatever everyone must risk, forcing rivals toward larger commitment or quiet retreat
example: When the neighbours offered free tuition alongside the flat, the other landlord upped the ante with a scooter parking spot.

hindi: बीच मँझधार में फँसना — बिना किसी सहारे संकट में
definition: stranded within serious trouble without rescue, where damaging consequences already appear unavoidable and worsening
example: The ferry left without them and the last bus had gone, leaving both cousins properly up the creek by nightfall.

hindi: चौपट — पूरी तरह बिगड़ा हुआ
definition: in British usage, ruined or wasted beyond repair, plans spoiled and hopes completely lost
example: The oven died on Christmas morning and dinner looked up the spout, until the neighbours offered theirs.

hindi: बराबरी का — अपेक्षित स्तर का
definition: good enough, matching the required standard people reasonably expect from work, British usage
example: The bakery's sourdough is finally up to scratch, and the queue now curls round the corner every Saturday.

hindi: गले तक डूबा — काम से लदा
definition: deeply buried and extremely busy, facing more demands than time allows
example: He was up to his ears in exam marking, but he still found an hour to help his niece with her fractions.

term: up to your eyeballs in debt
hindi: कर्ज़ में डूबा होना — गले तक कर्ज़ में
definition: owing enormous debt, borrowed well beyond any realistic hope of orderly repayment
example: They were up to their eyeballs in debt, yet the shop stayed open because neighbours kept turning up.

hindi: गले तक डूबना — बुरी तरह फँसना
definition: deeply involved in trouble, debt or work, with barely space left to breathe
example: Up to her neck in wedding planning, my sister still found time to bake her flatmate a birthday cake.

hindi: चढ़ाई की लड़ाई — हर कदम पर विरोध झेलती कोशिश
definition: prolonged struggle against constant resistance, demanding heavy effort while progress remains slow, difficult, uncertain
example: Getting the neighbourhood library reopened was an uphill battle, three years of petitions before anybody unlocked the door.

hindi: पलड़ा भारी होना — बढ़त हासिल कर लेना
definition: holding decisive control over rivals, deciding matters while others merely follow
example: By the fourth over the bowler clearly had the upper hand, and the batsmen stopped attempting anything clever.

hindi: उड़ती अफ़वाह — झूठी पर मशहूर कहानी
definition: widely circulated modern story believed because friends repeat it, though completely untrue when checked
example: The rumour about alligators in the sewers turned out to be an urban myth, which disappointed the boys more than it relieved them.

hindi: भड़ास निकालना — दबा गुस्सा उड़ेलना
definition: release pent-up anger by ranting bitterly and at length about whatever person or thing upset you
example: After the match he vented his spleen to his brother over the phone, and felt light enough to sleep.

hindi: बेलगाम बकबक — बिना रुके बोलते जाने की आदत
definition: talking extremely rapidly without pausing, words pouring out uncontrollably, often nervously, British slang
example: Before his first date he warned his sister he got verbal diarrhoea when nervous, and she told him to ask questions instead.

hindi: जीत का जश्न — जीत के बाद इतराना
definition: public celebration after success, openly enjoying praise, sometimes lingering rather longer than needed
example: After finally fixing the leaking tap, Dad took a victory lap round the kitchen, showing everyone the dry sink.

hindi: अब अपनी बारी — दूसरों को खुश करना छोड़कर खुद को चुनने का दौर
definition: deliberate phase choosing yourself first, refusing constant people-pleasing that earlier exhausted everybody
example: After years of covering everyone's shifts she declared her villain era and left work at six, guiltless, phone silenced.

hindi: जंगल में पुकार — अनसुनी चेतावनी
definition: sensible warning that listeners entirely ignore, leaving honest speaker feeling unheard
example: For years she was a voice in the wilderness about the cracked staircase, until it finally proved her right.

hindi: वोट बैंक — पक्का वोटर समूह
definition: used for community voters treated like secure deposits, courted by politicians offering favours, as said in Indian English
example: The candidate kept visiting the grandmothers' temple group, knowing that particular vote bank never missed an election.

hindi: कीचड़ में चलना — हर क़दम भारी और धीमा
definition: progressing slowly and exhaustingly, every step feeling heavy, sticky and frustrating, like walking through thick syrup, mainly British English
example: Moving house with three toddlers felt like wading through treacle, but by Sunday the kettle was on in the new kitchen.

hindi: परदे के पीछे तैयार खड़े रहना — बुलावे के क्षण की प्रतीक्षा करना
definition: stay ready and unseen, waiting patiently until the moment arrives to step forward and take action
example: Her younger brother waited in the wings all evening, holding the guitar nobody had asked him to bring.

hindi: अंतहीन इंतज़ार — जिसका आना कभी तय नहीं
definition: waiting endlessly for something promised that never arrives, pointless hoping while nothing ever happens, from the famous Samuel Beckett play
example: Waiting for the landlord's plumber felt like waiting for Godot, so the neighbours taught each other to change washers.

hindi: चेतावनी की घंटी — आँखें खोलने वाली घटना
definition: startling event that makes somebody suddenly realise a problem needs serious attention
example: Getting breathless on the stairs at his daughter's wedding was a wake-up call, and he started morning walks the next day.

term: walk a mile in someone's shoes
hindi: दूसरे की जगह खुद को रखना — उसकी तकलीफ़ समझना
definition: truly understand another person's feelings by imagining their life, hardships and circumstances yourself
example: Before judging the grumpy bus driver, walk a mile in his shoes: twelve hours of traffic and shouting passengers.

hindi: रौंद डालना — आसानी से हावी हो जाना
definition: defeat someone thoroughly and easily, dominating them completely while they offer almost nothing back
example: The under-tens walked all over the dads' team, scoring seven goals while their fathers wheezed on the touchline.

hindi: मेज़ छोड़ देना — बातचीत बीच में ही खत्म
definition: abandoning further discussion, argument, bargaining deliberately rather than continuing pointless engagement
example: After the third rewritten promise he walked away from the table, thanked everybody sincerely, and drove home relieved.

hindi: मंडप तक जाना — विवाह करना
definition: marry your partner during a formal ceremony, publicly promising lifelong commitment
example: Her father practised the slow walk down the aisle every morning for a week.

hindi: चुटकियों का काम — बिना मेहनत हो जाने वाला
definition: activity handled easily, pleasantly, without effort, strain, trouble, remaining simple, gentle, undemanding
example: He had trained on steep hills all summer, so the flat coastal race felt like a walk in the park.

hindi: चुटकियों में जीतना — बाएँ हाथ का खेल
definition: winning easily and comfortably, needing hardly any effort because rivals never threatened; British
example: He was so nervous about the spelling bee, but once the words started coming he walked it and grinned all the way home.

hindi: फूँक-फूँक कर कदम रखना — किसी के गुस्से के डर से सँभलकर रहना
definition: behave with anxious caution around someone, avoiding words that might trigger angry confrontation
example: The whole house walked on eggshells the week before results, speaking only about weather and vegetables.

hindi: आग पर चलना — किसी के लिए हर मुसीबत झेलना
definition: enduring any danger, hardship or suffering willingly, usually for someone deeply loved
example: My mother would walk through fire for her students, and every year one of them comes back to tell her so.

hindi: किसी के लिए आग में कूद जाना — कुछ भी कर गुज़रना
definition: remain so loyal to someone that you would face whatever danger or suffering to support them
example: Everyone on that team would walk through fire for their old coach, who had driven each of them home after late practices.

hindi: रस्सी पर चलना — ज़रा चूके तो गिरना
definition: managing risky delicate balance where smallest careless mistake would bring immediate disaster
example: Between his mother's opinions and his wife's patience he was walking a tightrope, and holding it rather gracefully.

hindi: पैर ज़मीन पर न पड़ना — ख़ुशी में उड़ते रहना
definition: delighted beyond measure, moving through ordinary chores lightly because happiness carries you
example: He swept the courtyard singing, walking on air since the phone call about the scholarship.

hindi: ख़ामोशी की दीवार — सबका मिलकर चुप रहना
definition: collective refusal among people to reveal information, everyone staying silent to protect someone
example: The teacher met a wall of silence when she asked who had drawn the moustache on the class photograph.

hindi: थका-थका कर हराना — लंबी खींचतान
definition: long struggle where each side wears the other down slowly until someone finally collapses
example: Bedtime with the twins became a war of attrition, one more story at a time, until everyone fell asleep but Dad.

hindi: ज़ुबानी जंग — तीखी बहसबाज़ी
definition: bitter public quarrel fought through angry statements, insults, and heated replies rather than violence
example: The war of words between the two village councils ended when both agreed to rebuild the bridge together.

hindi: दिल गदगद होना — भीतर तक गर्माहट
definition: soothing comfortable feeling of warmth, sentimental cosy contentment spreading gently through your chest
example: The old photographs left everybody warm and fuzzy, until somebody produced the one with the terrible haircuts.

hindi: हाथ धो लेना — ज़िम्मेदारी छोड़ देना
definition: abandoning further responsibility completely, declaring somebody's troubles no longer your involvement
example: After the second postponement, Uncle washed his hands of the whole renovation and took up gardening instead.

hindi: पाई-पाई का हिसाब रखना — सोच-समझकर खर्च करना
definition: spend money carefully, checking every small amount before parting with anything from your purse
example: Dad watched the pennies at the market, then bought us all ice cream without blinking.

hindi: पानी पर से बूँद — असर ही नहीं होता
definition: criticism that leaves personal calm untouched, ignored instead of causing lasting distress
example: The comments about his cooking were water off a duck's back, and Vikram served second helpings to everybody anyway.

hindi: बीती बात — जो हो गया सो हो गया
definition: a past grievance nobody feels resentment about anymore, forgotten completely and no longer worth arguing
example: The argument about the wedding seating chart is water under the bridge now that the grandchildren have arrived.

hindi: सफ़ेद झंडा दिखाना — खुलेआम हथियार डालकर हार मान लेना
definition: to abandon resistance openly and signal defeat, inviting the other side to stop attacking
example: Two hours into the argument about the thermostat, Amma waved the white flag and fetched a blanket.

hindi: तारीफ़ों के पुल बाँधना — जोश में बढ़-चढ़कर सराहना
definition: talking enthusiastically and at great length, praising something with flowery, gushing admiration
example: Grandpa waxed lyrical about the mangoes of his childhood village until everyone at the table was hungry.

hindi: घर की बागडोर संभालना — घर में असली अधिकार रखना
definition: hold decisive authority within a household, controlling important family decisions alone
example: He joked about wearing the trousers, then checked with his wife before agreeing to sell the farmhouse.

term: wear your heart on your sleeve
hindi: दिल का हाल चेहरे पर — भावनाएँ छिपा न पाना
definition: showing private feelings openly, letting everyone notice affection, sadness, disappointment
example: Ravi wore his heart on his sleeve at the airport, weeping happily while everyone else pretended composure.

hindi: तूफ़ान झेल जाना — मुश्किल दौर में डटे रहकर उसे पार कर लेना
definition: survive a stretch of severe difficulty by continuing steadily until the pressure passes
example: The bakery lost half its customers that winter, and they weathered the storm on soup and stubbornness.

hindi: मन पर बोझ होना — किसी बात की लगातार चिंता
definition: troubling you constantly, an anxious worry pressing heavily on your thoughts for days
example: The argument with her brother weighed on her mind all week, until she finally rang him and they both apologised.

hindi: सिर से बोझ उतरना — बड़ी ज़िम्मेदारी हटने की राहत
definition: relief felt when heavy blame or obligation lifts, released from burden, finally free
example: Handing over the last instalment on the loan was a weight off her shoulders, and she walked home the long way for once.

hindi: बाँहें फैलाकर स्वागत — पूरे मन से अपनाना
definition: greet arriving somebody with generous warmth, showing complete gladness that they belong comfortably here
example: The village welcomed the returning nurse with open arms, and three households fought politely over who would feed her first.

hindi: निहाल होना — दिल से ख़ुश
definition: delighted in northern British usage, genuinely pleased about welcome news somebody delivers
example: He rang round every cousin, well made up about the apprenticeship, before telling anybody the wages.

hindi: चढ़ा हुआ — पीकर खुलकर बातें करने वाला
definition: pleasantly drunk in Irish and British usage, loosened and talkative after steady drinking
example: By the second round of songs the quietest guest was well oiled and telling stories nobody had heard in twenty years.

hindi: तेल पिलाई मशीन — बिना रुकावट चलता इंतज़ाम
definition: group working smoothly and efficiently, every person handling their portion without friction
example: By the third morning the kitchen ran like a well-oiled machine, aunts chopping while cousins carried plates outside.

hindi: दूध के दाँत न टूटना — नासमझ और अनुभवहीन
definition: young and inexperienced, still knowing very little about how the world actually works, like a newborn animal
example: Wet behind the ears on his first fishing trip, he cast straight into a tree, and his grandfather laughed until he cried.

hindi: रंग में भंग डालने वाला — महफ़िल का मज़ा किरकिरा करने वाला
definition: gloomy companion dampening everybody's enthusiasm, spoiling cheerful gatherings with constant discouraging remarks
example: Being called a wet blanket stung, so he learned two card games before the next family holiday.

hindi: बेहद मज़ेदार समय — यादगार मौज
definition: hugely enjoyable, memorable experience, usually 'have a whale of a time'; wonderful, unforgettable enjoyment
example: The kids had a whale of a time at the beach, burying their uncle up to his neck in sand.

hindi: किसी की फ़ितरत — भीतर की प्रेरणा
definition: the hidden motives and character that explain why a particular person behaves as they do
example: Twenty years married, and she still loved puzzling over what makes her quiet husband tick.

hindi: क्या सीन है — क्या प्लान है, क्या हाल है
definition: casual question asking what plans are happening, or what situation currently stands, as said in Indian English
example: What's the scene for Saturday, asked Meera, and within an hour the whole gang had planned a picnic by the river.

hindi: गाड़ी बिखर जाना — सब कुछ अचानक ढह जाना
definition: carefully arranged plans collapsing suddenly, losing control while trouble spreads through everything remaining
example: The wheels came off their little bakery when both ovens failed together, though regulars queued anyway for yesterday's bread.

hindi: जब सूरज पश्चिम से निकले — कभी नहीं
definition: never, because the thing described seems utterly impossible, voicing complete doubt that it happens
example: My brother says he'll apologise to his old rival when hell freezes over, though they were laughing together by Sunday.

hindi: जब सूरज पश्चिम से उगेगा — कभी नहीं होने वाला
definition: impossible, never happening however long anybody keeps waiting hopefully
example: He said he would learn cooking when pigs fly, and last month sent photographs of surprisingly respectable parathas.

hindi: मुसीबत की घड़ी में — असली परीक्षा के वक़्त
definition: during difficult moments when serious trouble arrives and somebody's character becomes clearly visible
example: When the chips were down after the shop fire, the quietest tenant appeared with buckets before anybody thought to call.

hindi: गड़े मुर्दों का जानकार — परिवार या संस्था के पुराने काले राज़ जानने वाला
definition: hidden shameful secrets of a family or organisation, known only to trusted insiders who could expose past wrongdoing
example: Nobody dared retire old Mrs. Dutta from the society committee; after forty years she knew where the bodies were buried.

hindi: बागडोर हाथ में — निर्णायक बढ़त
definition: controlling advantage over rivals, allowing you to dictate what happens next and decide terms
example: Once she had the only key to the attic, the youngest sister held the whip hand over which toys came downstairs.

hindi: तूफ़ानी इश्क़ — झटपट मोहब्बत
definition: love affair developing astonishingly fast, meeting and marrying within weeks or months
example: Their whirlwind romance went from a delayed train to a registry office in six weeks.

hindi: कानाफूसी का जाल — भरोसेमंद लोगों में चुपचाप बँटती ख़बर
definition: informal circle sharing rumours and warnings privately, gossip passed quietly between trusted people
example: The whisper network among the new mums meant everyone knew which café welcomed prams and which merely tolerated them.

hindi: कानाफूसी मुहिम — छिपकर बदनाम करने की कोशिश
definition: organised spreading of damaging rumours quietly, undermining someone's reputation without open accusation
example: A whispering campaign nearly cost the headmaster his post, until the parents gathered and spoke up for him.

hindi: डर छिपा कर बेफ़िक्री का दिखावा करना
definition: pretend cheerful confidence to hide fear, ignoring obvious danger while hoping everything turns fine, American
example: The shopkeepers kept whistling past the graveyard as the new mall rose, until they joined forces and started a weekend market.

hindi: ताबड़तोड़ दौरा — जल्दी-जल्दी घूमना
definition: hurried journey visiting many places briefly, pausing only moments before moving onward
example: We gave our cousins a whistle-stop tour of the city, eating chaat in three neighbourhoods before sunset.

hindi: चेहरा सफ़ेद पड़ जाना — डर से रंग उड़ जाना
definition: drained pallid appearance following sudden fright, leaving somebody looking bloodless from unexpected shock
example: She came inside white as a sheet after the ladder slipped, and her father made her sit until colour returned.

hindi: सफ़ेद हाथी — जिसका खर्च फ़ायदे से ज़्यादा
definition: expensive useless possession costing more upkeep than benefit, embarrassing whoever owns something unwanted
example: The gifted piano became a white elephant until the youngest daughter decided, aged nine, that she would learn.

hindi: सफ़ेद झूठ — किसी का दिल रखने को बोला गया छोटा-सा झूठ
definition: harmless untruth told mainly to spare someone awkward feelings about something
example: He told a white lie about loving the sweater his aunt knitted.

hindi: जान हथेली पर — डर से मुट्ठी भींच लेना
definition: terrifying tense experience gripping somebody with fright throughout, although ending safely afterwards
example: The night bus down the ghat road was a white-knuckle ride, and everyone applauded the driver at dawn.

hindi: दूध का धुला — बेदाग़
definition: in British usage, morally spotless, thoroughly honest, never suspected of wrongdoing or dishonesty
example: The church treasurer was whiter than white, yet she still asked two volunteers to double-check her accounts every month.

hindi: बिल्कुल नया खेल — पूरी तरह बदली हुई स्थिति
definition: completely different situation requiring fresh rules, skills or thinking than anything before
example: Cooking for two had been easy, but feeding the twins' entire football team was a whole new ball game.

hindi: पूरा का पूरा — कुछ भी छोड़े बिना
definition: the entire extent of something, every trimming included rather than some partial version
example: For the wedding they wanted the whole nine yards, right down to marigold ropes across the terrace.

hindi: धूम मचाना — ज़ोर-शोर से जश्न
definition: celebrate noisily and exuberantly, partying with shouting, music and laughter through the night
example: The cricket club whooped it up in the pavilion after winning the league for the first time in thirty years.

hindi: अनिश्चित पत्ता — अनपेक्षित तत्व
definition: unpredictable person or factor whose influence could change the outcome in unexpected ways
example: Aunt Rosa was the wild card at every wedding, likely to start a conga line or burst into opera.

hindi: आकाश-कुसुम तोड़ना — असंभव के पीछे व्यर्थ भागना
definition: pointless effort pursuing something impossible to catch, wasting hours finding nothing
example: Four shops and one bus ride later, the hunt for cardamom ice cream turned into a wild goose chase.

hindi: आसानी से बाज़ी मारना — बिना ज़ोर लगाए जीतना
definition: gaining victory comfortably, never needing full effort or speed, British racing phrase
example: The school quiz team won at a canter, finishing so far ahead that they started helping tidy up.

hindi: बाल-बाल जीतना — ज़रा से अंतर से बाज़ी मारना
definition: triumphing narrowly, finishing fractionally in front after an extremely close contest that might have gone either direction
example: Their sandcastle won by a whisker, the judges agreeing the seashell windows just edged it over the family next door.

hindi: जन-जन का दिल जीतना — भावना और तर्क दोनों से समर्थन पाना
definition: earn genuine popular loyalty by appealing to people's feelings and reasoning together, instead of relying on force
example: The new librarian won hearts and minds by learning every child's name before she changed a single rule.

hindi: मस्ती से जीतना — हल्की चाल में ही आगे निकल जाना
definition: winning easily and comfortably, cruising ahead without ever needing full effort, like horses cantering; British
example: Her sponge cake won in a canter at the village show, and the judges asked for the recipe before the ribbons went out.

hindi: आसानी से जीतना — बिना मुकाबले की जीत
definition: cruising to first place because rivals offered hardly any serious competition, said in American usage
example: Nobody else entered the chilli contest with real heat, so Aunt Rosa won in a walk.

hindi: दिल जीत लेना — किसी का प्यार पाना
definition: gaining someone's deep affection gradually through patience, kindness and steady devotion to their heart
example: He won her heart by fixing her bicycle every Sunday without ever once being asked.

hindi: अपनी योग्यता सिद्ध करना — पहली बड़ी कामयाबी पाना
definition: prove your ability publicly for the first time, gaining respect through achievement
example: The young nurse won her spurs during the flood, calmly organising the evacuation while senior staff were stranded.

hindi: चिढ़ाना — जान-बूझकर छेड़कर परेशान करना
definition: tease somebody deliberately until they become annoyed, British usage, joking because their reaction seems entertaining
example: His cousins wound him up about supporting the losing team, and he defended them loudly through the entire journey.

hindi: अपनी हद में रहना — ज़्यादा बोलना बंद करना
definition: command telling someone to stop talking, interfering or behaving so arrogantly, informal British
example: When the new neighbour started lecturing everyone about their bins, old Maureen told him kindly to wind his neck in.

hindi: ऊपरी लीपापोती — सिर्फ़ दिखावे का सुधार
definition: attractive surface changes covering the absence of real substance beneath, arranged purely for appearances
example: They painted the school gate before the inspection, pure window dressing, while the roof still leaked over the library.

hindi: बदलाव की बयार — आने वाले परिवर्तन के संकेत
definition: powerful forces bringing sweeping transformation, signs that major changes are steadily approaching
example: The winds of change blew through the sleepy seaside town when the old pier reopened as an arts market.

hindi: खिला-पिलाकर रिझाना — शाही ख़ातिरदारी
definition: court someone lavishly, treating them to fine restaurants, good drink and expensive evenings meant to impress
example: He saved for months so he could wine and dine her properly on their first anniversary.

hindi: बिना तैयारी काम चला लेना — मौके पर सूझ से
definition: proceed without preparation confidently, improvising every answer while pretending careful readiness
example: He had read only three pages, so he winged it through the viva and somehow charmed the examiner.

hindi: जीत का सिलसिला — लगातार कामयाबी का दौर
definition: unbroken sequence of successes arriving together, making everything suddenly feel almost effortless
example: Their winning streak ended against the mechanics' team, and the boys still walked home sharing sugarcane juice like champions.

hindi: धूल में मिला देना — पूरी तरह हरा देना
definition: defeat rivals utterly in a contest, leaving them without answer or excuse
example: The junior team wiped the floor with last year's champions and nobody stopped cheering.

hindi: पुराना हिसाब मिटा देना — बीती बातें भुलाकर नई शुरुआत करना
definition: forget every past grievance completely and begin the relationship again without resentment or scorekeeping
example: On his first day back, the coach wiped the slate clean and handed him the captain's armband.

hindi: आधी रात का पहर — बेचैन अजीब घड़ी
definition: eerie midnight hours, restless period when children wake before morning, everybody feels strange
example: During the witching hour the youngest padded downstairs claiming shadows, and his mother sat reading beside him until dawn.

hindi: भारी मन से — दुख के साथ
definition: acting while feeling deep sadness, continuing reluctantly despite genuine private sorrow
example: With a heavy heart she locked the shutters her father had painted, keeping only the brass handle.

hindi: सांस रोके — बड़ी उत्सुकता से
definition: waiting anxiously and eagerly, almost holding breath, hardly daring to move until news arrives
example: The children waited with bated breath as Grandpa lifted the cloth from the cake he had baked all by himself.

hindi: ऐसे दोस्तों से तो दुश्मन भले — दोस्त ही धोखा दें
definition: wry remark when supposed friends treat you worse than enemies would, shortened from a longer saying
example: His mates filmed him falling off the paddleboard and posted it before he surfaced; with friends like these, he laughed, dripping.

hindi: आँखें मूँदे हुए — पूरे आत्मविश्वास से
definition: managing something easily, confidently, without thinking, effort, hesitation, thanks toward thorough familiar practice
example: He walked the dark corridor toward the boiler room with his eyes closed, counting doors from memory.

hindi: बेल पर ही सूख जाना — बिना इस्तेमाल खत्म होना
definition: fade slowly through neglect, dying unused while nobody offers necessary support
example: The music room plan withered on the vine until one retired teacher quietly carried her harmonium there.

hindi: बिना किसी अड़चन के — निर्विघ्न
definition: completed smoothly from start until finish, without trouble, delay, problems, interruption, anything failing
example: Three hundred guests, monsoon clouds overhead, and the wedding still went off without a hitch.

hindi: बिना पतवार की नाव — दिशाहीन
definition: operating without leadership, direction, nobody steering while everything simply drifts along
example: The neighbourhood committee ran without a rudder for two monsoons, so the tank repairs waited while everybody blamed somebody else.

hindi: बिना पसीना बहाए — आराम से
definition: achieving something hard with apparent ease, showing almost zero strain, effort or worry
example: The seventy-year-old climbed all four flights without breaking a sweat and then offered to carry our bags.

hindi: भेड़ की खाल में भेड़िया — साधु वेश में ठग
definition: dangerous person appearing harmless, hiding hostile intentions behind gentle friendly outward behaviour
example: The polite man selling insurance door to door was a wolf in sheep's clothing, and half the lane learned that slowly.

hindi: दूर पहाड़ी देहात — शहर से कोसों दूर
definition: somewhere extremely remote in New Zealand usage, distant countryside holding almost nothing commercial
example: Their bach stands out in the wop-wops, so visitors bring bread, batteries, and every conversation they have saved.

hindi: ज़ुबानी — लोगों के कहने-सुनने से
definition: information spreading informally from person to person through conversation, rather than print or advertising
example: The tailor never advertised; every customer found him by word of mouth from a satisfied friend.

hindi: सुनी-सुनाई बात — लोगों में फैली ख़बर
definition: rumour or gossip circulating informally, news people whisper before anything official appears
example: Word on the street is that the old cinema will reopen, and half the town has already chosen their first film.

hindi: बेतुके शब्दों की खिचड़ी
definition: jumbled speech that sounds impressive but makes no sense, words thrown together meaninglessly
example: Half asleep, he answered his wife's question with a word salad about penguins and tax forms, and they both laughed.

hindi: समझदार को इशारा काफ़ी — छोटी सी सलाह
definition: brief discreet warning or advice, offered tactfully and trusting the listener understands
example: A word to the wise, whispered the old waiter, the fish is lovely today but the chef is heartbroken about the soup.

hindi: जादू की तरह असर करना — पूरी तरह कामयाब
definition: succeed perfectly and quickly, producing exactly the desired result without trouble
example: Her grandmother's honey and ginger remedy worked like a charm on the children's coughs.

hindi: गधे की तरह खटना — बिना आराम लगातार मेहनत
definition: labouring exhaustingly through long hours, finishing heavy tasks without proper rest
example: He worked like a dog through the festival season, and his wife hid one afternoon from him by unplugging the doorbell.

hindi: बैल की तरह खटना — अथक मेहनत करना
definition: labour tirelessly through punishing hours, showing stamina other people quietly admire
example: The young cook worked like a Trojan through the feast, and the elders noticed, sending sweets to his mother afterwards.

term: work your fingers to the bone
hindi: हाड़ तोड़ मेहनत करना — थककर चूर हो जाने तक काम करना
definition: labouring through long punishing hours until exhausting effort leaves your body aching
example: Grandmother worked her fingers to the bone stitching quilts so the four of us could finish school.

hindi: जी-तोड़ मेहनत करना — दिन-रात खटना
definition: British: work extremely hard, sparing no energy, usually chasing something that really matters
example: He worked his socks off all summer at the garden centre so he could buy his sister the bicycle she had been dreaming about.

hindi: ख़ुद को खपा देना — काम में घिस जाना
definition: exhaust yourself completely through relentless labour until your health begins suffering
example: After years of working himself into the ground, he finally took his daughter fishing on a Tuesday and forgot to check his phone.

hindi: मुसीबतों का पहाड़ — बहुत भारी तकलीफ़
definition: serious trouble or great suffering heading toward someone soon, an American phrase
example: Dad warned that forgetting Mum's birthday again would land us in a world of hurt, so we started planning in March.

hindi: पेट से बात निकलवाना — धीरे-धीरे राज़ उगलवाना
definition: extract secret information gradually, coaxing patiently until someone reluctantly reveals it
example: It took three walks and a lot of ice cream, but Mum finally wormed it out of him that he had a crush.

hindi: थककर बेहाल — निचुड़ा हुआ
definition: completely exhausted and frayed, tired beyond patience after prolonged strain
example: By the end of the school trip the teacher was worn to a frazzle, but she still sang every song on the coach home.

hindi: चिंता से बेहाल — फ़िक्र में घुलना
definition: extremely anxious, worrying constantly about someone's safety until you feel physically unwell
example: Mum was worried sick when my train was cancelled, so the first thing I did at the station was call her.

hindi: टूटा-फूटा हाल — थका और घिसा हुआ
definition: tired and battered after strain, exhausted, with energy and freshness noticeably reduced
example: The team returned from the trek somewhat worse for wear, boots muddy and spirits high.

hindi: जगज़ाहिर राज़ — ऐसा भेद जो सब जानते हों
definition: supposed secret that practically everybody already knows, despite people pretending otherwise
example: Their engagement was the worst-kept secret in the village, and everyone rehearsed looking surprised.

hindi: नमक-हलाल — अपने काम में खरा उतरने वाला
definition: deserving respect through proven practical experience, handling difficult work exactly as promised
example: A tailor worth your salt will measure twice before touching the wedding sherwani.

hindi: बात दिमाग़ में बैठाना — उलझी चीज़ समझ पाना
definition: understand something complicated after considerable mental effort, finally grasping confusing information
example: It took two cups of coffee before she could wrap her head around the electricity bill, which included somebody else's flat.

hindi: उँगलियों पर नचाना — किसी को अपनी मर्ज़ी से चलाना
definition: charmed into helpless obedience, ready to obey another person, granting their wishes without protest
example: Their granddaughter had the entire household wrapped around her finger before she could even walk properly.

hindi: रूई में लपेटकर रखना — दुख से बचाकर पालना
definition: sheltered from hardship and difficulty, protected until ordinary trouble becomes overwhelming
example: His parents never let him cycle past the gate, and at twenty he still felt wrapped in cotton wool whenever a train timetable confused him.

hindi: साफ़ चेतावनी — अंजाम पहले दिख जाना
definition: unmistakable warning signals showing trouble approaching, understood before other people accept them
example: The shutters stayed closed until noon three days running, and regular customers quietly read the writing on the wall.

hindi: ग़रीब बस्ती — समाज का उपेक्षित हिस्सा
definition: poorer neighbourhood of town, associated with poverty and struggle, looked down upon by wealthier residents
example: Raised on the wrong side of the tracks, Marcus now runs the youth club there and wouldn't live anywhere else.

hindi: निचोड़े कपड़े जैसा — पूरी ताक़त निकल चुकी
definition: completely exhausted, every trace of energy squeezed away after weeks without proper rest
example: He arrived wrung out from three weeks of night shifts, and his brother simply cooked without asking questions.

hindi: डरपोकपन की लकीर — स्वभाव में छिपी कायरता
definition: hidden vein of cowardice in someone's character that shows itself when courage is tested
example: Uncle Vikram joked that he had a yellow streak a mile wide, then quietly sat up all night with the frightened puppy.

hindi: बीती बात — जिसकी चर्चा ख़त्म हो गई
definition: outdated, forgotten quickly because everybody stopped discussing this months earlier
example: The scandal that shook their lane became yesterday's news the moment a film crew started shooting near the temple.

hindi: बात हम दोनों तक — किसी तीसरे तक नहीं
definition: strictly confidential between speakers only, British phrase promising secret travels nowhere further
example: Between you, me and the gatepost, the caterer never arrived and they ordered chips instead.

term: your guess is as good as mine
hindi: मुझे भी उतना ही पता है जितना तुम्हें — कोई अंदाज़ा नहीं
definition: honestly admitting that you know nothing more about the answer than the person asking, both equally uncertain
example: When the kids asked when the delayed train would finally arrive, their mother shrugged and said your guess is as good as mine, then shared out the sandwiches.

hindi: दिमाग़ सुन्न हो जाना — कुछ भी याद न आना
definition: suddenly unable to remember or think of anything, usually under pressure or nervous excitement
example: His mind went blank halfway through the wedding speech, so he looked at his brother and simply said he loved him.

hindi: शून्य से शिखर — गुमनाम से नायक
definition: sudden transformation from overlooked failure into admired champion, success after unpromising beginnings
example: The goalkeeper went from zero to hero in one evening, saving three penalties after fumbling the opening goal.

hindi: पल भर में शून्य से शिखर — अचानक तेज़ी
definition: sudden acceleration from complete calm into full intensity within seconds rather than gradually; American, from car speed figures
example: The toddler goes from zero to sixty the moment he hears the ice-cream van, abandoning his nap entirely.

hindi: ज़ुबान पर ताला — कुछ न कहना
definition: sealing your mouth shut, keeping news secret and telling nobody what actually happened
example: The twins zipped their lips about the broken vase, though their guilty faces gave everything away.
